tei:titleStmt.tei:title: pod 33 gsung 'bum/_tA ra nA tha/ （dpe bsdur ma/）

tei:div.tei:p: spyi khyab bsdu sgrig 'gan 'khur ba gtso bo/ gzan dkar thub bstan nyi ma/bsdu sgrig 'gan 'khur gzhon pa dang / gtso sgrig pa/ karma bde legs/gtso sgrig gzhon pa/ 'gro 'dul rdo rje/bsdu sgrig pa/ mun sel/ thub bstan nyi ma/ bstan 'dzin blo gros/zla ba bstan 'dzin/ shes rab bzang po zhu dag dang dkar chag sgrig mkhan/ dpal ldan rgya mtsho/ phur pa phrin las/dkon mchog bsam gtan/ thub bstan nyi ma/ bstan pa dar rgyas/par sgrig lag rtsal pa/ tshe ring chos sgron/ shes rab dpal g.yang /bsod nams 'khrug rgyas/

〈mes po'i shul bzhag〉 ces pa'i dpe tshogs 'di ni dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang gis bsgrigs shing 'di ga dpe skrun khang dang mnyam 'brel gyis bskrun pa'i dpe rnying dpe tshogs shig yin la/ de yang mkhas dbang gzan dkar rin po che thub bstan nyi ma mchog gis spyi'i gtso skyong gnang ste/ dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang gis nye ba'i lo bcu tsam gyi ring la 'bad brtson chen pos bod kyi sa gnas gang sar bzhugs pa'i bod yig dpe rnying po ti khrir longs pa rang byung dang mi'i gnod 'tshes 'jig la nye ba'i nyen kha las bskyabs te legs par bsgrigs shing dkar chag tu btab/ dpe thum gsol/ dpe sgrom bzhengs te srung skyob mdzad gnang ba dang gnang mus su yod pa ni/rang re'i mes po'i shul nor srung skyob rgyun 'dzin dang bod rig pa'i gal che'i dpyad gzhi mkho 'don gyi dgos pa che ba ma zad/ rang rgyal mi rigs rig gnas nor mdzod dar rgyas dang srung skyob bgyi ba'i 'phrin las gal chen zhig red/nye char dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang dang 'di ga dpe skrun khang gnyis zhib gros byas mthar/ srol rgyun rig gnas srung skyob dang bod rig pa'i dpyad yig myur skyob dang cha tshang du gtong ba'i dmigs yul ngos 'dzin gcig gyur thog 〈bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus〉 zhes pa'i dpe rnying dpe dkon gyi dpe tshogs chen mo zhig mu mthud nas legs sgrig dang dpe skrun byed bzhin yod pa dang / da char yang dmigs yul dgos pa gcig gyur thog 〈mes po'i shul bzhag〉 ces pa'i dpe rnying dpe dkon gal chen gyi dpe tshogs chen mo 'di nyid par skrun bya rgyu yin la/ de yang sngon byon mesapo mkhas dbang dam pa du mas shul du bzhag pa'i gsung 'bum dpe dkon gal chen rnams dang / 'thar 'thor du bzhugs pa'i dpe dkon gal chen dag phyogs gcig tu bsdus te bsgrigs pa 'di'i nang don thad la/ nang don rig pa dang / gso ba rig pa/ tshad ma rig pa/ sgra rig pa/ bzo rig pa/ lo rgyus/ rtsis rig sogs bcu phrag rig pa'i gnas kun 'dus pa'i dpe dkon nor bu dgos 'dod kun 'byung lta bu zhig yin/ —1—

'ad 'dra' dpe skrun mnyam las go skabs legs po nged cag dpe skrun khang la thob pa shan tu skal ba bzang zhing gzi brdzid kyi 'os 'gan zhig tu brtsis te lo 'ga'i dpe skrun 'char gzhi gtso bo'i nang du bkod zin cing / las gzhi 'di la krung go'i bod rig pa zhib 'jug lte gnas kyi dbu khrid dang rgyal khab phyi nang gi bod rig pa'i mkhas dbang du mas gdeng 'jog dang mthong chen gyis skul ma yang thob/〈mes po'i shul bzhag〉 gi ma phyi phal cher ni dbu med bris rnying sha stag yin pas/ ma dpe gsal mi gsal dang skung yig mang zhing bris tshugs 'dra min gyi dbang gis klog dka' ba'ang shin tu mang po 'dug 'on kyang dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang gis lo mang ring nyams myong bsdu len dang mkhas dbang du mar bka' 'dri zhus par brten yig gzugs gsar rgyag dang phyogs sgrig thub pa byung / par shing du 'khod yod pa rnams kyang dpe rnying gzhan pa dang bsdur te gtan la phab yod pa bcas te zhib cha deb so so'i bsdu sgrig gsal bshad du gzigs par zhu/dpe rnying srung skyob dang phyogs sgrig dpe skrun gyi las ka 'di la rgyab skyor dang thugs khur gnang mkhan gyi mkhas dbang rnams dang / lhag par du krung go'i bod rig pa zhib 'jug lte gnas kyi dbu khrid lhan rgyas dang / mkhas dbang thub bstan nyi ma rin po che mchog sogs kyis rgyab skyor dang mdzub ston gyi bka' drin bskyangs pa la snying thag pa nas thugs rje che zhu rgyu dang / dpal brtsegs zhib 'jug khang gi 'gan 'dzin pa lhan rgyas dang / zhu dag pa/ yig rgyag pa sogs mdor na las gzhi 'di la lhag bsam dang 'bad brtson chen pos zhabs phyi zhu mkhan rnams la snying thag pa nas bka' drin che zhes zhu rgyu dang /dpe tshogs 'di'i dpe sgrig dang zhu dag thad la ha cang nan tan dang zhib tshags bgyi khul byas mod/'on kyang nga tshor shes tshad dman pa'i dbang gis nor 'jug mi nyung ba yod srid pas dpyod ldan dag gis nor bcos yo bsrang gi dgongs 'char lhug stsol gnang bar zhu zhu/zhes krung go'i bod rig pa dpe skrun khang nas/spyi lo 2007lo'i zla ba dang po'i tshes 10la/

de la 'dir rang cag kha ba can gyi zhing 'dir chos rgyal lo paṇa rnams dang / sa dge bka' rnying sogs kyi mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa'i dam pa'i skyes bu rnams kyis/ bshad sgrub kyi shing rta chen po bco brgyad rjes 'brang dang bcas pa'i chos brgyud dang bka' srol mtha' dag dang / de dang rjes su 'brel ba'i thun mong gi rig gnas sum rtags snyan ngag mngon brjod sdeb spyor/ skar rtsis 'byung rtsis / sgra tshad bzo gso sogs mdo sngags rig gnas dang bcas pa'i gzhung lugs zab cing rgya che ba tshang la ma nor ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig 'chad nyan 'gyur gsum dang / bshad sgrub las gsum gyi sgo nas thog mar srol gtod/bar du gtan la phab/ rim bzhin dar rgyas btang ba sogs 'dzin skyong spel bar mdzad pa'i bka' drin bdag rkyen la brten nas/ dbus gtsang khams gsum du bzhugs so cog gi glegs bam thams cad gcig tu spungs na ri rab lhun po'i gtos dang mnyam zhing / chos tshan gyi rnam dbye ji snyed yod pa grangs su bgrangs na nam mkha'i gza' skar tshogs kyang skyengs par byed pa zhig mchis pa tsam du ma zad / rgya bal hor sogs kyi yul gru kun tu'ang dar khyab che/da lta'i char bod rig pa'am bod kyi shes rig ces su grags pa 'di nyid 'dzam gling shar nub kyi yul gru dag tu'ang mched de/ dper na/ o ka si phor dhi dang / har wid lta bu yo rob dang / a ri sogs su grags chen gyi slob grwa chen mo —1 —

rnams su bod yig gi dpe mdzod wo po yod par ma zad/ bod kyi chos dang rig gzhung slob gnyer byed sa'i sde tshan dang slob ma yang mi nyung ba yod/da ni gong du smras pa'i bshad sgrub shing rta chen po bco brgyad ces pa de gang dang gang yin pa'i ngo sprod mdo tsam zhu na/ de yang ji skad du/ 'jam mgon kong sprul rin po che'i zhal nas/ chos blon thon mi be+e ro ska cog zhang / /gnubs chen rin bzang rngog lo sa skya pa/ /bu ston bshad rgyun 'degs pa'i ka chen bcu// zhes dang / bod yul sgrub brgyud shing rta chen po brgyad/ /rnying ma bka' gdams lam 'bras bka' brgyud pa/ khangs pa zhi byed sbyor drug bsnyen sgrub bo/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ shes bya'i gzhung lugs sna tshogs kyi 'gyur khyad dang 'chad tshul gyi dbye bas bshad rgyun 'degs pa'i ka chen bcu dang / sgrub pa nyams su len tshul la brgyud pa'i khyad par dang man ngag gi dbye bas sgrub brgyud 'dren pa'i shing rta brgyad de/ bshad sgrub shing rta chen po bco brgyad rjes 'brang dang bcas pa'i gsung rab rgya mtsho lta bu zhig bdag cag gi yab mes gong ma rnams kyis gces pa'i lus srog longs spyod thams cad phangs pa med par btang ste/ phyi rabs rang re'i brgyud 'dzin rnams la 'phran yun phan bde'i dpal la dmigs nas bzhag pa'i nor bu rin po che yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal po mtha' yas pa zhig mchis/de dag las mang che ba rig gsar lo bcu'i god chag chen po sogs dus kyi rgud pa'i dbang gis sems med 'byung bzhi'i 'jig pa dang / sems ldan mi dang mi min gyi gnod pas nyams nyes chen por gyur pa ni rgya bod yongs grags ltar lags/ —2—

rig gnas gsar brje'i mjug sgril ba dang myongs cig tang gi yang dag pa'i srid jus kyi nyi 'od slar yang 'phros te/ tang dang rgyal khab kyis 'go khrid dang rtsa 'dzugs gnang nas/ dpe rnying 'thor bsdu dang / legs sgrig dpe skrun/ sgyur spel sogs kyi sgo nas rang rigs kyi rig gnas nyams pa sor chud dang / mi nyams gong 'phel gyi bya bar so so'i 'khos bstun gyi sri zhu sgrub pa'i skal ba bzang po'i dpal la longs su spyad du yod pa'i skabs 'dir/ rang re'i yab mes rnams kyis bzhag pa'i pha nor mang po zhig da dung yang nged cag gi bsod nams kyi bgo skal du lhag yod pa rnams la gces spras chen pos srung skyob dang dar spel byed rgyu ni mes rgyal gyis gnang ba'i las 'gan yin par ma zad/ 'u cag bod kyi rig gnas slob gso'i bya bar legs skyes 'bul mkhan gyi rgan dar 'bring gsum gyi shes yon can la mtshon na/ rang re'i phrag par bab pa'i gzhan dring mi 'jog pa'i gzi 'od bla na 'bar ba'i 'os 'gan mchog tu gyur pa zhig kyang yin par sems/der brten/ phyogs dang ris su ma chad pa'i skyes bu dam pa rnams kyis ljags rtsom gnang ba'i gsung rab/ bshad sgrub shing rta bco brgyad las grub pa'i mdo sngags kyi gzhung bshad dang / chos 'byung dang gdan rabs/ rnam thar dang gsan yig brda sprod dang snyan ngag /rtsis dang gso rig sogs dpe dkon 'thor ba rnams bsdus/ chad pa rnams bsab/ nyams pa rnams gsos/ 'khru/gas pa rnams bsgrigs te dpe tshogs 'ga' rim pa bstar chags su par du bskrun pa dang bskrun rtsis las/—3—

da lan 'dir jo nang rje bcun tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum dpe bsdur ma 'di rgya che'i gzigs pa po rnams kyi spyan lam du phul ba yin/'byung char nga tsho'i dpe tshogs dpar skrun zhu rgyu'i skor la lhag bsam ldan zhing mkhyen spyan yangs pa'i mkhas dbang rnams kyis dgongs 'char gyi bka' slob stsol gnang dang / dpe dkon gyi ma phyi g.yar gnang gi skyabs 'jug yong ba mkhyen mkhyen/ /zhor 'phros gsal 'debs zhu ba/ lhag par du da lta lus kyi lang tsho rgyas shing / sems kyi blo gros bkra ba'i gzhon skyes rnams la mtshon na/ snying pos dben pa'i kha pho 'don pa las/ zol med kyi lhag bsam dkar po snying la 'chang / don ldan gyi rnam dkar bya ba dang du len/ lhad med kyi chos dang rig gzhung slob gnyer byed/ 'khos bstun gyi sri zhu'i las/ ka cung zad re sgrub nus na/mes rgyal la zhabs tog 'grub/ rang rigs la legs skyes 'bul/ rang nyid kyi la rgya mngon thub pa zhig kyang 'ong ba ni mthong chos mngon gyur lags pas/ de bzhin dgongs dbyings su chub par zhu'o/ /phran 'brog rgan 'khyam/sa po thub bstan nyi mas/spyi lo 2007pa'i zla tshes la gus phul/—4—

bsdu sgrig gsal bshad/da lam nga tsho'i jo nang rje btsun tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs te par skrun zhus pa 'di ni/ gzan dkar mchog sprul thub bstan nyi ma'i bka' slob dang bdag rkyen 'og byung ba zhig yin/de yang spyir khong la gsung 'bum pod bzhi bcu tsam zhig yod tshul phyis su bris pa'i rnam thar 'ga' las gsal yang / dngos su pod bzhi bcu'i dkar chag kha gsal zhig da sngon nga tsho'i mjal rgyu ma byung / da lam dngos su mjal rgyu byung ba'i pod bco lnga ni/ deng sang yongs grags su rtag brtan par ma zhes 'bod pa 'di ni/ bod rab byung bcu pa'i me 'brug (spyi lo1616) la/ mnga' ris smad kyi gung thang gi rgyal rabs nyi shu rtsa gsum pa'am/ yang lugs gcig la dmar po sde bsgrangs na nyi shu rtsa bzhi pa bsod nams dbang phyug sdes yon bdag byas/ tā ra nā tha'i dngos slob gnya' yi ban+di dkon mchog legs pas/ thog ma'i mtshams sbyor dang par byang 'bri ba sogs byas te/ dus 'khor sngags phreng dang skad gnyis shan sbyar sogs chos tshan bcu bzhi shing par du bkos pa/ rtag brtan dam chos gling du spyan drangs te bzhugs su gsol/ de'i steng du rtag brtan rang nas brkos pa bcas pod —1—

bco lnga tsam zhig yod pa de'i bu dpe par ma tshar gcig /rgyal dbang lnga pa chen pos 'bras spungs dpe mdzod khang du gdan drangs ba/ phyis dus 'gyur skabs su pe cing mi rigs pho brang du bzhugs kyang / deng seng bod ljongs dpe mdzod khang du spyan drangs te bzhugs pa de yin/yang gangs can mkhas grub rim byon gyi ming mdzod las/ khong la gsung rtsom shin tu mang po yod par grags kyang rgyal dbang lnga pa chen pos/gsung 'bum shing par rnams bka' rgya btab ste par mi chog pa mdzad pas da lta khong gi gsung rtsom rnams kha tshang ba ha cang dka'/ rgyal dbang lnga pa zhing du gshegs rjes/ blo gros brtan pas khong gi gsung 'bum la dkar chag bsdus pa zhig mdzad 'dug /de'i rjes zha lu ri phug sprul skus mdzad pa'i tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum dkar chag dwangs gsal me long zhes pa'i nang du/ pod ka nas tsa bar bcu bdun la chos tshan nyis brgya don gnyis dang / ldeb grangs bdun stong brgyad brgya lnga bcu bzhugs/da lta pe cing mi rigs pho brang du pod bcu bdun la chos tshan nyis brgya don brgyad dang / ldeb grangs bdun stong dgu brgya lnga bcu rtsa brgyad bzhugs zhes gsal yang nga tsho'i gong gi dkar chag gnyis po da sngon mjal rgyu ma rnyed/ de yang zha lu ri phug sprul skus dkar chag dwangs gsal me long zhes pa ljags rtsom gnang ste/ sngar rtag brtan gyi shing par dus zing dbang —2—

gis nyams chag shor ba rnams/ kha gso mdzad tshul thos kyang zhib phra'i lo rgyus kha gsal mjal rgyu ma byung / da lta dgen 'jam dbyangs rnams rgyal gyi dpe mdzod du bzhugs pa'i par rnying pod bcu bdun 'di/ zha lu ri phug sprul skus nyams gso mdzad pa de yin nam snyams ste/ da lta rtag brtan gyi par rnying bod ljongs dpe mdzod khang du bzhugs pa pod bco lnga dang / pod grangs dang chos tshan mang nyung tshig mtshams sogs cung mi 'dra ba yod pa'i phyir/da lam nga tshos khong gi gsung 'bum glog klad nang du bcug skabs kyi thog ma'i ma dpe ni/ nye char bla ma yon to bzang pos 'dzam thang du shing par la brkos pa'i glegs bam nyer bzhi can de la byas te zhu dag thengs gsum byas/ de rjes sngar jo nang rtag brtan du bzhugs pa rtsom pa po tā ra nā tha rang nyid kyi phyag dpe skabs 'gar phyag mchan yod pa/ da lta 'bras spungs gnas bcu lha khang nang bzhugs bris ma pod chung bcu la chos tshan43la bsdur gzhi dang / jo nang rtag brtan gyi par rnying pod bco lnga bod ljongs dpe mdzod khang du bzhugs pa dang / a ri ba dgen 'jam dbyangs rnam rgyal gyi dpe mdzod du bzhugs pa par rnying pod bcu bdun yod pa gnyis phyogs bsdoms kyis/ par rnying pod nyi shu tsam la chos tshan 314byung ba la sdur byed byas te dpe bsdur thengs dang po zhus/—3—

de nas rtag brtan gyi par pod nyi shu la bsdur gzhi dang / 'dzam thang gi par mas sdur byed byas te dpe bsdur theng gnyis pa zhus pa yin/ 'on kyang par ma snga phyi gnyis dang bris ma gcig bcas dpe gsum po rtsa ba'i cha nas gcig mtshungs su bzhugs pa las khyad par chen po mi 'dug /cho ga'i skor la mi 'dra ba cung zad yod pa ni mchan dkyus su shor ba yin 'dug pa rnams kyang / gug rtags nang du bcug te gsal po byas yod/ rtag brtan par rnying dang 'bras spungs bris ma gnyis su dpe ma bzhugs pa/ 'dzam thang par ma'i nang bzhugs gsung thor bu'i skor wa rtags can dang / zha rtags can gnyis dang / za rtags can dbu ma theg mchog gi zin bris rab byed drug pa yan chad/ tā ra nā tha'i zhal gsung slob ma ye shes rgya mtshos zin bris su bkod pa dang / rab byed bdun pa brgyad pa gnyis dza 'go'i dge bshes mchog grub rgya mtshos gsar du bsnan pa/ 'a rtags can nyang yul gyi lo rgyus tā ra nā thas zhabs btags mdzad par grags pa bcas chos tshan121la 'dzam thang gi par ma'i dpe gcig pu las/ rtag brtan par rnying dang 'bras spungs bris ma gnyis kyi bsdur gzhi ma rnyed/ rtag brtan par rnying gcig pu las gzhan gnyis la med pa chos tshan4/ yang rtag brtan dang 'dzam thang par ma gnyis char med pa/ 'bras sbungs gnas bcu lha khang du bzhugs pa'i gral nas chos tshan bco brgyad la ldeb193gsar rnyed byung —4—

ba bcas la/ zhu dag byas te kha skong gi tshul du bzhag yod pa bcas khyon bsdoms deb bzhi bcu zhe lnga la chos tshan900yod/ da lta nga tsho'i ma dpe g.yar rgyu ma rnyed pa sngon rtsom pa po'i phyag dpe'i gral nas yin pa/ 'bras spungs gnas bcu lha khang / dpe rtags phyi298nang bzhugs gtam du bya ba nor bu'i 'byung gnas ldeb6/ yang phyi508nang bzhugs 'khor lo gsum gyi rnam bzhag chos dbyings rgya mtsho'i rgyan rnam par bkod pa ldeb92/ ste lag bris kyi chos tshan gnyis po ma 'ongs par dpe g.yar thabs bya dgos/da lta nga tshos dpe bsdur dang zhu dag gi skabs su ma dpe rtsa 'dzin byas te/ dpe gsum mi 'dra ba'i tshe rtag brtan la〈〈rta〉〉rtags 'di dang /'dzam thang la rtags〈〈rjo 〉〉'di/ dag cha nor bcos la gug rtag 'di( 1dang / mchan rnams gug rtag〈 〉'di'i nang du blug yod/gsal bshad zhu rgyu zhig la deb bzhi pa'i nang du/ kun mkhyen dol po pa'i gsung chos tshan bzhi/ rig 'dzin tshe dbang kun khyab kyi gsung lho sgo'i cho ga zhes pa'i chos tshan gcig bcas 'dzam thang par mar bzhag yod pa dang / yang sa bzang ma ti paṇa chen gyi gsung dus 'khor phyag rgya'i skor chos tshan gcig rtag brtan par rnying du yod pa rnams rang 'jag bzhag yod pa dang / khong gi rang rnam gtso bor gyur pa'i lo rgyus zhal gdams rnams su/gtsang gi yul skad yin nam snyam pa'i tha snyad go dka' ba mang po zhig —5—

bed spyad gnang ba dag kyang rang sor bzhag yod/da lam bka' 'bum 'di rtsis 'khor nang du blugs pa'i 'gro song tsā 'dra tshogs pa nas zhus shing / par skrun tshar lnga brgya'i 'gro song bod rig pa dpe skrun khang nas bgyis/ tshar brgyad brgya'i 'gro song be krin sogs kyi rgya'i sbyin bdag rnams kyis gnang zhing / tshar nyis brgya'i 'gro song tsā 'dra tshogs pa nas bgyis pa bcas kyi mthun rkyen las/ da lam dngos su par du bskrun thub pa byung ste rgya che'i klog pa po rnams kyi spyan lam du phul ba yin/las gzhi 'dir bod ljongs dpe mdzod khang nas ma dpe pod bco lnga g.yar gnang byung ba dang / 'dzam thang bla ma mun sel mchog nas kyang ma dpe btsal rogs dang / go rim sgrig rgyu/ zhu dag bcas la rogs ram gang mang gnang ba dang / khams sprul bsod nams don grub mchog nas nyang yul chos 'byung zhu dag gi rogs ram gnang ba dang / bla ma dpal ldan rgya mtshos zhu dag gi las ka spyi'i thugs 'gan che bzhes gnang ba bcas la thugs rje che zhu rgyu ba'o/ /dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang nas karma bde legs kyis/—6—

khong ni slob dpon chen tshu pa sku sge sgro 1 6 3 'byu / shadang gnas dang / paṇ+ḍi ta gha ya dha ra/gnyos lo tsā ba/ kha rag sgom chung sogs skyes chen mang pos byin gyis brlabs shing / bod skyong brtan ma bcu gnyis kyi nang tshan kha rag khyung btsun gyi gnas jo mo kha rag ces pa'i 'dabs/ chu bo chen po lo hi ta'i nye 'gram du rwa lo tsā ba chen po'i brgyud pa bar ma chad par byon pa la/ shar nub gnyis su gyes pa las shar ba kun dga' seng ge'i gdung brgyud/ sngags 'chang tshul khrims rgya mtsho'i sras rnam rgyal phun tshogs dgung lo bzhi bcu zhe dgu pa rje 'di'i yab dang /yum rdo rje bu dga' dgung lo bcu dgu pa gnyis kyi sras su bod rab byung bcu pa'i shing phag (spyi lo1575) la/ ngo mtshar ba'i ltas dang bcas sku 'khrungs te mes pos pad+ma sri gcod rdo rje zhes mtshan gsol/sku bltams te zla ba brgyad song rjes bzhengs nas gom pa spo thub pa dang / dgung lo gcig tsam nas gsung byon te nga bla ma kun dga' grol mchog yin zhes zhal gyis bzhes pa dang / gzhan yang sku gong ma'i rten gsum dang sbyin bdag / nye gnas sogs kyi lo rgyus gsal bar gsungs pa sogs kyis/jo nang bla ma kun dga' grol mchog gi yang srid 'khrul med du shes te/ dgung lo bzhi par jo nang mkhan chen lung rigs rgya mtsho dang / zhabs drung bkra shis — 1 —

stobs rgyas dbang po sogs rta pa brgya dang drug cu rtsa lnga tsam gdan 'dren du byung nas/ gtsang phyogs su gdan drangs te sku gong ma'i slob ma rdo ring kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ lha dbang grags pa/ mkhan chen lung rigs rgya mtsho/ mkhas dbang byams pa lhun grub/ rje drung kun dga' dpal bzang sogs kyis chos lung byang rtser khri ston mdzad/ rdo ring pa chen po 'jam dbyangs kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyi drung du/ thog ma'i rten 'brel du sgrol dkar gyi rjes gnang dang / gshed dmar lha lnga'i dbang / lam 'bras gtso bor gyur pa'i dbang dang gdams pa mang po gsan/de nas dgung lo drug pa nas yi ge sbyor klog phul du phyin pa mkhyen te/dbang dang rjes gnang sogs yig thog nas gnang ba la dka' tshegs med pa byung /dgung lo brgyad par rje gong ma'i dngos slob mkhas dbang byams pa lhun grub yongs 'dzin du bsten nas/ tshad ma rigs gter sbyangs pas gzhung don la go ba rnyed rung blo 'dzin la zla ba lnga tsam 'gor/ gas yang mdo rgyud kyi gzhung lugs mang por gsan bsam mdzad pas mkhyen rtogs rgyas/dgung lo brgyad la phebs skabs stag lung kun dga' bkra shis rgyal mtshan gdan drangs te thog mar bka' gdams glegs bam gyi lung zhus te/ de nas bod rab byung bcu pa'i chu rta khrums stod zla ba'i tshes lnga (spyi lo1582)la/ chos lung byang rtse'i mchod khang gi yang thog tu/ dpal stag lung pa chen po rje btsun kun dga' bkra shis rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhal snga nas kyi —2—

mkhan po dang / 'jam dbyangs kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos slob dpon dang / rje drung kun dga' dpal bzang pos dus go ba/chos rje mchod gnas pas grogs dan bgyis te yongs rdzogs dge bsnyen dang bar ma rab byung sngon du 'gro bas dge tshul gyi sdom pa bzhes te/ mtshan kun dga' snying po bkra shis rgyal mtshan zhes gsol/ dag pa'i gzigs snang du rgya gar gyi paṇa chen dz+wa la nā thas tā ra nā tha zhes pa'i mtshan gsol/chos rje brag stod pa lha dbang grags pa'i drung nas chos drug dang phyag chen sogs/ zab chos mang po gsan pas nang zab lam gyi rtogs pa mngon du gyur/ rje drung kun dga' dpal bzang las dus 'khor gtso bor gyur pa'i zab chos mang po gsan/ mkhan po lung rigs rgya mtsho'i mdun dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang dang rgyud bshad/ dpal rgyal ba jo nang pa'i lugs kyi sbyor drug gi zab khrid mtha' dag gsan te nyams len mdzad/ bu lugs kyi sbyor drug gi khrid kyang rdzogs par gsan/ gzhan yang jo zhal bla ma mang po'i gdams khrid dang bka' bstan sogs rgya gzhung gi man ngag mang po dang / kun mkhyen dol bo pa'i gsung 'bum sogs lung mang po gsan/ mkhas grub sangs rgyas ye shes/rdo rje 'dzin pa ye shes dbang po sogs las/ sa skya jo nang shangs pa zhwa lu 'brug pa kaX tshang / stag lung sogs kyi chos skor bcas rgyud sde bzhi'i dbang khrid man ngag mtha' dag ma lus par gsan/ gzhan yang rgya gar gyi grub chen gu ru lho phyogs pa sangs rgyas sbas pa'i mgon po/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga'i mtshan can sogs bshes gnyen mang po'i zhabs la gshugs te/ zhang tshal pa'i chos —3—

skor dang / yang dgon pa'i bka' 'bum/ dwags po lha rje'i bka' 'bum/ ri chos ma drug gi khrid/ mai tri bcu gsum ma'i dbang / sangs rgyas thod pa'i dbang /o rgyan bsnyen sgrub skor gyi khrid lung yongs rdzogs/ mar pa nas brgyud rngog pa'i bka' babs dgyes rdor yab yum/ gur rigs bsdus/ gdan bzhi yab yum/ ma hā mā ya ste drug smri ti nas brgyud pa 'jam dpal gsang ldan bcas rngog dkyil bdun/rngog ṭīka rin chen rgyan 'dra'i mdzub khrid/brtag gnyis sa rngog gnyis ka'i bshad srol/ stag lung thang pa'i bka' 'bum/sgrub thabs brgya rtsa'i rjes gnang /ni gu chos drug 'jam dkar gyi rjes gnang /'grel chen dri med 'od dang /rdo rje snying 'grel dang / dgyes pa rdo rje'i rgya gzhung / dgyes rdor skor la gtso che'i chos sna sum cu so dgu dang / gdan bzhi'i khrid tshul rgyas pa/ ār+ya de wa'i chos lnga sogs rgya gzhung bcu/ sa ra he'i chos lnga/ nag po'i gzhung drug lha hi smad lnga/dril bu skor gsum/ gshed dmar bi rū pa'i gzhung brgyad/ ku ku ri pa'i chos bdun/ sgrub thabs mtsho skyes sogs dgyes rdor gyi gzhung shin tu mang po dang / dpe med 'tsho'i sbyor drug rtsa 'grel/dza lan+ta ri'i do ha/ sems kyi phyag rgya sogs mdo sngags spyi dang / khyad par du gsang sngags rgyud sde'i dbang bskyed rdzogs mtha' yas pa gsan/de nas dgung lo bcu bdun pa rab byung bcu pa'i lcags yos hor zla bcu gcig pa'i tshes bcu bdun (spyi lo1591)la/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyis mkhan po/ bla ma byams pa lhun grub kyis las kyi slob dpon/dge ba'i bshes gnyen blo bzang pa dang / rje drung kun dga' bsod nams —4—

sogs kyis kha skong gnang ste bsnyen par rdzogs pa dge slong gi sdom pa bzhes te/ phyi ltar ngur smrig gi rgyal mtshan 'chang ba'i dge slong 'dul ba 'dzin pa/nang ltar gzhan phan snying rje chen pos thugs rgyud yongs su brlan pa'i rgyal sras sems pa chen po/ gsang ba bskyed rdzogs kyi zab gnad la mnga' brnyes pa'i sngags 'chang rdo rje 'dzin pa zhig tu gyur/de nas bsam sdings su dpal ldan bla ma dam pa byams pa'i mtshan can gyi drung du rdo rje phreng ba'i dbang yongs rdzogs dang / dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i dbang bcas zhus/ bla ma dpal ldan chos kyi bzang po'i zhal snga nas/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor la brten nas dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang yongs su rdzogs pa bdag po chen po'i mthar thug pa dang / gsang bdag 'khor lo chen po/dril bu lha lnga/ gzungs grwa lnga/ dril bu lus dkyil sogs dbang mang po gsan/ gzhan yang dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams las/ gsang 'dus 'phags lugs dang / zhabs lugs/ gshin rje gshed dgra gdong 'jigs gsum/gshed dmar bram ze dpal 'dzin gyi lugs/ gdan bzhi'i gzhung bdun/sangs rgyas thod pa phyogs kyi rgya gzhung mang po dang / rgyud sde 'og ma ci rigs pa dang / grub pa sde bdun/ snying po skor drug yid la mi byed pa'i chos skor rnams dang / phreng ba skor gsum/ rgyud 'grel grags can phal che ba dang /bslab btus dang / byang sa sogs gzhung mang por thos bsam gnang bas blo gros kyi lus stobs ches cher rgyas te gzhung lugs rab 'byams smra ba'i mkhas pa chen por gyur/—5—

de nas bla ma kun dga'i mtshan can dang slob dpon rin po ches bka' bzhin/ rje 'di nyid dgung lo nyer gcig pa rab byung bcu pa'i shing lug hor zla brgyad pa'i tshes lnga(spyi lo1595)la/ ri khrod chen po jo mo nang gi gdan sa par bskos pa bzhin bla brang gi rtsis sprod rtsis len gnang rjes/ skyid phug tu zla gcig lhag tsam bcad mtshams la bzhugs te phag mo'i ljags bsnyen gnang skabs/ rmi lam du ngo bo slob dpon pad+ma yin pa'i rnal 'byor pa gzi brjid che ba zhig gi drung du/ dwags po rnyi ba rin po che dge bshes bgres song gi rnam par bzhugs 'dug pa las/ rnal 'byor pa'i zhal nas nga dang dol po pa ngo bo gcig yin gsung pa dang / bod kyi dge bshes bgres song des kyang nga yang ngo bo gcig yin gsung pa rmis pas/ dang po pad 'byung gi rten 'brel de sad de sgom gyi sa bon thebs/ bar skabs su dwags po rin po ches chos kyis rtogs pa brnyes/ phyis kun mkhyen chen po'i bzhed dgongs ltar nyams su myong ba'i brda ru go /de nas rgya gar gyi paṇ+ḍi ta pu rje nan+da dang pra yā mā nan+da gnyis dang mjal 'phrad mdzad de gsung gleng gnang bas/ khong gnyis grub mtha' nang par 'dug kyang pha mes kyi chos rig byed la yang chen che bas/ phyi rol pa'i lha gcig gnyis bsten gyin 'dug pas dbang chos sogs ni ma zhus/ rig pa'i gnas thams cad la shin tu mkhas par 'dug pas dogs gcod mang du bgyis shing bstan bcos kyang than thun bsgyur/ bha ra ta dang rā ma ya ṇa la sogs pa'i lo rgyus kyang mang du thos/ de skabs rā ma ya ṇa'i srung ma ha nu ma tha'i cho 'phrul lus —6—

byang chen gyi ri dang mnyam pa'i spre'u dang / bha ra ta'i srung ma rgyal po sgyi ma dngos su mthong bas paṇ+ḍi ta na re/ khyod la 'go bar 'dug mthu dang snyan grags longs spyod r+ṣa po yong gsungs na yang / chos la mi dad pa'i lha 'dre bsten pas ci bya snyam nas yal bar dor ba yin zhes gsungs/lo dus chag med jo nang du sbyor drug gi khrid gsungs pas ngo ma 'phrod pa gcig kyang ma byung / rgya gar gyi slob dpon su ni khyu ṇa shrī dang puṇ+ḍa badz+ra sogs las zab khrid kyi gdams pa mang po gsan/ jo nang du sgrub mchod la dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i rdul wo gyi dkyil 'khor bzhengs te/ 'dus pa bdun brgya tsam la dbang bcu gcig pa rdzogs par gnang / dgung grangs nyer drug skor rwa sgreng du phebs te tshogs su chos 'brel tsam dang / rje tsong kha pa'i bzhugs khri'i steng nas lam rim gsungs/dgung lo nyer dgu par jo nang du bzhugs skabs tho rengs shig la rje btsun byams pas zhal gzigs te/ khong rang la thim pa'i gzigs snang byung bas gzhan stong dbu ma'i grub mtha' la nges shes gting nas rnyed/ kun mkhyen dol po pas zhal yang yang gzigs nas lung bstan gnang ba dang /gzim lam du sham+bha lar phyin nas rigs ldan sprul pa'i sku dang mjal te chos gsan pa'i snang ba sogs gzigs snang mang po byung /dgung lo so dgu par chos 'khor lha sar phebs nas dar chen mang po bslangs te jo bo'i mdun thugs smon zab rgyas gnang / de nas kun mkhyen dol po pa'i sku brnyan gsung byon ma dang / thugs rje chen po/ tshe dpag med bcas —7—

byin rlabs can gyi rten gsum po'i mdun du mchod 'bul dang thugs smon rgya chen gnang ste smon lam rgyal ba rgya mtsho yang brtsams/dgung lo zhe gcig pa rab byung bcu pa'i shing yos hor zla gnyis pa'i tshes bcu gcig (spyi lo1615)la/ gtsang pa sde srid phun tshogs rnam rgyal gyis chos gzhis dang / lha 'bangs sogs rgya cher phul nas mthun rkyen sbyar ba las/dpal rtag brtan dam chos gling nges don dga' ba'i tshal gyi gnas gzhi'i las grwa btsugs te/ phyi gtsug lag khang dang grwa khang brgya phrag tsam lcags ri dang bcas pa/ nang gi rten sangs rgyas rabs bdun dang / tshe dpag med/ sgrol ma/yum chen mo/ dzam bha la sogs gser zangs las grub pa mang po dang / dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i sku zhal phyag yongs rdzogs gser zangs las grub pa dang /bde gshegs mchod rten cha brgyad sogs rten gsum dpag tu med pa bzhengs/jo nang du yang lha khang gsar bzhengs dang nang rten byams chen thog tshad gnyis tsam gser zangs las grub pa sogs mang po bzhengs/ gzhan yang lha bzo sogs lag rtsal pa rnams dang po rgya bal sogs nas gdan drangs/ de nas bris pa dang / spar brko shing bzo sogs lag rtsal pa gso skyong gnang bas/las rigs lag rtsal pa rnams kyang gzhan la re mi dgos pa byung ste/ bka' bstan 'gyur ro cog tshar mang po dang / bka' 'bum skor po ti bzhi bcu shing par du brkos pa sogs rten gsum mang po gsar bzhengs gnang /skabs shig ri bo che nas rgya dpe pod bcu tsam zhig 'byor byung ba'i nang / yar klung lo tsā ba'i phyag dpe ngo ma dus 'khor 'grel r+ṣa pod gnyis —8—

'dug dus 'khor rgyud kyi dpe de dbus phyogs nas snga mo zhig tu lag son byung ba dang / 'grel pa 'di skabs su rnyed pa la ya mtshan chen po byung ste thengs mang bklags pas zung sbyor la yang blo skyed chen po byung / gzhan yang dbang mdor bstan gyi 'grel pa don dam bsdus pa'i mdzad byang la nā ro pa'i mtshan yod pa dang / kyai rdo rje'i 'grel pa rdo rje'i tshig bsdus kyi mdzad byang du byang chub bzang po'i skad dod bo dhi bha dra zhes yod pa sogs mang po byung /yang skabs shig gtsang pa sde srid kyis sog po'i steng du dmag dpung chas rtsis la srung 'khor dang sku rim gnang ba'i tshe/ khong ni rje tsong kha pa chen por lhag tu dad pa che ba dang / khyad par du chos sde chen po 'bras sprungs la nye sems kyi bag chags shin tu che ba zhig yod pas/ chos sde chen po de nyid dar zhing rgyas pa dang rtsod pa 'jam po'i sgo nas zhi ba'i smon lam btab kyang / nus pa ma thon pa ni phyogs gnyis ka las ngan gyi dbang gis ded pa la g.yol thabs bral zhes gsungs/ de nas dpal 'khor ra bde chen/ rtse chen chos sde/'jag bsam gnyis/ thar pa gling / rtag brtan chos 'phel sogs dbus gtsang gi chos sde mang por chos dang longs spyod kyi bsnyen bkur rgya chen gnang ste bskyangs/de nas dgung grangs re gcig bzhes pa rab byung bcu gcig pa'i shing phag (spyi lo1635) la/ rtag brtan dam chos gling nges don dga' ba'i tshal gyi gdan sa 'jam dbyangs sprul sku sangs rgyas rgya mtsho la gtad de/ chos lung rtse dang jo mo nang du dus khrid phyag len rgyas pa gnang nas/ da res ma gtogs —9—

'dir chos mi 'chad gsungs te bu slob rnams la zhal ta mang po gnang ste/ lo de'i nag pa zla ba'i tshes nyer brgyad la zhi bar gshegs so//slob ma/ sprul sku sangs rgyas rgya mtsho/ mkhas dbang ye shes rgya mtsho/mkhan chen rin chen rgya mtsho/ mkhas grub blo gros rnam rgyal rnams dang / sgam po sprul sku/ chos rje ngag dbang pa/ bla ma chu bo chung ba'i sku skye/ mkhan po kun dga' bkra shis rgyal mtshan/ sprul sku ngag gi dbang po/ tre bo sprul sku/chos rje rin stengs pa/ dus 'khor shar chen pa/ chos rje lha bo pa/ dge slong snying po mtha' yas/ byams pa yon tan mgon po/ ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams/ mi pham dkon mchog legs pa/ kun dga' 'phrin las dbang mo/gtsang gi rgyal sras kun dga' bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan sogs mang po byung /gzhan yang bstan pa'i spyin bdag gtsang pa sde srid phun tshogs rnam rgyal/ byang bdag bkra shis stobs rgyal/ yar 'brog bstan 'dzin mi 'gyur dbang gi rgyal po sogs mang ngo/ /dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang nas karma bde legs kyis/— 10—
dam pa'i chos rin po che 'phags pa'i yul du ji ltar dar ba'i tshul bzhugs / 1bka' babs bdun ldan gyi brgyud pa'i rnam thar bzhugs 271

༄//dar ga ba'i rdo tshul spyan sgyu gas wang gal pa zhe che ༵kur lo / bya ba shā ༷pa ༵/two sa/la 'du / rdo ltar 'a ༅ //i swa rdzi pra dze khyuḥ dpal ldan dpal gyis brgyan pa dpalagyi 'byung gnas dam pa'i cho lo rin po che 'phags pa'i yul du ji ltar dar ba'i tshul gsal bar ston pa dgas 'dod kun 'byung zhes bya ba/sangs rgyas srakhodang slob mar bcas pa la phyag 'tshal lo//cho se dbyings lha yi las lasa'ongs//mtshan dpe dbang po'i gzhu yis spras/'phrin las bdud rtsi'i rderdezim 'bebs/thub dbang sprin gyi dbang por 'dud/'di na yig tshang lo rgyurdemakhas rnams kyang //'phags yul gtam gyi sbyor ba la bzhugs na//dbulapo'i skye bo tsho ngo zog 'grems pa bzhin//rtsal shugs phyung yang phongs pa'i rgyu nyid mthong //mkhas pa 'ga' yang cho lo kyi khungs 'chad tshe/lken tu 'khru wa pa mang du mthong ba'i phyir//'khrul pa sel byed gtam gyi sbyor ba ni//gzhan laphan pa'i r+sā du mdo tsam gri//'dir nye bar mkho ba'i sdom ni/rgyal po mthordeldan dge ba'i brgyud//lag bzang gzhu bzang dbang chen dang //tsa ma shā dzhaibazhi yin no//mya ngan med kyi brgyud pa la//mya ngan bral dang dpa' rde'i ste/dga' bo pad+ma che ste bzhi//tsan+t+ra'i rigs las byung ba ni//ha ri mi sa k+ṣi3dza ya dang //4ne ma 5pha ni 6bhang sa dang //7swa la rnams la ca spre sbyar//de nas ca spre

gup+ta 8 dang / /snying po thig 9le de'i tsha bo/ /shrī tsan+d+ra 1rmego5bya go /11dha rma 12karma 13brik+ṣa dang / /14bi ga ma dang 15kā ma dang / /16piṅka 17bā la14bye tshal/ 19go bi la 20li ta rnams la'ang / /tsan+d+ra tha mar sbyar bar bya/ snying po thig le mi bgrang na/ /tsan+t+ra'i ming can bcu dgu ste/ /de las dbang po 〈a sna 〉zla ba 1dang / /rgyal ba'i 〈dza ya〉 zla ba 2zhes bya dang / /chos kyi〈dha'i zla ba 3las 〈karma〉zla 4ba/ /'du 〈pig ma〉bral 5'dod pa'i 〈kā ma〉zla ba 6dang/ khri med 7〈pim la〉 zla ba zhes bya ba/ /tsan+d+ra bdun du grags pa yin/ /de steng zla 〈ā+oṃgup+ta〉 ba sbas pa dang / /phyogs〈go bi〉grol rol (bye)〈la ṣ+ka〉ba'i zla ba tshe /tsan+t+ra bcu zhes rab tu grags/ /pā la'i rigs las byung ba ni/ /gog la dang de wa dang / /rā sa dharma ba na dang / /ma hi mahā snga dang / /sne ya ne ya a mra dang/ /hasti/rā ma yak+ṣa ste/ /kun la pā la tha mar sbyar/ /pā la'i rigs la bcu bzhi'o/ /rgyal po mes spyin ka ni gi/ lak+ṣa a shwa tsan+dan skyong / /shrī har+sha phab tshul dang / bde spyod go ḍa 'phel byed dang / /ka ni ka dang tu ru ske/ /sog po mang pos bkur ba dang / /sangs rgyas phyogs dang zab mo'i phyogs/ /g.yo bag g.yo brtan biṣ+ṭha dang / /seng ge bha lha seng ge lnga/ gsal ba rab gsal sde chen dang/ tak+ṣa/ stobs chen zhes bya'o/ /'di dag thor bu byung ba yin/ /ba sur khri tsan ka/ zhingaskyong bzod pa skyong ba rnams/ /pā la'i gseb la thor bu byung / /la wa kā sa ma ṇi ta/ /rā rdzika ste se na bzhi/ /lho yi phyogs su byung ba ni/ /ka rnyil sogasasnatshogs par/ /dkar po zla 'dzes swā la'i bzhon/ /dbang chen sde byed yid 'ongadang / /longs spyod skra bzang zla ba'i sde/ /bde byed seng stag bu da dang / /bublu—2—

shu tsa gdong smru dang tsho//rgya lto rab gnon rgyaX ra she 'a she//ga'i dbangaskya kyi rgyal kyi//nī da byas pa 'aX gdung nga //lha rdzu phyags su bus ze na//ga lha bshas she klu ya she/༷la ba 'a stong byu ba zhes pa byung //ga ra dang gzhan nu dga'//bla gzhan bzang pa' kun dga' dang //sbyin bzang laṅka de wa dang //ba hu bhu dze dbu ma'i blo//sngon gyi glo ra co'u rtse ram ra 7 yi ri ‘ri ra 7dpan rnams sdu//rgyal ba stan pa' gtad rabs na//gas pa bsos ji zhirdernam pa she//nyam gung pa cho/ she phud//sgi mtsho gas pa she 'a cha//she sa yul ba lo sbu pa//gtang dho pa da lta ba ༅/rdzu༅rdekya sa she she can kau //rta sbas kau pa she/she/bsnya pa skyabazang 'bebs ma//bla ma 'ad she mang stan dang //sa skyun chas she bsrung cha sherabazang 'bas//gnas ma budang gas dmar she/ye/ped ji mo tha rda~X /mchal/srungaḍi pa//yang dag rgyal ༵rdo gnas brtan dang /rngo/ya/ rdza nu' pa mi rusposgrags dang //dpa' ge sangs rgyas lha ge rden//da nu yerdedang //ku na la she ༵ byed she //da 'du na 'phal dang bsam rdzags/te/dre/btsuX pa wo pa sde rnams sa//'a ba legs rgyal dgob she /khrus she ༵ gas mad ra rig sgyu//she da~Xs padaX //bzang ༷ mchagarded su tra dang //gas lhas mthobatsun bad dā da~X //ka gying gas pa si rnyib 'jug bzang /she/sbrang spyo sna ḍā pra kau dang //mak+ṣi da ga pa gas pa ྅ //tsa na ka dang nar gya ga/ye ri phur bu ma ka/ba su nā yib ma~X bskyangs//gang ba gang ba bzang pa ste//bstan la bya ba byas pa //bram

chen po'i sde rnams so/ /theg chen ston pa'i slob dpon ni/ /phal cher shin tugrags che bas/ /sdom du gsal bar ma bkod kyang / /gtam rgyud bshad pa tsam gyis rtogs/ /'dzam gling rgyan drug yongs su grags pa nyid/ /dpa' bo sgra gcan 'dzin dang yon tan 'od/ /chos skyong rnams la chen po bzhi zhes grags/ /zhi ba lha dang tsan+d+ra go mi la/ /rmad byung slon dpon gnyis zhes mkhas rnamasasgrog /mchog gnyis rgya gar yul na grags pa med/ /rgyan drug mchoge ge nyesazhes byar bod kyis btags/ /ye shes zhabs dang mar me mdzad bzangapo/ /laṅga rgyal bzang dpal 'dzin bha wa bha/ /skal ldan grags pa snyil badz+radang / /mi thub zla ba dam tshig rdo rje dang / /de bzhin gshegs bsrungs byang chub bzang po dang / /pad+ma srung zhes bya ba bcu gnyis po/ /rnam gnon tshuwa gyi sngagasapa'i slob dpon yin/ /de nas mkhas pa sgo drug la sogs dang / /gsang sngagasaslon dpon rnam pa sna tshogs byon/ /zhes pa 'di rnams blo la byang bar bzung na 'og tu 'chad pa'i lo rgyus rnams ma 'dzings pa nyid kyis go bde zhing bshad sla bar 'gyur ro/ /de'ang 'o skol gyi ston pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyasa'ajig rten du bzhugs pa yan chad kyi rgyal po'i rabs rnams ni 'dul ba lung dang / mngon par 'byung ba'i mdo dang / ci rigs pa rgya che rol pa sogasasu'abyung ba nyid yid brtan du gzung bar bya la/ mu stegs byed kyi gzhung lugasarnams las rdzogs ldan dang / gsum ldan dang / gnyis ldan dang / rtsod ldan gyi dus so sor byung ba'i rgyal po dang drang srong la sogs pa'i rabs shin tu mang ba yod na'ang / ci rigs par brdzun tshig kyang 'dres pas mtha' gcig tu yid —4—

brtan dka' ba dang / dam pa'i chos kyi lo rgyus dang 'brel ba gcig kyang med pas/ rnam dkar don gnyer la nye bar mkho ba mi snang bas 'dir mi'abri'o/ /'on kyang de dag gi ston pa'i gzhung lugs ci zhig ce na bha ra ta zhesapa blo ka 'bum lhag bcas dang / ra mā ya na zhes pa rtse pa ka 'bum yod pa zhig dang / aṣ+ṭa da sha pu rā ṇa ste/ sngon gyi rabs bco brgyad ces pa sho ka 'bum lhag bcas yod pa zhig dang / snyan ngag gi bstan bcos ra khyu waX sha zhes pa thokastong phrag brgyad cu pa la sogs pa rnams so/ /'dir ni ston pa'i bstan pa la bya ba byas pa'i lo rgyus rnams brjod par bya ba yin te/ de yang gang gi tshe ston pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi bka' bsdu ba dang po byas pa'i tshe/ lha rnams kyis bstod/ mi'i 'jig rten thams cad du bde zhing lo legs par gyur/lha dang mi rnams bde bas gnas so/ /rgyal po mthong ldan dge ba zhes kyang bya ba ma skyes dgrar grags pa yang rang bzhin gyis bsod nams 'phel bar gyur te/ spong byed ma gtogs grong khyer lnga po thams cad 'thab rtsod med par mas 'og tu chud par gyur to/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dang mchog zung cig dgra bcom pa khri phrag bcu drug stong phrag brgyad dang bcas pa rab tu zhi bar gzims/'od srung chen po yang mya ngan las 'das par gyur pa'i tshe/ skye bo thams cad skyo shasache bar gyur te/ dge slong ston pa'i zhal mthong bas so/ skye bo rnams ni yosargyas bzhugs pa'i tshe bdag cag bag med par gyur pas khyad par ma thob bo zhes yid 'byung bas chos la rtse gcig tu brtson par byed do/ /de bzhin du 'phags pa slob pa rnams kyang tho/ /dge slong gsar bu ston pa'i zhal ma mthong—5—

ba dag ni bdag cag gis ston pa'i zhal ma mthong bas dngos su 'doms par byed pa nyam chung gis/ bstan pa la brtson par ma byas na rab tu 'byams para'agyur ro snyam nas dge ba'i phyogs la shin tu brtson par byed do/ /de'i phyira'abras bu bzhi thob pa nyin re bzhin yang mang du 'phel bar gyur to/ /dus dus su 'phags pa kun dga' bos 'khor rnam pa bzhi la gdams ngag gi lung 'bogs par byed/ sde snod 'dzin pa rnams kyis chos ston par byed pas/ rab tu byung ba thams cad bag yod pas 'tsho bar byed de/ ston pas 'od srung chen po la bstan pa gtad/ des 'phags pa kun dga' bo la bstan pa gtad pa yang don dang ldan par gyur to/ /rgyal po la sogs pa khyim pa'i skye bo thams cad kyang bsod nams kyi mthu dpag par dka' ba'i rgyal po de rnams kyang mthong ba'i spyod yul du ma gyur pas yid 'byung zhing / sngon ni zhing godatshapa ston pa yang mthong na/ da ltar ni de'i slob ma dang / yang slob kyi tshogs tsatshazhig mthong ngo zhes sangs rgyas dang chos dang dge 'dun la dkon pa'i 'du shes nye bar bzhag nas rtag tu gus pas mchod pa dang / dgob la brtson par byed/'thab rtsod la sogs pa med de/ tshul de lta bus lo bzhi bcu tsam 'jig rten dge ba la gnas par gyur to/ /zhes grags so/ /de la 'phags pa kun dga' bos bstan pa bskyangs nas lo bco lnga tsam lon pa na/ khye'u gser mdog gisadagra bcom pa thob ste/ de'i lo rgyus ni gser mdog gi rtogs brjod nyid na gsal lo/ /de'i tshe gser mdog lta bu'i skyid de ba yang tshegs med par dgra bcom pa'i gnas la bkod na/ 'phags pa kun dga' bo ni sangs rgyas dang —6—

'dra ba'i nyan thos so zhes rgyal po ma skyes dgras bsams te/'phags pa kun dga' bo la sogs pa'i dgra bce me pa lnga stong la lo lnga'i bar du yo byad thams cad kyi bstabs pa'i mchode pa byas so//de'i tshe lho phyogs kyi grong khyer ki smi li'i phreng ba bya ba nas/bram ze bha ra dh+wa dza gnod pa can dang rus gcig pa rdekhobya ba sgyu ma'i rigs sngags la shin tu mkhas pa ma ga dhar 'ongs nas/dge slokhornams dang cho 'phrul 'gran par byas so//rgyal po la sogs pa skye bo thams cad la du / sa pa'i gru/dun du/gser dang dngul dang shel dang be+e 'a rje bya' ri bzhi sprul/de re re la rin po che'i skyed rderdetshal bzhi bzhi/tshal re re na pad+ma'i rdzing bu bzhi bzhi/'dab cha lta sna rdeltopas gang ba sprul pa na/'phags pa kun dga' bos glang chen ga tshu po mibazad pa mang po sprul te pad+ma rnams ni zos/rdzing rnams ni tshog/rma dragapo btang ste shing rnams ni bcag/rdo rje'i char phab pas rwa ba dang ri rnams ni lhag ma med par byas so//de nas 'phags pa kun dga' bos lus kyi brded pa lnga brgya tsam bstan te/la la ni 'od 'byin/la la ni char 'ape bas / la la ni mkha' la spyod lam bzhi byed/la la ni stod nas me 'bar zhing smad nas chu 'bru 1 ba pa la sogs pa ya ma zung gi cho 'phrul mang po bstan te slar bsdus so//bha ra dh+wa dza gnod pa can dang rus pa gcig la sogs pa skye bo'i rdeltornams shin tu dad par gyur pa la cho se mang du bstan pas zhag sa dung na gyi khongs su bha ra dh+wa dza la sogs pa bram ze lnga brgya dang gzhan yang skye bo khri phrag brgyad bden pa la bkod do//de nas dus gzhan zhig na 'phags pa kun dag ri bo

rgyal byed kyi tshal na bzhugs pa'i tshe/ khyim bdag sha na'i gos can 3sa lo lngaradage 'dun rnams la dus ston chen po byas te/ mthar 'phags pa'i bkas rab tu byung / rim gyis sde snod gsum 'dzin pa dang / dgra bcom pa gnyis ke'i malas rnam par grol bar gyur to/ /de ltar na snga phyir rim gyis dge slong khri tsamadagra bcom pa'i gnas la yongs su bkod nas/ yul yangs pa can gyi li cabirnams dang / ma ga dha'i rgyal po ma skyes dgra gnyis char gyis gdung gi skal ba thob pa'i don du yul de gnyis kyi bar chu bo ga d+ma'i dbus su bzhugs pa la/drang srong lnga brgyas bsnyen par rdzogs pa zhus pa la/ chu'i dbus su gling sprul/der dge slong rnams kyang 'dus pa la rdzu 'phrul gyis chu tshod gcig kho na la lnga brgya po rnams rim gyis bsnyen par rdzogs nas dgra bcom pa la bkod pas nyi ma gung pa lnga brgya dang / chu dbus pa lnga brgya zhes grags/ de'i gtso bo ni nyi tshagung pa chen po dang / chu dbus pa chen po zhes grags so/ /de nas der myang na las 'das te/ sku gdung rang byung gi mes zhugs la bzhen te/ zin po che'i gongabu lta bu cha gnyis su gyur pa chu'i rlabs kyis bdas te 'gram gnyis su phyin nas/ byang gi ni spong byed pas khyer/ lho'i ni ma skyes dgras khyer te so rbo'i yuladu mchod rten byas so/ /de ltar na kun dga' bos lo bzhi bcur bstan pa brkyangs/ de'i phyi lo rgyal po ma skyes dgra yang 'das te/ yud tsam dmyal b.raskyes nas/ de las shi 'phos nas lhar skyes te/ 'phags pa sha na'i gos can lachos nyan pas rgyun du zhugs pa thob par grags so/ /rgyal po ma skyes dgro'i skabs kyi gtam ste dang po'o// //—8—

de nas rgyal po ma skyes dgra'i bu lag bzang gis rgyal srid byas/ lobacu bdun tsam du sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa mchod de/ de'i tshe 'phags pa sha ne'igos can gyis kyang bstan pa cung zad skyong la/ gtso bor 'phags pa nyi mgungapa yul lbā rā ṇa srir bzhugs te/ 'khore rnams pa bzhi la lung 'bogs parabyed/ bram ze dang khyim bdag rnams la chos ston par byed do/ /dus gzhan zhig na lha rā ṇa sri'i bram ze dang khyim bdag mang po zhig dge slong slong ba po mang po yid sun par gyur te/ dge slong rnams la bsod snyoms kyi spyod yul gzhan na med pa lta zhes kha zer bar gyur pa dang / wa rā ṇa sī las longs spyod mod pa 'ga' yang med zer ba dang / bdag cag gis khyed rnam se gso dgos na khyed dag gis kho bo cag la cung zad cig kyang mi byin pa lta zer ba na/ 'phags pa nyi ma gung pa dgra bcom pa khri phrag gcig gi 'kho 3 gyis bskor nas nam mkha'i lam la 'phur zhing gshegs nas/ byang phyogs ri u shi rar byon no/ /der khyimabadag a dza zhes bya bas/ phyo gas bzhi'i dge 'dun thams cad bsdus te/ dusaston gyi mchod pa lo gcig tu byas pas/ dgra bcom pa bzhi khri bzhi stong 'dusaso/ /rkyen de la brten nas byang phyogs su bstan pa lhag par dar bar gyurato/ /de ltar nyi ma gung pas u shi rar lo gsum du chos bstan to/ /dus de'i tshemanyan yod na 'phags pa sha na'i gos can bzhugs te/ 'khor rnam pa bzhi lachos bstan pas dgra bcom pa stong du nye ba tsam byung ngo / /sngon rgyal po ma skyesadagra yod pa'i tshe/ bram ze'i rigs chos dang mi ldan pa shin tu gdug cing gtso/pa kha zas kyang gtsang rme med par spyod cing / srog chags sna tshogs kyi srog—9—

gcod pa/ pa na dang / na ba zhes bya ba gnyis yod do/ /de gnyis kyis khyima'aga' zhig tu rkun mo byas pa'i rgyus rgyal pos chad pa bcad pa na/ de rnamasashin tu khros pas/ dgra bcom pa mang po la gdugs tshod gsol te dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis gnod sbyin du gyur te/ rgyal po dang ma ga dh+wa pa rnams 'joms paragyur cig ces smon lam btab bo/ /dus lan gcig na de gnyis rims kyisabatab gshi nas gnod spyin du skyes so/ /gang gi tshe rgyal po lag bzang gisargyal srid byas nas lo bdun nam brgyad len pa'i tshe/ de gnyis ma ga dhar gnod spyin gyi sa thob par gyur te/ yul du rims nad wo po bto ngo / /deromi phyugs mang po shi zhing rims chad du ma 'dod pa na/ ltas mkhan rnams kyisade ltar shes te/ ma ga dh+wa pa'i yul pa rnams kyis mnyan yod nas 'phags pa sha na'i gos can spyan drangs te gnod spyin de gnyis 'dul bar gsol bar btab bo/ /des kyang de gnyis gnas pa'i ri gu rba zhes bya bar gshegs te gnod sbyin gyi phug par bzhugs pa na/ de'i tshe gnod sbyin de gnyis gnod spyin gzhan gyi mdun sar song ba las grogs gnod sbyin gzhan zhig gis sbran te/ slar sgosanas rab tu khros pas phug pa'i brag rnams rtib pa na/ yang phug pa gzhan thig byung ste/ de na 'phags pa sha na'i gos can 'dug go /de ltar lan gsus songab na/ de gnyis kyis me sbar bas/ dgra bcom pas de bas kyang tshe ba'i tshephyogs bcur sbar te/ gnod sbyin gnyis skrag ste bros pas/ phyogs thams cad 'bar bas 'bros pa'i sa yang ma rnyed/ der sha na'i gos can la skyabs su songabs me zhi'o/ /de nas chos bstan pas shin tu dad par gyur te skyabs su 'gro ba —10—

dang bslab pa'i gnas la bkod/de ma thag rims kyang zhi/de lta bu'i cho 'phrul bstan pa bram ze dang khyim bdag brgya stong gis mthong ngo //rgyal po'agabazang gi dus su byung ba'i gtam ste gnyis pa'o// //rgyal po de 'das pa na/de'i bu gzhu bzang gis rgyal srid byas te nyi wagung pas kha che'i yul bshul ba dang dus mnyam mo//de yang nyi ma gung pasardzu'aphrul gyis kha che'i gnas su byon/klu gnas pa'i mtsho'i 'gram du bzhugasardeso//de'i tshe klu'i rgyal po au wo 'khor dang bcas pa rnams khros pas rdzi charadrag po phab kyang chos gos kyi mtha' ma g.yos so//mtshon cha sna tshogs kyi charaphab pa me tog tu gyur pas klu dngos su 'ongs te/'phags pa ci bzhed zerapol sa gzhi byin cig gsungs pas/sa gzhi ji tsam/skyil krung gcig gis khyabardepa'i sa'o//'o na 'bul lo//deng rdzu 'phrul gyis skyil krung gcig gis khatsheyul dgu'i sa non par mdzad pa na klu na re/'phags pa la 'khore ji tsam/lnga brgya'o//de las gcig ma tshang nas slar 'phrog go zer ba na/sa 'de ni ston pas lhag mthong dang mthun pa'i gnas su lung bstan pa yin na/gang na sbyin pa po yod pa der slong ba po yod pas/bram ze dang khyim bdag dag kyang 'a ༅ /dgos so//zhes gsungs nas u shir nas 'khor nyi ma gung pa lnga brgya po rnamasadang /wā rā ṇa srinas chos la mngon par dad pa'i bram ze dang khyim bdag bgyostong du ma dang lhan cig kha cher zhugs so//de nas rim gyis yul sna tshogasardenas skye bo du ma 'ongs te/nyi ma gung pa nyid bzhugs pa'i dus la yang grong khyerar+pā po dgu dang /ri bor gyi grong mang po dang /rgyal po'i pho brang godze/dang/

gtsug lag khang bcu gnyis dge 'dun shin tu mang ba dang bcas pas yul brgyan par gyur to/ /de nas kha che'i skye bo'i tshogs rnams rdzu 'phrul gyis ri spos ngad ldan du khrid nas byon te/ me 'bar ba'i cho 'phrul gyis klu rnams btul/chos gos kyi grib mas non pa'i gur gum rnams 'bul bar byas pa la/ dgra bcom pas chos gos chen por sprul te/ de'i grib mas phogs nas skye bo thamasacad kyis gur gum blangs te/ slar yang yud tsam gyis kha cher sleb pa dang / khache'i yul gur gum gyi skye gnas kyis khyab par byas nas/ khyed rnams kyi longasaspyod 'phel ba'i khyad par 'di yin no zhes bstan zhing kha che na gnas pa thams cad bstan pa la btsud nas mya ngan las 'das so/ /des kha che'i yul du lo nyi shu tsam cho se bstan par grags so/ /gang gi tshe nyi ma gung pa kha cher gshegs pa de'i tshe/ 'phags pa sha na'i gos can gyis grong khyer drug la gnas pa'i 'khorarnam pa bzhi la chos ston par byed do/ /nam zhig na rgyal po gzhu bzang rgyal srid lo nyi shu rtsa gsum du brkyangs nas dus las 'das so/ /de'i 'og tu rgyal po de'i 'khor dang zho shas 'tsho ba nyis stong zhig sha na'i gos can la rab tu byung ste/de dag la sogs pa rab tu mang po dag dang lhan cig dur khrod bsil pa'i tshal du dbyar gnas par mdzad do/ /dgag dbye'i tshe dur khrod kyi rgyud lta zhing songabs de thams cad kyis mi sdug pa'i ting nge 'dzin thob ste/ mi ring bar yid labyed pa'i khyad par thams cad bsgrubs nas dgra bcom par gyur to/ /de nasaspos tshong sbas pa'i bu nye sbas bsnyen par rdzogs pa tsam gyis bden pa mthong ngo / /zhag bdun nas dgra bcom pa gnyis ka'i cha las rnam par grol bar gyur—12—

to/ /de nas nye sbas la bstan pa gtad de/ yul tsa spar mya ngan las 'dasaso/ /sha na'i gos can 'dis snga phyir gdams ngag bstan pas bden pa mthongab ni 'bum tsam/ dgra bcom pa yang khri tsam byung ngo / /de la kha che ba rnams ni nyi ma gung pa yang bstan pa'i gtad rabs la nges par bgrang dgos te/ yuladabus su nyi ma gung pas lo bco lngar bstan pa bskyangs pa de'i tshe 'phags pa sha na'i gos can slob ma nyung ngur gnas so / /nyi ma gung pa kha cher gshegs pa nasasha na'i gos can gyis bstan pa bskyangs pa yin pas bstan pa'i gtad rabs brgyad yin no zhes zer la/ gzhan rnams ni nyi ma gung pa kha che 'dul bar ston pas lung bstan zhing / kun dga' bos bka' bsgos pa yin la/ kun dga' bos bstan pa gtad pa ni sha na'i gos can kho na yin pas/ gtad rabasanibadun kho na 'ozhes zer te bod rnams kyang de'i rjes su 'brang ngo / /rgyal po gzhu bzang gi dus su byung pa'i gtam ste gsum pa'o// //de nas nye sbas kyis gaṅgā brgal nas byang phyogs su gshegs nas/ yulalus 'phags zhes bya ba ti rā hu ti'i nub thad kyi yul zhig tu/ khyim bdag ba sus ra zhes bya ba zhig gis gtsug lag khang bzhengs phyogs bzhi'i dge 'dun mchod pa zhig yod pa'i sar bzhugs/ dbyar gnas pa mdzad/ der sa dmasangag bstan pas zla ba gsum de nyid la dgra bcom pa thob pa stong phrag gcig tshang bar byung / de nas ri'i rgyal po gan+ta rar byon nas chos bstan pas kyang skye bo dpag tu med pa bden pa la bkod/ de nas yang yul dbus dang nye ba'i nub byang gi mtshams grong khyer bcom brlag tu byon pa na bcom brlag gi sgo drung na —13—

skye bo mang po tshogs pa'i sar gyad kyi gtso bo tshod pa'i las byed pa na ṭa dang /bha sna zhes bya ba gnyis gtam du gleng pa las/ 'phags pa nye sbas kyi pa byed cing / shir ste mgo bo zhes bya ba'i ri la 'phags pa sha na'i gos can gyidus/ de gnyis rang gis bzhengs pa'i gtsug lag khang du 'phags pa nye sbasaganas 'cha' bar byed na ci ma rung zhes smon par byed do/ /de'i tshe nye sbas kyisargyang ring po nas mthong bas e ma'o ring mo nas dbang po dul ba brjid dang ldan pa 'ong ba 'di ni 'phags pa nye sbas yin yang dag go zhes phan tshun du bgros nas cung zad bsu ru song ste phyag byas nas/ 'phags pa nye sbas la gsasam zhes dris pa la/ 'jig rten du de ltar grags so zhes gsungs pa ga gnamakhan dpa' bo'i gtsug lag khang zhes bya ba mgo bo'i ri la yod pa de phul nas yo byad thams cad kyis stob par byed do/ /der chos bstan pas rab tu byung ba dang khyim pa mang po zhig gis bden pa mthong ngo / /de nas dus gzhan zhin na skyebo 'bum phrag mang po 'dus pa la chos ston zhing yod pa'i tshe/ bdud sdigs gyis grong khyer du 'bras kyi char phab bo/ /de'i tshe skye bo mang po zhig grong khyer du song / lhag ma rnams chos nyan par byed do/ /nyi ma gnyis pa la gos kyi charaphab pas yang skye bo mang po zhig grong khyer du song / de bzhin du gsum pa ladangul gyi char dang / bzhi pa la gser gyi char dang / lnga pa la rin po che sna bdun gyi char phabs pas chos nyan pa'i tshogs pa shin tu bri bar gyur to/ /nyi ma drugapa la bdud sdig can rang nyid lha'i gar mkhan gyi mas su byas/ bu dang chungawabu mo rnams kyang lha'i glu dang gar mkhan gyi gzugs su bsgyur nas gar mkhan —14—

pho mo sum cu rtsa drug grong khyer du byung ste/ gar gyi bkod pa dang sgyu 'phrul gyi ltad mo sna tshogs pa dang / glu dang rol mo'i sgra dbyangs snyan pos skye bo thams cad kyiyid bsgyur nas/ chos nyan pa gcig kyang med do/ /de'i tshe 'phags pa nye sbasakyang grong khyer du byon te/ e ma'o skyes bu dpa' bo khyod rnams kyi gar legasakyi/ bdag gis kyang phreng ba gdags par bya'o zhes re re bzhin gyi mgo dang mgrin par me tog gi phreng ba re bcings so/ /de ma thag tu 'phags pa'i rdzu'aphru’la gyis sdig can 'khore bcas thams cad lus rgas 'gogs shing mi sdug pa gos hrul ba/ mgo la ni mi ro rul pa bcings/ mgrin par ni khyi rob ma pa re btags pa dring na pa phyogs bcur ldang zhing / mthong ba tsam gyis skyugs/para'adren par byin gyis brlabs so/ /der 'dod chags dang ma bral ba'i skye bo thams cad skyo ba dang 'jigs pa dang skyug bro bas sna bkag cing phyir phyogs pas 'dug go /de'i tshe nye sbas kyis kyang sdig can khyod nga'i 'khor la ci'i phyira'atshe/ des smras pa/ 'phags pa bzod par mdzod la bdag cag bcings ba las khrol zhig /gsungs pa/ nga'i 'khor la mi 'tshe na de ltar bya'o/ /smras pa/ bdag gi lus zhig par gyur kyang mi 'che'o/ /de mthag bdud kyi lus rnal du gnas par gyur to/ /des smras pa/ bdag gis byang chub snyingapor go ta ma la kun tu mtho 'tsham par byas na/ de ni byams pa'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas so/ /go ta ma'i nyan thos rnams ni gdug pa pha rol gnon pa ste/ rezhig bdag gis rtsed mo cung zad byas pa la 'phags pas bdag bcings go /de nas nye sbas kyis bdud sdig can de la'ang chos kyi gtam kun tu sbyor bar —15—

byas nas/ ngas ni ston pa'i chos kyi sku mthong na/ /gzugs kyi sku ni tshamathongab las/ /sdig can khyod kyis de mthong ba'i phyir sku'i rnam pa ji lta bu ston cig /des ston pa'i rnam par sprul pa na/ 'phags pa nye sbas rab tu dad pa skyes te/ba sbu langs mchi ma 'khru/ga bzhin du sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal zhes thal mo sbyar ba spyi bor bzhag pas/ bdud sdig can gyis ma bzod de brgyal zhing 'byelabar gyur to/ /der bdud kyang mi snang bar gyur/ tshul des skye bo thams cad yid 'byung zhing dad pa lhag par skyes/ 'bras kyi char phab nga/ nas brtsams te/sngon gyi dge ba'i rtsa bas bskul ba'i skye bo phyogs bzhi nas 'dus pa de rnams thams cad la zhag drug pa de nyid kyi mtshan thog thag tu chos bstan pas nyi ma bdun pa la skye bo 'bum phrag bco brgyad kyis bden pa mthong bar gyur to/ /de nas gar mkhan dpa' bo'i gtsug lag khang du ji srid 'tsho'i bar du bzhugs te/phug srid du khru bcod brgyad pa/ rgyar khri bcu gnyis pa/ dpangs su khru drugapazhig yod la/ nye sbas kyi gdams pas dgo slong rab tu byung ba gcig gis dgra bcom pa thob pa na shing bu sor bzhi pa zhig phug der 'phangs so/ /de nas dusagazhan zhig na tshul de kho nas phug de shing bu de 'dra bas go mtshams med par gang bar gyur to/ /de'i tshe 'phags pa nye sbas kyang yongs su mya ngan las 'dasate/ gdung yang shing bu de rnams kyis zhugs la phul bas/ ring bsrel gcigatugyur pa lha rnams kyis khyer ro zhes grags so/ /'di ni ston pa nyid kyis mas med pa'i sangs rgyas su lung bstan pa ste/ sku la mtshan dpe med pa ma go togasa'agro phan ston pa nyid dang phyogs mtshungs pa'i don yin la/ de bzhin gshegs—16—

pa mya ngan las 'das pa'i 'og tu 'di las 'gro ba'i don che ba ma byung ngo / /nye sbas kyis bstan pa skyong ba'i tshe/ nyi 'og gi rgyal khams phal che ba/ rgyal po gzhu bzang gi bu rgyal po dbang chen gyis rgyal srid bskyangs pa'i lo dgu dang /de'i bu tsa ma shas lo nyer gnyis su rgyal srid bskyangs nga/'i skabs shas che ba yin zhing / de'i tshe rgya gar shar phyogs su dgra bcom pa bla ma zhes bya ba bzhugs pa la rgyal po dbang chen lhag par dad par gyur te/ yul ba gal pa rnams kyis bya gag skyong ba'i ldongs shig tu gtsug lag khang bzhengs te phul/bya gag gi kun dga' ra ba zhes bya bar grags so/ /des kyang nyi 'og go 'khorarnam pa bzhi la gdams ngag mang du bstan pas 'bras bu bzhi thob pa mang du byung / de'i slob ma'i gtso bo ni dgra bcom pa grags pa'o/ /rgyal po wod bang 'das nas rgyal po tsa ma sha rgyal srid la 'khod nas mi ring pa na yul ma ga bhā na bram ze mo dzaXs zhes bya ba lo brgya dang nyi shur nye ba zhig yod do/ /de la bu spun gsum ste/ rgyal ba dang / legs rgyal dang / dge ba zhes bya go /dang po ni lha chen po dbang phyug la mos pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni thub pa ser skya la mos pa'o/ /gsum pa ni yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas la mos pa'o de rnams rang rang gi gzhung lugs legs par byang ste/ khyim gcig tu nyin rebazhin rtsod par byed do/ /der ma/na re/ khyod dag la gos dang kha zas la sogasapa rtag tu phongs pa med par ngas sbyor bar byed na ci'i phyir rtsod/ de rnams na re/ bdag cag kha zas la sogs pa'i phyir rtsod pa ma yin gyi/ ston pa dang chosalas brtsams te rtsod do/ /der ma na re/ rang gi blo gros kyi mthus ston pa dang —17—

ni bzang ngan mi da skye bo she shes rig dri spre la dris dzi3 ༵gartse~X zur ma she nyan spya she sna gas su de 'dzi/ga sa dā na/sa zird pa' gi gta thab pa da da//dzor /gra ba a pa bla ma~X drug/nga du sang na sprel ge nye/rde' rang ring rdzo she zi//prel che/bdang po'i ba/ sa rgyalardekya~Xgrang 'a she saXlaXshe dgeng gtam ni shā/thub she pa miX nga pa'i khrirang ka mthu sags cha ba brjad sa rdzo dā sbyang ming ta zi na dmad ༵ no byad pa phyar dka3 brdzo/ba zhe~Xrde ma gruX par mngan she lha na she par re byad 'a ma//sdang gis/she/ pa la dge she pa bsdid pa na/zugadod dod dge ge rtse5pa ci zhi/kau spe ji sdang swā khang 'grugs ngh+ru dmad pa sad ༷ la na dka' tso she ༷ yad da/she ltar 'ad na mkha' 'gra / dang sran rdi rda/dug da spya65pa 'di rtse 'di ge sde char ra gi dodage /ngang 'a : nge lha pa bang pa rde dag kyaX nga ni ma da rdzo sa mi da//dardezhag 'ad na she rdo dang rnying she cwa bag pa chi sags pa' sa pa ni de par ye 'gra 'a she dag gdan rnyi gā bar blun pa ste mi/ rdeb yan na/)ga 'a pa' sbyar ba kun tu rtsam pa shan tu blun pa / 'a pa 'ga' rdezhag rnyi ma nub bzhi she pa la dbyug pas pa zeju baX tshe bstin byu rdebaka bdag nyada~Xl rdo po bas mas pa ban na//gzhan yang bram dag nyan/ ba / sangs rgyas(rde garten phan btso pa'i//chos ni 'tshe ba med pa yin//de la yid rton de'i rjesaje / lboḥ/ da ge tsho sbyonge 0ri 1dekyizhugs/ yang shar rdzo/ba mad par brjad/tshe/ni / tha nga phan sdoXrde bya ba ༷dzad// las byang dzi thab she nas//rtag no 'a da na dgeXspyadang ni//lnga4 di sdusardephan pa brtsan par 'dams//bram spre'u yang na da sbyang //gzhan

thos pa'i tshig la yang //'dis gnod byas pa'i gtam yod min//kun tudagoba'i ngang tshul 'di'o//drag po dur khrod gnas la dga'//mi sha tshug lnga bu rkangadag za//gtum zhing srog chags gsod dga' bar//lha chen nyid kyi chas las4zhad//gzhung yang 'tshe bas dri mar byas//de la rab yid rton pa yang//rtagatu 'tshe ba longs spyod pa//'di la gabs pa su zhig mgu//dpa' bo yon tan nyid yin na//seng ge stag la sogs pa yang //mchod bya nyid du 'gyur min nam//zhi bar sems pa yon tan nyid//ces pa ni/rgyud chags dang po gi/de dag la sogs pa skyon dang yon tan gyi khyad par bstan pa'i sgo lnga brgya'i bar du rgyud chags bzlas pas bram ze de gnyis kyis kyang bden par go ste/dkon mchog gsum la lhag par dad par gyur to//bram ze'i bu dgob sngar nas dad pa nyid lhag par 'phel bas/de gsum char blo gros gcig par gyur nas rangagi khyim du song ste ma la smras pa/bdag cag rnams kyis sangs rgyas kyi yo 0 shes pas ston pa'i sku gzugs bzhugs pa'i lha khang re bzhengs par byed na/sa gang yin pa mas ston cig de nas ma des bstan pa ltar bram ze rgyal bas ni wā rā ṇa sri'i chos 'khor gnas su sku gzugs kyi lha khang bzhengs so//ston pa nyid bzhugs pa'i gtsug lag khang rnams ni/dngos gnas la sprul pa'i rangabazhin can yin pa'i phyir sprul pa bsdus par mngon na'ang sems can rnams kyi snang ngor ral 'drum la sogs pa'i skyon gyis dus de tsam na shul tsam las med do//de'i phyir bram ze legs rgyal gyis ni rgyal po'i khab kyi 'od ma'i tshal du skugazugs dang lha khang bzhengs/chung ba bram ze dge bas ni/rdo rje'i bdan gyi 9

gan+dho la ste/ dri gtsang khang byang chub chen po dang bcas pa bzhengs te/ bzo bo ni lha yi bzo bo mi'i rnam par sprul te 'ongs pa rnams kyis byas te/ de la byang chub chen po bzhengs pa'i rgyu tshogs rnams dang / lha bzo ba rnams dang bram ze dgob rnams nang du 'dug zhag bdun gyi bar du gzhan su yang nang du mi 'ong b.rabyas pa las zhag drug song ba na/ bram ze sbun gsum gyi ma 'ongs te sgo brdungasaso/ /der zhag drug las ma len te/ nangs par sgo dbye'o zhes byas pas/ man re/ nga ni do nub 'chi ba yin na/ da ni sa'i steng na sangs rgyas kyi zhal mthong ba kho mo kho nar zad pas phyis gzhan gyis sku gzugs de bzhin gshegs pa 'dra ba dang mi 'dra ba mi shes so/ /de bas na nges par sgo phye zhig ces zer bas sgo phye ba na/ bzo bo rnams mi snang bar gyur to/ /der legs par brtags pa na/ 'di ni thams cad kyi thams cad du ston pa dang 'dra na/ 'on kyang mi 'dra ba'i khyad paragasum zhig yod de/ 'od zer spro ba yang med/ chos kyang mi ston/ bzhugs pa kho na las spyod lam gzhan gsum yang mi 'dzad pas so/ /zhes zer te/ sangasargyas dngos dang 'dra ba'i sku gzugs yin skad/ zhag bdun ma lon pas bsi khyad par cung zad ma grub pa ni kha cig zhabs g.yas kyi mthe bong yin par 'dod/ kha cig dbu skra g.yas su 'khyil ba yin par 'dod pas de gnyis phyisabazhengs par byed do/ /'on kyang parnyi ta rnams ni sku la ba sbu dang na bza' sku lam reg pa gnyis ma grub pa yin no zhes gsungs par grags shing / parnyi ta sadabang bzang pos kyang de bzhin du zugad do/ /de'i nub mo bram ze mo dza loX yangaganod pa med par dus las 'das/ de nas mi ring ba nyid na bram ze dgob —20—

lam zhig tu song ba las/ nor bu asma gar+bha rang 'od 'byin pa cig rnyed do/ /des bsam pa byang chub chen po bzhengs ma zin pa'i sngon du rnyed na spyan 'brasabya ba las/ ma rnyed do snyam pa la/ de ma thag spyan 'bras kyi thad du rang byungagokhung bu byung ngo / /de dum bu gnyis su bya bar brtsams pa na de nyid 'dra ba gnyisasu rang gyur te spyan 'bras gnyis kyi sar bcug go /de bzhin du in+d+ra nī lod 'phro ba rnyed de smin mtshams kyi mdzod sbur bcug go /de'i mthus rgyal po rashrīkā yan chad du byang chub chen po'i lha khang gi nang du mtshan mo'ang nor bu'i 'od kyis shin tu gsal bar khyab pa rtag tu byung ngo/ /de'i 'og tu bram ze spun gsum po rnams kyis lha khang gsum po de rnams su dge slong lnga brgya lnga brgya'i 'tsho ba rtag tu sbyor zhing / phyogs bzhi'i dge 'dun thams cad yo byad kyisamachod par byas so/ /'phags pa nye sbas kyi dus su byung ba'i gtam ste bzhi pa'o /de yang 'phags pa nye sbas kyis 'phags pa dhī ti ka la bstan pa gtad de/ de'i lo rgyus ni yul 'phags rgyal du bram ze phyug po nor mang ba zhig yod do/ /de la bu dhī ti ka zhes bya ba yod te gsal ba mkhas pa yid gzhungs pa rigabyed bzhi dang rig pa'i gnas bco brgyad la byang bar gyur nas/ pha rab tumagunas khyim phub ste bag ma blang bar brtsams pa na des smras pa/ bdag ni khyim gyi 'dod pa med kyis/ rab tu 'byung du stsol cig phas smras pa ci sto khyod gdon miza bar rab tu byung yang ji srid nga ma shi'i bar du rab tu ma byung zhig 'khor busaze 'di rnams kyang khyod kyis skyongs shig des kyang pha las nyan te mdu 21

tshangs par spyod pas gnas nas bram ze lnga brgya po de rnams la 'tshe ba med pa'i rig pa dag ston par byed do/ /dus nam zhig na pha 'das par gyur te/ khyim kyi 'byor pa thams cad dge spyong dang bram ze la btang ste 'khor lnga brgya dang bcas pa kun tu rgyu'i ma༅su zhugs te/ grong khyer chen po bcu drug tu rgyu zhing/ mustegs can dang bram ze che ba che bar grags pa rnams la tshangs par spyod pa'i lam dris kyang mgu ba'i lan ma byung ste/ mthar bcom brlag tu 'phags pa nye sbas la dris so/ /der lhag par dad pas rab tu byung zhing bsnyen par rdzogs nas nye sbas kyis gdams pa rnam pa bdun bstan pas zhag bdun gyis bram ze lnga brgyas dgra bcom pa thob par gyur te/ 'phags pa dhi ti ka ni rnam par tharapa brgyad la bsam gtan par byas so/ /des yul dang yul gyi bram ze'i go5bo mang pos sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la mchog tu dad pa la bkod do/ /gangagotshe 'phags pa nye sbas kyis bstan pa gtad pa de'i tshe grong khyer drug po rnams su 'khor rnam pa bzhi la lung phog sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rab tu rgyas par byagasems can thams cad bde ba la yongs su bkod do/ /dus lan cig thog ra gyi yul na rgyal po mi nar zhes bya ba yod do/ /yul de na gnas pa thams cad ni nam mkha'i lha la mchod par byed kyi/ gzhan du na dge ba tsam dang sdig pa tsamayang shes pa med de/ de dag dus ston gyi tshe 'bru dang gos dang rin po che dngadribazang po'i shing mang po bsregs pa'i dud pa chen pos nam mkha' la mchod par byed do/ /de rnams mchod pa byed pa'i sar 'phags pa dhi ti ka 'khor dgra bcom pa lnga brgya dang bcas pa nam mkha'i lam nas byon te/ bkad sang—22

bzhugs so/ /de rnams kyis kyang nam mkha'i lha yin par bsams te/ zhabasal phyag byas nas rgya cher mchod pa la chos bstan pas rgyal po la sogs pa skye bo stong snyed kyis bden pa mthong ngo / /skye bod pag tu med pa skyabs su 'grob dngabaslab pa'i gnas la bkod/ dbyar zla ba gsum du der bzhugs pas dge slongayang dpag tu med pa 'phel/ dgra bcom pa thob pa'ang stong tsam byung tho/ /de nas yul de dang kha che'i bar du lam 'gro 'ong ci bde ba dod par gyur nas kha che'i gnas brtan mang po der 'ongs te/ bstan pa ches dar bar gyur/ rgyal po de nyid dang de'i sras i ma rtsi yi dus kho na la yang gtsug lag khang chen po lnga bcu tsam dge 'dun grangs med pa dang bcas pas gang bar gyur to/ /yang shar phyogs kā ma rū pa na bram ze sidha zhes bya ba longs spyod rgyal po chen po dang mnyam pa 'khor stong phrag mang po dang bcas pa nyi ma mchod pa la brtson par byed do/ /des nyi ma mchod pa'i dus zhig na/ 'phags pa dhi ti kas nyi me'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus nas 'ongs pa'i cho 'phrul bstan te/ 'od zer mang po sprobazhin du 'dug go /des kyang nyi ma yin par bsam te/ mchod cing phyag 'tshalab la chos bstan pas dad pa shin tu che bar gyur pa'i tshe/ 'phags pa nyid kyi lus su snang bar byas so/ /slar yang chos bstan pas bram ze des bden pa mthong zhing dad pa chen pos mchod rten chen po zhes bya ba'i gtsug lag khang byas so/ /der phyogs bzhi'i dge 'dun rnams la dus ston chen po yang byas te/yul kā ma rū par sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa lhag par dar bar byas so/ /de'i tshenub phyogs ma la wan bram ze dregs med ces bya ba cod pan ma bcings pa'i —23—

rgyal srid la gnas so/ /de ni nyin re bzhin ra skyes stong stong bsad de sha khragagi spyin sreg byed do/ /de la sbyin sreg gi thab kyang stong yod do/ /rang ni 'thor bram ze thams cad kyang so so'i 'byor pa dang 'tsham par a dza me dha'i spyin sreg byed du 'jug go /bram ze ma yin pa rnams kyang mchod spyin gyi rgyu tshogs gsogatu 'jug go /dus nam zhig na de go me dha ste ba lang gtsang ma'i mchod spyin byed par 'dod pas/ ngan spong gi rigs kyi drang srong rtso ku ra kā sa zhes bya ba 'di1 sbyin byed pa por bos/ ba lang dkar gsal khri phrag gcig bsags shing/bram ze rab tu mang po dag kyang bos/ spyin pa'i yo byad gzhan mang po yangabashams/ sbyin sreg byed par brtsams pa na/ 'phags pa dhī ti ka mchod sbyin gyi sar 'ongs te/ der thabs gang gis kyang me sbar bar ma nus/ ba 'ang rnamasathabs gang gis kyang bsad par ma nus shing rma byung bar ma nus so/ /bram ze rnams kyis rig byed dang rig sngags bton pas kyang sgra ma byung ngo / /der lha kurak+ṣa sa na re/ mchod sbyin 'grub pa'i gegs 'di ni dge sbyong 'di'i mthu'o/ /der thams cad kyis rdo dang dbyug pa dang thal ba 'phangs pas metogadang tsan+dan gyi phye mar gyur pa mthong ba na/ de rnams dad pas zhabs la phyag byas te bzod par gsol nas/ 'phags pa bka' ci zhig stsole// 'phags pa na re/kye bram ze rnams thong zhig mchod spyin sdig pa ngan pa 'dis ci ga bya/ spyin pa dag byin/ bsod nams dag gyis shig bdag bram ze'i rigs kyi lha yin zhing / me'i bya ba byed pa zhig yin na ni lha dang pha ma bsad pas ci zhig tu'agyur/ ba lang gi sha kun tu mi gtsang ba bram zes reg par bya ba yang ma yin —24—

na/ lha rnams tshim par 'gyur re skan/ drang srong sdig pa'i chos 'di thos/shigasha yi bza' ba la sred pas/ sreg blugs 'dis khyod ci zhig 'gyur/ sgyumasagaso bar ston pa ni/ /rig sngags 'jig rten bslus pa yin/ zhes bya ba lasogs pa chos rgya cher bstan pas/ de rnams sdig pa'i las la ni 'gyod/ rangagi spyod pa la ngo tsha bas gdong smad de bcom chung ngus sdig pa zhi thabs dris so/ /de'i thabs 'phags pas bstan pa ltar bram ze de thams cad skyabasasu'agro ba dang bslab pa'i gnas lnga la bkod/ khyim bdag gdangs can gyi kun dga' ra ba'i shul du gtsug lag khang chen po byas te rdzas las byung ba'i bsod nams bdun la brtson par byed do/ /de ltar yul der bstan pa lhag par rgyasapar mdzad do/ /dus de tsam na rgyal po mya ngan med skyes nas yun ring ma len pa'i dus so/ /de dag gi rjes su rim gyis bram ze lnga brgya tsam dkon mchogaladad par byas te/ yun ring por sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa yongs su bskyang༅rdeshing / sems can la phan par mdzad nas/ 'phags pa nag po la bstan/ pa gtad de ma la wa'i yul gyi khyad par 'phags rgyal gyi yul du mya ngan las 'das so/ /'phags pa dhī ti ka'i dus kyi gtam ste lnga pa'o// //dus de tsam na rgyal po mya ngan med gzhon nur gyur pa'i skabs go /de'i gtam rgyud ni tha dra'i rgyud du gtogs pa yul tsa spa a rje zhes bya bar nyi ma'i rigs kyi rgyal po ne sī ta zhes bya ba blon po lnga brgya dang bcas 'byor pa chen pos byang phyogs kyi sa la dbang sgyur bar byed do/ /de la dang por bu drug yod de/ dge ba can dang / shing rta can dang / dung can dang/nor ho dang / pad+ma —25—

can dang / drug pa ni gser can no/ /dus gzhan zhig na tshong dpon gyi chungamazhig rgyal po dang 'dus pa las sbrum mar gyur zhing / nam zhig na rgyal po de'i ma'adas pa'i mya ngan bsal ba'i nyin par tshong dpon gyi chung ma las khye'u btsas pas 'di ni mya ngan bsal ba'i nyin par btsas pa'i phyir/ 'di'i ming mya phan med par thogs shig ces de ltar btags/ cher skyes pa'i tshe sgyu rtsal drugastodang / brtag pa bgyod dang / yi ge dang lag rtsis la sogs pa shin tu byang b.ragyur pa'i skabs shig na/ skye bo'i dbus su bram ze ltas mkhan zhig la blon po rnams kyis rgyal po'i bu su zhig rgyal srid byed par 'gyur zhes dris pag zasakyi mchog za/ gos kyi mchog gon/ stan gyi mchog la 'dug pa des go /derablon po'i mchog gnyis kyi lkog tu dris pas/ zas kyi mchog 'bras chan/ gosakyi mchog ras sbom po/ stan gyi mchog gzhu'o/ /zhes bstan pas rgyal po'i bu gzhan rnams ni phun sum tshogs pa'i dpal 'byor can yin la/ mya ngan med ni zas gos phal pa de rnams la longs spyod pas de rgyal por 'gyur bar shesaso/ /bar skabs der bal yul dang / kha sh+ya'i yul sogs kyi ri bor ba mang po ngo log go /de rnams 'dul bar mya ngan med dmag dang bcas pa btang pasadaka' ba med par ri bor ba rnams phab ste dpya phab/ gte'u bzung lo thangabacad de rgyal po la phul bas/ rgyal po na re/ khyod kyi blo dang stobs dang dpa' ba gang yin pa la kho bo mgu yis/ ci 'dod pa spyin no/ /des bdag phyogasa'adir sbun gzhan rnams kyis 'tshe bas/ grong khyer pa ṭa li pu tra gnas su stsol ba dang / 'dod pa'i yo byad thams cad kyang 'tshal lo/ /des kyang / byin te grong —26—

khyer der skyed mos tshal lnga brgya byas shing / bud med rol mo thogs pa stong gisabaskor te wo mawo du 'dod pa'i yon to rnams la rtse bar byed do/ /de nasayul ma ga dhar rgyal po tsa ma sha dus las 'das/ de la bu bcu gnyis yod pa 'ga' zhig rgyal srid du bskos kyang rgyal sa ma zin/ blon po bram ze ngang tshuwazab pa zhes bya bas lo 'ga' zhig tu rgyal srid byas so/ /de'i tshe rgyal po ne grwa ta dang de gnyis dgrar gyur pas gasnye'i 'gram du yun ring du g.yul 'gyed pa las rgyal po'i bu thu bo drug ni g.yul gyi las la zhugs pa las/ de tsam na rgyal bo ni sī ta yang dus las 'das so/ /rgyal po shi ba'i gtam bsgrags na ni/ ma gaṅgā pa stobs che bar 'gyur ro snyam nas gsang ste/ rgyal srid kyi bya ba blon po ge nyesanyid kyis byas pa las/ zhag bdun nas grong khyer gyi skye bo rnams kyis shes te sgro po de gnyis kyi ngag gcog par byed do/ /de'i tshe sngon bram zes lung bska pa'i dus ni 'di yin no bsams te/ mya ngan med bos te rgyal srid la bzhanago /rgyal po'i bu drug po ma ga dh+wa pa las rgyal te grong khyer drug po thob pa de'i lpin par mya ngan med rgyal srid la 'khod do zhes thos nas blon po lnga brgya'i tshogs dang bcas pa ga d+ma'i byang phyogs su ma 'ongs par rgyal po'i khab la sogs pa'i grong khyer lnga dang / drug pa ni grong khyer aṅga ste/ grong khyer drug po de dag tu rgyal po'i bu re res rgyal srid byas/ de yang rgyal po'i bu dang po ni 'garten rgyang pan gyi gsang tshig la mos so/ /gnyis pa ni lha chen po la mos so/ /gsum pa ni khyab 'jug la/ bzhi pa ni rig byed mtha'i gsang ba smyab la/ lnga pa ni gcer bu pa gser can la/ drug pa ni bram ze ku sha'i bu zhes bya —27—

ba'i tshangs par spyod pa la mos te/ de dag gis kyang rang rang gi gnas bzhi dag byas so/ /mya ngan med ni rtso ku'i rigs kyi drang srong mkha' 'gro ma dang /srin po mchod par byed pa dag gis ngag tshig la brten te/ lha mo u ma dur khrod kyi ma mor bcas pa la lhar 'dzin no/ /de nas lo 'ga' zhig tu 'dod yon larnam par rtse bas gnas pa las/ ka ma a sho ka ste 'dod pa'i mya ngan med cesagrag go /de nas nam zhig phu bo rnams dang mi mthun par gyur te lo mang po'i bar du 'thabs shing / mthar phu bo drug blon po lnga brgya dang bcas pa yangabasad/ gzhan yang grong khyer mang po btsom nas/ kha ba can dang / ri bo 'bigs byed kyi bar gyi yul kun la dbang bsgyur la/ shin tu khro gtum tshe bar gyur kla sa chad pas gcod pa'i bya ba rnams ma byas par sems rnal du mi gnas par kha zas kyang mi za ste/ nyin mo'i dang po la gsod pa dang / tshaja ba dang/brdeg pa la sogs pa chad pas gcog pa'i bya ba rnams bsgos nas de'i 'og tu sems rnal du 'dug nas kha zas la 'jug go /de ltar rgyal po de'i dar gagogatam ni shin tu mang bar yod na'ang dgos pa med pa'i phyir ma bshad do/ /zhes sa dbang bzang po gsung la/ rgya gar ba'i gtam rna bar brgyud pa 'ga' rethos mod/ 'dir yang ma bris so/ /de'i tshe bram ze log par lta ba rnams kyisabaskul te srog gi mchod sbyin la brtson par byed cing / khyad par lha ku'i rigasakyi drang srong ba lang rna ba zhes bya bas mi khri phrag gcig bsad pa'i mchod sbyin byas na rgyal srid kyang rgyas shing thar ba'i rgyur 'gyur ro zhes bstan pa las mchod sbyin gyi khang pa brtsigs/ mi khri phrag gcig gsod par nus pa phyogs—28—

kun tu btsal yang re zhig ma rnyed/ mthar ti rā hā ti nas gdol pa'i rigasashig rnyed de/ gang gsod par 'os pa thams cad khang pa der ge tong la/ khro phragagacig ma longs kyi bar du der byung tshad sod cig 'di ni dka' thub zlogawamachod pa'i dam bca'o zhes rgyal po nyid kyis khas blangs te/ tshul des mi stongangam nyis stong tsam bsad pa na/ gsod pa po de grong khyer gyi phyi rol tu rgyu ba la/dge slong zhig gis de'i spyod pa bzlog tu re nas srog gcod pa'i nyes dmigs dmyal ba'i gtam sna tsho go/sa pa dag bsha/da pas dge ba'i rtsa ba ni sad ma nus par gshed ma des bsams pa/ sngar ni mi rnams mgo bcad de bsad na/ da ni dge slong 'di'i gtam las thos pa de 'dra ba kho nar sreg pa dang / gtub pa dang / pags pa bsdo/ ba la sogs pa sna tsho gis pas bsad du ru dzapra snyam ste/ de lta bus mang du bsad nas mchod sbyin khang pa der mi lnga stong tsam bsad do/ /de'i tshe sngar gyi ming 'gyur te/ tsaṇ+ḍal a sho ka zhes gtum po mya ngan med du grags so/ /de'i skabs dgra bcom pa grags pa'i slob ma dge tshul mang du thosapa sbyor lam gyi rtogs pa la gnas pa zhig lam rgyus ma shes par mchod spyin khang pa'i nang du sleb bo/ gshed mas ral gri brdeg par brtsams pa na rgyu mtshan dris so/ /des kyang sngar gyi gtam bshad pas/ 'o na zhag bdun nasasod cig de bar du kho bo yang gzhan du mi 'gro yi/ mchod sbyin khang pa leganyid du 'dug par bya'o/ /zhes smras pas gshed mas kyang de ltar rung zer/ des kyang mchod spyin gyi gnas de nyid sha khrag rus pa nang khrol rnams kyis yongs su gang ba de nyid mthong ba'i rkyen gyis mi rtag pa la sogs pa bden pa'i rnam pa bcu 29—

drug mngon du byas/ zhag bdun gyi sngon du dgra bcom pa yang thob/ rdzu lnga yi/yang grub bo/ /zhag bdun song ba'i nyin par cha lugs 'di lta bu sngon chad khangapa 'dir ma byung bas/ sngar ma byas pa' gsod lugs bya'o zhes zangs chen po til mar gyis bkang ba'i nang du dge tshul bcug nas me btang stobasregasapas lpin mtshan du me 'bar bar gyur kyang de'i lus la cung zad kyang gnod par ma gyur nas/ rgyal po la sbran pas rgyal po ya mtshan skyes te/ de lta bo'i phyiramachod sbyin khang par 'ongs so/ /der gshed ma des ral gri thogs te rgyugasanas byung ba na rgyal pos rgyu mtshan dris pas/ 'di ni rgyal bo nyid kyis dmabacas pa'i tshig ste/ mi khri phrag gcig tu ma longs kyi bar du khang pa 'dirasubyung ba de thams cad bsad par bya'o/ /rgyal pos smras pa/ 'o na nga'i snga rol du khyod ṣ+ka 'dir 'ongs pa'i phyirasngar bsad do zhes de gnyis 'thab par gyur pa na dge tshul des char 'bab pa dang / klog 'gyu ba dang / nam mkha' la 'gro ba la sogs pa'i cho 'phruwa bstan pas rgyal po dang gshed ma gnyis char lhag par dad par gyur te/ zhubasalaphyag byas shing / byang chub kyi sa bon rab tu sad par gyur to/ /de nas des chosabastan pas rgyal po sdig pa'i las la shin tu 'gyod par gyur te mchod sbyin gyi khang pa yang de nyid du bshig sdig pa sbyang ba'i phyir dge tshul la bzhugs parazhus pas/ rgyal po khyod kyi sdig pa sbyong thabs ngas bstan par mi nus kyis sharaphyogs bya gag gi kun dga' ra ba na/ mkhan po dgra bcom pa grags pa'i rgyalarjematshan zhes bya ba bzhugs te/ des rgyal po khyod kyi sdig pa sbyong bar 'gyuraro—30—

zhes lung bstan pa ltar rgyal pos kyang dgra bcom pa'i drung du 'phrin brdzangs te/'phags pa pa ṭa li pu trar byon te bdag gi sdig pa sbyong bar zhu/ galate'aphags pa 'dir mi 'byon na bdag der 'ong ngo zhes byas pas/ rgyal po derabyung na skye bo mang po la gnod par mkhyen nas/ dgra bcom pa grags pa nyid pa ṭa li pu trar byon te/ nyin re bzhin rgyal po'i thad du chos bstan/ mtshan rebazhin gtsug lag khang du byon nas 'khor rnam pa bzhi la gdams ngag 'bogs so/ /gang gi tshe dgra bcom pa grags pa dang mjal ba phyin chad nas rgyal po de shin tu dad pa che bar gyur nas/ lpin mtshan du dge ba'i bya ba kho nas dusa'ada' ste/ nyin re bzhin dge slong khri khrag gsum gsum mchod par byed do/ /bar skabs der sgra bcom pa grags pa'i ma ga dh+wa la sogs pa'i yul gzhan du bzhugs pa'i skabs shig rgyal pos tshong pa lnga brgya tsam nor bu'i gling nas norabu len par mngags nas/ de rnams kyis kyang gru legs par grub ste/ zin poche sna tshogs pas bkang nas tshur 'ongs/ rgya mtsho'i tshur 'gram du ngal gso zhingabasdad pa las/ klu rnams kyis mtsho rlabs btang ste zong thams cad rgya mtshorakhyer ro/ /de nas de rnams 'tsho ba gzhan la rag las shing rim gyis 'ong༅pas/ nam zhig na zhag bdun na sna'i pa rnams pa ṭa li pu trar sleb bar grags shing / de rnams kyis ji ltar gyur pa'i gtam ma thos pas bram ze dang / kun turgyu dang / skye bo'i tshogs dpag tu med pa dag 'dus te/ nor bu rnams kyi kha dog dang ngo mtshar ba'i yon to gang yin pa de mthong bar 'gyur ro zhes zhag bdun pa'i lpin par rgyal po skye bo'i tshogs dag bcas pa skyed mos tshal du song —31—
