rdzogs zhes bya bas bstan pa la phan cher btags te/ nyan thos kyi sde snod rgyasapar byas/ ma ga dhar chos gzhi drug cu btsugs so/ /de'i tshe nub phyogs molatān zhes bya ba'i grong khyer bā ga da zhes bya bar kla kle'i ston pa'i rjes su zhugs pa stag gzigs sog po'i rgyal po ha la lu zhes bya ba byung wo/ /de rta 'bum rnyed dang ldan pa'i dbang thang chen por gyur te/ rgya gar gyi yul du kla klo byung ba'i thog ma yin par grags so/ /rgyal po bhaX sa tsan+t+ra'i che'i gzhug dang / galatsan+t+ra'i dus su shar phyogs su bram ze kā shi dzā ta zhes bya ba ka byung ste/ sngar gyi chos gzhi thams cad gus pas mchod/ khyad par bha ṅga la'i grong khyer su na ra gha bo zhes bya bar chos smra ba drug cu rtsa bzhi dang / de re re la chos nyan pa bstobacu dang bcas pa'i 'tsho ba sbyar/ bstan pa nyams pa sos par byas go /de dag ni slob dpon klu sgrub dpal gyi rir bzhugs pa'i dus dang / de rjes ring poramalon pa'i skabs su byung ba'o/ /bstan pa la dgra dang po byung zhing slar sor chud pa'i skabs te bcu drug pa'o// //de nas rgyal po swa la tsan+d+ra gusta ste zla ba sbas pa zhes bya ba byung / de mnga' thang shin tu che bas tsan+d+ra bcu la bgrang / dge sdig 'dres mar byed cing/ sangasargyas la skyabs su song ba ma yin pas tsan+t+ra bdun la mi 'dren zhing rgyal po 'di'i dus dpal nā len+t+ra ra slob dpon ār+ya de wa dang / nā ga hā wa zhes pa slob rgar+sha/ klu bos kyis bstan pa rgya cher bskyangs so/ /de la slob dpon ār+ya de wa ni bod rnams la yongs grags ltar na/ siṅga gling gi rgyal po'i skyed mos tshal du pad+ma las brdzus te skyes shing / rgyal pos kyang sras kyi dod du bskyang ga mthar slob —83—

dpon klu sgrub kyi slob mar gyur nas/ slob dpon klu sgrub bzhugs pa'i dus na mu stegs thub dka' nag po btul bar 'dod la/ 'ga' zhig ni der ma zad grub thob ka rna ri pa dang gcig pas klu sgrub bzhugs pa'i dus nyad du 'ja' lus su gshegs so zhes zer/ bod 'dir ni dag rung mi dag rung gtam gangayang rung ba grags chen pos skye bo kun la yongs su khyab pa zhig yod na shin tu bden pa'i don can gzhan zhig smras kyang rna bar mi 'ong zhing / yid la mi bde ba zhig snang na'ang 'dir dngos gnas su brjod na/ bzhi brgya pa'i 'grel paraslob dpon zla ba grags pas kyang siṅga la'i gling gi rgyal po'i sras su bshad/'phags yul gyi gtam khungs ma la yang de bzhin du grags pas de ltar bshad na/ siṅga la'i gling gi rgyal po pa nyu phre| gaX zhes bya ba zhig la sras mtshan dang ldan pa shig byung / cher skyes nas rgyal tshab kyi sa la bzhag kyang rab tu byung ba lalhag par mos par gyur te/ mkhan po he ma de wa zhes bya ba las rab tu zhi byungangabasnyen par rdzogs/ sde snod gsum po mtha' dag chub par byas pa na yul sna tshogs kyi lha khang dang mchod rten dag blta ba'i phyir 'dzam bu'i gling du byon/slob dpon klu sgrub rgyal po bde byed kyi sa nas dpal gyi rir gshegs pa dang nye ba'i tshe mjal te dpal gyi rir slob dpon gyi zhabs pad bsten zhing bcud len la sogs pa'i dngos grub mang po thob par mdzad nas mthar snying po'i don gyi bstan pa'ang gtad do/ /slob dpon klu sgrub sku 'das pa'i 'og rol du de dang nye ba'i lho phyogs kyi rgyud rnams su slob ma dang nyan bshad la sogs pas sems can gyi don mdzad cing / ri'i lha dang shing gi lha la sogs pa las yo byad —84—

blangs nas/ gtsug lag khang nyi shu rtsa bzhi bzhengs/ gnod sbyin mo skal pa bzang mos 'tsho ba sbyar te de thams cad du theg pa chen po'i chos gzhi re btsugs so/ /de'i tshe shar phyogs na li ni'i grong khyer khor ta zhes bya bar byung ba bram ze thub dka' nag pos yul dang yul thams cad du phyin te/ sangs rgyasapa'i bstan pa rtsod pas pham par byas nas/ dpal na len+t+ra ra 'ongs pa nasasangs rgyas pa rnams kyis rtsod par ma nus nas slob dpon ār+ya de wa spyan drang pa'i phyir 'phrin yig bris te nag po chen po la gtor ma byas pa na/ nag po chen po'i rdo sku rang byon gyi thugs ka nas bya rog cig byung ste/ de'i mgul par yigobatags pas 'phar te lho phyogs su song ste slob dpon la gtad pas/ slob dpon gyis kyang 'dul ba'i dus su mkhyen nas/ rkang mgyogs kyi rdzasalabarten te tshur byon/ lam du mu stegs kyi rigs kyi bud med cig dngos grub kyi rdzas kyi don du dge slong mkhas pa'i mig dgos par byung nas spyan ya gcig slong pa la de byin te/ thun tshod gcig gi yun tsam la nā len+t+ra ra phebs/ deramustegs kyi dpung gnyen sring mo pa'i ta dang / ne tso dang / thod le kor rnams dge bsnyen spyi brtol can dang / byi la dang / mar nag gi bum pa rnams kyis btul/phyogs thams cad rig sngags kyis bcings shing gos khrul la sogs pasabaskor bas dbang phyug chen po nyed rgyud la 'jug par yang ma nus/ yun ring du rtsod pa byas pas kyang slob dpon gyis de lan gsum du tshar bcad do/ /de rigasngags kyi mthus nam mkha'i lam las 'bros par brtsams pa las slob dpon gyis de'i sngags bcings te bzung nas/ gtsug lag khang zhig tu btson du —85—

bcu/ga pa la glegs bam rnams bklags pas ring nyid lung bstan pa'i mdo sdemathong nas/ sngar bstan pa la bya ba ma yin pa byas pa la ni 'gyod/ sangs rgyasal dad pa ces cher 'phel bar gyur nas/ rab tu byung ste ring por mi thogasapar sde snod gsum 'dzin par gyur to/ /de nas slob dpon ār+ya de was na len+t+ra ra yang yun ring du bzhugs shing / mthar yang lho phyogs kyi rgyud du gshegs nas sems can gyi don rgya chen po mdzad de yul kañci dang nye ba'i raX ga nā tha zhes bya bar sgra gcan 'dzin bzang po la snying po'i don gyi bstan pa gtad nas sku 'das so/ /slob dpon ār+ya de wa dang dus mtshungs pa la/ lho phyogs kyi rgyud du slob dpon klu bos zhes bya ba mtshan dngos ta thā ga ta bha dra sto de klu rnams kyis spyan drangs te/ klu'i yul du lan bdun byon pa yin la/ theg pa chen po'i mdo sde du ma rnam par bshad pa mdzad cing / rnam rig gi dbu ma cung zad gsal bar mdzad do/ /da lta bod du 'gyur ba'i sku gsum la bstod pa yang slogadapon 'dis mdzad pa yin zhing / khyad par slob dpon des snying po'i bstod pa zhes bya ba'i bstan bces kyang mdzad la/ de'i tshe lho phyogs kyi rgyud bi t+ya na garal sogs pa phal che bar de bzhin bshegs pa'i snying po'i mdo'i tshigs bcad rnams grong khyer gyi khye'u bu mo tshun chod kyis skur len pa byung zhing / de tsang du bstan pa rgyas par mdzad nas/ slar yang dpal nā len+t+ra'i mkhan po yun ring du mdzad do/ /slob dpon 'di yang klu sgrub kyi slob ma'o/ /yang shar phyogs bhaX gala'i yul gyi bram ze rgan rgon gnyis la bu zhig kyang yod cing / longs spyod kyis dbul ba la slob dpon klu sgrub kyis gser mang po gnang bas lhag par —86—

dad de/ de gsum char gyis slob ma byas/ bu des slob dpon gyi nye dzinas byasashing bcud len gyi dngos grub kyang thob pa na/ rab tu byung ste sde snod gsu5lamakhas par byas pa ni slob dpon klu'i byang chub bo/ /des kyang slob dpon klusgrub bzhugs kyi bar du slob dpon gyi g.yog byed cing / sku 'das pa na dpalagyi ri'i phyogs cig phug zab mo zhig tu 'dug nas rtse gcig tu bsgoms pas lo bcu gnyis na phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub thob/ sku tshe nyi zla dang mnyatshapas gnas de nyid du bzhugs so/ /mtshan gyi rnams grangs gnyis yod de/ na ga bo dhi klu'i byang chub dang / nā ga snyo klu'i blo'o/ /yang grub thob shing kha ba zhes bya ba byung ste/ slon dpon klu sgrub 'khor stong tsam dang bcas te byang phyogs ri.ushi rar bzhugs pa'i skabs shig slob ma shin tu blo rtul ba/ tshigs bcad gcig kho na yang nyin zhag mang por 'dzin mi thub pa zhig la/ kyal ka'i tshul gyis mgo la rwa skyes par bsgoms shig ces gsungs pas des kyang bsgoms pa na/ dmigs pa shin tu rno bas de ma thag tu reg mthong gi mtshan ma grub nasarang sdod pa'i phug pa la rwa thogs so/ /de nas slob dpon gyis dbang po rno b.ramakhyen te/ yang rwa de med par sgom du bcug pas med par song / de la rdzogasapa'i rim pa'i khyad par 'ga' zhig bstan nas sgom du bcug pas/ des kyangamiring bar phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub thob/ de nas slob dpon snyen ra bcasakyis zla ba drug tu dngul chu'i bcud len bsgrubs so/ /grub nas slob ma so so la ril bu 'gyed pa na des ni ril bu de la mgo gshugs te/ ci bder bor nas song bas slob dpon gyis rgyu mtshan dris pa na/ bdag la ni 'di'i dgos pa tsha—87—

mchis te/ gal te slob dpon nyid 'di lta bu bzhed na snod chus gang ba dag sta gon mar+sā cig ces zer ro/ /der chang snod wo po stong phrag gcig a bkang ste nags tshal de gang ba ltar byas pa la/ de nyid kyi dri chu thigs pa re re snod de dag tu blug pas de thams cad grub pa'i bcud len gser 'gyur rtsir gyur to/ /slob dpon klu sgrub kyis de dag thams cad ri de'i phyogs cig gi brag phugabagrod dka' ba zhig tu gter du sbas/ ma 'ongs pa'i sems can gyi don byed par smon lam btab bo/ /blo rtul po grub pa thob pa de la ni shing khi pa ste rwa can pa zhes bya ba'o/ /slob dpon shākya bshes gnyen chen po yang slob dpon klu sgrub kyi slob ma yin par nges mod kyi lo rgyus ma mthong zhing ma thos so/ /grub chen shā bā ri pa'i lo rgyus ni rin chen 'byung gnas lta bu'i gtam du bshad zin la/grub thob ma tang gi yang klu grub yab sras kyi slob mar grags pa ni dus 'di skabs byung ba ni min/ phyis zhal mthong ba'o/ /slob dpon ār+ya de wa la sogasapa'i dus kyi gtam ste bcu bdun pa'o// //de nas rgyal po zla ba sbas pa'i bu snying po thig le zhes bya ba yul go rar byung ba lo sum cu so lnga rgyal srid byas/ slob dpon bram ze tsan ka zhes bya bsakhro bo chen po gshin rje gshed bsgrubs te zhal mthong bas rig sngags kyi mthu shin tu che bar gyur/ grong khyer wo po bcu drug tsam gyi rgyal po dang blon po rnams mngon spyod kyi las kyis bsad cing / de'i shul du rgyal pos dmag byasapas shar nub phyi'i rgya mtsho la thug pa tsam la dbang bsgyur/ de la bram ze desabasad pa'i las kyi sbyor bas skye bo sum stong tsam bsad/ spyo ba'i sbyor bas kyang—88—

skye bo khri tsam spyo bar byas/ de bzhin du bskrad pa dang / dbye ba dang/ sengs pa dang / ngag lkugs par byas pa la sogs pa skye bo mang po la gnod pa byas pa 'i sdig pas lus tshal bar gas pa'i nad kyis shi myo/sa dmyal bar skyes so/ /rgyal po de'i tshe grong khyer me tog can du me tog gis brgyan pa zhes bya ba'i gtsug lag khang byas te/ der slob dpon chen po ma khol bzhugs te theg pa tshe chu pagochos shin tu dar bar mdzad/ slob dpon ma khol gyi sku tshe'i smad la snying po thigale'i nu bo'i bu rgyal po shrī tsan+t+ra sa rgyal srid byas shing / des 'phags pa spyan rasagazigs kyi lha khang zhig byas/ der theg chen smra ba'i dge slong nyis stong re'i 'tsho ba sbyar/ dpal nā len+t+ra'i mkhan po sgra gcan 'dzin bzang pos ma/dzad de/der dri gtsang khang bcu bzhi bzhengs/ chos gzhi mi 'dra ba yang bcu bzhibatsugs/ rgyal po shrī tsan+t+ra sa rgyal srid bskyangs nas lo mang rab song ba na/ nub phyogs ḍi li dang ma la wa'i yul du rgyal po ka ni ka lo gzhon nu zhig la rgyal sar bskos te/ rin po che'i 'byung khungs nyi shu rtsa brgyad gsar du brdol ba sogs dpal 'byor chen pos gnas par byed do/ /phyogs bzhir gtsug lagakhang re re yang bzhengs shing / theg pa che chung gi dge slong sum khri re rtagatumachod par byed do/ /des na rgyal po ka na sti dang ka ni ka mi gcig par godagosaso/ /de la slob dpon ma khol ni gong du cung zad brjod pa'i bram ze sa dka' nag po de nyid yin te/ dpa' bo dang / rta dbyangs dang / mkhol dang / pha khowadang / thub dka' dang / chos ldan rab 'byor dang / ma ti tsi tra rnams mtshane gyi rnam grangs su grags pa yin no/ /de yang grong khyer khor ta na tshong dpon cigal—89—

bu mo bcu yod/ de thams cad kyang skyabs su 'gro ba dang / bslab pa'i gnasalnga la gnas pa dang / dkon mchog mchod pa yin no/ /de dag so sor yulagyiskye bo chen po dag gi bag mar song zhing / tha chung gang yin pa de ni bram ze longs spyod chen po sa ṅgha gu phya zhes bya ba'i bag mar phyin nas/ nam zhig na bu zhig btsas pa ming nag po zhes btags so/ /de rig byed yan lag dang bcasapa mtha' dag la shin tu byang bar gyur te/ pha ma la shin tu gus pas mkhol dang / pha khol zhes grags so/ /sngags rgyud kyi sbyor ba dang /rtog gol shin tubyang bar gyur te/ lha dbang phyug wo pos dngos su lung ston par byed do /de nas rtsod pa'i snyems pa dang bcas te o ḍi bi sha dang / go ra dang / ti ra tu ti dang / kā ma rū pa la sogs pa'i yul rnams su sangs rgyas pa rnams rtsod pasapham par byas te/ 'ga' zhig ni mu stegs la bkod/ 'ga' zhig gorang sna thangaphrog cing / kha cig ni mu stegs la phyag 'tshal du gzhug pa sogs dma' dbab par byas so/ /der mas bsams pa/ gal te 'di nā len+t+ra ra song na rtsod pa'i khyu mchog rig sngags grub pa dag gis btul te chos la 'jug par 'gyur ro snyam du bsams nas/ yul gzhan gyis sangs rgyas pa rnams ni rta'i rna ba'i sbu tsam/ma ga dha'i sangs rgyas pa rnams ni rta'i lus dang mtshungs pa ste/ gang ma ga dha'i sangs rgyas pa rnams las rtsod pa rgyal bar ma gyur ba de srid du rgol ba'i grags pa mi thob bo zhes brjod pas/ ma ga bar phyin pa nas/ rab ci / tu byung ba bar gong bzhin/ der gnas brtan sde snod 'dzin par gyur pa na/ mnal lamadu 'phags mas lung bstan te/ khyod kyis sangs rgyas la bstod pa mang du gyis—90—

shig sngon chos la sdig pa bsags pa'i las kyi sgrib pa byang bar 'gyur ro zhesagasungs pas bskul te/ bshags pa'i don du bsngags par 'os pa lapa'i bstod pa brtsams shing / gzhan yang sangs rgyas kyi bstod pa brgya rtsabartsams par grags/ bstod pa rnams kyi mchog tu gyur pa ni bstod pa brgya lnga bcu pa'o/ /gang gi tshe ma khol sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la zhugs pa de'i rmuphyogs bzhi'i gtsug lag khang rnams su mu stegs byed dang / bram ze rab tu'abyung bar byed pa shin tu mang bar byung ste/ bram ze rnams kyi mchog rab gya nom pa thub dka' nag po yang rang gi grub mtha' mchil ma'i thal ba bzhin bor nas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la zhugs na nges par sangs rgyas kyi chos 'di ya mtshan che'o/ /zhes de'i rgyu las dpal nā lethro kho nar yang bram ze stong lhag pararab tu byung zhing / mu stegs byed kyang de snyed rab tu byung ngo / /slob dpon de ni bsod nams chen po dang ldan pa yin pa'i phyir nyin rer grong khyer du bsod snyoms la gshegs pa na yang kha zas dpag tu med pa dag 'byor te/ bsamogatan pa nyis brgya lnga bcu dang / klog pa ba nyis brgya lnga bcu stodage sle nge lnga brgya 'tsho bas brel ba med par byed do/ /slob dpon 'dis mdzad pa'i bstod pa rnams ni sangs rgyas gyi bka' dang mnyam pa tsam du byin rlabs che ste/ rgyal ba nyid kyis bstod pa byed par lung bstan pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /des mdzad pa'i bstod pa thams cad kyang yul thams cad du khyab ste/ tha na glu gar mkhan dang / bzhad gad mkhan rnams kyang 'don par byed pas yul gyi skye bo thamasacad sangs rgyas la dad pa rang shugs kyis skyes te/ bstod pa kho nas kyang—91—

bstan pa dar ba la tshes phan pa zhig go /sku tshe'i smad kyi dus na/ rgyal po ka ni kas slob dpon spyan 'dren pa'i pho nya brdzangs pa la shin tu bgres pas 'byon ma thub ste/ 'phrin yig mdzad pas rgyal po de chos la bkod/ slob rga 3 nyid kyi slob ma ye shes snyan pa zhes bya ba rgyal po de la chos ston pa'i slob dpon du brdzangs/ mdo la sogs pa'i glegs bam na bzhugs pa khon ma ltos paramakhan po dang slob dpon dag gi snyan nas snyan du brgyud pa'i skyes rabs bcu pha rol tu phyin pa bcu dang sbyar te rtsom par bzhed pa las/ sum cu rtsa bzhi mdzad zin pa na sku 'das so/ /lo rgyus kha cig las byang chub sems dpa' stag molalus byin pa sogs rkyen nye bar dmigs na bdag gis kyang nus pas/ bya dka' ba'i mdzad pa min nam dgongs pa na/ nam zhig na de kho na 'dra ba'i stanamo phru gu 'brangs pa bkres pas nyen pa gzigs/ lus sbyin par brtsams pa na cung zad mi nus pa ltar 'dug nas lhag par yang sangs rgyas la dad pa skyes shing / smon lam bdun cu pa rang gi khrag gis bris shing / stag rnams la dngapor khrag blud de cung zad lus nyam stobs rgyas pa na rang gi sku lus byin no zhes zer ro/ kha cig ni de lta bu'i mdzad pa can gyi slob dpon gzhan la phan pa'idabyangs dgon pa ba de ni slob dpon ma khol gyi phyis byon pa zhig go zhes kyang zer ro/ khrer phyin bsdus pa sogs bstan bcos gzhan yang mang du byas shing/theg pa che chung gi dge slong kun la shin tu snyoms par phan 'dogs pa theg chen kho na'i kha zin yang ma mdzad pas nyan thos rnams kyang lhag par dad cing/ nangapa'i spyi mi lta bur gyur pas shin tu grags che'o/ /slob dpon sgra gcan 'dzin —92—

bzang po ni rigs dmangs rigs yin kyang gzugs dang longs spyod dang dbang phyug phun sum tshogs pa zhig nā len+t+ra ra rab tu byung / dge slong sde snod gsum 'dzin par gyur pa na/ slob dpon ār+ya de wa'i zhabs pad bsten zhing de khon nyid khong du chud par mdzad/ nā len+t+ra ra bzhugs nas/ snod chen pon ma mkha' la bzed pa tsam gyis kha zas bzang pos gang yong / tshul des dge 'dun mngapo la 'tsho ba sbyor bar mdzad/ mthar yul lhing ko ṭar sangs rgyas 'od dpagamed kyi zhal mthong nas/ bde ba can gyi phyogs su zhal bltas te sku 'dasaso/ /'di'i gtam sgrol ma'i lo rgyus su bshad zin to/ /slob dpon mkholalasogs pa'i dus kyi skabs te bco brgyad pa'o// //de'i rjes su shar phyogs su rgyal po shrī tsan+t+ra'i bu dharmā tsan+t+ra byung/ waṃsakyang sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la mchod pa cher byas/ de'i blon po bram ze bā su zhe tra zhes bya ba sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la mngon par dad pa 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi zhal mthong ba zhig byung nas/ des klu rnams las sman gyi rigasasnasnags pa dag blangs te/ nyi 'og gi rgyal khams su nad rims thams cad rgyun chad par byas/ yul gyi bu lon thams cad lan gsum bsnyoms/ de'i tshekhache'i yul na rgyal po tu ru'i zhes bya ba tshe lo brgya thub pa chos kyi rgyal po chen po zhig byung ngo / /dharmā tsan+t+ra sa rgyal srid byas pa'i ring la/ yul mol twan dang/ lahor gyi rgyal po ban+di ro yang zer ba khu ni ma ma rto zhes bya ba stag gzig gi rgyal po zhig yod la/ de dang rgyal po dharmā tsan+d+ra gnyis res 'khrug res bsdums pa mngadu byung ngo / /lan cig 'dums par gyur te/ phan tshun gyi pho nya ba dge slong rnyed —93—

bkur la chags pa 'ga' res byas so/ /der stag gzig gi rgyal pos ni rta dang rin po che'i rigs dag yul dbus kyi rgyal po la skyes su bskur rdo /gcig shos kyis ni glang po che dang / dar gos kyi khyad par bzang po dag stagagazig la skur bar byed do/ /lan cig nyi 'og gi rgyal gro dharmā tsa spros zab chen gyi gos srubs med pa stag gzig gi rgyal bo la bskur ba la/ stes dbang gisathags ris la snying ga'i thad du rkang rjes 'dra ba zhig byung bas/ ngan sngags/byed do snyam nas the tshom skyes/ yang lan cig shing 'bras skyes su bskur bar 'o dod pa la bram ze zhig gis sngags kyi 'khor lo gro ga la bris pa mang po nyi 'od la bzhag pa las rlung gis khyer te/ ke le'i 'bras bu kha bye ba'i nang du song / de la sogs pa'i shing tog rnams sgrom mar khus bkang ba'i nang du bcug ste stag gzigs gi rgyal po la bskur/ nam zhig na shing rtog gi nang nas sngags kyi 'khor lo byung bas/ nges par ngan sngags byed do snyam nas tu dra ske'i dmin gisam ga dha'i yul kun bcom/ gtsug lag khang mang po zhig kyang bshig dpal nā le spror yang gnod pa cher byung / rab tu byung ba rnams kyang thag ring por brosaso/ /de'i rjes su dharmā tsan+d+ra 'das te/ de'i tsha bo zhig rgyal srid la yod kyangaturu po/ g.yog tu gyur pas dbang med do/ /dharma tsan+t+ra'i zhang po'i bu wā rā ṇa snyi'i rgyal pos sangs rgyas phyogs zhes bya ba zhig yod de/ des rgya nag gi yul du mdo sde smra ba'i slob dpon 'ga' zhig brdzangs pa las/ rgya yul gyi rgyal posadrin lan du gser mi khur brgya la sogs pa mi stong phrag bcus khur ba'i yo byad bzang po dag rgyal po sangs rgyas phyogs la byin no/ /de nas nor de dag gis—94—

nub phyogs dang dbus kyi rgyal po rgyal phran gtso bo gtso bo dag mgu bar byas nas/ stag gzig gi rgyal po dang 'khrugs pa las rgyal po khu ni ma ma p+ta lasogs pa stag gzig gi dpa' bo phal cher bsad/ nyi 'og dang nub phyogs kyi rgyal khams phal cher la rgyal po sangs rgyas phyogs kyis lung btang ngo / /desasngar gyi lha khang nyams pa thams cad bsos/ dge 'dun rnams spyan drangs/dpal nā len+t+ra ra chos gzhi brgyad cu rtsa bzhi btsugs pa las rgyal po nyid kyis bdun cu rtsa gcig /gzhan rnams btsun modang blon pos btsugs/ de'i tshe'ajam dpal gyi zhal mngon sum du mthong ba'i ma ti tsi tra phyi ma gcig kyang byon te/ de rgyal po'i bla mar gyur/ dge 'dun rnams rgyal po'i khang bzang ni rtse moramachod cing / mu stegs byed rnams la sgo khang gi phyi rol du zas dag ster ro/ /de ltar bstan pa nyams pa shin tu sos par byas so/ /dam pa'i chos la dgra b.rapa byung zhing / slar yang sor chud pa'i skabs te bcu dgu pa'o// //de nas lho phyogs yul kriṣ+ṭha rā dzar slob dpon mā le ka ba dhi zhes bya ba shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa smra ba zhig byung ste/ des yul dbus su cho sos zhi chen po nyi shu rtsa gcig tsam btsugs shing / mchod rten lha can stong phrag gcigabazhengs/ lo nyi shu tsam du shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i chos dar bar byas/mthar tu dra gi'i chom pos bkrongs/ khrag 'o mar zags shing / khong skrugo1pa nas me tog mang po 'thon te bar snang khengs so/ /yul de nyid du 'khrungs pa'i slob dpon mu ti tā ba bha dra ste kun tu dga' ba bzang po zhes bya ba mdo sto stong phrag mang pos mgrin pa brgyan pa/ sbyangs pa'i yon tan bcu gnyis la gnas—95—

shing / mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa thob pa zhig byung ste/ des kyang sngar gyi ཿ zhe rten zhig pa thams cad ni bsos/ mchod rten gsar pa bcu bcus bsgor b.rabyas/ bram ze dang khyim bdag thams cad dad pa la bkod/ der yul dbus na rab tu byung ba ma bsdams pa mang po yod pa rnams/ lhung ba phyir bcos paradaga' ba rnams bcos/ khas mi len pa rnams bskrad pas/ de thams/cad kyisadage slong mchog de la sdang bar byas shing / kha zer bas thugs skyo nas 'phagasapa kun tu bzang po la gsol ba btab pa na dngos su zhal bstan/ bdag gangadu sems can gyi don yod pa der 'khrid par zhu zhus pas/ na bza' la 'jaslashig gsung / 'jus pa tsam na li yul du sleb ste/ der lo mang por 'gro ba'i don byas nas 'das so/ /de ltar lo bzhi bcu tsam du chos shin tu dar bar yon pa las/ dpal nā len+t+ra ra rgyal po'i blon po'i ka ku ta sidha zhes bya bas lha khangazhig bzhengs pa'i zhal bsro'i tshe/ skye bo thams cad la ston mo cher byas pa las/mu stegs kyi grub mtha' 'dzin pa'i mu to ba gnyis slong du yongs pa la/ dgetshul gtum po rnams kyis khrus khu gtor/ sgo glegs kyi bar du btsir/ khyi gtum po dag rbad pas/ de gnyis shin tu khros te/ gcig gis 'tshob sbyarazhing / gcig shos kyis nyi ma sgrub par byas so/ /sa'i dong gting ring por zhugs te/ lo dgu'i bar du bsgrubs kyang ma grub nas phyir 'gro bar brtsamasapas/ grogs po na re/ khyod kyi snga gas grub bam zer ro/ /ma grub byas pa na/ de na re/ phyogs thams cad mu ge nyam nga bas khyab pa la ngas dka' ba 'di snyed kyis 'tsho ba sbyar na/ khyed sngags ma grub par phyir nam byung ba'i tshe/ mgo drud —96—

nas gcod do byas nas/ chu gri rnon po bsrel bas/ de 'jigs te slar yangalogasum pre sgrubs so/ /de ltar lo bcu gnyis na grub nas/ des spyin sreg byas te sbyin sreg gi thal ba la sngags bzlas te gtor ba tsam gyis me rang 'bar du byung bas/ sangs rgyas pa'i chos gzhi rten pa'i lha khang brgyad cu rtsa bzhi po thams cad bsregs/ khyad par du dpal nā len+t+ra'i dharmā gañja ste gsung rab mtha' dgabazhugs pa'i gtsug lag khang rat+na sa gā ra/ rat+na da dhi/ rat+na raṇ+ḍa ka zhes bya ba lha khang chen po gsum yod/ theg pa chen po'i sde snod kyi po ti thams cad de na bzhugs pa la de gsum char yang tshig go /de'i tshe rat+na da dhi zhes bya ba'i gtsugartelag khang dgu thog tu yod pa'i steng khang gi glegs bam 'ga' zhig las chu'i rgyun chen po babs te me bsad/ chu rgyun khyab tshad du glegs bam rnams ma ci'i|go /phyis glegs bam de blangs te bltas pas na rgyud sde lnga'i glegs bam yin zhes zer ba dang / kha cig gsang ba 'dus pa kho na yin zhes zer ba'ang yod/gang ltar bla med kyi rgyud sde yin la/ de'i nang na gsang ba 'dus pa yod pa lartsod pa med do/ /yul gzhan dang gzhan du'ang gtsug lag khang mang po bsregasaso/ /mu stegs byed de gnyis rgyal po'i chad pas 'jigs te/ byang phyogs ha sāmā zhes bya ba'i yul du bros kyang sdig pa'i las kyi mthus lus la me rang 'bar nas shi'o/ /de nas phyogs dang phyogs kyi dge slong mang du thos pa thams cad 'dus/ blo la bzhugs pa dang / glegs bam du bzhugs pa thams cad yi geraspel/ rgyal po sangs rgyas phyogs dang / bram ze sha du dang / bras ze phur bu dang /khyim bdag dad pa can mang pos lha khang mes tshig pa rnams bsos so/ /de la—97—

theg pa chen po'i sde snod sngon mi yul du byon pa rnams cha bco lngar btang ba'i cha gnyis gnyis tsam te dam pa'i chos kyi dgra snga ma gnyis kyis kyang nub cing/ chagacig tsam dgra'i gnod pa la ma ltos par yang nub pa dang / lhag ma chadagutsam me'i dgra byung ba'i rkyen gyis nub pas da lta cha gcig tsam zhig lus/ dela'aphags pa dkon mchog brtsegs pa 'dus pa stong phrag gcig las bzhi bcu zhe dgu lus/ de bzhin du phal po che le'u stong las sum cu so brgyad lus/'dus pa chen po dum bu stong las dum bu dgu lus/ la skor gshegs pa las de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po'i le'u nyi tshe lus pa la sogs pas mtshon pa zho /dam pa'i chos kyi dgra lan gsum pa byung zhing slar yang sor chud pa'i skabs te nyi shu pa'o// //de nas rgyal po sangs rgyas phyogs kyi tshe'i smad kyi dus na shar phyogs o ḍi bi sha'i yul rgya mtsho wo po dang thag nye ba'i ri zhig na rtse mo la rin chen ri bo zhes bya ba'i gtsug lag khang bzhengs te/ theg pa che chung gi bka' dang / bstan bcos mtha' dag tshar gsum bzhengs nas bzhugs su gsol/ chos gzhi chen po brgyad dang dge slong lnga brgya 'tshogs par byas so/ /bhaX ga la dang nye ba gyomatsho'i 'gram gyi ri zhig tu lha'i ri bo zhes bya ba rin chen ri bo dang 'dra ba'i gtsug lag khang zhig bzhengs te/ lha khang ni blon pos bzhengs/ gsung rab rnams ni bram ze sha dus bzhengs/ mchod pa'i yo byad thams cad ni bram ze phurabus sbyar/ de'i chos gzhi dang dge 'dun gyi 'tsho ba ni rgyal po'i btsun cho༅sbyararo/ /de la bram ze sha du ni ma ga dha dang bhaX ga la'i bar gyi yul pun+ta was na zhes—98—

bya bar bram ze swā ro zhes bya ba pha sbun bdun dang longs spyod chen po dang bcas te yod la/ des dbang phyug chen po'i rig sngags bsgrubs te yul gyi klu zhina'adul bar brtsams pa na ma thul te/ bram ze bza' mi pha sprun bdun dang bcas pa thams cad sbrul gdug pas zin nas shi/ bram ze de'i bu ni sha du yin la nye du rnams kyis gces par byas/ khyim gyi 'og khang du ne'u le mang po dag btagagakhyim gyi phyi rol du she la zhes bya ba sprul gsod pa'i srog chags rnams btags/khang steng du rma bya mang po dag bzhag ste sbrul bsrungs pa las/ klu 'dul ba'isngags dang rdzas dag 'tshol ba la brtson par byed do/ /de nas dus lan cigakludag 'ongs te phuṭa sgra chen po phyung pas rma bya 'grogs te bros/ rlung 'tshubasamachen po btang bas she la zhes bya ba'i srog chags rnams khung du zhugs/ derasprul phra mo zhig khang pa'i zur la 'dzegs te nang du 'ongs nas shaṅka zin te shi/phung po dbyung ba na/ de'i chung mas phung po khyer song ste sdong po gcig pa'i gru chungadu zhugs chu bo ga d+ma'i gzhung la khyer nas song ste/ 'di gso bar nus pa su yod ces nyi ma gsum gyi bar du song ba las nyin gsum gyi bar la phyugs rdzi rnamasakyis kyal kha byed do/ /lan cig bud med cig byung nas/ chu la sngags bzlas te de'i lus bkrus pas slar sos so/ /de nas yul du 'ongs pa'i tshe gtam drisapas/ bram ze shaṅka shi nas zhag bdun lon/ khyim gyi yo byed rnams bram ze rnams la mchod par byed do zhes zer ro/ /der khyim du 'ongs pas sgyu ma yin nam snyam nas re zhig yid ma ches/ phyis yid tshes te lhag par dge gi /de nasade klu 'dul pa'i rigs sngags kho na 'tshol ba las/ lan cig gi tshe zhing las—99—

byed pa'i bud med cig sngags shig bzlas pa na gang nas byung cha med pa'i sprul zhig 'ongs nas/ bud med de'i bu chung gi rkang pa la khas reg pas re zhig shi ba ltar song yang zhing las rnams grub pa na sprul zhig 'ongs te/ bu chung de'i rkangapa la rmugs pa tsam gyis slar yang sos so/ /de mkha' 'gro mar shes te zhabasal phyag byas/ rigs sngags bslab par zhus pas/ khyod ni rig sngags/kyi snod ma yin zhing / dam rdzas kyang rnyed par dka'o zhes phyir bzlog pa las sa thebatsugs nas gsol ba btab pas khas blangs so/ /der dam rdzas khyi monagarkyang gi 'o ma bskol ba'i 'o thug snyim pa brgyad dgos par byung bas btsal nas rig sngags zhus pas/ des sngags mang du bzlas nas sha du la 'thung du bcug go /snyim pa drug gis lto gang ste/ de bas lhag pa 'thung mi nus khad la'i de ma'athungs na thog ma nyid du khyod sbrul gyis gsod/ de nas skye bo mang po'ang gsod ces sdigs nas nan gyis 'thung du bcug pas slar yang snyim pa gcig 'thungs/snyim pa lhag ma cig thabs ji ltar byas kyang 'thungs ma thub bo/ /de nas mkha' 'gro ma na re/ ngas dang po nas khyod nyid snod ma yin no zhes ma smras sam/ da khyod kyis klu rigs bdun 'dul nus zhing ji ltar 'dod par dbang byed nus la/nor rgyas kyi rigs ni ma yin te/ nam zhig na sprul nor rgyas kyi rigs kyisazin nas 'chi bar 'gyur ro zhes zer/ de nas bram ze de shin tu mthu dang rdzu'aphrul che bar gyur te klu rnams mngag bzhug tu bskul nas phan gnod kyi las gang la'ang thogs pa med par spyod pa zhig byung ngo / /de nyin re bzhin bum ze mang po la bstan bcos klog pa dang / spyin pa dag byin zhing bsod nams dag—100—

byed do/ /mtshan re bzhin skyed mos tshal du song nas/ klu mo rnams dang lhan cig 'dod pa'i yon to lnga dang rtsa bar byed do/ /des yul puṇ+ḍa wadhe waṃphyogs cig tu aṣ+ṭa dh+wa tu las rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol ma'i lha khang bzhengs/dkon mchog gsum la mchod pa rgya chen po byas pa las/ dus nam zhig klu zhi bud med rnams kyi khrod du klu'i rgyal po nor rgyal kyi g.yog mo zhig yod pa ma shes par bram ze bag med pas gnas pa las/ des dpral par so btab nasabros so/ /de nas g.yog la bskos te rgya mtsho'i lha ba longs tshur 'ong ba'i tshe phyi mig ma lta/ gzhan gyi tshig/ ma nyan/ phar gtam ma smra zhes/ bsgos te rkad/mgyogs kyi rdzas byin nas song ngo / /des tshur 'ongs pa'i tshe skyes bu zhin lend cing byung ngo / /der nyan pa la/ bdag ni sman pa ste nad dang dug mtha' dgagaso bar byed do zer ba la phyi mig bltas pas/ bram ze sman gyi snod thogs pa cig byung ngo / /de ma thag de na re/ khyod kyi sman ci yin pa ston zhig zer/ des rgya mtsho'i lbu ba bstan pas sa la gtor te mi snang bar song ngo / /slar sha du dpa'aphrad de gtam bshad pas sa dang lhan cig phyags la long zhig zer/ der phyin pas klu'i rdzu 'phrul gyis sa phyogs der mtsho brdol nas len par ma nus/ shaṅkuyang dus las 'das/ de lta bu'i bram ze sha dus rgya gar lho phyogs kha ga spre'i yuladu nam mkha' lding gi mchod sdong rdo rings shig btsugs te/ de la mchod pa tsamagyis dug nad zhi ba dang / khrus gsol ba'i khu ba 'thung zhing khrus byas pasaklund sel bar 'gyur ba yod do/ /bram ze phur bu ni ku ru kulbe'i gas sngagasagrub pa ste/ rgyal pos klu'i rgyal po ta k+ṣa ka ston cig byas pa las/ ku ru kulbe'i —101—

sngags bzlas pa'i rdo mtshor 'phags pas mtsho khol zhing dbus nas klu'i pho brang gi ba gam nyug nyug pa rgyal po 'khor bcas kyis mthong / der klu'i dugagis mi phyugs mang po shi bas klu dngos ston ma thub ste slar nub par byas so/ /bram ze phur bu des o ṭi bi sha'i grong khyer ka ṭa ka ra sangs rgyas kyi lha khang mang du bzhengs/ dge 'dun mang po la dus ston yang btsugs sgo /rgyal po sangs rgyas phyogs dang / de'i rjes su dharmā tsan+t+ra'i tsha bo karma tsan+d+ra zhes bya ba byungaste/ de dag gi ring la slob dpon dga' byed snyan pa dang / slob dpon rta dbyangs chung ba dang / sgra gcan 'jin bzang po'i slob ma sgra gcan 'dzin bshes gnyen yin la/ de'i slob ma klu'i bshes gnyen rnams byung ste/ de dgagis theg pa wo po dar bar mdzad do/ /'on kyang da lta bod du yod pa'i spro zhi pa brgya lnga bcu pa'i 'grel pa mdzad mkhan slob dpon dga' byed snyan pa ni phyogs glang la sogs pa'i phyis 'byung bar 'grel pa de las gsal bas/ 'di skabs kyi de dang mtshan gcig tsam mo/ /rgyal po sangs rgyas phyos/sa kyi bya ba'i mtha' ma dang / rgyal po karma tsan+t+ra'i dus skabs kyi pha/tam ste nyi shu rtsa go rmo/pa'o// //de'i 'og tu rgyal po karma tsan+t+ra sa rgyal srid skyong bzhin pa'i dus na/ rgyawapo sangs rgyas phyogs kyi bu zab mo phyogs zhes bya ba pho brang grong khyer lnga len du byed pa zhig byung ste/ lo bzhi bcur nye ba rgyal srid byas so/ kha tshe'i yul du rgyawapo tu rtsa kho/ bu tu ru ske mang pos bkur ba zhes bya ba khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i zhal mthong ba tshe lo brgya dang lnga bcu thub pa/ rgyal srid kyang lo brgya tsatsha—102—

bskyangs ba zhig byung ste/ des kha che dang tho gar dang / yul ga dza ni la sogs pa thams cad mnga' 'bangs su bsdus nas/ dkon mchog mchod pa zhig byung/khyad par yul ga dza nir sangs rgyas kyi tshems bzhugs pa'i mchod rten chen po bzhengs la/ dge slong pha ma dang / dge bsnyen pha ma stong phrag re re mchod rten mchod pa'i lag len du bskos/ sku gzugs kyi khyad par dpag tu med pa bzhengs/ dge slong dzī wa ka ra zhes bya ba dang / dge bsnyen chos 'phel zhes/bya ba 'khor dge slong dang / dge bsnyen lnga stong lnga stong gis bskor te shas tha kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i don sgom pa de bzhin gshegs pa sgrub pas mnyes par byed pa byung nas/ dge slong dang dge bsnyen rdzu 'phrul can brgya phrag mang po yang byung /chos spyod bcu shin tu 'phel bar byed do/ /rgyal po zab mo'i phyogs rgyal srid du 'khod nas lo bcu gnyis lon pa'i tshe/ rgyal po karma tsan+d+ra 'das/ de'i bu bṛk+ṣatsan+t+ra rgyal srid la bskos kyang dbang thang chung ngur byung nas/ o ṭi sa'i rgyal po dzā le ru ha zhes bya bas shar phyogs phal cher la dbang bsgyur/ rgyal po de dgagoskabs su dge slong chen po a rta ta zhes bya ba'i sku tshe'i smad kyi dus dang /'phags pa thogs med kyi 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i dus yin zhing / slob dor+sha/ dbyig gnyen dang / sangs rgyas 'bangs dang / dge 'dun 'bangs rnams kyi sku tshe'i stod kyi dus so/ /slob dpon klu'i bzhes gar+sā tshe ring por gnas pa de'i slob ma dge 'dun srung ba zhes pa'ang byung la/ dus 'di yan chad du gsangasngags rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i chos skal pa dang ldan pa rnams la ma dar ba ni ma yin te/ sngon theg pa chen po'i chos dar ba nas mi ring bar byung ba'i rig pa —103—

'dzin pa stong phrag brgya po de dag dang / u rgyan gyi yul du skye bo thams cad rigapa 'dzin pa'i gnas thob pa rnams kyang phal cher bla med kyi lam la brten pa yin la/ 'on kyang de dag ni gsang ba'i bdag po la sogs pas skal ldan brgya'am stong la sogs pa la cig car du zhal bstan te sngags kyi theg pa bstan/ de dag thams cad 'ja' lus su gyur nas/ de'i rjes su gdams pa bzhag pa'ang med la/ sngon gyi skyes bu rnams shin tu sgom zhing gsang ba srung ba yin pa'i phyir de dag rig pa 'dzin pa ma grub kyi bar du sus kyang gsang sngags spyod pa yin par ma shes te/ gang cho 'phrul chen po dang bcas te mkha' lagashegs pa'am mi snang bar gyur pa na/ kye ma de dag ni sngags kyi spyod pa can yin no zhes slad nas rig par 'gyur ba sha stag go /de'i phyir slob dpon gyisaslob ma la brgyud pa'i rim pas 'doms pa'ang cung zad tsam las med la/ bya ba dang spyod pa'i rgyud kyi sngags rgyud nyams su len pa ni theg pa chen po dar nas brtsams te shin tu mang ba zhig yod na'ang / shin tu gsang zhing spyod pa yin pa'i phyir gsang sngags de nyid la spyod pa yin na ma gtogs ci zhig nyams su len sus kyang mi shes so/ /de'i phyir las dang dngos grub rnams thogs pa med para'agrub pa zhig yod do/ /sa ra ha dang / klu sgrub yab sras dang/ grub thob shā wa ri pa'i bar du brgyud pa nas brgyud par rjes su bzung ba ni/ yongs su gragasapa ltar yod par mngon la/ gzhan du de yan chad kyi slob dpon rnams gsangasngags bla med kyi brgyud pa la bzhugs pa'ang cher ma mthong ngo / /spyod bsdusasgron me las khungs su mdzad pa'i pad+ma badz+ra dang / ka spa la pa byung yang / dang por —104—

ni 'phags pa'i yul du 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa ma byung bar mngon la phyi ma'i lo rgyus ni ma mthong ngo / /de bas na bram ze chen po dang / klu sgrub yab sras sogasakyis mdzad pa'i bla med kyi bstan bcos yod pa 'di kun las gzhan pa'i sngags bla na med kyi dgongs 'grel yang 'di yan chad du cher med par gragasashing / bstan bcos de dag kyang dbu ma rig tshogs la sogs pa'i gzhung bzhin du yongs khyab tu grags pa ni ma yin te/ klu'i byang chub rig pa 'dzin pa'iganas brnyes pa de kho na la gtad pas/ phyis rgyal po de wa pā la yab sras kyi dus su dar bar gyur pa yin te/ de'i phyir 'phags skor dang sangs rgyas thod pa'i skor sogs la rgyud thag nye mor 'byung ba'i rgyu mtshan yang de yin no/ /dper na bod kyi yang dag snang gi chos dang / gter chos rdzun gsob med pa rnams dang 'dra'o/ /dus 'di tsam nas bzung nas bya spyod kyi sngags rgyud rnamasalo nyis brgya tsam gyi bar du shin tu dar zhing mngon mtshan du spyod pa byung la/rnal 'byor dang rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud rnams ni dngos grub ma thob kyi bar du mngon mtshan du spyod pa med kyang / sngon las tshes dar bar gyur zhing/dgongs 'grel gyi bstan bcos kyang ci rigs pa mdzad par byung la/ grub thob grags che ba rnams kyang byon te/ skabs der slob dpon rta mchog dang/ slob dpon chen po lha yi pa dang / grub thob tsarla ṭi pa rnams kyang byung ste de da yo lorgyus gzhan du gsal/ slob dpon a rta ta ni rgyal po karma tsan+t+ra'i dus su sdotshabartson sde snod gsum 'dzin par gyur pa zhig yin la/ des gter gyi bum pa chen po bsgrubs so/ /mthar gyis grub ste yul wā rā ṇa snyir sa 'og tu zin po —105—

che'i bum pa srid du dpag tshad tsam yod pa byung ste dge 'dun khri phrag mang po la 'tsho ba sbyor ba zhig yod pa las/ dus lan cig srung ba byed pa brjed de/ de'i nub mo gnod sbyin rnams kyis brkus te/ nangs par dge 'dun mchod pa'i don du kha phye ba na stong par mthong nas/ dge slong rig sngags mkhan rdzu 'phrulachen po des tshangs pa la sogs pa lha chen po thams cad kyang bkug ste/ de rnams gzir ba'i de dag gis gnod sbyin rnams bkug ste slar yang gter gyi bum pa gang ngo / /lha rnams 'ongs pa'i rtags su sa g.yo ba dang / tshe togo gi char dang / dri bzang po zhag bdun gyi bar du rgyun ma chad pa skye bo thams cad lamangon par gyur to/ /tshul des lo bzhi bcur nye ba dge 'dun mchod par byas/gter gyi bum pa kho rang nyid la snang ba yin gyi gzhan dag gis sa 'khru bar mthong ngo / /'phags pa thogs med sku mched kyi lo rgyus ni/ sngon rgyal po goṭa'aphel byed kyi dus dge slong sde snod gsum 'dzin pa 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs la yid dam du byed pa zhig yod pas dus lan cig dge slong gzhan zhig dang gal bzung ba dang gzhung gzug pa dang / brgal brtag byed pa'i tshengargyal gyi skyon gyis de la bud med kyi rig pa can 'di zhes smad do/ /de'i tshe'aphags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis khyod kyi las 'dis skye ba mang por bud med du skye bar 'gyur ro/ /'on kyang byang tso ma tho gyi bar du khyo kyidage ba'i bshes gnyen ni nga yin no zhes gsungs so/ /de ni rgyal po sangs rgyasaphyogs kyi dus tsam na skye ba blangs pa ni/ bram ze mo pra kā sa shī la zhes pa rab tu gsal ba'i ngang tshul ma zhes pa yin te/ de skye ba dran zhing chung ngu nas mdo sde —106—

dang / mngon pa'i gzhung lugs dag mthong zhing thos pa tsam gyis rang shes pa 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs rtag tu mchod pa/ dgob bcu'i lam la ngang gis gnas pa/ byang chub kyi sems stobs su gyur pa zhig ste/ 'di dge slong mishrī'adod pa 'khrul pa yin la/ cher skyes pa na/ de rgyal rigs zhig dang 'dus pa las khye'u mtshan dang ldan pa bcas te blo rno ba'i cho ga byas/ cung zad cher skyesapa na yi ge dang rtsis dang / brtag pa brgyad dang / brda sprod pa dang /rtogagodang / sman dpyad dang / bzo'i gnas rnams dang / rig pa'i gnas bco brgyad la sogs pa ma nyid kyis legs par bslabs te shin tu byang zhing gsal par gyur to/ /des rang gi rigs kyi chos dri ba na bu khyod rigs kyi bya ba byed pa'i phyir bskyed pa ma yin te/ dam pa'i chos dar bar bya ba'i phyir bskyed pa yin na/rab tu byung nas mang du thos pa dang ting nge 'dzin thob par gyis shig zhesagasungs pa ltar rab tu byung nas mkhan po dang slob dpon dang dge 'dun gyi zhabs 'bring gi bya ba'i dus 'da' ba logacig tu mdzad nas/ bsnyen parardzogs nas lo lnga'i bar du klog pa la brtson par gnas te/ lo re re tshigasasubacad pa 'bum 'bum gyi tshig don thams cad chub par byas/ de ltar thun mongagi sde snod gsum dang / theg pa chen po'i mdo sde phal cher ni rtogs paraslayang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i mdo'i brjod bya ma zlos shing ma rmedze pasapa ni rtogs par dka' bar dgongs nas/ de'i don du lhag pa'i lha zhal mthongabar bya'o zhes gcig tu brnags pas/ gong du bshad pa'i slob dpon a rta ta denyid la dbang bskur pa ma nos pas me tog rgyal ba mi pham pa la phog —107—

go /dbang bskur ba'i rgyud dang / dkyil 'khor gang yin mi gsal yangasgyu'aphrul drwa ba'i dkyil 'khor yin par mngon te/ slob dpon 'dis sgyu ldo yi/drwa ba'i rgyud la brten nas byams pa'i sgrub thabs mdzad pa'i phyir ro zhes bla ma pa ni ta gsung / de nas gur pa pa rba ta ste/ gsung rab las kug kuṭa pyad pa rba ta/ ri bo bya rkang can du grags pa de'i phug cig tu 'phags pa byams pa bsgrubs te lo gsum du ltas ci yang ma byung bas thugs mug nas phyir thon pas/brag gi ngos la bya'i tshang bcas snga dro zan 'tshol ba la 'phur ba dang / dgongasaka tshang du log yongs pa brag gi ngos la gshog pa reg tsam de byung ba la/ yun ring pas brag zad par gzigs nas nga'i brtson 'grus chung ngo snyam nas slar ldog ste lo gsum sgrub pa mdzad/ de bzhin du yang thon pa na/ chu thigs kyisabrag zad par gzigs/ yang lo gsum bsgrubs te thon pa na/ mi rgan po zhikaras bal 'jam pos lcags 'phyid par byed cing / 'di las phra khab byed pa yin/ sngar yang ras bal gyis phyis te lcags zad pa las khab 'di tsam byungango / /zhes snod cig khab kyis gang ba bstan no/ /yang lo gsum bsgrubs te/ de ltar lo bcu gnyis su lhas ma byung bas thugs skyo ste thon nas phyin pag grongakhyer zhig na khyi mo mi la zug cing za ba/ smad 'bus khyer ba zhig gzigs nasasnying rje lhag par skyes te/ 'bu 'di rnams ma bsal na khyi 'di 'tshel/ bsalanas bor na 'bu rnams 'chibs rang gi lus kyi sha rnams bcad nas der 'bu rnams gzhug par bya'o snyam ste/ a tsin+ta zhes bya ba'i grong khyer nas skru gyi bla pas/lhung bzed dang ga bar gsil gteng par bzhag /sbu gris sku'i brla sha nas phral—108—

te/ spyan btsum nas 'bu rnams blang bar brtsams pa na/ phyag gis yul ba las ci yang ma rnyed nas spyan phye ba na/ khyi dang 'bu med par rje btsun byams pa mtshan dpe 'od du 'bar ba gzigs nas/ kye ma yab gcig bdag goskyabs/ /ngal brgyas 'bad kyang 'bras ma mchis/ /ci'i phyir char sprin gyomatsho'i dpung / /gdung bas bsregs te skom tshad 'bab/ /bdag gis de tsam du bsgrubs kyang zhal mi ston pa zhes sbyan chab phyung ba'i/ lha yi rgyal po'i char phab kyang / /sa bon mi rung mi 'khrungs ltar/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni byon gyurakyang / /skal ba med pas bzang mi myong / /rang gi las kyi sgrib pas bsgribs te ma mthong ba yin gyis/ nga ni rtag tu khyod kyi drung na gnas so/ /sngar ga sngagasabazlas pa'i nus pa thams cad da ltar snying rje chen pos rang gi lus kyi sha bcad pa'i dka' ba des sdig sgrib dag ste/ mthong ba yin gsung / da ltar phrag parakhur la grong khyer gyi skye bo rnams la ston zhig gsung / bstan pas gzhan sdosakyang ci yang ma mthong / chang 'tshong ma zhig gis khyi gu zhig khur bar mthong ba na yang phyis longs spyod zad mi shes pa byung / dbul po khur bskyed pas le tshob zhig gis zhabs mgo tsam mthong bas kyang ting nge 'dzin brnyes shing / thun mongagi dngos grub thob bo/ /dus de nyid du slob dpon gyis chos rgyun gyi ting nge 'dzin thob/ khyod ci 'dod gsung pa la/ theg pa chen po dar bar zhu zhes zhusngapas/ nga'i gos kyi mtha' la 'jus shig gsung / 'jus pas de mthag dga' ldan du sleb/ de la sa sde'i gna' mchan las/ dga' ldan du zla ba drugabazhugs zer ba yod par grags pa dang / 'ga' zhig mi lo bco lnga sogasarde—109—

bzhugs par byed pa ci rigs yod kyang / rgya bod yongs khyab tu grags pa lamilo lnga bcu bzhugs zer te/ de yang lo phyed lor brtsis pa yin pas lo nyer lnga'o zhes rgya gar ba rnams gsung / der dga' ldan du mgon po mi pham pa las theg pa chen po'i chos ma lus pa mtha' dag gsan te/ mdo sde thams cad kyi don thugs su chud/ byams pa'i chorme/ lnga gsan pa na don tshan re re gsan pa tsamarnagyis ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo mi 'dra ba re re thob/ slar yang mi'i yul du byon nasa'agro ba'i don mdzad pa na gzhan gyis sems shes pa'i mngon shes thogs pa med pa dang / zla ba phyed dam zla ba gcig la sogs pas bgrod dgos pa'i thagaring por 'bo / ra dang bcas pas gshegs pa na'ang thun tshod gcig gam nyi ma gcig gis bgrod pa dang dang por byams pa zhal bzigs pa'i dus de tsam gyi lang tsho la gnas te/ dgung lo dgu bcu lhag kyang sngon gyi de kho na bzhin du gnas pa dang / sku la mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis rjes mthun tsam du yod pa lasogs pa spyir sa thob pa'i 'phags pa'i yon tan mngon gyur du mnga' ba dang /khyad par mnal lam du yang rang don yid byed kyi blo med cing / ting nge le rdon gyi sgo mtha' yas pa la spyod pa dang / shin tu 'jam zhing dul la des pa yang yin la/ grub mtha' ngan pa sun 'byin zhing spyod pa ngan pa tshar gcod pa sog༅lhagapar rno ba dang / thos pas mi ngom nyid dang ni/ zang zing med par chos sbyin dpa/zhes sogs kyi longs spyod la spyod bzhin pa sogs rgyu mtshan du mas logasum pa brnyes par byed do/ /de yang slob dpon des dang por ma ga dha'i yul gyi phyogs cig be lu ba na zhes bya ba'i nags su gtsug lag khang mdzad de bzhugs —110—

nas slob ma tshul khrims dang ldan zhing mang du thos pa brgyad la theg pa chen po'i chos zab mo dag bkrol zhing bstan pas/ de thams cad kyang bzod pa theb cingaskye bo dad pa'i phyir rdzu 'phrul mngon par 'du byed pa mdo sde rgya mtsho'i pha rol tu son pa sha stag byung ste/ gnas de la chos kyi myu gu'i dgon par gragasaso/ /der byams pa'i chos lnga yang yi ger bkod/ mngon pa kun las btusadang / theg pa chen po bsdus pa dang / sa sde lnga dang / mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan gyi rnam par bshad pa la sogs pa bstan bcos phal cher mdzad/ de nas yulanub phyogs dang nye ba grong khyer sa ga ri zhes bya bar uṣ+ṭha pu ri zhes bya ba'i gtsug lag khang du rgyal po zab mo'i spyin bdag byas te phyogs bzhi'i dge slong thams cad 'dus/ der 'phags pa thogs med kyis so so'i blo dang 'tsha༅parachos mang du bstan te/ nyan thos kyi sde snod gsum dang / theg pa chen skra'i mdo sde lnga brgya tsam bshad cing / thams cad kyang yang dag pa'i don la bkod pasatheg pa chen po la rigs sad cing mdo sde'i don la blo gros rgyas pa stong phrag brgal ba tsam byung ste de yang sngon theg pa chen po shin tu dar ba las/ phyis dusakyi dbang gis blo gros chung ngur gyur pa dang / dgra lan gsum gyis rim pasanyams te/ slob dpon 'di byon pa'i dus kyi thog ma na/ theg pa chen po'i phyogs 'dzin pa'i dge slong mang po yod na'ang theg pa chen po'i mngon pa shes pa ni ye med cing / mdo sde re re nas 'don pa dar po yod kyang / mdo don rdzi bzhi du shes pa med pa la gnas der slob dpon nyid slob ma'i mchog brgyad dang bcas pas chos bstan pas/ de ltar gyur pa'i tshe theg pa chen po'i bstan pa —111 —

bar skabs su nub pa las slar yang dar bar gyur to zhes phyogs kun tu grags so/ /de'i tshe rgyal po zab mo'i phyogs de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i mdo kha ton du byed do/ /des bsams pa/ slob dpon 'di ni 'phags pa yin zhingagazhan gyis sems kyang shes so grags na/ de nyid bden na bdag gis kyanga'adi'i yon tan bsngags par bya/ gal te mi bden na skye bo rnams bslu bar byed pa yin pas skye bo'i dbus su brgal te dma' dbab par bya'o zhes blon po rnams dang / bram ze rnams dang / yid brtan pa'i skye bo lnga brgya ca5la bgrosate/ pho brang 'khor gyi khyams su skye bo mang po'i dbus su slob dpon ge bor bcas spyan drangs/ bsod snyoms dang na bza' phun sum tshogs pa dag phulatekhyim gyi nang du ma he nag po sa dkar gyis byugs pa sbas/ gser gyi bum pa zhig gi nang du mi gtsang ba sna tshogs blugs/ kha sbrang rtsis bkang ste ras kyi g.yogs pa lag tu thogs nas/ khyim 'di na ci yod/ lag tu thegs pa 'i de ci yin dris pas/ ji bzhin du gsungs/ 'di tsam ni lkog gyur shes pa chung ngu la'ang 'byung na/ sems shes sam mi shes snyams nas/ shes rab kyi pha rolatuphyin pa'i mdo'i tshig la dri ba gsum/ don la dri ba gsum ste drug po yid kyisadris pas/ ji lta ba bzhin lan gsungs nas/ rang bzhin gsum bstan pa lasogs pa de dang mthun pa'i bstan bcos chung ngu re yang mdzad do/ /de la tshigagi dri ba gsum ni/ byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya ba gang gi tshig bla dwags yin dris pa la/ byang chub sems dpa' yang dag par rjes su ma mthong zhes lan —112—

btab pa 'di lung ma bstan pa'i lta bar mi 'gyur ram/ bya shin tu lus tsheb dpag tshad lnga brgya yod pa zhes dper byas pa'i lus che ba 'di don gang dang sbyor/ ri dang nags tshal gyi mtshan ma ma mthong na/ rgya mtsho dang thag nye'o zhes pa la/ mtshan ma ma ma3tshe snang ba'i sa mtshams gang la byed ces pa gsum yin pa 'aḥgi/dang po ni nang stong pa nyid la dgos/ gnyis pa ni dge ba'i las stobs tsheb/gsum pa ni chos mchog chen po'o/ /don la dri ba gsum ni/ kun bzhi rnam parashes pa rdzas su yod dam med/ chos thams cad ngo bo nyid med par gsungasapas gang ngo bo nyid med pa de yang ngo bo nyid med dam/ stong pa nyid kyis chosathams cad stong pa nyid du mi byed par bshad pa'i mi byed mkhan dang / mi byed rgyu'i stong nyid gang yin zhes pa la/ dang po la/ kun rdzob tu rdzas su yod/don dam pa'i rig shes kyi don med/ gnyis pa ngo bo nyid med pa gsum la dgos/pas/ ngo bo nyid med pa nyid la slar yang ngo bo nyid yod med gnyis su 'byed/gsum pa la stong pa nyid du byed mkhan gyi stong nyid ni stong nyid kyi rnam pa tsam gyi blo dang / des byed tshul sngar yod phyis med pa'i tshul gnyis kar 'gog pa yin no/ /zhes pa'i don du lan btab bo/ /der rgyal po dang skye bo'i tshogs thamasacad ngo mtshar rmad du gyur pas/ slob dpon gyis rgyal po de yang dag par lto/nas theg pa chen po'i chos gzhi nyi shu rtsa lnga byed du bcug ste/ re re yang dge slongabargya brgya dge bsnyen la sogs pa dpag tu med do/ /gnas 'di nyid du bzhugs pa'i tshe/ gcung dbyig gnyen yang bshul ba yin te 'og tu 'chad do/ /de'i tshe lho phyogs yul kriṣ+ṭha rā dzar bram ze bā su nā zhes bya ba byung ste/ des—113—

'phags pa thogs med ces bya ba rgyal ba mi pham pa las lung blangs te/ theg pa chen po slar yang dar bar byed do zhes thos nas bram ze rang nyid 'khor lnga brgya tsam gyis bskor te yul dbus su 'ongs/ gnas chen po brgyad kyi mchod rten rnams mchod/ lho phyogs kyi bram ze dang / khyim bdag rnams la dgoba'i rtsababaskyed pa'i phyir slob dpon 'byon par zhus pas/ der slob dpon dang lhan cig gnas pa nyi shu rtsa lnga dang / bram ze 'khor dang bcas pa lhan cig tugashegs par brtsams pa'i tshe/ bram ze de'i ma nad kyis btab bo zhes pho nya byung ngo / /der bram ze myur du sleb par 'dod pa'i sems kyis gdungs pa na/slob dpon gyis de la bram ze 'dod na myur du sleb par bya'o/ /des kyang de bzhin du mdzod cig /de nas lam du zhugs pas/ nyi ma de nyid kyi nyi ma phred na slob dpon dang / bram ze 'khor dang bcas pa yul spos rā dzar sleb ga de yang kriṣ+ṭha rā dza ni yul tri lid+ma'i nang tshan zhig yin la zla ba gsum gyi lam thun tshod gnyis la bgrod pa yin gsung / nub phyogs u rgyan gyi yul nag tshongadapon dha na rak+ṣi ta zhes bya bas spyan drangs pa'i tshe na yang / slob dpon dang tshongadapon 'khor dang bcas pas ma ga dh+wa dang u rgyan gyi yul gyi lam thams cad zhag gcig nyid la bgrod/ yul kriṣ+ṭha rā dza dang / u rgyan gnyis kar du yun ring rab bzhugs shing chos bstan pas skye bo thams cad la theg pa chen po dar bar mdzad cing / yul de gnyis kar mchod rten brgya phrag re bzhengs/ lha khang nyi shu rtsa lnga bzhengs/ de rnams su theg chen gyi chos gzhi re re yang btsugs go /de bzhin du ma ga dhar yang ma sna de rten brgya dang / cho che/ gzhi nyer lnga lan —114—

cig rgya gar mtha' 'khob grong khyer a yo dh+ya dang nye bar rgyal phran zhig la chos ston zhing bzhugs pa'i tshe/ de dang nye ba na gar log gi grong zhig yod pas/slob dpon chos gsung bzhin pa la gar log rnams kyi dmag byung bas/ chosanyan pa rnams la bzod pa'i khur bskyed cig par gdams nas thams cad mnyam par bzhag pas gnas pa la/ mda' 'phangs pa thams cad kyang rdus du song / gar log gi gtso bos slob dpon la ral grib rtogs pas kyang ga rdod pa med cing / ram gri nyid dum bu brgyar chag go /gzhan yang skur pa gtab pa sogs ji tsam byas kyang g.yo ba med par 'dug pas/ de rnams kyang lhag par dad de phyag byas nas song ngo / /slob dpon 'dis gzhan gyi bsam pa mkhyen pa'i phyir chos ston pa thams cad slob mas gang mi shes pa dang / the tshom yod pa de nyid gsal bar bkral nas ston pa'i phyir/ slob dpon 'di las chos nyan pa la mkhas par ma gyur pa cung zad kyangamed do/ /dus de'i tshe theg pa chen po phal cher gyis mdo sde sna re tsam ma zhus pa med pa lta bu yin zhing / slob dpon nyid kyi bdag rkyen kyis chos gzhi brgya thawapa btsugs pa las/ re re la yang blo sbyong ba nyis brgya re nyung mtha' rnamasala'ang yod pas/ spyir chos nyan pa'i slob ma'i tshogs dpag tu med cing/thams cad kyang mchog tu gus pas grub pa'i mtha' yang de ltar 'dzin la/ sathob pa'i yon tan skyes pa dang / sbyor lam gyi yon tan skyes pa sogs stong phragamang po yang byung zhing / mdo sde dang grub mtha' phyogs re tsam ma yin parasgothams cad nas gsungs shing / nyan thos rnams kyang dus de nyid du lhag par—115—

gus par byed cing / nyan thos rnams nyid kyi mngon pa dang / mdo sde kha parabyed pa yang mang du byung ngo / /gan+dha ri'i ri sngags grub pas dga' ldan gyi gnasasu phyin zhing / thag ring po yang yud kyis bgrod par byed/ rtog byed kyi rigasngags grub pas pha rol kyi sems shes pa yin te/ tshul khrims dang ldan zhingamang du thos pa/ rig sngags grub pa 'di ni ngo mtshar che ste/ gzhan du na theg pa chen po la zhugs pa 'di kho na skyon no zhes zer bar grags so/ /de yang sngon theg pa chen po'i chos shin tu dar ba'i tshe yang theg chen gyi dge slong khri phrag tu longs pa ni med/ klu sgrub kyi tshe yang dge 'dun phal cher nyan thos yin no/ /slob dpon 'di'i dus theg chen gyi dge slong khri phrag mang po byung ba sogs rgyu mtshan de rnams kyi sgo nas theg pa chen po'i bstan pa mtha' dag gi bdag po yin no zhes grags so/ /'on te slob dpon nyid dang lhan ga gnasapa'i slob ma ni dge slong nyi shu rtsa lnga tsam las med de/ de dag thams cad tshuwakhrims dang ldan pa/ sde snod 'dzin pa/ lhag pa'i lha la the tshom gcod cing bzod pa thob pa sha stag go /sku tshe'i smad kyi dus na nā len ra lo bcu gnyis bzhugs/dgun gyi dus nyin re bzhin mu stegs rgol ba re yong ba la grub mtha' rnams rigs pa sna tshogs kyis sun phyung ste chos bstan pas mu stegs stong du nye ba tsam rab tu byung / gtsug lag khang gang na dge slong lta ba dang / tshul khrims/dang/spyod pa dang / cho ga nyams pa thams cad chos bzhin tshang gcod par mdzad pasadage 'dun shin tu dag par mdzad do/ /mthar grong khyer rgyal po'i khab tu sku 'das te/ de'i shul du slob ma rnams kyis mchod rten byas so/ /yang dbyig—116—

gnyen ni/ bod na 'ga' zhig 'phags pa thogs med kyis mtshe ma'i sku mched du 'dod pa dang / 'ga' zhig chos kyi sku mched du 'dod pa snang na'ang/ 'phagasayul mkhas pa la de ltar ma grags te/ 'di'i yab tu gyur pa ni bram ze rigabyed gsum dang ldan pa zhig yin la/ slob dpon 'phags pa thogs med rabatubyung ba'i phyi de'i lor 'khrungs te/ slob dpon 'di gnyis yum gcig pa'i skumago do/ /blo rno ba'i cho ga byas pa nas mang du thos pa dang ting nge 'dzin thob par gyis shig pa'i bar gcen thogs med kyi skabs dang 'dra/ der dpal nā len+t+ra ra rab tu byung nas nyan thos kyi sde snod gsum mtha' dag byang bar bslabs/ da dung chos mngon pa'i mtha' rtogs pa'i phyir dang / sde ba bocobargyad kyi grub mtha' nges pa'i phyir dang / rig pa'i lam mtha' dag rtogs pa'i phyir du/ kha cher byon nas slob dpon sa ṅgha bha dra gtso bor brten/ bye bragatubashad pa dang / sde pa bco brgyad kyi bstan bcos so so dang / sde pa so rbo'i mdo sde 'dul ba mi 'dra ba'i khyad par rnams dang / mu stegs can lta ba drug po rnams kyi gzhung lugs mtha' dag dang / rtog ge'i tshul mtha' dag la byang zhingamakhas par byas nas/ yul de nyid du yang lo mang por rigs pa dang mi rigasapa rnam par phye zhing nyan thos kyi sde snod rnams bshad/ slar yul dbus su byon pa'i lam du chom rkun dang / lam gyi gnod sbyin la sogs pas lam dgagatshanus par ma ga snye byon/ der yang lo 'ga' zhig tu nyan thos kyi dge 'dun mngapo la rab tu rig pa dang ldan pa'i chos mang po ston zhing bzhugs/ de'i tshe'aphags pa thogs med kyis mdzad pa'i sa sde lnga'i glegs bam gzigs pas —117—

theg chen thugs su ma chud cing /lhag pa'i lha la gsan pa la thugs yid mtshes nas/kye ma thogs med nags su lo//bcu gnyis bar du ting won bsgrubs/ting 'dzin ma grub glang chen gyi/rgyab khal longs pa'i grub mtha' brtsams/zhes gsungs par grags la/gang ltar yang cung zad bsting tshigatumadzad pas/de gcen po 'phags pas gsan te 'dul ba'i dus yin paradagongs te/dge slong gcig ni blo gros mi bzad pas bstan pa'i mdo won du bcu gagazhan zhig ni sa bcu pa'i mdo 'dzin du bcug byang ba na the gomarablogros mi zad pa cwan/de nas sa bcu pa thon cig ces gsungs nas ga chungagodrung du btang bas/de gnyis kyis kyang sred la blo gros mi zad pa brtan pagatheg chen 'di rgyu la bzang ste/'bras bu la g.yel lam dgongs/thorangasasabacu pa brtan pas/rgyu 'bras gnyis kar bzang ba la skur pa btab pas sdigapa chen po bsags/skur pa btab pa'i lce bcad par bya'o dgongs te/gri sgru btsal bas/dge slong de gnyis na re/'di'i don du ljags bcad par gala'atshal/sdig pa bshags pa'i thabs gcen la mnga' bas 'phags pa'i drung du gshegs par zhu byas nas/'phags pa thogs med kyi drung du byon/de nas bod kyi lo rgyus ltar na/theg pa chen po'i chos mtha' dag gzigs nas/sku 'ad chos kyi bgro gleng mdzad pa'i tshe yang spobs pa myur zhing /gcen spobs pa mimyur yang lan bzang po byung bas rgyu mtshan dris pas/yi dam la dris nas lan 'debs gsung /gcung gis kyang zhal ston par zhus pas/da zes/skal ba med gsungs nas sdig sbyong gi thabs bstan ni kyang rgya gar ba'i ngag

sgros ji bzhin du mi snang zhing / rig pas kyang mi 'thad par mngon te/ 'phagasapa thogs med la theg pa chen po'i mdo sde rnams gsan nas/ bla ma la rtsod pa byed pa dang / bla ma la ma zhus par dpe bltas nas rtsal bshad byed pa gnyis kar yang sngon dus bzang po'i skyes bu dam pa rnams kyi spyod pa la med cing /'dus bzang la yang slob dpon dang rtsod pa mi byed ces gsung par 'dod bzhin du 'phags pa thogs med la rtsod par 'dod pa ga la 'thad/ thogs med kyis byams pa las lung blangs pa thams cad la grags bzhin/ dbyig gnyen gyis de ltar ma mkhyen par dris pa'i tshul dang / yi dam gyi lha zhig la zhu sho zhesathogs med kyis kyang gcung la sbas tshul du gsungs pa de kun 'thad kyang mi 'dra'o/ /des na rgya gar gyi lo rgyus las 'di ltar 'byung ste/ sngar gyi 'phro de las brtsams te/ sdig pa sbyong ba'i thabs zhus pas 'phags pas rgyal ba pham pa la zhus nas/ khyod kyis theg pa chen po'i chos rgya cher shod/ mdo sde yi ba po la'agrel pa gyis/ gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma'i rig sngags 'bum du zlos shigaces gsungs pas/ gcen la theg pa chen po'i mdo sde mtha' dag tshar ge rtsegartegasan pa tsam gyis thugs su chud/ slob dpon sngags mkhan zhig las sngags kyi 'jug sgo mnos nas/ gzungs mdo lnga brgya bklags/ gsang ba'i bdagapo'i rig sngags bzlas pas grub/ yang dag pa'i don thugs su chud cing/ tingange 'dzin khyad par can mnga' bar gyur/ de'i tshe rgyal ba'i bka' mi yul na bzhugs pa mtha' dag thugs su chud pas/ ston pa mya ngan las 'das pa'i 'og rol tu slob dpon dbyig gnyen lta bu'i mang du thos pa ni 'ga' yang med do — 119—

zhes grags so/ /de la nyan thos kyi sde snod gsum las mdo lnga brgya thoka'abum phrag gsum/ 'phags pa dpo zhe mchog brtsegs pa 'dus pa zhe dgugacig tu bsdoms/ phal po che dang / 'dus pa zin po che yang re rer bgrangagalhag ma sher phyin 'bum pa la sogs pa theg pa chen po'i mdo sde che chung kun bsdoms pa lnga brgya dang / bzung sngags lnga brgya ste/ de dag thams cad tshig don ma lus pa thugs su bzhugs so/ /lo re'i nang du lan re zhal 'don du mdzad de/ til mar gyi rdzing bu'i nang du zhugs nas nyin mtshan sprel ma bco lngasadernams tshar gcig zhal 'don du grub par mdzad cing / shes rab kyi pha rolatuphyin pa brgyad stong pa nyin re bzhin 'don par mdzad pa yang chu tshod gcig gnyis tsam re la grub par mdzad do/ /slob dpon 'di theg pa chen po la zhugs pa'i tshe nyan thos kyi sde snod 'dzin pa sogs mkhas pa lnga brgya tsam theg chen la zhugs shing / 'phags pa thogs med sku 'das pa'i 'og tu dpal nā len+t+ra'i mkhan po mdzad de/ chos kyi rnam grangs du ma bton par mdzad pa las/ nyin re bzhin mos pa tha dad pa rnams kyi ngor rab byung bsnyen rdzogs gzhan la gtod pa dang / rang nyid kyisarab tu byung ba dang / dge slong gi mkhan po dang glob dpon du mdzad pa dang /soso'i lhung ba phyir 'chos su 'jug pa dang / bdag nyid chos spyod bcu ma chag par mdzad pa dang / stan na stong phrag re nyin rer chos spyod bcu tshang ba la sbyor ba dang / khyad par theg pa chen po'i mdo sde mi 'dra ba'i chos thun nyi shu re chag med du gsung pa dang / srod kyi dus su chos rnams kyi snying po bsdus te gal bzung ba —120—

dang / gzhung gzug par mdzad cing / gung thun la cung zad tsam mnal ba'i ngangal lhag pa'i lha las chos gsan par mdzad/ tho rangs yang dag pa'i ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par 'jog bar bar du bstan bcos rtsom pa dang / nokyi rgol pa zlog par mdzad de/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa nyi khri lnga stong pa dang / blo gros mi zad pas bstan pa dang / sa bcu pa dang / de kon mchoge rjesadran dang / phyag rgya lnga'i mdo dang / rten 'brel gyi mdo dang / mdo gyon dang/'byed gnyis sogs theg pa che chung gi mdo sde che chung / dgongs 'grel gyi bstan bco se sogs la gzhan 'grel du brtsams pa lnga bcu tsam dang / zang rkangadu pra ka ra ṇa sde brgyad mdzad/ gtsug tor rnam rgyal 'bum bzlas pas kyang de'i rig sngags grub/ de nas gsang ba'i bdag po'i zhal mngon gsum du gzhigs shing / ting nge 'dzin dpag tu med pa brnyes so/ /slob dpon 'dis mdzad pa'i rten 'brel mdo 'grel sogs gzhan 'grel gsum po pra ka ra ṇa sde brgyad la bgrang ba phyogs 'dir spyi khyab tu grags kyang / tshig 'grel la rab tu byed pa'i tha snyad mi sbyor zhing/ rnam bshad rig pa la'ang rab tu byed pa'i tha snyad 'jug pa dka'o/ /de la rab tu byed pa nidon tshan gtso che ba re re ston pa'i bstan bcos thor bu'i ming yin pas/ mdo sde rgyan lta bu'i gzhung chen po la'ang mi zer na/ de'i tshig 'grel la zer ba ltasmos kyang ci dgos/ rab tu byed pa sde brgyad las la la la rab tu byed pa'i mingayod la/ 'ga' zhig la med pa'ang mi rigs so/ /slob dpon 'dis mtha' 'khobo thag ring po rnams su ma gshegs/ phal cher ma ga dh+wa nyid du bzhugs/—121 —

der chos gzhi rnying pa rnams cung zad zhig pa gso ba dang / theg pa chen po'i chos gzhi gsar pa brgya rtsa brgyad btsugs te ma ga dha'i sa phyogs thams cad chos gzhis khyab par mdzad/ shar phyogs go ri'i yul du lan cig byon/ deragrong khyer gyi skye bo dpag tu med pa 'dus pa la mdo sde mang po gsungs pag lha rnams kyis gser gyi me tog gi char phab/ mu to ba re res kyang gser gyi tshetog bre bo che re re tsam rnyed pa byung / yul der yang chos gzhi brgya rtsa bgyod btsugs so/ /o ṭi bi shar bram ze mak+ṣi ka zhes bya bas spyan drangs te/ deratheg pa chen po'i dge 'dun stong phrag bcu gnyis la zla ba gsum du dus ston byas pas/ bram ze'i khyim du rin po che'i 'byung khungs lnga brdol/ yul de yangabram ze dang / khyim bdag dang / rgyal po rnams dad par byas na gder yangachos gzhi brgya rtsa brgyad btsugs so/ /gzhan yang lho phyogs kyi rgyud la sogasardepa mang por yang slob dpon nyid kyis bka' bsgos te chos gzhi btsugs pa thams cad bsdoms na de dang mnyam pa tsam yod pas/ chos gzhi drug bgyodapalnga bcu rtsa bzhi tshugs so zhes grags so/ /slob dpon 'phags pa thogs med kyi dus las kyang theg pa chen po'i dge 'dun 'di skabs mang ste/ yul thams cad kyi rnams bsdoms na theg pa chen po'i dge slong drug khri longs pa tsam yod skad/ slob dpon nyid dang lhan cig tu rgyu zhing gnas pa'i dge slong yang stongatsam ste de thams cad tshul khrims dang ldan zhing mang du thos pa sha stag go /slob dpon de nyid gang du bzhugs pa thams cad du mi ma yin gyi mchod pa'i yo byad 'byung ba dang / rin po che'i 'byung khungs brdol ba sogs ya mtshan gyi chos—122—

rgyun mi 'chad du 'byung ngo / /bsam na shes pa'i mngon shes kyis dge midagodris pa thams cad bden par lung ston/ rgyal po'i khab kyi grong khyer la tshe shorab bden stobs brjod pas zhi ba dang / grong khyer mthar skyes su nad mas byungaba'am bden stobs brjod pas zhi ba dang / rig sngags kyis mthus sku tsheladabang thob pa sogs ngo mtshar ba'i rnam thar rgyun mi 'chad pa zhig go /snga phyir mu stegs kyi rgol ba lnga brgya tsam sun phyung zhing / spyir bus ze dang mu stegs can stong phrag lnga tsam sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la bcugamathar slob dpon stong gis bskor nas bal yul du byon te/ der yang chos gzhi btsugs te dge 'dun mang po thug med du 'phel bar mdzad/ khyim btsun chos/gos gyon nas zhing rmo ba gzigs nas/ ston pa'i bstan pa nyams so zhesathugs 'byung nas/ dge 'dun gyi dbus su chos bstan te/ gtsug gtor rnawargyal gyi gzungs mgo zhabs bzlog pa lan gsum zlos pas de nyid du sku 'das te re zhig chos kyi nyi ma nub bo zhes grags so/ /der slob ma rnams kyis mchod rten yang byas so/ /bod kyi lo rgyus ltar na mngon pa mdzod rtsa ba brtsams nasakha cher 'dus bzang la bskur bas dgyes shing 'grel pa gzigs phul bas ma dgyes te/ rtsod pa'i don du ma ga dhar byon pa la/ slob dpon dbyin go〉 gyisabal yul du byon pa yin no zhes zer ba/ mdzod rtsa 'grel brtsams nas 'dusabazang la gzigs phul bas dgyes pa dang / ma dgyes pa sogs de ltar 'thad du rung la/ 'dus bzang ma ga dhar byon pa'i gtam gsal po rgya gar na med cing / byon du zin na'ang snga mor yin par mngon nas/ dbyig gnyen bal yul—123—

du byon pa'i dus na/ 'dus bzang sku 'das nas lo mang por lon par 63 no/ /de la slob dpon 'phags pa thogs med kyis rab tu byung nas chos kyi bya ba lo bdun cu rtsa lnga tsam mdzad/ lo ni brgya dang lnga bcur 'tsho/ /gsungs pa'i lung bstan pa'i lo ni phyed yin zhing / chos kyis 'tsho ba'i dbang du mdzad pa dang 'grig lo sum cu lhag cig 'gro don nges par mdzad la/ rgya gar ba kha cigabazhi bcu lhag par mdzad par 'dod pa'i lugs kyang snang / slob dpon dbyigaganyen gyis dgung lo brgyar nye ba tsam bzhugs shing / 'phags pa thogs med bzhugs pa'i dus nyid du'ang lo mang por 'gro ba'i don cher mdzad/ 'phagasapa'i rjes su lo nyi shu rtsa lnga tsam 'gro ba'i don mdzad do/ /slob dpon r+ṣa po 'di dang bod kyi rgyal po lha tho ri gnyan btsan dus mnyam mo zhes grags pa ltar yang 'thad do/ /'phags pa thogs med sku mched kyi dus su byung ba'i gtamastonyi shu rtsa gnyis pa'o// //slob dpon chen po dbyig gnyen gyi sku tshe'i smad tsam gyi dus na/ rgyalapozab mo'i phyogs 'das pa'i 'og tu nub phyogs ma rle'i yul du skyes pa rgyal bo shrī har+sha zhes bya ba las kyi stobs shin tu che ba byung ste nub phyogs kyi rgyal khams thams cad la dbang bsgyur/ phyis sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la dad pa thob ste slob dpon yon tan 'od bla mar bkur ba chig byung / dus de tsam na shar phyogs su rgyal bo brik+ṣa tsan+t+ra'i bu brgyud la rgyal po bi ga ma tsan+d+ra dang / sda'i bu kā ma tsan+d+ra gnyis kyis rgyal srid skyong ba'i dus te/ rgyal po de gnyis dbang thang dang longs spyod kyang che/ spyin pa la dga'/ rgyal srid chos lugs bzhin du skyong ba —124—

yin kyang dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su ma song ste/ phyi nang gnyis karamachod cing khyad par gcer bu pa rnams la mos so/ kha cher de tsam na yang rgyawapo mang pos bkur ba nyid yod do zhes grags so/ /de'i tshe shar phyogs su slob dpon blo gros brtan pa dang / phyogs kyi glang pos 'gro don mdzad/ nub phyogasasu 'phags pa thogs med kyi slob ma sangs rgyas 'bangs kyi sku che'i smad kyi 'gro don dang / yon tan 'od kyi 'gro don dar ba'i dus so/ kha tshe'i yul du 'a sno pa dge 'dun 'bangs kyis 'gro ba'i don cher mdzad/ slob dpon chos 'bangaloyul thams cad du gshegs shing chos ston pa zhig byung la/ lho phyogs kyi rgyud du slob dpon sangs rgyas bskyangs byon/ legs ldan dang / rnam grol ste rnyas kyi sku tshe'i stod kyi dus tsam yin/ o ṭi bi sha'i yul du rgyal po dza le ru he'i bu nā ge sha dang / blon po bram ze nā ga ko sha zhes bya ba byung ste/ lo bdun tsam rgyalasrid bskyangs pas shin tu dbang thang che zhing / bi kha ma tsan+t+ra sa kyang phyag byas/slob dpon lo yi pas btul te rgyal srid spangs/ grub pa thob pa ni rgyal po da ri ka pa dang / blon po ḍi gi pa'o/ /slob dpon dkon mchog gsum gyi 'bangasazhes pa'ang legs ldan dang dus mnyam pa tsam yin zhing / o ḍi bi shar bramazebha dra pā li ta zhes bya ba'i kyang bstan pa la bya ba cher byas so/ /de dag las/rgyal po shrī har+sha 'gran zla med pa'i rgyal por gyur pa'i tshe kla kle'i chos rnams nub par 'dod pas/ yul mo la ta na dang nye ba'i yul phran zhig tu ma si ta sto kla kle'i dgon gnas chen po shing khang 'ba' zhig yin pa brtsigs nas kla kle'i ston pa mtha' dag bos/ zla ba mang por yo byad thams cad kyis bstabs/ de'i —125—

ring lugs kyi glegs bam thams cad kyang bsdus/ thams cad me la bsregs pas kla kle'i grub mtha' 'dzin pa stong phrag bcu gnyis tshig go /de skabs yulakho rā sa ṇa ra kla kle'i chos shes pa gcig thags 'thag cing yod do/ /de lasarim gyis mched pa ni phyis kyi kla klo thams cad yin no/ /rgyal po des de ltarabasnubs pa la brten te lo brgyar nye bar stag gzig sog po'i chos lugs de spyod pa shin tu yi ngo / /de nas sdig pa sbyong ba'i don du ma ru dang/ malawadang / me wa ra dang / pi tu wa dang / tsi tā wa ra zhes pa'i yul rnams su gtsunalag khang chen po re re bzhengs/ dge slong stong phrag re re'i 'tsho ba sbyar zhingachos shin tu dar bar byas so/ /slob dpon wo po yon to 'od ni/ yulabacom brlag tu bram ze'i rigs su skyes/ rig byed dang bstan bcos mtha' dag legs par byang ba phyis de nyid kyi gtsug lag khang zhig tu rab tu byung zhing bsnyen par rdzogs nas/ slob dpon chen po dbyig gnyen gyi drung du nyan thos kyi sde snod gsum dang / theg pa chen po'i mdo sde du ma la yang mkhas par sbya pagasde pa tha dad pa'i 'du/la ba bstan bcos dang bcas pa mtha' dag mkhas par mkhyen/ 'dul ba 'bum sto rtag tu thugs la 'don par mdzad/ yul bcotshabarlag gi gtsug lag khang a gra pu ri zhes/ bya bar bzhugs te/ lhan cig/gan/sapa dge slong stong phrag lnga re yod cing / thams cad kyang bsdam bya'i nyes byas phra mo tshun chod so so'i phyir bcos kyis 'phral 'phral du bcos pas tshul khrims rnam par dag pa ni sngon dgra bcom pa rnams kyis bstan pa skyong ba'i dus bzhin yod la/ mdo sde 'dzin pa dang / ma mo 'dzin pa'ang mang du yod cing/—126—

'dul ba 'bum sde thon pa'ang lnga brgya tsam mo/ /tshul khrims rnam par dag pa'i stobs kyis rgyal po shrī harnya'i blon po ma taṅka rā dza zhes bya ba lan cig rgyal po'i chad pas mig phyung ba yang slob dpon gyi smon lam gyi stobs kyis sor chud/rgyal po'i bla mar gyur pas nyin re bzhin yo byad dpag tu med pa'i 'du ba byung yang de ma thag thams cad dge bar bskyur te/ rang nyid sbyangs pa'i yon tan las nyams pa mi mnga' 'o/ /slob dpon blo gros brtan pa ni/ slob dpon dbyig gnyen 'bum sde dgu bcu go dgur grags pa'i gsung rab rnams zhal 'don mdzad pa'i tshe/ gdung gi phrag na phug ron cang shes pa zhig gnas pa shin tu gus pas nyan no/ /de shi nas lho phyogs daṇ+ḍa ka ra n+ya zhes bya bar tshong dpon gyi bu zhig tu skyes/ skyes ma thag tu slob dpon ga na bzhugs dris pa la/ slob dpon su yin dris pas/ dbyig gnyen yin te ma ga dh+wa na ste/ yulade'i tshong pa la dris pas kyang bzhugs zer bas/ lo bdun lon pa'i dus na slob dpon dbyig gnyen drung du bskyal te rig pa slob cing yod pas kyang dka' ba med par shes/ de'i tshe sran ma sbar gang rnyed pa za'am snyam nas sgrol mo'i lha khang zhig na yod pa la/ 'phags ma la ma phul bar bza' mi rung snyam nas dran ma 'ga' zhig phul bas 'gril nas byung / 'phags mas ma gsol bar rang za ba mi 'ong snyam nas/ zad zad phul yang 'gril te byung ba na/ byis par gyurapas ngus so/ /'phags mas zhal mthon sum du bstan te/ khyod ma ngu zhinangasabyin gyis rlob bo zhes gsungs/ skad cig de la blo gros mtha' yas par gyurazhing/ sku brnyan de la yang ma ṣa tā ra zhes grags so/ /phyis gnas brtan sde snod —127—

gsum 'dzin pa khyad par du theg pa che chung gi mtho zhe pa mtha' dag la mkhas pa 'phags pa dkon mchog brtsegs pa la zhal 'don mdzad pa/ bya ba thams cad 'phags ma sgrol mas lung ston pa zhig ste/ dkon mchog brtsegs pa 'dus pa zhe dgu dang dbu ma rtsa ba la 'grel pa yang mdzad/ slob dpon dbyig gnyen sku'adas tsam na/ mu stegs be ni bā la la sogs pa rgol ba mang po tshar bcad de smra ba'i dbang phyug tu grags/ slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyis mdzad pa'i 'grel pa phal cher 'grel bshad dang / gzhung la 'grel pa yang mang du mdzad do/ /mngon pa mdzod la'ang 'grel pa mdzad zer te/ slob dpon 'di nyid yin min mi shesaso/ /slob dpon snga ma rnams kyi dus su btsugs pa'i chos gzhi rnams de tsam na cher med pas/ slob dpon 'dis kyang chos gzhi brgya rtsa btsugs so zhes kyangagrags so/ /slob dpon phyogs kyi glang po ni/ lho phyogs grong khyer siṅga bak+ta zhes bya ba ka snyu'i yul dang nye ba zhig tu bram ze'i rigs su 'khrungs shing / mu stegasakyi grub mtha' thams cad la shin tu mkhas par byas pa chig gnas ma bu'i sde pa'i mkhan po sde pa de nyid kyi grub mtha' 'dzin pa nā ga dat+ta ste glang po byin zhes bya ba las rab tu byung zhing nyan thos kyi sde snod gsum la mkhas par byas nas/mkhan po de nyid la gdams ngag zhus pas/ brjod du med pa'i bdag 'tsholaba'i gdams pa byin no/ /der rnam par brtags shing btsal na yod paramamathong ste/ nyin mo skar khung thams cad bsal/ mtshan mo phyogs bzhin maratshebatang ste/ lus gcer bur phyung nas phyi nang kun tu yang bltas so/ /de ltar byed pa grogs kyis mthong nas mkhan po la bshad pas mkhan pos kyang dris pa na/—128—

bdag ni blo rtul zhing blo gros dman pas mkhan pos bstan pa'i de nyid gang yin pa de ni bdag gis mi mthong ste/ de'i phyir sgrib byed kyis bsgribs sa5snyam de ltar byas nas blta ba yin zer/ don gyis de 'gog par byed pa'i rigapa rnams kyang bstan pas/ mkhan po khros te/ kho bo'i grub mtha' la zur za ba khyod ma 'dug cig ces skrod pa'i gnas ma yin par bskrad pa na/ de nyid du rig pas sun dbyung bar nus mod kyis/ 'os ma yin pas phyag btsal nas phyir byon/ mthar gyis slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyi drung du gshegs/ theg pa tshe chudagi sde snod mtha' dag gsan/ mthar mdo lnga brgya tsam bzung bar grags te theg pa che chung dang / gzungs sngags tshun chad bsdoms pa'o/ khyad par du sngagasamakhan gyi slob dpon zhig las rig sngags nos te bsgrubs pas 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi zhal mngon sum du gzigs pas ji ltar bzhed pa na chos gsan par mdzad do/ /o ḍi bi sha'i yul nags tshal shin tu dben pa'i phyogs gcig bho ta sil zhes bya ba'i brag ri'i phug tu bzhugs/ rtsegacig tu bsam gtan la rtsolabar mdzad do/ /lo 'ga' zhig 'das pa na/ dpal nā len+t+ra ra mu stegs kyi rtsod pa cher byung / der bram ze su dur dza ya zhes bya ba rang gis bsgrubs pa'i lha mngon sum mthong ba rtog ge la shin tu byang ba thub par dka' ba zhig kyang 'dus te/ der sangs rgyas pa rnams kyis rtsod par ma nus nas/ shar phyogasanas slob dpon phyogs kyi glang po spyan drangs so/ /mu stegs de lan gsum du pham par byas shing / der 'tshogs pa'i mu stegs kyi rgol ba thams cad kyangare—129—

re nas sun phyung / sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la bkod/ gnas der dgo'adun rnams la mdo sde du ma rnam par bshad cing / chos mngon pa yang rgyas par byas/rnam rig dang rtog ge'i bstan bcos thor bu yang mang du mdzad de/ yongasasubasdoms pa la bstan bcos brgya rtsa mdzad par grags/ slar yang o di bi sha'i yul du gshegs nas bsam gtan la brtson par mdzad do/ /der rang go thun mong ma yin pa'i blo gros kyi mthu las byung ba rtog ge'i tshul lugs 'di la sngar brtsams pa'i bstan bcos rnams 'thor ba bzhin du gyur pas gcig tu bya bar dgongs te/ tshad ma kun las bshus pa'i mchod brjod dam bca'/tshad mar gyur pa 'gro la phan bzhed pa/ /ston pa bde gshegs skyob la phyag 'tshal nas/ /tshad ma bsgrub phyir rang gi gzhung kun lag /btus/te sna tshogs 'thor rnams 'dir gcig bya/ /zhes rdo thal gyis bris pag sa g.yo ba dang / phyogs kun tu snang bas khyab pa dang / sgra chen po grags par gyur/ der bram ze nag po zhes bya bas de lta bu'i ltas yin par shes te/ slob dpon bsod snyoms la bzhud pa'i shul du des 'ongs te bsubs/ de ltar lan gnyisasubasubs pas lan gsum pa bris pas/ 'di ku re dang kyal ka'i phyir bsdang/ pa yin na dgos pa chen po yod pas ma bsub cig /gal te don nor te rtsod para'adod na lus snang bar gyis zhes pa bris te/ yang bsod snyoms la gshegasapa'i shul du bsub tu 'ongs pas yi ge mthong nas bsdad do/ /der slob dpon 'khor nas/ bstan pa dpang du btsugs te brtsad pas lan mang por spo stegasapham par byas pas/ da khyod sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa zhugs shig byas pa na/—130—

des sngags bzlas pa'i thal ba gtor bas slob dpon gyi yo byad rnams tshigaslob dpon yang tshig la khad par byung ste/ mu stegs de phyir song ngo/ /bdagagis 'di cig pu'i don yang mi nus na gzhan gyi don ga la nus snyam du sems bskyed gtong bar brtsams pa na/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal mngon sum du byon te/ bu ma byed ma byed skye bo dman dang 'phrad las blo gros ngan skye ste/ /khyod kyi bstan bcos 'di la mu stegs tshogs kyis gnod mi nus par shes/ khyod kyi sangs rgyas ma thob bar du dge ba'i bshes su nga 'gyur gyi/ /phyi ma'i dusasubastan bcos kun gyi mig gcig tu ni 'di 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs pa la/slob dpon gyis/ bzod dka'i sdug bsngal du ma dang ldan brnag dka' la/ /sems kyang dam pa min pa'i spyod pa la dga' zhing / /skye bo dam pa 'phrad dka' gal te khyod kyi zhal mthong yang / /bdag la byin gyis ma brlabs de laci bgyir mchi/ /zhes zhus pas/ bu khyod ma dga' bar ma byed cig /nyamang ba thams cad las bdag gis bsrung ngo / /zhes gsungs nas mi snang bar gyurato/ /de nas bstan bcos de yang legs par brtsams/ lan cig cung snyung b.ragyur te/ grong khyer nas bsod snyoms bslangs te nags mthong zhig tu bzhugasapas yur te mnal du song / mnal lam du sangs rgyas mang po'i zhal mthongazhing ting nge 'dzin mang po thob/ phyi rol tu lha rnams kyis me tog gi char phab/nags kyi me tog rnams kyang 'dud par gyur/ glang po che rnams bsil grib tubyed cing yod pa las yul gyi rgyal po skye bo'i 'khor dang bcas pa skyo sangs la 'ongs pas mthong ste/ ngo mtshar skyes nas rol mo'i sgra bsgrags pas man las da —13/—

de/ khyod phyogs kyi glang po yin nam dris pas/ de ltar 'dags gsungs/ derargyal pos zhabs la phyag byas/ de nas mthar lto phyogs kyi rgyud du byon/ yulathadad kyi mu stegs kyi rgol ba phal cher tshar bcad de/ sngon gyi slob dpon rnamasakyis btsugs pa'i chos gzhi nyams pa phal cher sor chud par mdzad/ slar yanga.o sko bi sha'i rgyal po'i blon po bha dra pā li ta zhes bya ba rgyal po'i mdzod kyi spyan pa yin pa de sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la bcug ste/ bram ze des gtsug lag khangachen po bcu drug bzhengs/ de re rer dge 'dun gyi sde chen po re btsugs/gtsug lag khang re rer yang chos gzhi du ma yod pa byas/ tshul khrims rnam par dag pa'i rtags su/ bram ze de'i skyed mod tshal na nad thams cad gso bar nus pa mu spyi ha ri ta ka zhes bya ba a ru ra'i khyad par zhig gi sdong po yod pas skye bo mang po la phan pa zhig las/ lan cig shing gi sdong po shin tu bskams par gyurapa la slob dpon gyis sos par smon lam btab pas zhag bdun na sor chud do/ /de ltar mu stegs kyi rgol ba phal cher tshar bcad pas rtsod pa'i khyu mchogatu grags shing / chos kyis sbrel ba'i slob mas ni phyogs thams cad khyab parayod/ phyi bzhin 'brang ba'i dge slong ni gcig kyang yongs su ma bzung/ 'dod pa chung zhing chog shes pas ji srid 'tsho'i bar du sbyangs pa'i yon tan bcu gnyis la gnas bzhin du o kho bi sha'i nags tshal dben pa zhig tu sku 'das so/ /btsun pa dgo'adun 'bangs ni/ slob dpon dbyig gnyon gyi slob tshazhig ste/ yul lho phyogs pa rigs bram ze/ sde pa thams cad yod par smra ba yin/ des rdo rje'i gdan du yun ring du bzhugs shing / rdo rje'i cwan du snyul—132—

ba dang / mngon pa'i chos gzhi nyi shu rtsa bzhi btsugs/ rgyal po tu sa| mang posabakur bas spyan drangs te kha cher byon/ rin chen sbas pa'i gtsug lag khang dang /nga kuṇ+ḍa li'i gtsug lag khang bzhengs/ theg pa chen po'i chos mang du dar b.ramadzad nas yul de nyid du 'das so/ kha che'i yul du sngon theg pa chen po'i bstan pa cher med/ thogs med sku mched kyi sku ring la cung zad tsam dar/ slob dpon 'di nas brtsams te rje dar du song ngo / /slob dpon chos 'bangs ni/ shar phyogs bhaX ga lar 'khrungs shing/thogs med sku mched gnyis kar gyi slob ma yin/ phyogs bzhi'i yul thamasacad du byon nas 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi lha khang re bzhengs/ rnal 'byoraspyod pa'i sa yongs su rdzogs pa la 'grel pa mdzad do zhes grags so/ /slob dpon sangs rgyas bskyangs ni/ lho phyogs ta sba la'i yul gyi bye brag ngang pasartseb zhes bya bar 'khrungs/ yul de nyid du rab tu byung zhing mang du thos par mdzad pa cig slob dpon klu'i bshes gnyen kyi slob ma/ slob dpon dge 'dun srung ba las slob dpon klu sgrub kyi gzhung lugs rnams thong/ par byas nas/ rtsegacigatu bsgom pas ye shes mchog brnyes/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi zhal gzigs shing / lto phyogs kyi gtsug lag khang daṇ+ḍa pu ri zhes bya bar bzhugs nas chos kyang mang du bstan/ 'phags pa yab sras dang / slob dpon dpa' bo la sogs pas mdzad pa'i bstan bcos mang po la rnam bshad mdzad/ mthararilu'i dngos grub bsgrubs pas grub bo/ slob dpon legs ldan ni lho phyogasamablo rar rgyal rigs mchog tu skye ba brnyes/ yul de nyid du rab tu byung nasasde—133
