snod gsum la mkhas par byas/ yul dbus su byon nas slob dpon dge 'dun srung ba las/ theg pa chen po'i mdo sde du ma dang klu de kyi man ngag nos te/slar yang lto phyogs kyi rgyud du gshegs nas phyag na rdo rje'i zhal mthong bar mdzad de/ ting nge 'dzin khyad par can yang bsgrubs/ lto phyogs kyi gtsug lagalnga bcu tsam gyi bdag po mdzad de chos mang du bstan/ slob dpon sangs rgyasabaskyangs sku 'das pa'i 'og rol du des mdzad pa'i bstan bcos rnams gzigs/ dbu ma rtsa ba'i gzhung la slob dpon snga ma'i bzhed pa de sun phyung ste/'grel pa mdzad cing klu sgrub kyi man ngag la brten par zhal gyis bzhes nas mdo sde 'ga' zhig la 'grel pa mdzad do/ /mthar 'dis kyang ril bu'i de grosagrub bsgrubs te grub la/ 'on kyang slob dpon 'di gnyis char gyi rnam par smin pa'i sku lus bor nas rig sngags 'chang gi gnas su gshegs so/ /de la slob dpon 'di gnyis kyis dbu ma ngo bo nyid med par smra ba'i gzhung btsug shing /sangs rgyas bskyangs slob ma ha cang mang ba ma yin kyang / slob dpon legasardeldan ni slob ma shin tu mang ba dge slong stong phrag du ma rjes su 'brang ba yin pas lugs de shin tu dar bar gyur to/ /slob dpon 'di gnyis ma byon gyibaradu theg pa chen po pa mtha' dag bstan pa gcig tu gnas pa las/ slob dpon 'di gnyis kyis 'phags pa klu sgrub dang / 'phags pa thogs med kyi lugs gnyis ni shin tu tha dad de/ thogs med kyi lugs ni dbu ma'i lam ston pa mayin par sems tsam kho na yin la/ 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi ba ched pa ni kho bo cag gi 'di las gzhan du med do zhes mtha' gzhan 'gog par mdzad pas/—134—

legs ldan sku 'das pa'i 'og tsam nas theg pa chen po pa'ang nang du sde gnyis su gyes nas rtsod pa byung ngo / /de yang slob dpon blo gros brtan pas dbu martsaba'i dgongs pa rnam rig tu 'grel ba'i rnam bshad cig mdzad la/ de'i glegasabam lho phyogs kyi rgyud du byung nas legs ldan gyi slob ma rnams kyis mi 'thad par byas so/ /de dag nā len+t+ra ra 'ongs nas blo brtan gyi slob ma rnams dang brtsad pas/legs ldan gyi slob ma rgyal po zhes ngo bo nyid med par smra ba rnams zer ba dang /tsan+d+ra go sī dang / zla ba grags pa'i byung tshul gyis shes so/ /bod mang po rnamasasangs rgyas bskyangs 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi sku tshe'i stod kyi slob ma dang / legasaldan sku tshe'i smad kyi slob ma yin pa dang / rtsod pa byas skad pa dang / drangs rgyasabaskyangs zla grags su skye ba zhes zer ba sogs rig pas dras pa'i bcos bgros tsam du snang / kha cig de dag bkag nas/ dpyod pa dag dag mor byas nas/ de dag slob dpon klu sgrub kyi dngos slob yin/ legs ldan gyi bsnyen rdzogasamakhan po'ang klu sgrub yin/ zla grags 'phags pa lha'i dngos slob yin zer te/'phags pa lha lta bu gnyis ka'i khungs su byed pa de bzhugs bzhin du/ deganyis grub mtha' tha dad du gyes don ga la yod/ dpyod ldan yod na de 'dralasu zhig yid da chas bya/ 'phags pa rnam grol sde ni/ yul dbus dang lho phyogs kyi mtshams 'bar ba'i phug dang nye bar 'khrungs te/ slob dpon sangs rgyasa'abangs kyi dbon po yin zhing / 'phags pa ku ru ku lce'i sde pa las ra btu byung/sde pa de'i grub mtha' la mkhas par byas pa zhig theg pa chen po la mos nas —135—

slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyi drung du byon/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa kha te sher phyin mdo sde rnams yongs su rdzogs par bzung nas/ man ngag ma gsan no/ /der slob dpon dge 'dun srung ba'i slob ma'i tha ma mdzad nas sher phyin gyi man ngag de la zhus so/ /slob dpon 'di bod la grags pa ltar na/ slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyi slob ma phar phyin rang las mkhas pa yin zer zhing/ rgya gar ba 'ga' zhig ni phyogs kyi glang po'i slob ma yin te/ dbyig gnyen gyi zhabs kyang ma zin/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i mngon rtogs ni sleb dpon chos 'bangs la zhus shing / man ngag ni legs ldan la gsan no zhesakyang zer mod kyis/ 'dir 'phags yul na grags che ba ltar na dkyus nyid de/dbyig gnyen gyi slob ma'i tha ma lta bu yin no/ /de la slob dpon 'di nyid rjesa'abrang rnams la 'di skad ces grags te/ de yang slob dpon 'di gzhung lugasasna tshogs kyis dub pa ngal gso ba'i phyir shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la bsam sgom mdzad pa'i tshe nyams myong khyad par can thugs la 'khrungs/ don lathe tshom med kyang mdo gcig dang mngon rtogs rgyan gyi tshig la mi 'byor ba 'ga' re byung ste thugs mi bde ba'i tshe/ mnal lam du 'phags pa byams pasalung bstan te/ khyod wā rā ṇa sri'i gtsug lag khang du song zhig /don chen po rnyed par 'gyur ro gsungs/ nangs par der byon pas dge bsnyen zhi ba'i gochalcags kyi byin pa can du grags pas lho phyogs po ta la nas nyi khri le brgyad ma'i dpe spyan drangs te byon pa dang 'dzom/ mdo tshig rgyan dang mthun par byung bsadabugs dbyung thob bo/ /de la mdo le brgyad ma dang / mthon rtogs ma ro bo —136—

nyid med par smra ba'i dbu ma'i don du bkral ba dang / mdo rgyan mtha' dgabasres pa'i bstan bcos mdzad pa po yin la/ slob dpon 'di ma byung ba'i sngarol du de ltar med pas/ nyi khri snang bar sngon chad gzhan gyis ma myongs gsungaba'i rgyu mtshan de ltar yin no zhes zer ro/ /mthar shar phyogs su rgyal phran zhinagi bla mar gyur/ gtsug lag khang nyi shu rtsa bzhi tsam gyi bdag po mdzad de shesarab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stsal tu bton nas gsungs pas/ sher mdo nyan pa'i dge slong rang yang nyung dus su stong phrag re 'tshogs pa lo sum cu tsam gyi bar du byung ngo / /slob dpon 'di rgya bod gnyis su sa dang po yin zer ba dang/ sbyoralam pa yin pas 'phags pa dngos min yang / 'phags pa dang nye bas de'i khongs su gtogs zer ba dang / so so skye bo yin mod 'phags pa grol sde zeraba'i 'phags pa ni mig gi zur te rgyal po sangs rgyas sogs byas pas sangs rgyas yin par mi 'gyur ba bzhin zer ba dang / dman lam sngon song gi byangasems yin zer ba sogs ma pa na yang / skyes mchog dam pa ngo mtshar can yin par rtsod par mi snang la/ de'i thugs rgyud skye 'phags rdzi ltar yin sus shes/tshul ston so so skye bo mos spyod pa cig tu mngon no/ /slob dpon dkon rmegogasum gyi 'bangs ni slob dpon dbyig gnyen las mngon pa'i sde snod thos la yul gzhan tha dad kyi sde snod 'dzin pa du ma bsten pa/ slob dpon phyogs kyi glang po dang shin tu mdza' bshes su gyur pa/ phyogs kyi glang po la shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa nyan pa'i slob ma zhig ste/ blo gros phyogs kyi glang po dang mnyam par grags shing brgyad stong don bsdus la 'grel pa yang mdzad/ 'dis mdzad —137—

pa'i yon tan mtha' yas par bstod pa la phyogs kyi glang pos kyang bsdus don mdzad do/ /slob dpon dkon mchog gsum gyi 'bangs slob dpon dpa' bo'i mtshan du 'dod cing / gang dag bstod pa brgya lnga bcu pa la phyogs glang gisaspel mar bstod pa'i kha skong mdzad pas dpa' bo dang / phyogs glang phar slob tshur slob yin no zhes chos 'byung rtsom par byed pa ni lo rgyus ma dag pa thos pa'am/ dag por thos kyang ma nges pa'i rang bzo'o/ /de yang spel mar bstod pa'i nang gi phyogs glang gi gsung rnams bstod pa brgya lnga bcu pa'i tshig de dang de'i mtshams sbyor ram/ don gsal byed khon yin pas 'grel par sbyar ba yin gyi/ slob dpon de gnyis kyis rtsom res byasapa ga la yin zhes go dgos so/ /slad kyis slob dpon des lho phyogs kyi rgyud du byon te gtsug lag khang du ma'i mnga' bdag mdzad nas skye bo du ma la chos bstan/ drwa ba la'i yul du byon nas chos gzhi chen po lnga bcu tsam gsar du btsugs shing bstan pa yun ring du gsal bar byas te/ mthar gnod sbyin mobasgrubs nas ri'i rgyal po me tog brgya pa zhes bya bar bzhud do/ /dge bsnyen zhiba'i go mas po ta lar phyin pa yang 'di dag dang dus mtshungs pa'i skabs te/yul puṇ+ḍa wa ste ni'i nags tshal na dge bsnyen de 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs bsgrubs shig grub pa'i rtags kyang phal cher byung / rgyal po shu bha sa ra zhes bya ba'i rmi lam du 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs spyan drangs na yul 'dir 'byon pas/ 'dzam bu'i gling du mu ge dang rims nad rgyun chad cing bde bar 'gyur la/de'i don du nags tshal na gnas pa'i dge bsnyen 'di lta bu ri bo ta lar rdzongs —138—

shig ces byung bas rgyal pos dge bsnyen bos te/ mu tig gi phreng ba dang spyan 'dren pa'i yi ge gtad/ lam rgyags pa ṇa dag kyang byin pan/ dge bsnyen gyis bsam pa/ lam bgrod dka' zhing ring bas srog gi bar chad kyang byed srid na/'on kyang yi dam gyi lha bzhugs pa'i sar 'gro bar bskul ba 'di'i ngag gcog pa ni cha ma yin no snyam po ta la'i lam yig thogs te song / mthar dha na shrī'i gling dpal ldan 'bras skrungs kyi mchod rten du sleb/ de nas po ta lar 'groba'i lam sa 'og cung zad brgyud nas phyin pa na/ slar sa steng nas 'gro sa yod pa ding sang ni rgya mtsho lud pas sa gzhi non te mis thar ba med gsung / sngon gyi dus de tsam na lam yod pas de las brgyud nas song / der chu bo chen po lawathar ba na/ lam yig ltar sgrol ma la gsol ba btab pas rgan mo zhig gi grubatang nas bsgral/ yang mtsho gcig la ma thar ba na/ khro gnyer can tshalagasol ba btab pas bu mo zhig gis gzings btang nas bsgral/ yang nagasakyi mtha' me 'bar nas ma thar ba la/ rta mgrin la gsol ba btab pas myongaphab ste zhi/ 'brug sgras lam bstan/ yang ngam grog gting dpag tshad mang po yod pas lam bcad de 'gro ma thub pa la/ ral gcig ma la gsol ba btabapas sprul chen pos zam pa byas te de la phyin/ de nas spre'u glang po che'i lus tsamamang pos lam bkag nas 'dug pa la/ don yod zhags pa la gsol ba btabapas spre'u chen po de rnams kyis lam phye zhing bza' bca' bzang po dag byin/denas ri bo ta la'i rtsa bar sleb nas brag ri la ma thar te/ 'phags pa spyan rasagazigs la gsol ba btab pas ga thag gi skas byung nas de la 'dzegs/ de —139—

nas phyogs thams cad rmugs pas non te lam ma rnyed/ yun ring du gsol ba btab pa na na bun dengs/ ri de'i sum cha la sgrol ma'i sku brnyan dang / ri sked na khro gnyer can ma'i sku brnyan sogs mthong / ri'i rtse mor phyin pa na dzinalamed khang stong pa na tshe tog tho re ba las gzhan su yang mi 'dug go /der phyogasagacig tu gsol ba 'debs kyin zla ba gcig tu bsdad pas/ nam zhig na bud med cig 'ongs nas 'phags pa byon pas 'dir shog cig zer te khrid nas pho brang gi sgo rim pa stong phye ba las/ sgo re re phye bas ting nge 'dzin re re skyes/'phags pa lha lnga dang dngos su mjal/ me tog sku la gtor/ rgyal po'i yi godang rten phul/ 'dzam bu'i gling du 'byon par gsol ba btab pas zhal gyis bzhes te dge bsnyen la lam rgyags pa ṇa mang po gnang / 'di tsam gyi 'tsho ba la brten nas khyod yul du sleb par 'gyur gyis pa ṇa ma zad pa na 'ong ngo / /zhesagasungs shing lam bstan/ ri sked dang ri'i rtsa ba'i sum cha na yod pa'i sku brnyan tsho yang sku dngos su mthong / tshur 'ongs pa na zhag bco lnga na rang gi gnas derasleb rgyu'i bcu bzhi song ba'i nyin mo puṇ+ḍa warta na'i ri mthong bas rab tu dga' ste/ pa ṇa lhag pos bza' btung lhag par nyos te zos/ rgyal po'i grong khyer du ma sleb par rang gi sgrub gnas dang nye bar sleb pa'i tshe pa ṇa zad/ sa derabasdad nas nyin rangs par 'phags pa 'byon nam sems pa las ma khyon/ natshaphyed na gnyid du phri song ba na rol mo'i sgra grags pas gnyid sad/ nam mkha' na lha rnams mchod pa byed kyin 'dug su la mchod dris pas 'dzam bu'i glingapa'i khye'u rmongs pa khyed nyid rgyab brten pa'i shing la 'phags pa 'khor bcas —140—

byon no zer/ bltas pas shing gi ngos la lha lnga dngos su byon 'dug pas phyaga'atshal gsol ba btab/ rgyal po'i yul du 'byon par zhus kyang dang po pa ṇa mazad na de ltar yin yang da ni 'di kho nar gnas so gsung / de nas rgyal po lasbran pas ma mgu bar dge bsnyen la gla rngan gcig kyang ma byin skad/ denasanags tshal der lha khang bzhengs/ kha sa rla ṇi'i gtsug lag khang du grags te/ kha sa rla ṇa ni nam mkha' la gshegs nas byon pa'i phyir mkha' spyod dam pa ṇa zad pa'i tshe byon pas pa ṇa zad pa zhes bya ba yin zer yang mkha' spyod du bsgyur ba ni shin tu legs shing / cig shos dang mthun par bsgyur na/ khar sa ni zas kyi rin gyi skad dod yin la/ pa ṇa ni gser dngul gyi dong tse da lta ṭa nga khar gragasapa 'di yin pas/ zas rin dong tse'i don yin no/ /de ltar ni rgya lta spya a tugrags pa ltar ro/ /nyi khri le brgyad ma'i lo rgyus ltar na/ rgyal pos bsku wa pa'i 'phros med par po ta lar lan gsum byon pa'i dang po khong rang nyid kyi mjal ba'i don dang / gnyis pa mngon rtogs rgyan dang mdo ma mthun pa'i dogasagacod la wā rā ṇa sri'i dge 'dun gyis btang ba yin na'ang / de ma zhus para'aphags pa kha sa dru ṇa nyid spyan drangs/ kha sa rla ṇa la zhus pas/ nga sprul/pa yin pas mi shes gsungs nas/ lan gsum pa de'i dogs gcod la po ta 'ang byon nas le brgyad ma yang spyan drangs zer ro/ /dge bsnyen de la 'phags pa khas chu ṇa lha lnga dngos su snang zhing / dus der mchod pa yang mngon sum du bzhes pa las/ dge bsnyen de yo byad la bltas nas chom rkun pas bkrong par brtsamasapa'i tshe/ myong bar nges pa'i las kyi mthur shes nas/ mgo bo 'phags pa'i phyag —141 —

tu phul zhig byas nas/ cho me rkun pas kyang de bzhin du byas/ 'phags pas spyan chab phyung ba klad khung du song bas de thams cad ring bsrel du gyur/ de phyin chad mchod pa dngos su ma bzhes zhes grags so/ /slob dpon phyogs kyi glang po lasogs pa'i dus kyi gtam ste nyi shu rtsa gsum pa'o// //de nas rgyal po shrī harnya'i bu rgyal po ngang tshul zhes bya ba byung / de ni sngon dge slong sde snod gsum pa zhig rgyal po'i pho brang du dus ston chen po yod pa zhig la slong mor phyin yang bsod snyoms ma thob par sgo bas bskrad do/ /de khazas bcad pas bkres nas 'das pa'i tshe/ dkon mchog mchod pa'i rgyal poragyur nas rab tu byung ba rnams zas kyis tshim par byed pa'i smon lam btab/de'i mthus rgyal po'i longs spyod chen por gyur te phyogs bzhi'i dge 'dun thams cad la kha zas bzang pos mchod pa zhig byung / pho brang grong khyer la ta zhes bya bar byas/ lo brgya dang bzhi bcu thob/ rgyal srid kyang lo brgyar nye b.rabyas so/ /yon tan 'od kyi sku tshe'i gzhug tsam na 'di rgyal sar thon/ shar du rgyal po li tsa sbu'i rigs las byung ba seng ge zhes bya ba mnga' thang chen po chig byung / de'i dus slob dpon tsan+d+ra go sī 'khrungs/ seng ge'i bu rgyal po bhar+sha zhes bya bas kyang rgyal srid ring du byas/ tsan+t+ra'i rigs rgyal po sing nga tsan+t+ra zhes pa rgyawasrid la 'khod de/ shugs chung ngur yod pas rgyal po seng ge dang / mi sgo'i lungalen dgos par byung / 'di skabs legs ldan dang / 'phags pa grol sde'i sku tshe'i smad kyi dus yin/ slob dpon nyi ma sbas pa dang / grol sde'i sleb tshamachogasde dang / sangs rgyas bskyangs kyi slob ma ka ma la bu rnyi'i sku tshe'i smad dang / yon —142—

tan 'od kyi slob ma 'phags pa zla ba'i nor bu dang / na len+t+ra'i mkhan po rgyalaba'i lha rnams dus mtshungs su byung zhing / lho phyogs su slob dpon zla ba gragasapa'ang byon/ slob dpon chos skyong dang / slob dpon zhi ba lha dpa/ grub thob birū pa'i sku tshe'i stod kyi dus tsam mo/ /'phags pa sa ga lha yang 'di dus byung bar mngon te/ me tog phreng brgyud lotsā ba snyel tsor shes rab grags kyis bsgyur ba na/ 'phags pa dge 'dun 'bangs kyi slob ma 'phags pa sa ga lhas mdzad pa zhes 'byung bas so/ /de'i phyir nyan thos dgra bcom pa yin min yang brtagadagos so/ /de dag las mchog sde dang / ka ma la bu rnyi'i lo rgyus mthos/ zla ba'i nor bu rgyal po ngang tshul gyi bla ma yin yang gtam rgyud rgyas pa mi snang la/nyi ma sbas pa ni/ 'phags pa klu sgrub dang thogs med kyi bzhed pa gcigatugasung zhing / kha che dang ma ga dhar chos gzhi chen po bcu gnyis bcu ge nyis btsugs nas/ yo byad thams cad gnod spyin rnams sbyor du 'jug go /nangapa thams cad 'jigs pa brgyad las skyob pa'i srung ba po mdzad cing / sgrolawagrub pa'i dge slong sngags mkhan zhig yin te/ lo rgyus gzhan du shes/ rgyal ba'i lha yang gsungs rab du ma la mkhas par byas pa'i slob dpon chen po na len+t+ra ra yun ring du bzhugs pa zhig ste/ rnam thar zhib mo ma thos go /de'i tshebyang phyogs ha sā mar sangs rgyas kyi tshems mche ba zhig byon te/ slob dpon dge 'dun 'bangs kyi slob ma snyan dngags mkhan gsang ba byin dang / chosa'abangs kyi slob ma rat+na ma ti la sogs pa 'khor rnam pa bzhi chos bzhin spyod pa brgya stong mang po byung nas tshems mche ba la mchod par byed pa byung / de'i rgyun da —143—

ltar pu khang na yod do/ /dpal ldan zla ba grags pa ni/ lho phyog sa ma ster sku 'khrungs nas/ chung ngu nyid nas rig pa'i gnas mtha' dag la sbyangs/ lho phyogs kyi yul de nyid du rab tu byung zhing sde snod mtha' dag la mkhas par byas/legs ldan gyi slob ma mang po dang sangs rgyas bskyangs kyi slob ma kam la brnyil klu sgrub kyi gzhung lugs dang man ngag thams cad nos/ mkhas pa'i mkhas pa chen por byung nas dpal na len+t+ra'i mkhan po mdzad/ rtsa 'jug bzhi gsuradang / rig pa drug cu pa'i 'grel pa la sogs pa mdzad de sangs rgyas bskyangasakyi lugs de nyid tshes dar bar mdzad pa yin no/ /der ri mor bris pa'i ba grus ma las 'o ma bzhos nas dge 'dun thams cad 'o thug gis tshim par mdzad pa dang / rdo'i ka ba la phyag thogs med du song zhing / rtsig pa la thogs med du bzhud pa sogs ngo mtshar ba'i ltas du mayod cing / mu stegs kyi rgol ba mang po bzlog par mdzad/ mthar lho phyogs kyi rgyud du byon te go du na'i yul du mu stegs kyi rgol ba mang po tshar bcad/ bramazedang khyim bdag phal cher bstan pa la bcug nas chos gzhi chen po mang du btab/ slad kyis ma nu bhaX ga zhes bya ba'i ri la sngags kyi lam la brten nasadangos grub mchog thob par bzhed pas/ yun ring du bzhugs nas 'ja' lusasu song bar sngags kyi slob dpon rnams 'dod de/ bod kyi lo rgyus ltar na dgung lo sum brgya bzhugs pa dang / rdo'i seng ge la bas nas tu ru sko / dmagabazlog pa'i mdzad pa khyad par can bstan par 'dod de/ phyi ma ni de ltar byungabar rung la/ snga ma ni 'ja' lus su gyur na 'chib med pa yin pas lo su5—144—

brgyas char yang mi bzod/ rnam smin rags pa'i sku lus kyis mi yul du de ltarabazhugs par 'dod na ni mi 'thad par mngon no/ /slob dpon tsan+d+ra go myi ni/shar phyogs pa ren+t+ra ra 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi zhal mthong ba'i pa ni ta zhig mu stegs rgyang 'phen pa'i ston pa zhig dang rtsod nga ra gyur te/ de'i ringalugs sun phyung yang rig pa ni blos rnam par brtags pa yin pas gang blo sgrin pa de rgyal bar zad kyi/ skye ba snga phyi yod pa'i rtags mngon sum du med pasakhobo cag de mi 'dod zer ba na/ rgyal po la sogs pa dpang por bzhag ste nganyid skye ba len pa yin pas dpral par rtags thob cig byas nas/ da das dprawapar mtshal gyi thig le sha la thim pa zhig byas/ kha nang du mu tig bcug sto de nyid du 'das te/ de'i lus zangs kha sbyor gyi nang du bcug nas rgyal po'i rgyasabatab bo/ /de rgyal rigs kyi paṇ+ḍi ta bi she sa ga zhes bya ba'i bur skye bar khasablangs pa bzhin de la khye'u /mtshan dang ldan pa zhig btsas ma thag tu mtshal gyi ri mo dpral par yod pa kha nang na mu tig yod pa de byung / rgyal po sogs kyis sngar gyi phung po de bltas pas dpral pa'i mtshal gyi ri mo yang byid/ mu tig go shulahar re 'dug go /der mu stegs de kra nga skye ba snga phyi yod par yid tshes skad/ khye'ude btsas ma thag tu ma la phyag byas te/ zla ba bcur 'o brgyal bar ma khyung tamabyas pas/ byis pa btsas ma thas/smra ba ni ltas ngan no snyam nas kha rog 'dugabyas so/ /de nas lo bdun gyi bar du cang ma smras pas lkugs pa'o snyamamo/ /der mu stegs kyi rgol ba zhig gis shin tu go dka' ba'i snyan dngags kyi tshigs su bcad pa/ snyan dngags de'i don gyis sangs rgyas pa rnams kyi grus —145—

mtha' 'gog pa zhig brtsams nas rgyal po dang / mkhas pa'i tshogs la grimasaso/ /der bi she sa ga'i khyim du byung ba na/ des yun ring du brtags pas sgra don ji bzhin go ba yang med na/ lan gdab pa ga la nus te/ don de sems shingakhyim gyi phyi rol tu bya ba zhig la song ngo / /der tsan+d+ra go sī lo bdun lon pa desabaltas pa na/ don shes shing lan gdab par dka' ba med de/ de'i don 'grolaba'i yig chung btab/ lan gyi tshigs bcad kyang bris so/ /phas nang du 'ongs pa na/ de ltar bris pa mthong nas/ khyim du su byung zhes tsan+d+ra go grwa'i ma la drisaso/ /gzhan su yang ma 'ongs te/ bu lkugs pas blta zhing bris so/ /der phas bu la dris pa na ma'i gdong la blta zhing 'dug go /mas smros shig byas pa ga 'di ni bdag gis bris pa ste rgol ba 'di bzlog pa ni dka' ba ma yin no zhes zer/de nas nang par tsan+d+ra go sī dang / mu stegs kyi ston pa de brtsad pag tsan+d+ra gomyirgyal te bya dga' chen po thob/ des na sgra dang rtog ge la sogs pa rig gnasathun mong ba thams cad ma bslabs par rang shes su shes pa zhig byung ste/phyogs thams cad du grags pas khyab bo/ /de nas theg pa chen po'i slob dpon zhig la skyabs su 'gro ba dang / bslab pa'i gnas lnga blangs/ slob dpon chen po blo gros brtan pa la mdo sde dang / mngon pa'i sde snod phal cher lan cig kha pa tsam gyis mkhyen/ rig pa 'dzin pa'i slob dpon mya ngan med pa zhes bya ba labaka' lung nos te/ rig sngags bsgrubs pas 'phags pa spyan ras gzhigs dang / sgrol ma'i zhal mthon sum du gzigs/ shin tu mkhas pa chen par gyur/de nas shar phyogs su rgyal po bharnya'i yul du sman dpyad dang / sdeb sbyor dang/— 146—

bzo'i gnas kyi bstan bcos mang du byas/ khyad par du sgra rig pa mang du bshad cing yod/ de'i tshe rgyal po'i bu mo tā rā zhes bya ba bag mar blangs shing/ rgyawapos yul 'khor zhig kyang mkhyen/ dus lan cig de'i g.yog mos tā rā zhesa'abod kyin 'dug pas/ yi dam dang mtshan mthun pa khyim thab tu mi rung ro snyamanas/ slob dpon nyid yul gzhan du 'gro bar brtsams pa rgyal pos shes te/de pha'i bu mo dang lhan cig mi 'dug na sgrom du chug la ga ṅga la skyur zhig ces bsgos te de bzhin du byas pa na/ slob dpon gyis rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrolam la gsol ba btab pas/ ga ṅga dang rgya mtsho 'phrad mtshams kyi rgya mtsho'i glingazhig la thon/ gling de 'phags mas sprul pa yin yang zer te/ tsan+d+ra dī pa zhes bya ba tsan+d+ra go mi nyid der bzhugs pa las ming chags shing / da ltar yang yod degrong bdun stong tsam shong ba zhig 'dug zer/ gling der slob dpon gyisabazhugs te/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dang / sgrol ma'i sku rdo la bzhe bus/thog mar nya pa rnams kyis gtam de thos/ de nas rim gyis skye bo gzhan yangabyung ste grong khyer chags/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyis bskul ba las gogrwa'i dge bsnyen mdzad/ mtshan ni tsan+d+ra yin la/ de phyin chad nas tsan+t+ra go miragrags so/ /de nas tshong pa rnams kyis khyer te siṅga la'i gling du byon/ yul de ni klu nad mang du 'byung ba zhig yod pa las der 'phags pa seng ge sgra'i lha khang bzhengs pas rang zhi yul der yang bzo dang sman dpyad la sogs pa rig pa'i gnas dpag tu med pa spel te/ gling phran gyi skye bo blun po rnams la lhag paraphan gtags/ theg pa chen po'i chos kyang ci rigs bshad/ yul gyi bdagapo—147—

gnod sbyin las nor blangs te chos gzhi mang du btsugs/ slar yang 'dzam bu'i gling gi lho phyogs kyi rgyud du 'ongs/ bram ze mchog sred kyi lha khang na klu la sgra nyan pa'i bkod pa dang / klu she khris byas pa'i pā ṇi ba'i 'grel pa 'dug pa yangagazags pas/ 'grel pa zhes bya ba tshig nyung ba/ don mang ba/ ma zlos pa/ tshang ba zhig dgos ba yin pa la/ klu ni rab tu rmongs te/ tshig mngab/don nyung ba/zlos pa/ ma rdzogs pa'o zhes smad nas/ pa ṇi ba'i don 'grel du chu byā kar ṇa yan lag dang bcas pa mdzad/ gzhung der/ nyung ngu rnam gsal yangs dgardzogs/ /zhes gsung pa yang klu la zur za ba'o/ /de nas rig pa'i 'byung gnasadapal nā len+t+ra ra 'ongs/ de yang nā len+d+ra na mu stegs dang rtsod par bzod pa'ipa ni ta rnams lcags ri'i phyi rol tu chos 'chad/ mi bzod pa rnams nang du 'chad pa las/ de'i tshe mkhan por gyur pa zla ba grags pa ni/ phyi rol tu chosa'achad cing yod pa'i sar tsan+t+ra go sī 'grengs te bzhugs pas/ rtsod par 'o dod pa rnams de bzhin byed pa yin la/ de min yang na mi nyan/ yang na gus/pasanyan pa yin no/ /der zla ba grags pas rtsod zla yin nam snyam nas/ khyed ganganas 'ongs byas pas/ lho phyogs nas 'ongs zer/ chos gang shes dris pa ga sgra pā ṇi pa dang / bstod pa brgya lnga bcu pa dang / mtshan yang dag par brjod pa gsum shes byas pas/ 'di gzhung gsum las mi shes zhes tshig khengasabaskyungs kyang / don gyis sgra rig pa dang / mdo dang / sngags thams cad shesapar khas blangs pa yin pas tsan+t+ra go sī yin nam snyam ste dris pas/ 'jig rten na de ltar grags gsung / 'o na mkhas pa chen po thog babs su byon pa ma—148—

legs kyis/ dge 'dun gyis bsu ba byed dgos pas re zhig grong khyer du bzhud cig gsungs/ tsan+t+ra go myis bdag dge bsnyen la dge 'dun gyis bsu ba byar ga la rung / zla grags na re/ 'di la thabs shig yod de 'phags pa 'jasladapal gyi sku zhig spyan 'dren pa yin pas/ de la rnga yab g.yob cing byon cigadage 'dun gyis 'jam dpal gyi sku la bsu ba byas par 'gyur ro gsung / slarade ltar byas pa'i shing rta gsum las/ dbus ma la ni 'phags pa 'jam dpalabazhugs/ g.yas na zla grags kyis rnga yab g.yob/ g.yon na tsan+t+ra go grwas/rnga yab g.yob/ mdun nas dge 'dun gyis bsus/ skye bo dpag tu med pa bltaba'i phyir 'ongs/ slob dpon tsan+t+ra go sī la sku brnyan de 'jam dbyangs dngosasusnang ste/ 'jam dbyangs phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs ba bye ba rnams kyisabastod par gyur mod de lta na'ang / zhes sogs bstod pa na/ 'jam dpal gyi sku brnyan zhal phyir log gis bstan nas gsan pa byung bas skye bo rnams kyis sku gzugs pha gi 'di ltar byed do byas pas de kha la lus te 'phags pa 'jing yon mar grags/ der tsan+t+ra go sī dad pa'i shugs rgyas te/ shing rta 'dren byed kyi kha'athen pa ma byung bar zla grags gyis sngon du song bas 'di ni nga rgyal che ste/bdag gis rtsod par bya'o zhes zla grags kyis dgos so/ /der tsan+t+ra go myis thogs med kyi srol la brten te rnam rig gi phyogs bzung / zla grags ni klu sgrub kyi gzhung sangs rgyas bskyangs sogs kyis bkralab la brten te ngo bo nyid med smra ba'i phyogs bzung / lo bdun gyi bar du bgro gleng gi brgal brtag mdzad do/ /rtsod pa de blta ba'i phyir skye bo mang po rtagatu—149—

'dus pas/ grong pa'i khye'u dang bu mo tshun chad kyis kyang phyogs tsam riganas/kye ma 'phags pa klu sgrub gzhung / /la la'i sman la la la'i dug /mi pham 'phags pa thogs med gzhung / /skye bo kun la bdud rtsi nyid/ /ces glur len no/ /de nas rtsod pa de zhir nye ba'i skabs ga na/ tsan+d+ra go sī 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi lha khang zhig na bzhugs kyin yod de/ zla grags kyis de ringartsod pa mang bo bkod/ pa'i lan/ do nub 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs la zhusate nangs par lan btab pa na/ zla grags kyis de la lan gdab par mi nusaso/ /de 'dra zla ba mang po song ba na/ zla grags kyis dgongs pa/ waṃ la rtsod pa slob pa zhig yod do bsams nas/ tsan+d+ra go grwa'i phyi bzhin song bas de lha khangadu song / sgo'i phyi nas nyan pas 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi rdo sku des chu go sī la chos gsungs te/ slob dpon gyis slob ma la ston pa bzhin du rig pa slob pa las/ zla ba grags ba'i 'phags pa la nye ring mi mnga' 'am zhes sgo phye bas de nyid du rdo skur gyur te/ chos slob bzhin pa'i phyag sor ker re pa la lusapas 'phags pa 'dzub ker mar grags/ de skabs nas rtsod pa snang zhi zla grags kyis spyan ras gzigs la gsol ba drag tu btab pas/ mnal lam du khyod ni 'jam dbyangs kyis byin gyis brlabs pasangs byin gyis rlob mi dgos kyis/ tsan+d+ra go sī la cung zad cig byin gyis brlabs pa yin gsung/ spya khyab tude tsam zhig grags la/ gsang 'dus 'phags skor ba rnams na re/ slar yangazhal ston par gsol ba btab pas/ gsang ba 'dus pa sgoms gsu ngas/ zhag —150—

bdun bsgoms pas dkyil 'khor gyi nub kyi sgo'i nang na 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs sku mdog dmar po byi dra'i phung po ltar dmar grong nger zhal gzigs skad/ de nas na len+t+ra'i gnas der bzhugs nas chos mang du bskul/ zla ba grags pas mdzad pa'i bstan bcos kun tu bzang po zhes bya ba tshigs bcad legs po zhig gzigs pas rang gis mdzad pa'i sgra mdo sdeb mi legs par mkhyen nas/ 'gro don mi 'byung snyam nas des khron par bskyur bas/ rje btsun 'phags ma sgrol mas/ khyod kyi 'di ni gzhan phan gyi sems bzang pos byasapas ma 'ongs pa na sems can la shin tu phan par 'gyur la/ zla grags kyis ni mkhas pa'i nga rgyal gyis non pas/ gzhan la phan thogs chung ngur 'gyuraro/ /de'i phyir glegs bam khron pa nas phyung zhig /ces lung bstan pa ltarablangs te/ khron pa de'i chu 'thungs pa tsam gyis shes rab chen por 'gyur ba byung / tsan+d+ra pa ni de nas da lta'i bar du shin tu dar rgyas che zhing / phyi nang thamasacad slob par byed la/ kun tu bzang po ni mi ring bar nub ste da ltar dpe tsa5yang yod par mi mngon no/ /der bzo'i gnas brgya rtsa dang / sgra dang /rtegagodang / sman dpyad dang / sdeb sbyor dang / zlos gar dang / mngon brjod dang /snyan dngags dang / skar rtsis la sogs pa'i bstan bcos kyang mang du brtsams/slob ma rnams la de rnams gtso bor bshad pa'i tshe/ 'phags ma sgrol mas/ sabacu pa dang zla ba sgron me dang / /sdong pos brgyan pa dang ni lang kara'ajug /rgyal ba rnams kyi yum gyur klogs shig kye/ /sdeb sbyor pha g.yo'i sbyor bas khyod la ci/ /zhes gsungs pas phyi rol kyi rig pa'i gnas rnams nyung ngurlo—151—

bstan zhing / rmad du byung ba'i mdo lnga po de dag dus rtag tu ma chad par gzhan la gsungs/ bdag nyid kyang nyin rer zhal 'don mdzad/ mdo de rnams la don bsdu'i bstan bces re yang mdzad/ spyir snga phyir mdzad pa la bstod pa brgyadang brgyad/ nang rig pa'i bstan bcos brgya dang brgyad/ phyi rol kyi bstan bcosabargya dang brgyad/ bzo gnas brgya dang brgyad de/ phra mo thor bu pa bzhi brgya sum cu rtsa gnyis brtsams zer/ pra dī ba mā li zhes bya ba'i bstan bcos byang chub sems dpa'i lam rim mtha' dag ston pa zhig kyang mdzad de/ cher ma dar/'gro lding dang / siṅga la'i gling na de 'chad pa'i srol da lta'ang 'dug gsung/sdom pa nyi shu pa dang / sku gsum la 'jug pa ni/ theg chen parnyi ta phyis byon pa thams cad kyis slob mar byed pa byung ngo / /sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs brgya rtsa dang /spyan ras gzigs kyi sgrub thabs brgya rtsa zhes bya ba slob dpon 'dis mdzad pa bod du 'gyur snang bas/ spyir bstan bcos mang po rang zhig mdzad par snangango / /yang bud med dbul mo rgan mo zhig la bu mo gzugs mdzes pa zhin yod pa/ bag mar rdzong ba'i chas med nas yul sna tshogs su slong mo la phyin/ nā len+t+ra ra 'ongs nas/ zla ba grags pa 'du ba rgya chen por grags pa la bslangs pas/ kho bo ni dge slong yin pas yo byad mang po ma bzung zhing / khri bzad yod pa'ang lha khang dang dge 'dun gyi don du dgos/ khang pa pha gi na tsan+t+ra go myi yod pas/ der slongs shig ces bstan pas/ rgan mos tsan+d+ra go grwa'i rung slong du phyin na/ sku la gsol ba'i na bza' phrugs gcig dang / 'phags pa brgyad stong pa'i po ti gcig las gzhan gang yang med de/ der logs bris la sgrol ma'i sku —152—

brnyan bzhugs pa dbul phongs la rab tu brtse ba'i sems kyis de la gsol ba btab cing spyan chab phyung bas/ de nyid sgrol ma dngos su gyur te/ skra zhi gyon rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa rin thang med pa'i nor bu dang bcas pa dag phud nas slob dpon la gnang / des kyang de la stsal bas shin tu tshim pa thob cing/ri mo'i sku brnyan rgyan med par song bas sgrol ma rgyan med ma zhes grags shing /rgyan phud pa'i shul lam me yod do/ /de ltar sems can gyi don yun ring du mdzad nas/ mthar po ta lar gshegs par bzhed de/ 'dzam bu'i gling nas dha na shi'i gling du byon pa na/ sngon klu she ṣa la smad pas 'khon du bzung nas rgya mtsho'i rlabs chen pos gru gzings gzhug par brtsams/ rgya mtsho'i dbus nasasgra byung nas tsan+t+ra go mi phyung zhing zer/ sgrol ma la gsol ba btab pas/'phags ma gtso 'khor ra lnga mkha' lding la cings pa mdun gyi nam mkhar byon pas klu rnams 'jigs shing skrag nas thos/ gru dha na shir bde bar sleb bo/ /der dpal ldan 'bras sbungs kyi mchod rten la mchod cing / sgrol ma'i lha khang brgya rtsa dang / 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi lha khang brgya rtsa bzhengs/ ri po ta lar gshegs nas da lta yang lus ma spangs par bzhugs so/ /slob tshalasprings pa'i 'phrin yig ni/ rgyal po'i bu rin chen grags pa zhes bya ba rab tubyung ba babs pa zhig la po ta la nas cha pa rnams la bskur bas/ de yang slob springs mthong nas chos bzhin spyod par gyur to zhes grags so/ /de ltar byon pa las/ dpal ldan zla ba grags pa dang / tsan+t+ra go myi'i sku tshe'i stod kyi dus ni/rgyal po seng tsho ge dang bharnyas rgyal srid skyong ba'i dus yin la/ chos skyong go yang sku —153—

tshe'i stod yin par shes so/ /zla grags tsan+d+ra go mi na le rgyur zhal 'dzom pa sogs sku tshe'i smad kyi dus dang / slob dpon chos skyong 'gro don mdzad 'i pa dusani/ rgyal bo seng ge lnga pa'i dus yin no/ /rgyal po ngang tshul gyi dus kyi gto/stonyi shu rtsa bzhi pa'o// //rgyal po bharnya dang / sidha tsan+d+ra 'das pa tsam gyi dus na/ nub phyogs ma la war rgyal po g.yo ba zhes bya ba stobs chen po byung ste/ rgyal po ngang tshul la bdo ba tsam du gyur zhing / des lo sum cu rgyal srid byas te/ rgyal po ngang tshuwa dngadus gcig tu shi'o/ /shar phyogs su bharnya'i bu rgyal po seng ge lnga pa zhes bya ba shin tu stobs che ba byung ste/ sidha tsan+t+ra'i bu rgyal po bā la tsan+d+ra bhaX ga la nas yulabaton te ti rā hu tir rgyal srid byas so/ /rgyal po seng ge lnga pa des byang bod/lho tri liṅga/ nub tu wā rā ṇa sī/ shar phyogs rgya mtsho la thug par dbang bsgyur/de'i tshe mchog sde'i slob ma dul ba'i sde dang / ma ga dh+wa ra btsun pa grol sdodang /yon tan 'od kyi slob ma mngon pa ba yon tan blo gros dang / slob dpon chosaskyong dang / dbang phyug sde dang / kha che'i yul du thams cad mkhyen pa'i bshesaganyen dang / ma ga dhar rgyal po bhan+t+ra'i bu chung ba rgyal po gsal ba zhes bya ba yul 'khor rgya chung yang longs spyod shin tu che ba dang bcas pa byung zhing/ lho phyogs ri bo 'bigs byed dang nye ba'i yul thams cad la dbang bsgyur ba rgyal po me tog ces bya ba byung ngo / /de la rgyal po g.yo bas pho brang gi phyogs bzhidagatsug lag khang re byas nas/ lo bcu gnyis su 'khor rnam pa bzhi su byung ba thams cad la zas gos rnyed pa gsum gyis/ yo byad bzang pos bstabs te/—154—

snga phyi bsdoms pas 'bum phrag gnyis so/ /rgyal po seng ge lnga pas phyi nangaganyis ka la mchod cing / nang pa'i 'ang chos gzhi nyi shu tsam mchod rten mang du bzhengs/ rgyal po gsal bas ni/ zla ba grags pa dang/ tsan+t+ra gordzil sogs pa dpal nā le spro'i mkhas pa thams cad mchod cing / gser gyi bumapa mu tig gis bkang pa brgya rtsa brgyad chos gzhi'i thebs su phul/ ma ga dha'i lha khang dang / mchod rten thams cad la mchod pa bla lhag tu byas so/ /dul ba sdodang / btsun pa rnam grol sde'i lo rgyus rgyas pa ma mthong / lha khang gag tu dulaba'i sdes mi pham mgon po'i sku bzhengs/ des gsung byon nas/ 'gro ba'i don spyod pa la grogs su u rgyu ta re yang bzhengs gsungs nas tsan+d+ra go sī spyan drangs nas bzhengs zhes grags/ lha sku gnyis po de phyis tu dra skore 'jigs pas lha'i ri bor spyan drangs te phyis 'byung gi bar du bzhugs so/ /de bzhin du btsun pa grol sdes mi pham mgon po bsgrubs pas lo bcu lon yang ltas gang yang ma byung bar/ slob dpon zla ba grags pa la thabs dris pas/ sdig sgrib byang ba'i don du sbyin sreg gyis zhes gdams/ sreg blugs 'bum phrag bcu gnyis phul bsathab nang du zhal gzigs zhes zer ro/ /slob dpon yon tan blo gros ni rigapa'i gnas thams cad la mkhas pas/ mngon pa mdzod kyi 'grel bshad dang /dbu ma rtsa ba la blo brtan gyi rjes su 'brangs te legs ldan 'gog pa'i 'gre'/ pa byas/ legs ldan gyi slob ma saX pra dū taXyang 'di dang dus mnyam du byung/shar phyogs pa la pū rir rtsod pa yun ring du byas pas yon tan blo gros rgyal lo zhes grags so/ /slob dpon chos skyong ni/ lho phyogs kyi rgyud du zhabrungs pa/—155—

snyan dngags mkhan gyi rigs las byung ba/ dge bsnyen du gnas pa'i dus nasasnyan dngags mkhan chen po phyi nang gi gzhung lugs phal cher shes pa zhes slob dpon chos 'bangs las rab tu byung zhing 'dul ba nyan nas/ mkhas pa chen por gyur pa na yul dbus su byon/ slob dpon phyogs kyi glang po las sdosnod yan lag dang bcas pa thams cad slar yang nyan te mkhas pa'i dbang phyug tu gyur pa/ mdo sde r+ṣa po brgya rtsa 'don pa/ des rdo rje gdan du byon nas lhagapa'i lha rnams la bstod pa mang du byas/ byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha'i snyingapo bsgrubs pas byang chub kyi shing gi rtse mo la byon pa gzigs/ de phyin chad nasa'aphags pa nam mkha'i snying bo la rtag tu chos gsan pa zhig byung ste/ rdorje'i gdan de nyid du lo sum cu lhag cig chos ston par mdzad cing / dpal ldan zla ba grags pa'i rjes su dpal na len+t+ra'i mkhan po mdzad do/ /de dag tu sleb mobyang chub sems dpa'i rtsa ltung byung ba kun la'ang / dngos dang rmi lam gang yangarung bar 'phags pa nam mkha'i snying po'i mdun du ltung ba bshags su 'jug nus shing / 'phags pa nam mkha' mdzod las nor blangs pas chog par gragasate/ rang nyid dge 'dun dang bcas pa la 'tsho ba'i yo byad sbyin bdag lasami'atshol bar nam mkha' las slong bar mdzad/ mu stegs kyi rgol ba rnams khro bo dbyug pa sngon pos bsdigs nas ngag gnon par byed pa zhig byung ngo / /desadabu ma bzhi brgya pa la rnam rig tu bkral ba'i 'grel pa mdzad/ 'grel pa '-idizla grags kyi bzhi brgya pa'i 'grel pa'i sngon la brtsams par mngon pas rdo rje gdan du brtsams pa yin zhing / slob dpon chos 'bangs kyi dpe 'grel la ni —156—

zla grags dang / chos skyong gnyis kar brten no/ /sku tshe'i mthar shar phyogasagaser gling du byon nas bcud len gyi dngos grub bsgrubs te/ mthar lha'i gnas su bzhud do/ /zhes grags so/ /'dis na len+t+ra'i mkhan po cung zad mdzad nas/ de'i 'og tu rgyal ba'i lhas mkhan po mdzad do/ /de'i slob ma ni zhi ba lha dang / bi hwa pa yin no/ /phyi ma'i lo rgyus ni de yang nā len+t+ra'i gtsug lag khang du slob gnyer byed skabs shig /lan cig de bī ko ṭar phyin pas/ bud med gcig gis me tog ut+pawagacig dang / 'gron bu gcig gtad pa blangs te phyin pas/ mi rnams mkha' rde'agro mas rgyas btab pa snying re rje zer/ rgyu mtshan ci byas pas/ de bor dang zer bor bas lag pa la 'byar te 'bor ma thub/ de nas nang pa'i mkha' 'gro ma dang 'phrad nas skyob dgos byas pas/ deng phyi nang gi mkha' 'gro ma rnamasatshetog sprod pa su snga dbang bar chad so byas zer/ thabs gzhan med dam byas pa na/ dpag tshad lnga'i pha rol tu phyin na thar zer yang nyi ma dgongs kar song bas mi sleb ste/ mgron khang gcig tu rdza ma kha sbub pa'i 'og tu bsdad/ stong pa nyid bsgoms so/ /nub mo de na yod pa'i mi rnams re re nas phra men rnams kyisabos/ rgyas btab pa de ma yin par shes nas yang yang bskyal/ bi hwa pa mamathong ba'i ngang la nam langs te de rnams gyes so/ /de nas bros te slar nā len+t+ra ra phyin parnyi tar gyur tsa na/ da ni phra men ma rnams 'dul dgos snyam lho phyogs dpal gyi rir phyin/ slob dpon klu'i byang chub la gzhin rje gshed zhusanas bsgoms pas nam zhig na zhal mngon sum du mthong / da dung yun ring du —157—

bsgoms pas dpal khro bo chen po dang mnyam par gyur skad/ de nas yang de bī sgo ko ṭar phyin pas sngar gyi phyi pa'i mkha' 'gro ma rnams na re sngon rgyas btab pa de byung zer/ nub mo 'jigs pa'i gzugs kyis za bar byung ba la gshin rje gshed kyi dkyil 'khor du bzhengs pas/ de rnams brgyal zhing shi la thug parasong / de dag dam la bzhag nas na le rgyur 'ongs/ de nas spyod pa la byon pa yin no/ /lo rgyus lhag ma gzhan du shes la/ zhi ba lha ni/ so ru ni ra rgyal po khro sras su sku 'khrungs/ sngon gyi las 'phro'i mthus chung ngu nas 'jam dpal yalalam du zhal gzigs/ cher skyes nas rgyal srid du bsko bar byas pa las/mnal lam du rgyal srid du bsgo ba'i khri la 'jam dpal bzhugs nag bu gcig 'di ni nga yi stan yin te/ /nga ni khyod kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen yin/khyod dang nga gnyis stan gcig la 'dug pa/ /'di ni rnam pa kun tu rigasamayin/ /zhes gsung pa dang / 'phags ma sgrol mas rang gi ma'i tshul bzung nagachu tshan spyi bo nas blugs pas/ ci yin dris pa na/ rgyal srid ni dmyal ba'i chutshan mi bzad pa yin te/ des khyod la dbang bskur ba yin no zhes zer bgargyal srid bzung du mi rung bar mkhyen nas nangs par rgyal sar bsko rgyu'i nub mo bros nas song ngo / /der zhag nyi shu rtsa gcig tu phyin pas/ nags zhin gortsab na chu mig 'dug pa 'thung bar brtsams pa na/ bud med cig gis bzloganas chu zhim po gzhan blud/ nags kyi phug na rnal 'byor ba zhig 'dug pa'i drungadu khrid/ de la yang dag pa'i gdams pa nos te bsgoms pas ting nge 'dzin dang ye shes bsam gyis mi khyab pa thob/ rnal 'byor pa de ni 'jam dpal dang /—158—

bud med de sgrol ma yin la/ de nas rtag tu 'jam dpal gyi zhal gzigasaso/ /de nas shar phyogs su phyin te/ rgyal po seng ge lnga pa'i 'khor gyi nang du bzhugs pas skyu rtsal gyi gnas thams cad la shin tu mkhas shing blo gros che bar 'dug nas blon po gyis gsung ba re zhig zhal gyis bzhes/ yi dam gyi phyagamatshan shing gi ral gri gcig 'chang gin yod/ der bzo'i gnas sngon med pa thams cad dar bar mdzad/ rgyal srid chos bzhin du skyong bcug pas wān po gzhan rnams kyis phrag dog byas te/ rgyal po la 'di ni g.yo can zhin ste/ ralagri yang shing las med do byas pas rgyal po la blon po thams cad kyi ral gri ston dgos byung bas/ slob dpon gyis 'di byung na lha nyid la gnod par 'gyurarobyas pas lhag par the tshom skyes te/ gnod kyang sla yi nges par ston cig zer/'o na spyan g.yas pa khob la g.yon pas gzigs shig gsung / de ltar byas nasabastan pas ral gri'i 'od kyis rgyal po'i mig g.yon pa lhungs so/ /de nas grub pa thob par shes/ rnyed bkur mang po byas nas bzhugs su gso wabs/ rgyalosrid chos bzhin gyis/ nang pa'i chos gzhi nyi shu tshugs zhes bsgos nas yuladabus su byon/ mkhan po rgyal ba'i lha las rab tu byung ste/ ming zhi ba'i lharabatags/ der paṇ+ḍi ta rnams dang lhan cig gnas pa las/ kha zas kyang 'brasabre bo che lnga lnga gsol/ nang du ting nge 'dzin dang 'phags pa 'jam dpalalachos gsan zhing / bslab pa kun las btus dang / mdo kun las btus legs par brtsams/ ma lus pa'i chos thams cad thugs su chud pa yin kyang/ nyin mtshan du mnal zhing / phyi rol gzhan ngor thos bsam sgom gsum gang yangami—159—

byed pa ltar bstan pas/ dge 'dun rnams kyis dad rdzas chud 'dza' bar byed pa 'di bskrad dgos pa las/ mdo 'don res byas na 'dir rang bud la 'gro zhes bgros nas/ de ltar byas te mthar zhi ba lha la'ang mdo 'don dgos byasapas/ thog mar zhal gyis ma bzhes/ nan gyis 'chu ba la 'o na khri brtsegs shigagadon par bya'o gsungs pas 'ga' zhig the tshom skyes/ phal cher dma' dbab pa'i don du 'tshogs/ der slob dpon seng ge'i khri la 'dug nas/ sngar byung ba zhig 'don nam ma byung ba zhig 'don byas pas/ thams cad kyis tshod bgamapa'i phyir ma byung ba thon cig zer/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jun pa gsungs te/ gang tshe dngos dang dngos med dag /blo yi mdun na miganas pa/zhes pa'i tshig mtshams nas nam mkha' la 'phur zhing gshe/gas nas/ sku lusami snang yang gsung gi snang ba ma chad pa byung ste spyod 'jug rdzogs par gsungs so/ /der pa'i ta gzungs thob pa rnams kyis blo la bzung ba las/ kha tsheb rnams kyi sho ka stong lhag pa zhig byung / mchod brjod rang gi blos sbyar/ shar pa —rnams kyi blo ka bdun brgya las med pa mchod brjod dbu ma rtsa ba'i de bcugade yang gshags le dang / sher le chad pa yin/ dbus pa rnams kyi mchod brjod dang rtsom par dam bca' med pa/ rjes bsngags kyi dbang du brtsis pa'i slo ka stong yod pa zhig byung / der the tshom du gyur pa las/ bod kyi sngar gyi lorgyus ltar na/ grong khyer dpal yon can du bzhugs zer na'ang / tri'i tho'i char gtogs pa grong khyer ka lid+ma ra gshegs te/ de na bzhugs zhes thos pas parnyita gsum gyis der song ste/ nā la rgyur ‘srog na par zhus pas ma gnang/'o na —160—

bslab—de shed gi pa kun las btus pa dang /mdo kun las btus pa blta bar gsung༅rdepa yang gang yin/dpe gsum po 'di'ang gang dag ces zhus pas/bslab rmedoni brang khang gi skar khang na shing shun la paṇ+ḍi ta'i yi ge phra mos bris pa'i glegs ra zu ḍarngabam yod pas de long /spyod 'jug ni yul dbus pa rnams kyis bzung ba ltarayin bzung /der yang nags tshal gyi gtsug lag khang zhig yod par dgo slongalnga brgya tsam dang lhan cig tu bzhugs shing /nags tshal de na ri dwags rmang du yod pa las/ri dwags grwa khang du byung ba rnams rdzu 'phrul gyi cho 'phrul gyis sha rnams gsol bas/dge slong rnams kyis ri dwags rnams slob dpon gyi grwa khangadu song ba mthong zhing /phyir byung ba ma mthong la/ri dwags kyi tso gos pa'angabribar shes so//'ga' zhig gis skar khung nas bltas pas sha gsol ba mthong/der dge 'dun rnams kyis rgol bar brtsams pa na/ri dwags rnams slarabasos te/sngar las kyang nyam stobs dang ldan pas phyir byung ste song/de dgagis rnyed bkur dang bcas te bzhugs su gsol ba na ma bzhugs te/rab tubyung pa'i rtags bor/u tsu9na spyod pas gshegs te/lto phyogs kyi yul zhinatuphyi nang gnyis rtsod par gyur pa las/nus pa 'gran par byas pa na nang pasamanus pa la/slob dpon sa der byon pa'i tshe/'khrud ma bor ba sku la phog pa na khol bar mthong ste nus pa thob par shes nas/mu stegs dang nus pa 'gran par zhus pas zhal gyis bzhes/der mu stegs kyis nam mkha' la rdul cho ne gyi dkyil 'khor chen po bris pas/skad cig de nyid la rlung drag po btang bsadakyi' 'khor dang mu stegs rnams rlung gis khyer te chu bo zhig yod pa'i pha rol

tu 'phangs/ mu stegs la dga' ba thams cad kyang khyer ba tsam du gyur/ rgyal po la sogs pa nang pa la mos pa rnams la rlung gis ci yang ma gnod pas mu stegs rnams bsnubs nas cho se/ dar bar byas/ yul de la'ang mu stegs pham pa'i yul zhes grags so/ /'di ni lo rgyus khungs ma kun las 'byung ngebasasapar yid tshes pa yin na'ang / dus kyi stobs las yul gyi ming 'gyur bas yin te 'ong / da lta yul gang yin ma shes so/ /gzhan yang bod rnams kyi lo rgyusaltar na/ ya mtshan can gyi lta ba 'dzin pa lnga brgya 'tshob chad pa la/ rdzu 'phrulartegyis bza' btung blangs te byin nas chos la bkod pa dang / mu to ba stong tsamala'ang de ltar mdzad pa dang / 'khrug pa chen po zhig gi 'thab zlar zhugs nasardzu 'phrul gyis 'khrug pa bsdums zhes zer zhing /lhag pa'i lha brnyes nā len+t+ra'i/ /bkod pa phun tshogs rtsod pa bzlog /ya mtshan can dang sprang po dang / /rgyal po mu stegs btul ba'o/ /zhes ngo mtsharacan gyi gtam bdun yin par 'dod do/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i bzhas gnyen ni/ kha che'i yul gyi rgyal po zhinagozil bu zhig byis pa chung pru'i skabs khang steng du bsnyal nas/ ma me tog 'thurasong ba las bu chung bya rgod kyis khyer te yul dbus dpal nā len+t+ra'i gan+dho la zhig gi rtse mor bzhag go /parnyi ta rnams kyis de blangs te bsos nas cher skyesapa na blo rno bar gyur te/ dge slong sde snod 'dzin pa'i bar du gyur/ rje 'an ma'aphags ma sgrol ma bsgrubs pas dngos su zhal gzigs shing longs spyod zad mi shes pa byung ba las/ thams cad sbyin par btang ba na nam zhig na yo byad —162—

spyin rgyu cung zad kyang med de/ phyogs 'dir bsdad na slong ba po mang po rkang stongaskyel par 'gyur snyam ste/ lho phyogs kyi rgyud thag ring por byon to/ /der la5khar bram ze rgan po mig long ba zhig bus long khrid byas nas byung ba las// gangadu 'gro dris pas/ nā len+d+ra na thams cad mkhyen pa'i bshes gnyen zhes bya ba slong ba po thams cad mgu bar byed pa zhig yod zer bas/ de la slong du 'grozer/ de nyid nga yin na yo byad thams cad zad de 'dir 'ongs so byas pa ga de shin tu sdug bsngal gyis gzir bar 'dug nas snying rje tshad med pa skyes te/rgyal po sa ra ṇa zhes bya ba lta ba log pa la mngon par zhen zhing / gdug pa' slob dpon gyi rjes su 'brang ba zhig mi brgya rtsa brgyad nyos te/ me la mchod sbyin du byas na/ de dag gi tshe dang dbang thang thams cad bdag nyid la 'byung zhangathar pa'i rgyur yang yin no/ /zhes bsams nas/ mi brgya dang bdun ni rnyed/lhag ma gcig ma rnyed par yod pa gsan nas slob dpon rang nyid btsong ste bram ze 'di la phan gdags so snyam nas/ khyod sdug bsngal bar ma byed cigangs yo byad blangs nas 'ong ngo byas nas/ grong khyer du mi nyo ba su yod byas pasargyal pos nyos te/ rin du slob dpon gyi lus ljid dang mnyam pa'i gseragazhal/ gser slob dpon gyis bram ze la phyin pas mgu nas song ngo / /de nas slob dpon rgyal po'i khri mon du byon/ mi de rnams na re/ gal te khyod ma'angasan nged rnams thar pa yang srid pa las/ da ni da lha nyid du sreg go zhes shin tusdug bsngal bar 'dug cing / de'i nub mo phyogs yangs pa zhig tu shing gotshogs ri ltar sbungs pa'i dbus su mi brgya rtsa brgyad po bcings te bzhag—163—

lta ba log pa'i slob dpon des cho ga byas/ shing thams cad me 'ur gyis 'baraba'i tshe/ mi brgya rtsa bdun po de rnams cho nges rang gis btab pas/ slob dpon snying rje mi bzad pa skyes te 'phags ma sgrol ma la yus kyis gsol ba btab pas/ rje btsun ma mdun du byon te phyag las bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun babs/ skye bo rnams kyi snang ngo la sa phyogs gzhan gang na yang med par me 'bar ba kho na'i thad du char gyi rgyun gnya' shing tsam byung / me zhi nas mtsho rdzing du gyur/ de nasargyal po ya mtshan skyes te slob dpon la ni gus pas mchod/ skye bo de rnamasalayang bya dga' byin nas btang ngo / /rgyal pos mchod pa chen po byas kyang yangadag pa'i lta ba la ma tshud cing / dam pa'i chos mi dar bar 'dug nas yun ringabar song ba na thugs skyo ste/ rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol ma la bdag rang gi skye yul du skyel bar zhus pas na bza' la 'jus nas mig tshums shig gsung /mig btsums pa na de ma thag mig phye zhig gsung / mig phye bas sngar ma mthongaba'i rgyal po'i pho brang chen po zhig gis brgyan pa'i yul ljongs shig na sleb nas 'dug pa/ bdag nā le rgyur mi skyel bar 'dir skyel ba ci lags zhus pas/khyod kyi skye ba'i yul ni 'di kho na'o zhes gsungs/ de nas der bzhugs nasasgrol ma'i lha khang chen po yang bzhengs/ chos mang du bstan zhing skye bo thams cad bde ba la bkod/ 'di nyi ma sbas pa'i slob ma yin no/ /dus 'di tsam na grub wo ḍa ma bi he ru ka dang / grub r+ṣa rdo rje dril bu pa yang byung / de rnams thogamanyam pa las snga phyi'i go rim cung zad ni/ bi rū pa grub pa thob nas lo bcu tsam na/ toX be+e he ru kas dngos grub brnyes/ de nas bcu tsam na dril bu pas—164—

bsnyes so/ /slob dpon tsan+d+ra go grwa'i slob ma tshong dpon gyi bu su kha de wa bya ba yang dus 'dir byung ste/ de yang de tshong gi las byed pa'i tshe/ mu stegs shigalas tsan+dan sa mchoge las grub pa'i sangs rgyas kyi sku gzugs bshig pa'i dum bu cig nyos nas yod pa la/ rgyal po'i bu mos sko dza ti zhes bya ba nad drag posabatab nas/ sman pa rnams kyis 'di'i sman ni tsan+dan sa mchog yin na de mi rnyed do zhes bor ro/ /der tshong pa des gal te 'di sos par gyur na bdag la stsolacig byas pas/ rgyal pos kyang de bzhin du khas blangs/ des tsan+dan sa mchog de brdar nas de'i lus la byugs/ sman khong du btang bas sos/ de su kha de wa labyin pas/ des nad sos pa ni legs na sdig pa 'di sbyong dka' 'o byas pas/sdig pa sbyong ba'i thabs slob dpon tsan+d+ra go mi la dris pas des kyang spyan ras gzigs gyi bka' lung stsal te bsgrub tu bcug go /nam zhig na 'phags pa'i zhal mngon sum du mthong / tshong dpon gyi bu su kha de wa chung mar bcas pasagrub pa thob bo/ /rgyal po g.yo ba dang seng ge lnga pa la sogs pa'i dus skabs kyi gtam ste nyi shu rtsa lnga pa'o// //rgyal po g.yo ba 'das nas de'i nu bo rgyal po g.yo ba brtan pas rgyal srid lo nyi shu byas te/ nub phyogs phal cher la dbang bskyur/ de'i bu biṣ+ṭha rā dzazhes bya bas kyang rgyal srid lo mang por bskyangs nas/ nub phyogs ha le'i yulagyi nang tshan bā la na ga ra zhes bya bar gnas pa'i tshe sngon gyi drang srong chen po rnams dang mtshungs pa'i bram ze dka' thub can nags tshal na gnas pa lnga brgya yod pa las/ de'i dka' thub kyi gnas kyi bya dang ri dwags thams cad bsad/—165—

chu chen po drangs nas drang srong gi gnas rnams bshig pas/ de rnams kyisadamod pa byas pas rgyal po'i pho brang gi 'og nas chu brdol te chur nub go /de'i tshe yul dbus dang shar phyogs phal cher la dbang sgyur pa ni rgyal po gsal ba'i bu rab gsal dang / de'i bu mahā phya ṇi zhes bya ba byung / byang phyogs su ni rgyalapo rab gsal gyi sbun zla shākya stobs chen zhes bya ba grong khyer ha ri dwa rar gnas pa kha tshe tshun chod la lung byed pa byung / bhaX ga la dang / kā mahwa pa dang/ti rā hu ti gsum la rgyal po bā la tsan+t+ra'i bu bi ma la tsan+t+ra sa dbang bsgyur rdo /del rgyal po g.yo brtan dang / gis rā dzas yul khams bde bar bskyangs shing/rgyal srid chos bzhin du byas kyang / bstan pa la bya ba 'di ltar byas kyi gsalakha med cing / gzhan rnams kyis bstan pa yang dag par mchod do/ /de yang rab gsal dang / mahā phya ṇi yis ni gtso bor dpal ldan chos kyi grags pa mchod/rgyal po shākya stobs chen gyis mngon pa ba chen po dbyig gi bshes gnyen zhes bya ba mchod/ rgyal po bi ma la tsan+t+ra sa parnyi ta a mā ra sidha dang / zin chen grags pa dang / saX pra dū ta'i slob ma dbu ma pa dpal sbas rnams mchod par byas go /deyang dus de tsam na spyir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa shin tu dar yang / thogs med sku mched dang / phyogs kyi glang po bzhugs pa tsam la ltos na/ shar phyogs dang/lho phyogs kyi rgyud kun tu mu stegs 'phel zhing sangs rgyas pa 'grib bo/ /de las rgyal po seng ge lnga pa'i dus na mu stegs kyi slob dpon sbun gnyis shig byung ba ni/ gcig ni dat+ta tri zhes bya ba ting nge 'dzin la mngon par dga' bcigago /gnyis pa ni saX ga ra ā tsar+ya zhes pa mahā de wa grub ste/ bum pa bcas/shing—166—

yol bas bskor nas sngags bzlas pa na/ mahā de wa bum pa'i dbus nasamagrin pa yan chad byung ste rtsod pa rnams slob par byed do/ /des bhaX ga la'i yul du rtsod pa byas/ dge slong rgan po rnams kyis 'di ni thub par dka' ba ste/ ci ste slob dpon chos skyong dam/ tsan+d+ra go lī 'am/ zla ba grags pa dag rtsod pa'i don du spyan drang bar bya'o zhes zer yang / paṇ+ḍi ta gzhon nu dag gis ma to te/rtsod pa po yul gzhan nas bos nas yul 'di'i paṇ+ḍi ta rnams kyi grags pa nyams par 'gyur la/ de dag pas kho bo cag mkhas so zhes nga rgyal gyi dbangagis saX ga ra ā tsar+ya dang brtsad pas/ sangs rgyas pa rnams pham ste/ cor+sha/gzhi nyi shu rtsa lnga tsam gyi yo byad rnams mu stegs la shor bas de rnams stongs/ dgobasnyen lnga brgya tsam mu stegs la 'jug dgos par byung / de bzhin du o ḍi bi sha'i yul du yang saX ga ra ā tsa bya'i slob ma bram ze bha sna ā tsar+ya zhes bya ba snga ma dang mtshungs pa las/ tshangs pa'i bu mos rig pa ston pa zhig yod de/ der phyi nang mang du rtsod pa las/ nang pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta ku li sha she ṣ+ṭha zhes bya ba sgra dang rtogagol shin tu byang bar 'dzin pa zhig yod de/ des kyang snga ma bzhin du nga rgyal byasate bstan pa dpang du btsugs te brtsad pa na/ mu stegs rgyal te/ nang pa'i gtsug lag khang mang po yang bshig khyad par du lha 'bangs dang chos gzhi rnams phrogs so/ /phyi ma 'di'i dus chos skyong dang / btsun pa zla ba ldogasamibazhugs pa'i dus so/ /de'i tshe lho phyogs kyi rgyud du/ mu stegs kyi rtsod 'i pa khyu mchog tu grags pa bram ze ku mā ra lī la stogazhon nu rol pa dang / lha cen po'i rjes su 'brangs pa ba lang gi brtul zhugs 'dzin pa ka ṇa dā ro ru ste gzigs —167—

ma sgra sgrog ces pa gnyis te/ de dag gis kyang lho phyogs kyi yul rnams su rtsod pa mang po dag byas pa las/ sangs rgyas bskyangs dang / legs ldan dang/ chos 'bangs dang / phyogs kyi glang po la sogs pa'i slob ma rnams dang / nyan thosakyi dge 'dun gang yin pa de rnams kyis de dag gi rtsod pa ma bzlog nag nangapa'i longs spyod mnga' 'bangs mu stegs byed kyi bram zes phrogs pa shin tu mang bar byung ngo / /'di ni sngar brjod pa las kyang 'phyi ba tsam gyi dus so/ /de'i dus na/ slob dpon chos skyong gi slob ma de wa shra ma zhes bya bas zla grags 'gog par bsams nas dbu ma'i 'grel pa dkar po rnam par 'char ba byas/ lho phyogs kyi rgyud du mu stegs 'ga' zhig dang rtsod pa byas pas slob dpon rgyal te/ rgyal po sa la wa ha na zer ba gcig sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa lachud/ des lha khang dang mchod rten mang du bzhengs/ chos gzhi yang btsugasardeso/ /rgyal po 'di'i dus su grub thob go rak+ṣa byung ngo / /slob dpon a mārasidha'i lo rgyus rgyas pa ni ma thos/ cung zad tsam gzhan du shes par bya go /zin chen grags pas dbu ma 'ju ga pa la 'grel bsha/da byas par grags shing /dbyig bshes kyis kyang mngon pa mdzod la 'grel bshad byas/ 'di sde pa bco brgyad gyi gzhung lugs bye brag bkod pa'i 'khor lo zhes bya ba rtsom mkhan de yin no/ /slob dpon chen po dbyig gnyen bzhugs pa yan chad na sde pa bco brgyad po yang cha tshang tsam du yod la/ sngon bstan pa'i dgra byung ba'i dus na lhasasmad de sde pa 'ga' zhig nyung ngur yod pa bar skabs de rnams su rtsod pa'i rgyu mtshan dang / stes dbang gis nus pa sna tsho gis byung ste/ dge 'dun phal chen pa —168—

las/ shar gyi ri bo pa dang / nub kyi ri bo pa dang / g.ya/rir gnas pa gsukhostongs / thams cad yod smra nas/ 'od srung pa dang / rnam par phye sto sngab gnyisastongs/ gnas brtan pa las/ gtsug lag khang chen pa dang / rmang pos bkukhob las/ srung ba pa'i sde pa stongs te/ lhag ma rnams ni dar bar yod do/ /de lanyan thos rnams kyi sgrub pa'i bstan pa ni lo lnga brgya nas nyams pa ltar gyur pa yin mod/ nyan thos kyi grub mtha'i phyogs 'dzin pa ni da lta'i bar du shin tumang ste/ chos 'byung rtsom pa kha cig theg chen dar nas mi ring ba na nyan thos kyi sde gud do zhes zer zhing / theg chen gyi sde tshugs pa nas nyan thos rnams kyi mnga' thang je nyung du song ste/ dus skabs 'di tsam na nyan thos kyi phyogs 'dzin cher med dam sems pa ni cha med kyi rgyus gtam ste/ rang gis phyogs tsam yangam nges bzhin du nges nges ltar gzhan la ston zhing yi ger 'bri ba ngo mtshar ro/ /dpal ldan chos kyi grags pa ni/ lho phyogs rgyal dbang gtsug go nor bu zhes bya bar 'khrungs zhes sngon gyi mkhas pa thams cad gsung la/ deng sang yul de 'dra'i ming can mi snang yang / dpal chos kyi grags pa'i 'khrungs yul ni/tri ma la ya'i yul yin par phyi nang kun la grags pas sngon dus de la rgyal dbang gtsug gi nor bu zer bar nges so/ /sku 'khrungs pa'i dus ni/ rgyal po seng go lnga pa dang / rgyal po gsal ba sogs rgyal srid la 'bod nas mi ring ba'i dus na yin par mngon la/ yab bram ze'i rigs kyi mu stegs kun tu rgyu sa ro3 na spro zhes bya ba'i bur skye ba brnyes te/ chung ngu nas blo gros shin tu sgrin pas bzo'i gnas dang / rig byed yan lag dang bcas pa dang / sman dpyad dang/ brda spod —169—

pa dang / mu stegs can gyi grub pa'i mtha' ma lus pa la shin tu sbyangs pa ga lobacu drug gam bco brgyad tsam gyis mu stegs kyi grub mtha' thams cad la shin tu mkhas par gyur/ bram ze rnams kyis lhag par bstod par byed pa'i skabasashig sangs rgyas kyi gsung rab 'ga' re gzigs pas/ rang gi ston pa skyon dang bcas shing / bstan bcos rnams shin tu mi 'thad pa dang / sangs rgyasadang dam pa'i chos ni de las bzlog par gzigs nas shin tu mos pa skyes te nang pa'i dge bsnyen gyi cha lugs su bsgyur bas/ bram ze rnams kyis rgyu mtshan dris pa na/ sangs rgyas kyi bsngags pa brjod pas de rnams kyis gnas nasabaskrad do/ /de nas yul dbus su byon te/ slob dpon chos skyong las tha tubyung nas/ sde snod gsum po mtha' dag mkhas par byas/ mdo sde dang gzungasardesngags bsdoms pa yang lnga brgya thugs nas 'don no/ /rtog ge'i bstan bcosagazhan mang po nyan yang blo gros ma khengs te/ dpal phyogs kyi glang po'i slob mdabang phyug sde las tshad ma kun las btus/ pa tshar gcig nyan pas dbang phyug sde nyid dang mnyam par gyur/ lan gnyis pa nyan pas phyogs kyi glang po dang mnyam par gyur/ gsum pa nyan pa na/ slob dpon dbang phyug sdes kyang phyogasakyi glang po'i dgongs pa ma longs par 'ga' zhig nor bar mkhyen nas slob dpon nyid la bzlas pas shin tu dgyes te/ khyod ni phyogs kyi glang po dang mnyam ste/ grub mtha' nor ba thams cad sun phyung la/ tshad ma kun las btus/kyi 'grel pa yang gyis shig ces slob dpon las gnang ba thob bo/ /derasngags kyi rdo rje slob dpon las dbang bskur ba yang dag par mnos te/ lhag—170—

pa'i lha bsgrubs pas he ru kas mngon sum du zhal bstan te/ ci 'dod gsung༅rdepa la/ phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal bar 'tshal lo/ /zhus/pas ha ha khruXgasungs nas de nyid du mi snang bar gyur to/ /der bstod pa rgyun chags kyangamadzad/ slob dpon 'di'i rdo rje slob dpon ni 'ga' zhig dā ri ka pa yin zer/kha cig rdo rje dril bu pa yin par 'dod kyang / ḍi gi yin par 'thad gsung/slob dpon 'dis dpal snyen ra lo sdom pa'i sgrub thabs gcig kyang mdzad yod gsung zhing / rdo rje sems dpa'i sgrub thabs pū yi pas mdzad par grags pa 'di yang slob dpon 'dis mdzad pa yin gsung / de nas mu stegs kyi grub mtha'i gsang tshig slob par bzhed nas/ khol po'i cha lugs su brdzus te lho phyogs kyi rgyud du byon/ mu stegs kyi grub mtha' la su mkhas dris pas/ grub mtha' thams cad la mkhas pa 'gran gyi do med bram ze gzhon nu rol pa yin zer/ 'di la bod na gzhon nu ma len zer ba ni/ ku mā ra lī la zhes pa bsgyuram shes pa'am/ yi ge nor ba las bsgyur ba'i skyon no/ /chos kyi grags pa'i zhang po yin zer na'ang rgya gar na ye ma grags/ grub mtha'i gsang tshig brku ba'i tshe/ bram ze'i chung ma'i rkang pa'i srin mdzub la thag gu btags pa sogasakyi lo rgyus 'chad pa yang rgya gar ba lam grags shing / bden bden yang mi 'drab cig go /der gzhon nu rol ba de rgyal po las mnga' thang chen po thob ste/'bras swā lu'i zhing phun sum tshogs pa dang / ba lang dang / ma he mang po dngaldan pa/ bran pho lnga brgya dang / bran mo lnga brgya dang / zho shas 'tsho ba mang po dang bcas pa yin pas/ slob dpon gyis kyang der phyi nang gi las thams cad la—171—

bran pho lnga bcu bran mo lnga bcu'i las slob dpon gcig pus grub pa na/ gzhon nu rol pa chung mar bcas pa shin tu dga'o/ khyod ci 'dod zer ba lag grub mtha' nyan par 'tshal lo byas pas/ gzhon nu rol pa slob ma la rig pa lhen pa rnam sa kyang nyan zhing / gsang tshig bu dang chung ma ma gtogs gzhan la mi ston pa 'ga' zhig yod pa rnams las kyi bya bas de'i bu dang chung ma mgu bar byas te/de rnams la dris pas shes so/ /der grub mtha'i gnas thams cad sheg dziltar 'gos/ pa'i tshul thams cad nyams 'og tu chud par gyur pa de'i tshe/ slob ma gzhan rnams la ji ltar rig pa slob pa'i yon rnams la slob dpon gyis rnam par brtags so/ /der rig pa/ gsar du shes pa dang yon rnams yongs subartsis te/ bram ze nor la sred pas yon ma byin na nyes par 'gyur ro snyam nas/de nyid kyis byin pa'i lag gi gla dngul pa ṇa lnga brgya zhig yod pa dang / phyogasade na gnas pa'i gnod sbyin zhig las kyang gser gyi dong tse bdun stong blangs/gser rnams gzhon nu rol pa la byin/ dngul gyis bram ze rnams la ston mocher byas te/ de'i nub mo nyid bros nas byon no/ /der kā ka gu ha zhes bya ba'i tshong 'dus chen po pho brang dang bcas pa zhig yod pa la/ rgyal po druXm ri pu zhes bya ba yod pa'i sar sgo yig btab ste rtsod par 'dod pa su yod byas pas/gzegs zan gyi grub mtha' 'dzin pa bram ze ka na gup+ta dang / gzhan yang lta ba drug gi grub mtha' 'dzin pa lnga brgya tsam 'dus nas zla ba gsum du brtsad pas/rim gyis lnga brgya po thams cad sun phyung ste sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la bcugargyal pos dbang bsgyur te/ de dag gi nang na bram ze longs spyod dang ldan pa lnga —172—

bcu tsam gyis nang pa'i chos gzhi re re 'dzugs su bcug gtam de gzhon nu rol pas thos nas shin tu khros te/ rang nyid bram ze lnga brgya dang bcas pa rtsod par 'ongs/ gal te kho bo rgyal na chos kyi grags pa sod cig /gal te chosakyi grags pa rgyal na nga sod cig ces rgyal po la bsgob las/ slob de pon gyisagal te gzhon nu rol pa rgyal na bdag mu stegs pa 'dug gam/ gar de dam/brdeg gam 'ching ba ni rgyal po nyid shes so/ /gal te bdag rgyal bar gyur na gzhon nu rol pa bsad du mi 'tshal te/ 'on kyang 'di nyid sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la gzhug par bya'o gsung / der bstan pa dpang du btsugs nas brtsad pagagazhon nu rol pa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i dam bca' lnga brgya yod pa thams cad re re nas rig pa'i rnam grangs brgya brgyas sun phyung / der gzhon nu rol bsakyang nang pa mchod par byas shing / bram ze lnga brgya po de rnams sangs rgyasakyibastan pa kho na rigs par shes nas sangs rgyas kyi bstan par rab tu byung ngo / /gzhan yang gcer bu pa ra hu pru ti dang / spyod pa pa blo ka ra gu phya dang /bram ze ku mā ra nan+da dang / mu stegs kyi rtsod pa'i khyu mchog ka ṇa dā ro ru sogalodang / 'bigs byed kyi ri bo'i khongs na gnas pa'i rgol ba thams cad kyangasun phyung ngo / /slar yang drwa ba li'i yul du byon nas/ yul 'di na rtsod par nusapa su zhig yod ces dril bsgrags pas/ mu stegs pa phal cher zhig bros/'ga' zhig gis rtsod par mi nus par khas blangs te/ yul der sngon gyi chosagazhi nyams pa thams cad gsos nas/ nags tshal dben pa rnams su bsam gtan mdzad cing bzhugs pa las/ de'i tshe dpa' nā le rgyur saX ga ra ā tsar+yas—173—

rtsod pa byed do zhes 'phrin brdzangs so/ /de rnams kyis kyang sang phod bya'o zhesaphyi dus btab/ chos kyi grags pa lho phyogs nas spyan drangs so/ /de nas rtsod pa'i dus su bab pa na/ sangs rgyas pa rnams dang / bram ze dang mu stegs can mtha' dag rgyal po rab gsal gyis wā rā ṇa rnying bsdus te/ rgyal po dpang po'i tshogs dang bcas pa'i dbus su/ saX ga ra ā tsar+ya dang / dpal chos kyi gragasapa rtsod par phyogs pa na/ saX ga ra ṇa re/ gal te nged rgyal na khyed rnams gaṅgā la mchong ngam/ mu stegs la 'jug gdam nga gyis/ ci ste khyod rnams rgyal na kho bo cag gaṅgā la mchis te 'chi bar byed do/ /zhes zer nas brtsad pas/chos kyi grags pas saX ga ra ā tsar+ya yang nas yang du pham par byas te/ mthar cang mi smra ba'i gnas la bkod/ de nas saX ga ra ā tsar+ya gaṅgā la 'chi bar rtsom pa la slob dpon gyis bzlog kyang ma nyan te/ kho rang gi slob ma bha sna ā tsar+ya la khyod kyisartsod pa gyis la/ mgo bregs 'di las rgyal bar gyis shig ma rgyal yang bu pa/nga khyod kyi bur skye ba blangs nas 'di rnams dang 'thab par bya'o zer nas ga sder mchongs nas shi'o/ /de'i slob ma kun tu rgyu tshangs par spyod khas 'che ba mang po zhig sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la btsud/ lhag ma rnams thag ring por bros go /de'i phyi lo nyid bha sna ā tsa bya'i bur skye ba blangs/ bha sna ā tsa byas kyang lo gsu5du slar yang lha mnyes par byas/ yang lo gsum du nang pa'i grub mtha' dang 'gog byed kyi rig pa bsams/ lo bdun ba la sngar bzhin bstan pa dpang du btsugs nas brtsad pas/ bhan+ta ā tsar+ya yang rnam pa kun tu pham par byas te/slob dpon gyis bzlog kyang ma nyan par ga snyer mchongs te shi'o/ /der de nyid —174—

kyi bu thu bo bha sna ā tsar+ya gnyis pa dang / saX ga ra ā tsa bya'i skye ba dang/ bram zerarang gi grub mtha' la mngon par zhen pa rnams shar phyogs thag ring por bros/bram ze drang po'i blo can lnga brgya tsam ni bstan pa la rab tu byung / lnga brgya tsamani dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su song / yul ma ga dha'i bram ze gang ba zhes bya ba dang / bcom brlag tu bram ze gang ba bzang po zhes bya ba byung / de dag mnga' thang dang longs spyod che ba shin tu rtog ge la mkhas shing / dbyangs can mdang khyab 'jug la sogs par rang gi lhas byin gyis brlabs pa yin la/ dedagakyang snga phyir rtsod du 'ongs ba slob dpon gyis rig pas btul te sangs rgyas pa la bkod/ bram ze de gnyis kyis kyang ma ga dh+wa dang / bcom 'barlag tu nang pa 'a cho khro/ gzhi lnga bcu lnga bcu btsugs so/ /der snyan pa'i grags pas sa steng thamasacad khyab bo/ /de nas ma ga dha dang nye ba drang srong ma taX ga'i nags su yun ring du bzhugs te rig sngags mang po grub par mdzad do/ /de nas 'bigs byed kyiribo'i khongs na rgyal po me tog gi bu me tog kun tu rgyas pa zhes bya ba yod de/grong 'bum phrag sum cu la dbang bsgyur ba longs spyod kyi khyad par ni lha dang mtshungs so/ /zhes grags pa zhig yod pa'i sar ljongs rgyu zhing gshegs pa las/mthar gyis rgyal po'i pho brang du byon pa na rgyal pos su yin dris pas/shes rab can ni phyogs kyi glang po ste/ /tsan+t+ra go sī brjod pa rnam paradag /snyan dngags dpa' bo las byung sdeb spyor mkhas/ /phyogs las rnam parargyal ba nga min su/ /zhes gsungs pa na/ cho che/ kyi grags pa yin nam zhes drisapas/ 'jig rten na de ltar 'dogs gsung / rgyal po des kyang gtsug lag khang—175—

mang du bzhengs shing der chos kyi grags pa bzhugs/ tshad ma sde bdun gyisabastan bcos kyang brtsams nas/ gal te chos kyi grags pa yi/ /smra ba'i nyi mnub pa na/ /chos rnams gnyid log yang na shi/ chos ma yin rnams da gdod langs/ /zhes ched du brjod pa rgyal po'i sgo khang du yi ger bris go /der yun ring du sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar bar mdzad nas yun der dge slong khri phrag snyed byung zhing / chos gzhi yang lnga bcu tsam btsugs so/ /de nas mtha' 'khob kyi yul gu dzi ra thar byon nas/ der yang bram ze dang mu stegs byed mang po sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la bcug go ta pū ri zhes bya ba'i lha khang bzhengs/yul der mu stegs shin tu mang pa las/ de rnams kyis slob dpon gyi brang khangal me btang ste phyogs thams cad mes tshig par gyur pa na/ lhag pa'i lha dngagasang sngags rjes su dran pas nam mkha'i lam la bgrod nas phyogs de nas dpag tshad gcig tsam gyis yul de nyid kyi rgyal po'i pho brang dang nye bar byon/thams cad ngo mtshar du 'dzin par gyur to/ /da lta'i grub thob brgyad rtso) pe zhe par grags pa 'di gcig tu khungs su mi rung yang / rgol ba tshar gcod mkha' la gshegs/ /zhes pa yang gtam rgyud 'di la brten par mngon no/ /de'i tshesaX ga ra ā tsar+ya slar yang skye ba blangs pa de nyid snga ma las kyang tshes shin tu blo rno zhing / rtsod pa la mkhas pa/ bum pa'i steng du lhas lus rdzogs par ston pa zhinabyung ste/ lo bco lnga'am bcu drug lon pa na/ dpal chos kyi grags pa la rtsod par 'dod de/ wā rā ṇa srir 'ongs nas rgyal po mahā phya ṇi la bsgos shing phyogasathams cad du dril bsgrags der slob dpon lho phyogs nas spyan drangs te/ bus—176—

ze'i skye bo stong phrag lnga tsam dang / rgyal po la sogs pa skye bo dpag tu med pa yang 'dus/ sngon bzhin bstan pa dpang du btsugs nas brtsad pa las shin tutshar bcad de/ yang sngon bzhin bzlog kyang ga blar mchongs nas shi go /derayang bram ze mang po dag rang gi grub mtha' sun phyung bar rigs par mthong nas mang po zhig rab tu byung / mang po zhig dge bsnyen byas so/ /de'i tshe kha tshe'i yulanas bram ze bi du sidha zhes bya ba dang / de wa biṅgā ka ra zhes bya ba dang/ de wa sidha zhes bya ba ste bram ze'i slob dpon chen po gsum dpal chos kyi grags pa'i drung du 'ongs nas drang po'i sems kyis grub mtha' la brgal brtags mang du byas pas/ cho se kyi grags pas kyang yang dag pa'i rig pa bstan/ de dag nang pa la shin tu dad de skyabs 'gro dang bslab pa'i gnas lnga rnams blangs grub mtha' yang nyan/ khyad par tshad ma sde bdun nyan pas shin tu mkhas par gyur nas/byang phyogs kha che'i yul du song nas chos kyi grags pa'i lugs kyi rtog ge dar bar byas/ bar pas wā rā ṇa snyir yun ring du gnas bcas par gragasaso/ /slar yang lho phyogs kyi rgyud du byon te/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa mdar ba dang nyams pa'i phyogs thams cad du bstan pa'i 'gal rkyen byed pa rnams rtsod pas tshar bcad/ rgyal po dang blon po la sogs pa chos kyi sgo nas dbang du bsdus te dge 'dun gyi sde dang chos gzhi thug med du dar bar mdzad/ slob dpon nyid kyis bzhengs pa'i lha khang yang brgya rtsa tsam yod cing / gzhan labaskur te bzhengs pa ni grangs las 'das so/ /slob dpon 'dis yongs subaskul te sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la bcug pa'i dge slong dang dge bsnyen yan —177—

chad bsdoms na 'bum du nye ba tsam yod par grags na'ang / phal cher mkhan slob gzhan la gtad pa kho na yin zhing / chos kyis 'brel ba'i slob mas ni sasteng thams cad khyab kyang / phyi bzhin rjes su 'brang ba ni lnga las lhag pa yongasasu kyi ma bzung ngo / /zhes grags so/ /sku tshe'i tha ma'i tshe/ yang sngar gyi saX gar ā tsar+ya de nyid bhaṭa ā tsar+ya phyi ma'i bur skye ba blangs te sngon las kyang blo gros kyi stobs che ba/ rang gi lha mdun du 'ongs te mngon sum du rig pa slob pa/ resa'aga' de'i lus la yongs su zhugs nas kyang sngon med pa'i rig pa brjod pa byung ste/ lo bcu gnyis lon pa tsam na dpal chos kyi grags pa la rtsod par 'dod pa na/ der bram ze rnams kyis re zhig gzhan la rtsod par gyis shigades na nges par rang nyid rgyal bar 'gyur la/ chos kyi grags pa ni pham paranus pa dka' 'o zhes smras kyang / gal te de las rgyal ba ma nus na/ rgol ba'i grags pa thob pa med do zhes lho phyogs kyi rgyud nyid du song ste/ gang rgyal ba de'i bstan pa la cig she/sa 'jug par byas nas brtsad pas/ dpal chos kyi gragasapa rgyal bar gyur te de nyid sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la bcug lho phyogs kyi rgyud nyid du bram ze dge bsnyen gyi spyod pa la gnas pa sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la mchod pa byed pa byung ro zhes grags shing / des bzhengs pa'i lha khang ni da ltaji preng yod do/ /de nas dus kyi mthar yul ka le sger gtsug lag khang bzhengasashing skye bo mang po chos la bkod nas sku 'das/ tshangs pa mtshungs par spyod pa rnams kyis gdung dur khrod du zhugs la bzhen pas me tog gi myong chen po babs shing / phyogs thams cad dri bzang dang rol mos khyab pa zhag bdun gyi —178—

bar du byung ngo / gdung / mas cad 'ching bu 'dra ba'i rdo'i gong bu gocogatu'adril ba las rus pa'i rnam pa ye med do/ /da lta yang dus ston gyi mchod pa byed do/ /slob dpon 'di dang bod kyi rgyal po srong btsan sgam po dus mnyam mo zhesagrags pa bzhin don la'ang gnas par mngon no/ /'dir bod kyi lo rgyus ltaran/ sde bdun rtsom pa'i tshe/ tshod ma la tig ta btab ste drangs kyang ma dgongs te gzhung gi don la blo gcig tu phyogs pas so/ /brtsams zin pa na rgyal posadris pas/ rgyal po khyed kyis chad pas bcad par bya ba'i mi 'ga' yod na gosadakar po bgos/ gzhong pa snum gyis bkang sre mog gi byug pa lag tu gtad/cung zad cig bo'am gos na gsod do byas nas ral gri thogs pa phyi bzhin du 'brang bas pho brang la skor ba byed du bcug la/ pho brang gi mtha' kun na gludang rol mo mkhan rtse ba zhog cig gsungs nas de bzhin du byas nas mthar dris pa na mi des glu gar dang rol mo sogs gang yang yod pa ma shes te/ de labasgrims pas so zer na'ang / nyung mar bkang ba'i snod bskur la/ zhes sogasaspyod 'jug gi tshig la brten nas bden bden mar smras pa 'dra la/ sde bdun ni rang gi blo gros goms pa'i phyir dang / slob ma dag gi ngor gnas gtsug lagakhang du brtsams pa yin gyis/ rgyal po'i 'phrin yig mkhan gyis 'gri ba bzhin du pho brang gi phyogs gcig tu brtsams pa ga la yin/ blo shin tu gsal bsargol ba bcu tsam la dus gcig tu lan thebs par grags pa las/ gzhud don bsam pa'i tshe gzhan mi rig na blo rtul po rnams dang khyad par med par 'gyur ro/ /gzhan yang gtam de shin tu mi 'thad par mngon la/ sde bdun brtsams—179—

zin shes na'ang phrag dog gi dbang gis/mi legs sobs zu she~X'i/'ga' nardegis shes na'ang khyi /ga dbang sa ba bzhin dung sa 'a ༷sdug tshe ma she/ lam spyang lti/ tu rgyu ba sa du nga 'a bstan bcas/kyangaphyags kun tu lja/par pa go pa sne / zi//sa zang/ngas shang / 'di she shegaci gzhung dang / phyi/ sne she da bang blo dang shwakya blo la sde shākaleg bcug pa sde no / sha rdogrel gyi 'bye (lnga dbang she /she bla las bdun ga~X par bshad da zus gri / sa sa ri gya 'gras lha dbang bla la rtsams par bskul/lan ga brtsams te gags phul bas chus bkrus/༷nga ge ge ge ge she dge ge ge ge mes/sdod par/ ra 'i phyir gom te/༵ldu ra ni mdor med nyad dang/khusa~Xdhirdesda/ sno di pa' ra//gams rno phyar mdar bsdus nas//dka' 'a' ༵ra byas so//zhes sa te phul bas/'gros dang tshig zur gyisamu she pa gnad don rnams ma byung bar grog ste'i/sngi gis mu sde ge ges sa ge ge pa' dan ༵sdu byung snyug she nas rnam 'gre 9 /'a 'ig pa 'ad dpyas sngin rnyi sus kyang shas pa 'dug dgangs nas rnam 'al gya mjug tu/rgya mtshal chu bo bzhi du rang gi lus la thim khi nub pa ṣ+ka du 'gyur//zhes pa'i tshigasarder 7theg/dz+nya/ sdo) rke ge ge lte ge ra6)kestebacad bcug ga/ grags/kha ga lha dbang sbyi' rung ma shākya 'od kyi /༵sa 'grel kha ci byas so ri chos rge ge ge ge mu ge lte rtse she/༵'i slob ma 'od blon she she/kha sheg ༵ mā chos she grags kya dngos slob na zer ba she/o she pa da~Xs ga grib 'i par mid ༵ kau /sbur ri chos kyi blangs par 'dad pa sags dus 'ag pa cal ca'/ ༷ zhang /yang chas/ grags pas rgyal 'ju rde

༵na ci pa gce brdungs zer yang nang pa'i sdom brtson rgyal rnga brdung dis gsod lted nga /kyir bu pa she na bya ba sngi nas su pham pa mdud she da zar da rtsad du gcer/lo ring gi kyas ma brtsad par lha ba'i blas pha shemaXr byas rjor yang she bu ༷ rang sa 'i mtha' dang 'gal ba spyad pa~X rgal ba 'jams pa~Xrge ye cha sde sde she chad/la snyirnga ༷ dhī |ye spra grags pa gtam gtaX sdod brjad pas phangs ༷ste smra~Xpa la sheng pa dad///ltar na rgyun she ༵ dag las/klu sgrub/da ji mo ka //sdigs 'a dir shesardebyad pa pa~Xkyi/'phags pa ye she/'ings gnyan/chaX/ kya grags/pa gsum na 'greX byed san na//de rnams so sa dus ces ga la ྅// te/bstan pa gsal/bar byad pa' mdzad pa mnyam/ pas ni dusa~X sa graga~X sa//she sasheXm ze bde byed (ga 'a ba ra rdzo sa mu~X ba na ༷sa dzo grags hūṃ/ pa ni gau tu 'go she sna ༷ tu tsol la//༵'a 'a thab nga 'a rnal lurapa /spyabaXcomatsho ses tho wa pa dang /li rta bhu ta bar ༷ wa spyi/kuku rādzadang /spub dpan ma skyes dā rje dang /la ta badz+ra rnams 'al di skab dudh+rimatsho ses/ni/de la pad+ma~Xrdzu sna mtsho gcan che tha mu ge ge byon na'ang /'a ltas ma skyes bar pa de na zhang /ma skyes kya skad dod mang po yod pa 'as/tshado ru ha spyo pa de yin la/de la slob dpon ku ku rā dza lte khyi'i rgyal po zhesar rna de tsho 0ri‘sge'e/rde sno ni/ rtse ni/da she su gyi yo ba pa'am/la she kya ya 'ga' ga mu ku ta rā rno nyi/ ༷rde/snro/ste/sngan mu ga ba rnams la yangs su grags pa sa po// la/de ma rnam pa can gya dpa' bo dang rnal 'byo/ ma stong phrag ga la chos ston par

byed la/ mtshan mo de dag dang lhan cig dur khrod gyi gnas su gshegs nasatshogs kyi 'khor lo la sogs pa dam tshig gi kun tu spyod pa byed pa zhig byung ste/de ltar lo bcu gnyis su spyad pas mthar phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub thob/des nang rgyud sde lnga dang rnal 'byor rgyud mang du bshad cing / de nyid ni zla gsangathig le'i rgyud la brten nas grub pa thob pa yin zhes grags so/ /slob dpon la li ta badz+ra ni/ nā len+t+ra'i paṇ+ḍi ta zhig yin la/ rnam par snang mdzad sgyu 'phruladrwa ba'i rgyud la brten te 'phags pa 'jam dpal yi dam du byed pa las/ rangagi slob dpon la/ rdo rje 'jigs byed 'jigs par byed sogs mtshan de rnamasakyi sgrub thabs dris pas/ 'di dag ni mi'i yul na med pas kho bos ni mi shesate/ de'i don du 'dod pa'i lha sgrubs shig gsungs pas/ des 'phags pa 'jam dpal rtsegacig tu bsgrugs pa na/ lo nyi shu tsam na zhal gzigs te rgyud byin gyis brlabs/ thun mong gi dngos grub 'ga' re'ang thob nas/ u rgyan gyiganas chos kyi mdzod nas gshin rje gshed kyi rgyud spyan drongs shig ces lung bstan pa'ang byung bas/ u rgyan du byon pa na/ mu stegs kyi rnal 'byor pa 'ga' zhig dang nus pa 'gran pas/ des lta stangs byas pa na slob dpon brgyal zhinga'agyel bar gyur pa sangs tsam na/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma rnams la gsol ba btab pas/ rdo rje ro langs mas zhal mngon sum du bstan te/ gzhin rje gshed kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur/ der rnal 'byor bzhi rdzogs pa'i rim pa dang bcas pa bsgoms pas zla ba phyed dang gsum nas dngos grub chen po thob pa'i ltas byung nas nags kyi ma he gdug pa can bkug nas chings te/ rig pa —182—

brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa yang mdzad do/ /de nas u rgyan gyi gnas dharma bya ba nas/ ma 'ongs pa'i sems can la phan pa'i don du gshen rje gshed lasogs pa'i rgyud spyan 'dren par bzhed pa la/ mkha' 'gro ma rnams na re/ thegabadun du blol ji tsam bzung bar nus pa de gnang ngo / /zhes zer ba la/ lhagapa'i lha la gsol ba btab pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsungardethugs gshin rje gshed nag po'i rgyud dang / sdom gsum pa dang /rtog pa 'dun pa dang / gzhan yang gzungs dang rgyud dang / rtog pa'i rim pa thor bu pa mang po dang bcas pa thugs su chud/ 'dzam bu'i gling du lhag par dar bar mdzad de/nub phyogs kyi yul du mu stegs kyi rgyal phran na ra warma zhes bya ba'i sar mu stegs rnams dang nus pa 'gran pa las/ mu stegs kyi gtso bo 'ga' zhig gisadug bre bo re zos/ slob dpon gyi dug ni mi khur bcu tsam gsol zhing/ dburachu chang snod gnyis 'thungs pas gnod pa med pa na/ rgyal po de lhag par dad nas/ nang pa la zhugs te 'jam dbyangs kyi lha khang bzhengs/ grong khyer hasti na pu rar mu stegs kyi sngags mkhan gyi sde zhig gshin rje gshed kyi 'khor lo nyin gcig bskor bas brlag pa dang / shar phyogs wa ra spre'i cha shas ba ga la zhes bya bar klu bi kri ḍa zhes bya ba nang pa la shin tu gnod pa cig yod pa'ang spyin sreg gis tshar bcad de/ de ma thag klu'i gnas mtsho yang bskams/ de dag la sogs pa bstan pa la sdang ba'i mu stegs dang stag gzigs la sogs pa stog phrag mang po tshar bcad/ mim yin gdug pa can lnga brgya tsam btul te gtso bo mngon spyod kyi 'phrin las kyis 'gro don mdzad mthar 'ja' lus su gshegs/ de'i —183—

slob ma lī la badz+ra gyis slob dpon gyi gsung ngag yi ger bkod pas gshin rje gshed 'byung ba dang / zhi khro rnam rol sogs lī la badz+ra chen pos mdzad parabyed do/ /lwa wa pa dang / la li ta badz+ra dang / in+d+ra bhu ti rnams kyis cho 'phya5'gran pa'i lo rgyus kyang yod de/ de yang lā wa pa dang / la li ta badz+ra gnyisakagrub pa thob pa'i phyis shig na/ nub phyogs u rgyan gyi yul du gshegs pa las/ri mu ruṇ+ḍa ka zhes bya ba bgrod dka' ba zhig yod pa la/ slob dpon gnyisabagrod te/ bdag cag gnyis las su'i rdzu 'phrul gyis bgrod par bya zhes pa las/ la li ta badz+ra gyis deng bdag gi rdzu 'phrul gyis bgrod la/ slar ldog 'ong ba'i tshe khyong/ kyi rdzu 'phrul gyi mthu las so/ /der la li ta badz+ra bdag nyid gshen rje gshed du gyur pa'i phyag mashaṃ ral gris ri de'i rtse mo nas rtsa ba'i bar du gzhags te/ der lam kha phrag shin tu dog po dog po zhig las bzhud nas slarari sngar bzhin du gyur to/ u rgyan gyi gnas su in+d+ra bhu ti thun mong gi grub pa thob pa'i skabs shig yin la/ la li ta badz+ra zhes bya ba'i grub ba'i slob dpon zhig gsar du 'ongs so zhes thos nas/ rgyal po skye bo'i tshogs dang bcas pa bsu ba'i phyir 'ongs te/ slob dpon gyi zhabs gnyis la bsku mnye byed pa'i tshe zhabs re re la lag pa gnyis gnyis gyis bsku mnye byed dgos pas rgyal pos lag pa bzhi sprul nas bsku mnye byas so/ /slob dpon gyis zhabs bzhi sprulapas/ rgyal pos phyag brgyad/ slob dpon gyis brgyad sprul pas/ ye rgyal pas bcu drug slob dpon gyis bcu drug sprul pa na/ rgyal po phyag bcu drug gi lha la goms pa brtag pas/ de bas lhag pa sprul ma nus par re res bsku mnye byas go /de —184—
