nas slob dpon gyis zhabs brgya'i bar du sprul nas rgyal po'i nga rgyal bcag go /phyis slob dpon lwa wa ba dang / la li ta gnyis slar shar phyogs su byon pa'i che/ ri mu ruṇ+ḍa ka'i drung du nub gcig brang btab bo/ /lwa wa pa na re/ ri bo shin tu che na nangs par snga mor 'gro'o byas nas/ nam phyed 'jing yol na tingange'adzin gyi stobs kyis ri med par byas thang bde mo zhig la 'ongs te/ nawalangs pa na la li ta badz+ra gyis phyi mig gzigs tsa na ri brgal bar shes te ngo mtshar skyes nas lwa wa pa la phyag byas rbe1 zhes grags tre ( / /de la 'phags/pa'i yul gyi gtam grags che ba ltar na/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug bi rū pa ni gshin rje gshed kyi lam bsgoms pas rdo rje phag mos byin gyis brlabs nas grub pa thob/ gzhin rje gshed nyid dang miganyis pa'i rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug ho por gyur pa yin pas rgyu mtha' dag ston du rung mod kyang / grub thob rnams ni dngos kyi gdul bya rnams dang skal pa 'tsham par ston pa nyid chos nyid yin pas/ gshin rje gshed dmar po'i rgyud spyan drangs shing / bcom ldan 'dasanyid kyis gsung bzhin du sgrub thabs dang man ngag yi ge bkod/ de'i slob washom bhi he ru kas ku ru ku lce'i rtog pa dang ā ra snyi gnyis kyi rgyud spyan drangs/rgyud kyi don mngon shes kyis mkhyen zhing / ye shes mkha' 'gro ma rnams dang bka' bgros pa las dgyes pa'i rdo rje'i rgyud kyi snying po blangs nas bdag med ma'i sgrub thabs dang / lhan cig skyes grub la sogs pa gzhung du ma mdzad cingaslob ma rnams la dbang yang bskur ro/ /de nas slob dpon lwa wa pa dang mtshoskyes gnyis kyis dgyis pa'i rdo rje'i rgyud spyan drangs te/ lwa wa pas swa saX be da pra —185—

kṛ ta zhes bya ba rdzogs rim gtso bor ston pa'i bstan bces dang / mtsho skyesakyis bskyed rim gyi sgrub thabs sogs mang du mdzad de/ dgyes pa'i rdo rje'i yab kyi sgrub thabs thog mar byung ba ni/ sgrub thabs mtsho skyes so zhes grags so/ /shar phyogs kyi slob dpon chen po dbu ma pa dpal sbas kyi gtam rgyud kyang gsal bar ma mthong zhing ma thos so/ /de'i tshe lho phyogs kyi rgyud du/ kam lagosī zhes bya ba spyan ras gzigs kyi grub thob gcig byung ste/ de yang lto phyogs kyi gtsug lag khang zhig na dge slong sde snod gsum pa dang / theg pa chen po labasam gtan pa zhig/ bzhugs pa'i g.yog dge bsnyen ka ma la go sī yin/ deyang ka ma la go sī des sngon bstan pa la ma zhugs shing las 'bras mi shes pa'i dus shig gtsug lag khang zhig gi sgo drung nas dngul gyi 'dab mal yi ge bris pa chig rnyed de/ de ci dgar blangs nas yul gyi gzugs tshong ma 'ga' la byin no/ /phyis dus der rang gi slob dpon dge slong de snga dro snga mo na bsod snyomasagasol nas/ sgo nang nas bsdams te nyi ma phyi phred kyi bar du sgo mi 'byed pa zhig yod pa las/ dus lan cig dge bsnyen des snga dro nas nyi ma phyi phred kyi bar sgo bsdams nas bzhugs pa ci zhig lags zhus pas/ bu 'di dris nas ci byed gsung pa la/ gang slob dpon rnal 'byor du mdzad pa de bdag kyang ma shos te sgom pa lags zhus pas/ bu nga la rnal 'byor du bya ba gzhan med/ ri po ta 'angaphyin nas 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs la chos nyan te/ slar yang 'dir 'ongasanas sgo 'byed pa yin gsung / 'o na bdag kyang 'khrid par zhu zhus pas/'phags pa la zhus nas 'ong gi gsung / nangs par slob dpon 'khor byung ba la —186—

dris pas slob dpon cung zad khros te/ bu khyod kyis nga yang sdig pa can gyiphonyar byas so/ /ci yin dris pas/ kho bos 'phags pa la zhus pan/ khyod sdig pa can de lta bu'i lon khyer ma 'ong zhig de ni 'phags pa shes rab kyi pha rolatuphyin pa'i glegs bam dngul las byas pa 'jig par byed pa yin zhes gsung ngo / /de'i phyir khyod ni po ta lar 'gro ba'i skal ba med do zhes gsung pas sngon rang gis rnyed pa'i dngul gyi 'dab ma la yi ger bris pa de yin par sheg sdigapa'i las la shin tu 'jigs shing skrag nas/ 'o na slob dpon gyis sdig pa sbyongaba'i thabs 'phags pa la zhus shig byas pa la/ nangs par des kyang 'phags pa la zhus/ spyan ras gzigs kyis kyang sgrub pa'i thabs zab mo zhig gnanganas/ slob dpon des kyang dge bsnyen de la gnang / des kyang nags tshaladaben pa zhig tu rtse gcig tu bsgrubs pas/ lo bcu gnyis tsam song ba na bya rog zhig gis 'bras rngan chad pa gcig shing khar za bar 'dod pa las ka ma la go grwa'i mdun du lhungs/ sngar lo bcu gnyis su mi zas cher ma zos pas/'bras chan de za bar 'dod de zos pa na/ 'bras chan la sred pa'i sems shin tu drag pa skyes te/ grong khyer du slong du phyin pa na stes dbang gis nyin zhaga'aga' zhig tu ma rnyed do/ /de nas cung zad cig rnyed pa de gyo dum zhig tu bcuganas nags gseb tu khur ba na de'i rang bzhin la rnam par brtags pas/'bras chan la sred pa'i sems rang bzhin med par mthong nas/ de kho na nyid gsal bar rtogs shing / 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs 'khor dang bcas pa yang rang gi drung na 'od 'bar bas bzhugs par snang ngo / /de nyid du gyo dusla—187—

'bras chan dang bcas pa de nyid sal brdabs pas sa g.yos shing / gyo mo gogogazeg ma zhig klu'i rgyal po nor rgyas kyi spyi bor lhungs nas brtags pas de ltar yin par shes te/ klu'i rgyal po nor rgyas kyi bu mo 'khor lnga brgya dang bcasakhazas bzang dgu thogs nas mchod pa la 'ongs kyang kha zas kyi sred pa spangs te phyir phyogs nas 'dug go /phyis klu rnams 'dul ba'i don du klu yul du'ang byon/ mi'i yul du'ang 'gro ba'i don mang du mdzad nas mthar ri po ta 'ang yangabazhud do/ /dpal chos kyi grags pa'i dus su byung ba'i gtam ste nyi shu rtsa drugapa'o// //de'i 'og tu biṣ+ṭha rā dza 'das pa na ma la wa'i rgyal po rnying pa'i rgyud las rgyal brgyud ma chad par byung ba'i rigs zhig la/ rgyal po bha shrī ri byung/ rgyal po de'i sring mo zhig bi ma la tsan+d+ra la bag mar btang ba las rgyal po go bi tsan+d+ra btsas/ chos kyi grags pa sku 'das pa tsam na de yang rgyal sar thon pa' mthon du nye ba'i dus shig yin/ rgyal po de gnyis kar grub thob dza lan+da ri pa dang/slob dpon nag po spyod pa pas btul nas grub pa thob pa'i lo rgyus gzhan du shes/ de'i skabs su grub thob tan+ti pa yang byung ste/ ma la ba'i gro pa khyer a rban+ti zhes bya ba de ni thags mkhan gyi rigs/ yun ring por de'i las kyis 'tshob zhig yin pa las/ de la bu dang tsha bo yang mang po yod cing / thags mkhan gyi rigs brgyud shin tu dar bar gyur pa las/ nam zhig na de rgas shing 'khogesate bya ba gang la yang sbyor mi bzod par gyur pa'i tshe/ bu rnams kyis khyim du re mos kyis gso ba las/ nam zhig na skye bo kun gyis dpyas gdags pa'i gnas—188—

su byas pa na/ bu rnams na re/ 'tsho bas ni 'o mi brgyal bar byed/ dben pa zhig tu bzhugs shig byas nas/ bu che ba'i skyed mos tshal gyi logs shigatuspyil bu chung ngu zhig byas nas 'dug la/ bu rnams so so'i khyim nas nyi ma re mosakyis zas 'dren par byed do/ /der lan cig grub thob dza lan+ta ri pa rnal 'byorapa phal pa'i tshul gyis byon/ thags mkhan gyi bu rgan pa la gnas myong g.yarabs des kyang skyed mos tshal der bkur bsti cung zad dang bcas pas bskyal/srod kyi dus na sgron me sbar te mgron po zhig yod pa rgan pos shes/ thorasakyi dus na/ de na yod pa su yin dris pas/ nga rnal 'byor ba lam du zhugs pa zhig yin/ dngos rang su yin gsung / des thags mkhan 'di rnams kyi pha zhigalags te/ rgas 'khogos par gyur pas skye bo gzhan la ston yang ma nyan te 'dir sbas pa zhig lags/ khyed cag rnal 'byor pa rnams ni sems rgyud yongasasu dag pa yin pas bdag la byin gyis rlob par zhu byas pas/ slob dpan gyisakyang de skal ba dang ldan par mkhyen te/ skad cig de la dkyil 'khor spras nasadabang bskur zhing / zab mo'i don gyi gdams pa cung zad cig gnang nasabazhud de/ rgan pos kyang bla ma'i gdams ngag rtse gcig tu bsgoms pas lo 'ga' zhig song ba'i 'og tu/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma mngon sum du byon te phyag spyi bor bzhag pa tsam gyis phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub thob/'on kyang re zhig gsang ba'i tshul gyis gnas pa la/ nang cig bu che shos kyi khyim du 'gron po mang bo byung ste nyin mo g.yengs nas/ pha la zas skyel ba ma byung/ mun sros pa na dran te g.yog mo zhig gis zan skyel du phyin pas skyed mos tshal na glu —189—

dang rol mo'i sgra zhig grags/ mthar brtags pas spyil bu chung ngu de'i nang na 'dug ste/ sgo seng nas bltas pas rgan po ni lus la 'od 'phro zhing/ 'bor lha dang lha mo'i cha byad bcu gnyis tsam gyis mchod pa phul zhing 'dug sgo phye ba tsaman yal te song skad/ de nas grub pa thob par shes te/ dris kyang khas ma blangasapar rnal 'byor ra ba zhig gis byin gyis brlabs pas/ lus nyam stobs dang ldan par song ngo zer nas/ slar yang thags mkhan gyi bya ba byed cing glu kho na len pa zhig byung / bar 'dir nag po spyod pa dang mjal ba'i lo rgyus yod de gzhan du shes par bya/ lan cig yul pa rnams dka' zlog ma la sogs pa ma mo rnamasamachod pa'i phyir ra skyes stong phrag mang po gsod par brtsams pa la/ slob rgane des ra rnams la sngags bzlas pas thams cad kyang ce spyang gi gzugs su gyur/mi rnams the tshom skyes nas phyir ldog dka' zlog ma'i rten gyi steng du 'gyel ba ltar byas pas/ de nyid gzugs dngos bstan te/ grub thob ci ba ched zer ba la/srog gcod pa'i mchod pa ma len zhig ces bka' bsgos/ da lta'i bar du yangadakar gsum gyis mchod pa yin/ de nas rdo rje'i glu mang po blangs te garagashegs cha med par bzhud do/ /de rjes go bi tsan+t+ra'i pha tshan gyi sbun zlar gyurapa/ la li ta tsan+t+ra sa rgyal srid byas/ lo mang po bde bar bskyangs pa las/ de yang nag po spyod pa'i sku tshe'i smad kyi dus su btul nas/ rgyal po dang blon posagrub pa thob/ de ltar rol ba'i zla ba de ni tsan+t+ra'i rigs kyi rgyal po rnams kyi thamar byung ngo / /de phyin chad tsan+t+ra'i rigs kyi rgyal rigs mang du yod kyang rgyawasrid zin pa ma byung ste bhaX ga la dang / o sko bi sha sogs shar phyogs yul tshan —190—

ldan rgyal rigs dang blon po dang / bram ze dang / tshong dpon wo po rnamasasosor khyim dang khyim na rgyal por gyur te/ yul 'khor skyong ba'i rgyal po ma byungango / /dus de'i tshe grub thob rgyal po lhan skyes rol pa dang / dpal nā khoraslob dpon dul ba lha byung / des tshad ma sde bdun la 'grel pa byas/ rme rdo sde 'dzin pa shu bha mi tra dang / slob dpon tshul khrims bskyangs dang / shwarnyi so malasogs pa byung ste/ rnam rig gi grub mtha' rtsa bar bzung / mdo sde dang 'dul ba dar bar byas so/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dgu pa zhes pa'i bstan bcos rtsom mkhan gyi slob dpon ka spa la pa dang / dpal sbas kyi slob ma slob dpon chen po ye shes snying po la sogs pas ngo bo nyid med pa'i dbu ma'i tshul bzung / shar phyogs bhaX ga la'i char gtogs pa ha tsi pu ra zhes bya bar dgobasnyen btsun pa ngo bo nyid med pa byon te/ rnam rig gi dbu ma rgya cher bshad/ tho gar gyi yul du bye brag tu smra ba'i slob dpon 'dul ba 'dzin pa chen po dharma mi tra chos kyi bzhes gnyen yang byon/ nub phyogs ma dra'i yul du 'dul ba 'dzen pa chen po bsod rnams grags zhes bya ba dang / tsi ta wa ra'i yul du 'du wa 'dzin zhi ba 'od dang / kha che'i yul du 'dul 'dzin ma khol zhes pa rnams byung ste/ de la gzhan rnams kyi lo rgyus rgyas par ma mthong / slob dpon ye shes snying po ni/o ḍi bi shar 'khrungs shing / der paṇ+ḍi ta chen por gyur pa zhig bhaX ga le'i yuladu slob dpon dpal sbas la chos nyan te/ legs ldan gyi srol 'dzin dbu mchen por grags pa yin te/ 'dis 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyugayun ring du bsgrubs shing / mthar yid bzhin nor bu'i 'khor los bsgyur ba —191—

zhal gzigs te mngon shes dang ldan pa zhig byung / mdo sde du ma thugs nasa'adon pa mu stegs rnams pham par mdzad pa yin no/ /dge bsnyen btsun pa robo nyid med pa ni/ tshong pa'i rigs las byung ba/ gzhon nu nas theg pa chen po'i rigs sad cing / 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi zhal ka zigs pa/ mdo sde lnga bcu tsam thugs nas 'don pa/ dus rtag tu chos spyod bcu dang ma bral zhing/ 'khoradage bsnyen stong phrag re dang / dge bsnyen ma de snyed la chos ston pa/ des kā tsharū pa'i phyogs su lan cig byon pa na/ dug sbrul a dza ga ra'i tshang yod pa'i stengadu khong gi slob ma rnams kyis song bas/ re zhig sbrul gnyid ma sad/ lamakhazhig tu brang btab ste gnas pa las sbrul gdug pa gnyid sad de/ mi'i dri tshoranas byung ste dge bsnyen 'ga' zhig ni mid/ mang po zhig la mche ba btab/ kharlangs kyi dug gis 'bros par brtsams pa rnams kyang 'thoms shing 'gyel ba la/ rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol ma yid la dran zhing bstod pa chen po mdzad pas dug sbrul la zug rngu chen po byung ste dge bsnyen gnyis po skyugs nas phyir phyung / sbrul nyid slar bros so/ /sbrul gyis mid pa dang / mche bas btab pa de rnams dug nad kyis brgyal ba la sgrol ma'i sngags bzlas pa'i chu gtor bas dug rnams rma'i sgo nas phyir phyung / mi rnams gsos so/ /yang lan cig slob dpon nyid la dug sprul gyis gnod pa byed du byung ba la/ sgrol ma'i sngagasabazlas pa'i me tog gtor bas/ slob dpon gyi mdun du sarba musti zhes bya ba'i mu tig mang du skyugs nas phyir song / nags la me shor bas sgrol ma'i rigasngags bzlas pas zhi ba sogs nus pa'ang mnga'o/ /chos kyi bshes gnyen gyi lo—192—

rgyus cung zad tsam ni gzhan du shes la/ chos bshes 'di dang / 'grel chung don gsal gyi 'grel bshad mjad mkhan gyi chos bshes gcig par smra zhing/ de nyid yon tan 'od kyi dngos slob tu 'dod pa ni 'khyams pa las kyang tshes 'khyams pa ste/ de 'dra'i lugs ltar na/ 'phags pa rnam grol sde dang sengagobazang po dus mnyam par byed dgos so/ /de'i tshe shar phyogs su rtsod pa'i khyad par mang po dag byung ste/ sngon gyi rtsod pa lta bu'i rgyal pham cher nus pa'i rtsod pa che ba ni ma byung yang / rtsod pa chung ngus dus 'da' ba zhig byung ngo / /der chos kyi grags pa'i gzhung lugs la brten nas brtsad pas/ nang pa'i phyogs sngon las rtsod pa bla ba zhig yod na'ang / dus kyi dbang gis mkhas pa nyung ba dang/ mustegs kyi rgol ba lhag par mang bas sangs rgyas pa'i gtsug lag khang phra mothams cad na/ nang pa'i rgol ba rnams sems 'tshab 'tshub mor gnas pa zhig yong ba na/ bhaX ga la'i bye brag tsa ṭi gha bo'i grong khyer gyi gtsug lag khang bi rje bi ha ra zhes bya ba na/ nangs par mu stegs kyi rgol ba mang po dang rtsod pa byed parakhas blangs/ thub bam mi thub snyam nas the tshomi me yod pa las bud med rgan mozhig byung nas/ tsher ma lta bu'i cod pan mgo la gyon te rtsod cig rgyal b.ra'agyur ro zer/ de bzhin du byas pas de rgyal zhing / gzhan du yang de ltar byasapas rgyal ba byung nas/ de phyin chad nas parnyi ta rnams zhwa rtse ring gyon pa zimogyis dar te/ rgyal po pā la bdun brgyud dang / se na bzhi brgyud kyi ring la thegachen pa'i pa ni ta thams cad zhwa rtse ring gyon pa byung ba yin gyis/ de yan chad du med do/ /slob dpon chen po chos kyi grags pa yan chad kyis sangs rgyas kyi —193—

bstan pa nyi ma ltar gsal bar mdzad cing / de man chad nas yang dag pa'i mkhan po chen po spyir nas bstan pa la bya ba khyad par can byas pa shin tu mang mod kyi sngon gyi slob dpon de dag dang mtshungs pa cher ma byon zhing byon du zin na'ang dus kyi dbang gis sngon bzhin bstan pa gsal bar ma gyur to/ /'phags pa thogs med byon pa'i dus tsam nas dus 'di tsam gyi bar du sngags kyi grub thob tshes che ba rnams byung zhing / bla med kyi chos rnams skal ba dang ldan pa nyanacig la dar ba las thun mong du 'chol ba ye med dus 'di'i 'og rol tsam nas rnal 'byor bla med kyi rgyud rnams je dar je dar la shin tu dar bar gyur zhing /bar skabs shig tu rnal 'byor rgyud kyang shin tu dar la/ bya spyod kyi rgyud rnamasa'achad pa dang sgom pa rim gyis nub bo/ /de'i dbang gis sngags kyi rdo rje slob dpon las dang dngos grub ci rigs pa 'grub pa rgyal po pā la bdun brgyud kyi ring la shin tu mang bar byung ba'i rgyu mtshan yang de yin no/ /dus 'di tsam na/tsan+t+ra'i rigs kyi rgyal phran zhig grub pa thob pa pra kā sa tsan+d+ra ste rab gsal zla ba yang byung / rnal 'byor rgyud rgya cher bshad do/ /gzhan yang nang pa'i slob tswa3 grub thob brgyad cu rtsa bzhir grags pa phyed lhag pa yang chos grags kyi dus man chad 'og tu 'chad pa ltar gyi rgyal po tsa na ka yan chad du byon pa yin no/ /gyon drug bzhugs pa'i dus na/ theg chen gyi slob dpon rnams tshes mkhas shing/dge 'dun yang bzang por yod pa ma gtogs/ grangs ni nyan thos kyi dgo'adun kho na tshes mang la/ dus 'di tsam nas bzung ste lho phyogs kyi rgyud kyi bstan pa yang je zhan la mi ring bar nub/ yul gzhan dang gzhan gyi rnams kyang—194—

rim gyis nub pa tsam du song bas/ pā la bdun gyi ring la ma gha dh+wa/ bhaXgal/o ḍi bi sha sogs nyi 'og gi rgyal khams dang / kha che'i yul rnams su shin tudar bar byung / gzhan rnams la thor bu tsam ma gtogs med la/ yul phran bal bo'i yul du lhag par dar/ de dag tu yang sngags dang theg chen lhag paradar zhing / nyan thos sde yang spyir shin tu dar bar yod mod/ rgyal po la sogasapa skye bo bzang tshang theg chen mchod/ theg pa chen po'i yang sngon mdo rnams nyid gtso bor 'chad cing / dgongs 'grel zhar byung du 'chad pa las/phyis nasasher phyin tsam ma gtogs/ go bzlog pa'i tshul gyis slob dpon rnams kyi gzhung rnams la 'chad nyan gtso bor dar ro/ /rgyal po go bi tsan+t+ra la sogs pa'i gtam kyi skabs te nyi shu rtsa bdun pa'o// //yul dbus dang shar phyogs kyi sa mtshams li kha ra shing 'phel gyi nags tshal dang nye ba zhig na/ rgyal rigs kyi bu mo gzugs byad bzang ba zhigashing gi lha zhig dang 'dus pa las/ na ma'i ga na khye'u mtshan dang ldan pa zhig btsas/ cung zad cher skyes pa na/ lha de'i gnas shing gi rtsa bar sa brus pa lasanor bu rin po che rang 'od 'phro ba zhig rnyed/ des slob dpon zhig la dbangabaskur ba mnos nas/ lha mo tsuna'i sgom lung zhus te bsgrubs/ yi dam gyi phyagamatshan shing gi dbyug tho chung ngu zhig mi 'bral bar sbas te 'chang / na tshan lha mos rmi lam du zhal bstan te byin gyis brlabs/ de nas 'phags pa kha ba spe ṇa'i gtsug lag khang du phyin te/ rgyal srid thob par gsol ba btab pas/ khyod shar phyogs su song zhig rgyal srid thob par 'gyur zhes lung bstan/ des kyang—195—

shar phyogs su phyin no/ /de'i tshe bhaX ga la'i yul du rgyal po med par lo mang podag song ba las/ yul mi thams cad mi bde zhing sdug bsngal bar song bsagatsobo gtso bo rnams 'dus gros byas te/ sa gzhi khrims kyis skyong ba'i phyir rgyalapozhig bskos/ rgyal po go pi tsan+t+ra'i btsun mo yin nam yang zer/ la li ta tsan+t+ra'i btsun mo yin yang zer te klu mo mthu tsheb gdug rtsub can zhig sngon rgyal po rdzu 'phrul can gyi btsun mor byas pa las/ der rgyal por bskos pa de de'i nub monyid zos so/ /de bzhin du rgyal por bskos r+sā bsad de/ 'on kyang rgyal po med na rgyal khams mi shis so zer zhing snga dro re bzhin rgyal po re bskos la de'i nub mo des bsad nas/ skya rengs shar ba tsam na phung po 'don no/ khro lnga desayul mi rnams la re mos byas nas lo 'ga' shas song skabs yin pa las/ lha mo tsun grub pa des khyim zhig tu phyin pas de rnams sdug bsngal gyis non pa la/rgyu mtshan dris pas/ nangs par de'i bu la rgyal po'i res mos 'bab zer gla byin na ngas tshab bya'o byas pas shin tu dga' lte glu yang blangs/ nangs par rgyal sar bskos/ de'i nam phyed na klu mo de srin mo'i gzugs su bsgyur nas sngarabazhin za bar 'ongs pa la/ yi dam gyi phyag 'tshan bsnun pas klu mo de rang shi'o/tho rangs phung po dbyung mkhan rnams byung ba la/ ma shi bar mthong nas thamasacad ya mtshan skyes/ de nas gzhan gyis yang tshab mar khas blangs nas zhag bdun la rgyal srid du lan 'dun bskos/ de nas thams cad kyis 'di ni ba chod nams chen po dang ldan pa yin no byas nas rtag tu rgyal srid du bskos te/mtshan go pā lar gsol/ sku che'i stod la bhaX ga la la dbang bsgyur/ smad lawa—196—

ga dh+wa yang dbang du bsdus te/ o tan+ta pu ri dang nye ba na nā len+d+ra zhes bya ba'i gtsug lag khang zhig bzhengs/ yul chen po de gnyis su dge 'dun gyi sdemangadu btsugs te bstan pa la mchod pa rgya chen po mdzad do/ /slob dpon spyod pa ba sku 'das pa'i phyi lo rgyal po 'di rgyal srid la dbang bskur ba yin zer ba dbang pos byin gyis bshad/ lo bdun nas yin zer ba sa dbang bzang pos bshad do/ /rgyal srid lo bzhi bcu zhe lnga byas/ rgyal po 'di'i sku tshe'i ring la zhi ba 'od dang / bsod nams grags kyi slob ma/ slob dpon shākya 'od nub phyogasasu'akhrungs nas kha che'i yul du 'gro don mdzad/ khyad par kha che'i yul du dā na shi la chen po dang / khyad par bshes gnyen dang / shes rab go mdang / 'dula'adzin slob dpon dpa' bo zhes bya ba rnams byung zhing /shar phyogs su ni slob dpon ye shes snying po'ang bzhugs pa yin la/gang dag legs ldan/ spyan ras gzigs brtul zhugs/ sangs rgyas ye shesazhabs/ ye shes snying po/ zhi ba 'tsho zhes dbu ma rang rgyud pa'i brgyud pa 'ded pa ni/ zhi ba 'tsho'i dbu ma rgyan la/ brgyad stong 'grel chen du seng bzang gisa'agrel pa mdzad pa ma mthong zhing / sangs rgyas ye shes seng bzang gi slob wayin par ma dran par/ sangs rgyas ye shes kyi slob ma ye shes snying por 'dod pa blun po'i blun rtags bstan pa khon 'o/ khwakya blo gros dang / ngang tshul phrengapodang / rgyal sras grags pa'i bshes gnyen dang / paṇ+ḍi ta sa'i rtsa lag rnams byung zhing / kha che'i yul du hra har+sha de wa zhes pa rgyal srid byed do/ /dus de dgatugrub pa'i slob dpon byung ba ni sngar gyi rigs pas shes/ khyad par bi hwab chud—197—

ba ni/ rgyal po 'di dang de wa pā la'i bar du byung bar mngon te/ nub phyogasaka rdzo yul du bi bha ra sna zhes bya ba'i rgyal po zhig byung / de'i bu mo de wa ga 'a'ibatsun mor blangs te/ bu rā sa pā la skyes par bshad/ bi bha ra sna sda'i dus su bi rā pa chung ba byung ba yin la/ rgyal po de la mchod gnas phyi nang gnyis kar yod pa las/ rgyal po rang ni nang pa la mos pa zhig ste/ blon po thams cad phyi rolapa la dad do/ /der lha khang bzhengs pa la phyi nang gnyis ka'i lha'i rdo sku mi tshad tsam pa mang po bzhengs/ sangs rgyas pa rnams kyis lha khang tha dad kyis zhes byas la/mu stegs pa rnams gcig tu bya'o/ /zhes zer zhing / blon po rnams kyis de ltar bkod de/ der rab gnas la bi rū pa chung ba spyan drangs/ cho ga sogs gang yang mi mdzad par a yi sha/ a yi sha zhes bod skang/ du shog shog ces pa ste da ltar gsungs pas lha sku rnams thams cad lha khang gi phyi rol gyi khyams su byon no/ /sdod cig byas pas lha rnams sa la bzhugs so/ /der snod cag tu chab btsags te/ lha sku rnams kyi dbu la nar tsam bran pas nang pa'i lha rnams haragyis bzhengs/ gad mo ding ding lha khang gi nang du bzhud/ phyi ba'i lha rnams mgodud de khyams su lus so/ /lha khang da lta yang yod de/ a mṛ ta khur pa zer/slob dpon chen po tog rtse ba che ba bsam mi khyab kyi gzhung mdzad pa po yang 'di skabs byung ngo / /rgyal po go pā la 'di'am de wa pā la'i mtshams ga dpal o tan+ta pu ri'i gtsug lag khang yang bzhengs te/ de ni ma ga dha'i phyogs gcig na mu stegs byed kyi rnal 'byor bsngags kyi nus pa grub cing drang po'i rang bzhin —198—

can nar dā zhes zer ba zhig yod cing / de ro langs kyi dngos grub pa la grogasalus stobs che zhing nad med la lus la dpa' bo'i mtshan ma dgu yod pa/ ngagabaden par smra ba/ blo rno zhing dpa' ba/ g.yo sgyu med pa/ bajo'i gas thamasacad la mkhas pa zhig dgos pa las gzhan med de/ nang pa'i dge bsnyen zhig la 'dug pa mthong / de la nga'i sgrub g.yog gyis byas pas/ mu stegs pa'i sgrub g.yog mi byed zer/ de na re/ khyod mu stegs la skyabs su 'gro ni mi dgogalongs spyod zad mi shes pa 'byung bas chos dar bar byas pas chog mod zer/'o na slob dpon la zhus la 'ong gi byas nas/ slob dpon la zhus pas gnangastede'i sgrub g.yog byas/ 'grub tu nye ba na de na re/ ro langs lce phyir g.yugs te bzung dgos te/ lan dang po la zin na dngos grub chen po/ bar pa la 'bring/tha ma la chung ngu 'grub/ lan gsum la ma zin na dang po 'o skol gnyis/za/ denas yul khams stong pa tsam du 'gro zer/ dge bsnyen gyis lan dang po sa nyisapa gnyis la ma zin/ de nas ro langs dang kha sprad de bsdad pas/ gsum pa laso btab pas zin/ de nas lce ral spir gyur/ lus gser du song ro / /dgobasnyen gyis ral gri thogs te bskor bas nam mkha' la 'phags pa na/ mustegs na re/ ngas ral gri'i don du bsgrubs pa yin pas ral gri nga la thod zer/ngas ltad mo zhig bltas la 'ong gis byas nas ri rab kyi rtse mor phyin/ gling bzhi gling phran dang bcas pa yud kyis bskor nas/ ral gri khong rang la gtad pas/de na re/ lus gser du song ba 'di khyod rang gyis/ rus pa la mthug par sha'i thad nas chod/ chang rin dang / smad 'tshong go don sogs log pa lam song ba —199—

gyis/ rang gi 'tsho ba dang dge ba'i las la sbyar na de ring bcad pa'i shuladonub gang ste zad mi shes pa yong zer/ khong rang ral gri thogs nas lha yul du song ngo / /dge bsnyen des ro langs kyi gser la brten te/ o tan+ta pu ri'i gtsug lag khang chen po bzhengs pa yin/ o tan+ta 'phur byed kyi don yin/ dgobasnyen gyis nam mkha' la phyin nas ri rab gling bzhi dngos su mthong ba'i bkod pa ltar bzhengs/ dge bsnyen de la u ṭu u pa si ka zhes thogs so/ /lha khang de la rgyal po blon po sogs su'i yang drin ngos med/ lha khang rtsig mkhan/lha bzhengs mkhan/ bzo bo rnams kyi gla lto yon rgyu sogs thams cad rol ngasakyi gser btsongs pa kho nas grub cing / gser de kho nas dge slong lnga brgya dang /dge bsnyen lnga brgya'i 'tsho ba sbyar te/ dge bsnyen de nyid ma shi'i bar du khongarang gis chos gzhi bteg/ 'da' ba'i tshe/ gser 'dis re zhin gzhan la phan mi thogs/ ma 'ongs pa na sems can la phan par 'gyur zhes gter du sbagachos gzhi rgyal po de wa pā la la gtad do/ /rgyal po go pā la'i dus kyi gtamasnyenyi shu rtsa brgyad pa'o// //rgyal po de wa pā la ni kha cig klu'i bu yin par yang 'dod cing / rgyalabogo pā la nas brgyud pa'i rig sngags kyi byin rlabs zhugs pa'i phyir de nyid kyi sras yin par ni sems la/ 'on kyang 'di skad ces grags te/ rgyal po gopāla'i btsun mo tha chung zhig gis bram ze'i rig sngags mkhan zhig las rgyal po dbang du byed pa'i rig pa zhus pas/ ri bo gangs can nas sman blangs te sngagasakyis btab/ kha zas dang sbyar rgyas btab/ rgyal po la drongs shig byas nas/—200—

bran mo la bskur bas chu 'gram zhig tu 'gred de rdzas chu la lhung / chus khyer te klu'i gnas su sleb pa na/ klu'i rgyal po rgya mtsho skyong zhes bya bas zos te de dbangadu gyur te/ rgyal po'i gzugs kyis 'ongs nas btsun mo dang phrad pas dzi༅skaldegyur ba'i gnas skabs su/ rgyal pos chad pas gcod par brtsams pa las/dus 'di'i tshe rgyal po nyid 'ongs so byas pas slar brtag go zer nas/ namazhig na khye'u btsas te lha mchod byas pa'i tshe/ sprul mgo rong gis byung nagakhye tha'i lag pa la sor gdub yod pa la bltas na klu'i yi ge mthong 'bas klu' rgyal po'i bur shes nas skyed bsrings/ rgyal po go pā la 'das pa na de nyid rgyawasrid du bskos/ rgyal po gong ma las kyang mnga' thang tshe ste shar phyogs wa deṭīmanga' 'og tu 'dus/ gtsug lag khang khyad par du 'phags pa zhig rtsig parab ched nas so ma pu ri bzhengs pa yin te/ 'di la bod kyi lo rgyus phal cheraltar na/ ltas mkhan rnams na re/ dge sbyong dang bram ze'i ras la sdong bu byagargyal po dang tshong dpon gyi khyi ma nas mar blangs/ dka' thub pa'i gnas nasakong bu blangs te mar me sbar ba yi dam gyi mdun du bzhag stogasol ba btab na chos skyong gi sprul pas kong bu gang du bsgyur ba der lha khang rtsigs shigargyal po'i mnga' thang yang je 'phel du 'gyur zhing yul phyogs thams cad la bkra shis par 'gyur ro zer/ de ltar byas pas/ bya rog gcig byung nag rkangabu mtsho zhig la bskur bas yid chad pa na mtshan mo klu'i rgyal bo sprul mgo lnga pa byung ste/ nga khyod kyi pha yin pas mtsho bskams la rtsig tu gzhug go/zhags dunabadun na mchod pa chen po gyis shig zer te/ de bzhin byas pas zhag nyer—201—

gcig na mtsho bskams/ der lha khang bzhengs zhes 'byung la/ kha che'i yul gyi rgya mtsho sbas pa'i gtsug lag khang bzhengs pa'i lo rgyus la rmi lam du mi nag po zhig byung nas/ nag po chen po la mchod pa gyis/ mtsho gnod sbyin rnams kyisaskems par byed do zhes pa las gzhan de kho na bzhin du byung ba'i/ de'i lo rgyusasom pu ri la sbyar ba min na rung ngo / /de bzhin du de wa pā la zhabrungs pa'i lorgyus kyang lhan skyes rol pa'i lo rgyus dang phyogs 'drar snang bas phan tshun dpe byas pa'i brjod rigs yin min brtag dgos la/ so ma pu ri yongs su gragasapa 'di som pu ri gsar pa yin no zhes kyang grags so/ /rgyal po de la rnala'abyor ba si ro ma ṇi zhes bya bas bskur te/ o ṭi bi sha la sogs pa'i yul 'di rnams sngon nang pa'i gnas yin yang/ da ltar mu stegs pa kho na dar bas dmanabya'o snyam dmag gi tshogs pa chen po bsdus te/ rang dang nye ba'i yul nas pharaphyin tsa na/ rgyang ring po nas mi nag po zhig dal gyis 'gro'o/ /de la su yin 'drir btang bas nga nag po chen po yin/ bye ma'i phung bo 'di bsal ba'i 'oganalha khang yod/ mu stegs kyi lha khang rnams 'jig par 'dod na gzhan byed midagos gyis lha khang gi mtha' dmag gis bskor la rol mo chen po gyis shig zer/ bye ma'i phung po bsal ba'i 'og nas sto lha khang ngo mtshar can za/dpal tsha ba gsum gyi gtsug lag khang du ming btags/ lo rgyus 'ga' zhig las de nas dge slong 'gog pa la snyoms par zhugs pa zhig don nas/ sangasargyas 'od srung dang / rgyal po khyi kri'i gtam dris pas/ 'di ni yos rgyas shwakya thub pa'i bstan pa yin no byas pas/ cho 'phrul mang bo bstan nas mya pan las—202—

'das so zer/ de nas mu stegs kyi lha khang rnams la ji skad bsgob bzhin byasapas lha khang thams cad rang zhig ste/ spyir na mu stegs kyi gnas ga chen pobazhi bcu tsam zhig la la bhaX ga la dang wa re rgyu'i yang yin/ de nas o to pi sha thams cad mnga' 'og tu chud do/ /rgyal po 'di'i ring la nag po spyod pa cob byon te/ de ni slob dpon nag po spyod pa'i rjes 'brang bde dgyes gshin rje bshed gsum la mkhas pa'i parnyi ta zhig yin/ des nā len+d+ra dang nye ba zhig tubade mchog bsgoms pas mkha' 'gro mas lung bstan/ kā ma rwaṇ+ḍi lha mo'i gnas na rdzas kyi dngos grub yod kyis long zhig zer/ der phyin pas za mkho/cig rnyed/ kha phye bsaḍa ma ru drwa ba can shig byung / de lag tu thogs pa tsam gyis rkang pa sal ma reg cing / drag tu dkrol ba na grub pa'i rnam 'byor pho mo lnga brgya gang nas byung cha med par 'ongs nas de'i 'khor byed pa byung ste/ yun ringapor 'gro ba'i don mdzad do/ /mthar ga ṅga swā ga ra zhes par gar gshegasachamed pa'i tshul gyis sku 'das/ 'dis sdom pa bshad pa la sogs pa bstan bcos mang du mdzad/ sku tshe ring bas rgyal po dharma pā la'i rjes su'ang sa zad bzhugs so/ /skabs 'dir slob dpon shākya 'od kyi slob ma shākya bshes gnyen zhes bya ba yang byung / gzhan yang 'dul 'dzin dge legs ba ye/sa gnyen dang/blo bzang ngang tshul dang / daX ni sen ste mche ba'i sde dang / ye shes zla bdang/rdorje mtshon cha dang / 'jam dpal grags pa dang / ye shes byin dang/ badz+ra de wa dang / lto phyogs kyi rgyug du btsun pa spyan ras zig gas brtul zhugs rnamasabyung / kha che'i yul du slob dpon dha na mi tra la sogs pa byung / slob dpon seng—203—

ge bzang po'ang rgyal po 'di'i dus su pa'i tar gyur/ 'gro don ci rigs pa mdzad/ rgyal po dharma pā la'i dus su 'phrin las cher byung ba yin te 'ogatu'achad/ bod kyi yul du byon pa'i ā tsar+ya bo dhi satwa ni/ rgyal po go gal nasargyal bo dharma pā la'i bar du ni nges par bzhugs par mngon la/ bod kyi lo rgyusakhungs che bar byas pa kun na ni bod kyi rgyal rabs dgu mkhan po'i sku tshe'i ring la 'das zer bar snang bas de lta na ni/ thogs med sku mched kyi zhabs chen pa tsam du byed dgos te/ ji bzhin yin par dka' 'o/ /'di dang dbu ma rgyan mdzad pa po mkhan chen zhi ba 'tsho gnyis gcig par kun tu grags shing / bod kyi mkhas pa chen po thams cad kyis kyang gcig par mdzad 'dug pas re 'ig de la yid brtan bya ste/ de ltar na rgyal po go pā la'i dus nyid du parnyi ta chen por gyur pa/ rgyal po 'di'i dus su gtso bor 'gro don mdzad pa zhig yin no/ /lha btsan po khri srong sde btsan gyis mdzad pa'i bka' yang dag pa'i tshad man/ mkhan po bo dhi sa twa'i mtshan dharma shwarnyi sto ṣa ste chos zhi ba'i dbyings zhes pa yin par bsha/da kyang / mtshan du ma 'byung ba mi 'gal zhing / rang gomakhan/ bu sad mi mi bdun kun la'ang rak+ṣi ta zhes pa'i shwan+ta rak+ṣi ta'i mtshan zur re yang 'dug pas mtshan gyi rnam grangs zhi ba 'tsho yang nges par yin no/ /'on kyang ye shes snying pos mdzad pa'i dbu ma bden gnyis kyi 'grel bshad mdzad mkhan gyi zhi ba 'tsho dang / dbu ma rgyan mdzad pa po zhi ba 'tsho mi gcig par 'dod pa ltar na/ de gnyis las gang yin brtag dgos pa tsam snang ngo / shwakya bshes gnyen gyis rnal 'byor gyi rgyud de kho na nyid bsdus pa'i 'grel pa ko sa la'i rgyan —204—

zhes bya ba yul kos lar brtsams/ khong nyid kyis bla ma bcu gcig tsa5lazhus par 'grel pa de las bshad/ sku che'i smad la kha cher byon nas 'gro don cher byung / rdo rje mtshon cha ni 'jam dpal gyi bstod pa gang blo mar grags pa rtsom pa po de yin te/ paṇ+ḍi ta lnga brgyas so sor brtsams pas tshig don gsagatubyung bas lha'i rdzu 'phrul du shes so/ /'jam dpal grags pa thi mtshan brjod kyi 'grel ba chen po mdzad pa po/ chos kyi dbyings gsung gi dbang phyugagodakyil 'khor dngos su zhal gzigs pa'i rdo rje slob dpon chen po zhig ste 'grel pa de la rnam par brtags na gsung rab rgya mtsho'i pha rol tu son pa zhig ni yin par snang ngo / /'di'i lo rgyus rgyas rgyas 'dra ba sngon bod la grags pa zhig snang ba kho bo'i yid la ni shin tu mi 'bab/ shes par 'dod na mkhasamachog bu ston gyis mdzad pa'i yo ga gru gzings su blta'o/ /badz+ra de wa ni/ rten khyim pa snyan dngags mkhan chen po zhig yin la/ bal po'i yul du phyin nasamustegs pa'i rnal 'byor ma zhig gi spyod pa log pa mang po mthong nas/ de ladamod pa'i snyan dngags sbyar ba na/ des kyang dmod pa byas pas snyung mdzesabatab/ der 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs la gsol ba btab cing/ nyin re bzhin bstod pa phreng 'dzin gyi sdeb sbyor gyi glo ka re re brtsams/ zla ba gsu5nas 'phags pa sbyan ras gzigs kyi zhal mthong ste snyung ba'ang gdangs/bstod pa blo ka brgyar longs te 'phags yul gyi phyogs thams cad du snyan dngags legs pa'i dper byed do/ /rgyal po de wa pā las lo bzhi bcu zhe brgyad du rgyal srid byas/ de'i rjes su sras rā sa pā las rgyal srid lo bcu gnyis byag—205—

bstan pa'i bya ba gsar pa cher ma mdzad pas de ni pā la bdun la mi bgrang /de'i tshe u rgyan gyi slob dpon sgeg pa'i rdo rjes dpal nā le rgyur lo bcu'i bar du bzhugs shing / sngags kyi theg pa mang du gsungs/ mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i 'grel pa yang mdzad/ slob dpon bā su je zhes bya ba dbyig gnyen gyi mtshan can zhig byon te/ chos mngon pa'i sde snod mang du gsungs go /de laslob dpon sgeg pa'i rdo rje ni/ yul ṣi ṣa ra zhes par 'khrungs/ u rgyan gyi gnas su rab tu byung zhing grub mtha' rnam rig dbu ma pa/ rig pa'i gnasathams cad la mkhas par byas pa'i mthar/ u rgyan gyi gling phran ma dhi ma zhes/bya bar 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i sgrub pa mdzad/de'i tshe 'phags pa 'jam dpal 'grub tu nye ba na/ 'jam dpal gyi bris skra zhi zhal las 'od zer chen po byung ste gling yun ring du snang bar byas bas/ nyimadang 'dra ba zhes bya bar mtshan gsol/ log par lta ba 'ga' zhig la nang pa'i parnyi ta'i dbang po lnga sgrub rdzas la dgos pa byung / slob dpon bkrong du 'os(pas glang po dang rta dang bu mo dang khye'u sogs sna tshogs kyi gzugs su bsgyur bas su yin ngo ma shes par phyir ldog sna tshogs gzugs can zhes mtshan gsol/ sku tshe'i smad la u rgyan gyi yul du 'gro don cher mdzad/ mthar 'ja 3 lus rdo rje'i sku brnyes so/ /rab tu byung ba'i mtshan dpal ldan byang chub mo chogagi skal ba dang ldan pa/ gsang mtshan sgeg pa'i rdo rje zhes bya ba yin pag desamadzad pa'i bstan bcos rnams la sgeg pa'i rdo rje nyi ma dang 'dra ba sna tshogs gzu gas can dpal ldan byang chub mchog gi skal ba dang ldan pas mdzad pa —206—

zhes 'byung ba yin no/ /'di'i dus gdol ba'i bu zhig ār+ya de wa dang mjalabyin gyis brlabs pas chos tol shes su byung / bsgoms pas grub pa thob ste/'phags pa klu sgrub yab sras kyi sngags gzhung mtha' dag rnyed/ ci rigs parabashad de ma tang gi pa'o/ /yang kong ka na ru slob dpon srung ba'i zhabs zhes bya ba des zla grags la dngos su mnyan nas/ sgron gsal gyi glegs bam yang byung /de bzhin du pa'i ta sgra gcan 'dzin zer bas kyang klu byang dang mjal zer te/chos 'phags skor mgo dar ba tsam byung / phyis pā la phyi ma bzhi'i dus su lhagapar dar ro/ /mkha' la nyi zla rnam gnyis dang / sa la gsal ba rnam gnyis zer ba byung skad/ rgyal po de wa pā la yab sras kyi dus su byung ba'i gtam sto nyi shurtsadagu pa'o// //de'i rjes su rgyal po de'i sras dharma pā la rgyal srid du bskos te/ 'disargyal srid lo drug cu rtsa bzhi mdzad/ kā ma rū pa dang / ti rā hu ti dang/gosalasogs pa yang dbang du bsdus/ chab srid shin tu che ste shar du rgya mtsho la thug pa/nub tu ṭi li tshun chad/ byang du dza le sto ra man chad/ lho la ri 'bigs byed kyikhongs tshun chad la lung bsgyur/ seng bzang dang / ye shes zhabs bla mar brnyan/sher phyin dang / dpal gsang ba 'dus pas phyogs thams cad gang bar mdzad/gsang ba 'dus pa dang / phar phyin shes pa'i parnyi ta gral mgor 'jog pa sogs byung / rgyal po 'di rgyal srid du 'khod tsam na/ grub pa'i slob dpon kuku ri pa yang bhaX ga la'i yul du byung nas 'gro ba'i don mdzad/ de'i lo rgyusagazhan du shes/ rgyal srid du 'khod ma thag nas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa —207—

'chad pa po rnams spyan drangs/ slob dpon seng ge bzang po la khyad par du mos/rgyal po 'dis spyir chos gzhi lnga bcu tsam btsugs pa las/ sher phyin 'chad pa'i chos gzhi sum cu so lnga yod/ dpal bi kra ma la shī la'i gtsug lag khangabazhengs te/ de yang ma ga dha'i byang ngos chu bo ga ba'i 'gram ri de'u zhig go rtseladabus su byang chub chen po'i sku tshad kyi lha khang / mtha' skor du gsang sngagasanang gi lha khang chung ngu lnga bcu nga gsum/ lha khang dkyus ma lnga bcu nga bzhi sto lha khang brgya rtsa brgyad yod pa phyi lcags ris bskor ba bzhengs/ paṇ+ḍi ta brgya rtsabargyad/ gtor ma'i slob dpon/ rab gnas slob dpon/ spyin sreg slob dpon/byi ba srung ba dang / phug ron srung ba dang / lha 'bangs kyi gnyer byed pa ste brgya dang bcu bzhi la zas gos kyi 'tsho ba'i khyad par mi bzhi bzhi'i 'tsho ba dang mnyam pa sbyar/ zla dus zla dus su chos nyan pa po thams cad la stag res 'khoragyi ston mo dang yon bzang po re 'bul bar mdzad/ gnas gzhi de'i bdag po gang yin pa des nā len+d+ra yang skyong bar byed do/ /pa ni ta re res chos sna re rgyun du gsung pas chos gzhi'i yo byad so sor ma sbyar yang chos gzhi brgya rtsa brgyad dang don gyis mnyam par song / rgyal po 'di slob dpon ka spa la'i skye ba yin para'adod na'ang ngos bzung yod pa dka'/ sde snod 'dzin pa smon lam gyi pa zhig shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dar bar byed pa'i smon lam btab ste rgyal por 'khrungs par ni yin par bshad/ rgyal po 'di nas bzung nas sheraphyin kho na dar rgyas tsheb byung / sher phyin gyi mdor yul dpyad pa'i skabs na dang por yul dbus su dar bar 'gyur zhing / de nas lho phyogs/ slar yang—208—

dbus/ de nas byang phyogs dang / byang phyogs nas byang phyogs su dar b.ragasungs pa'i lho'i rjes su yul dbus su dar ba ni rgyal po 'ji/'i dus tsam la ngos bzung dgos so/ kha cig byang phyogs kyi rjes su slar yang yul dbusasudar bar 'gyur zhing / de ltar mdo nas kyang bshad zer ba ni mdo ji bzhin tshabaklags pa'i skyon no/ /rgyal po 'di dang dus mnyam du rgya gar nub phyogs kyi rgyal bo tsakra yu dha zhes pa yod par/ rgyal sde dkar chung rdo rings kyi yi golasnang / rags rtsis su byas pa la bod kyi btsan po khri srong lde btsan dang dusamanyam par shes so/ /rgyal po 'di'i dus su rtog ge pa chen po dge srung dang/seng ge bzang po dang / mdzes bkod dang / rgya mtsho sprin dang / 'od zer 'byungaganas dang / gang ba spel dang / rdo rje slob dpon chen po sangs rgyas ye shesazhabs thugs sras dang bcas pa rnams dang / sangs rgyas gsang ba dang/sangs rgyas zhi ba dang / kha che'i yul du slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas dbyangasadang / rtog ge pa chos 'byung byin dang / 'dul 'dzin seng ge'i gdong to lasogs pa byung ngo / /de dag las slob dpon seng ge bzang po ni/ rgyal po'i rigs las rab tu byung ba gzhung lugs du ma la mkhyen pa rgyas pa cig slob dpon zhi ba 'tsho las dbu ma'i ga(hūṃng rnams dang gdams ngag rnams gsan/mkhan po rnam snang mdzad bzang pe7 la shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i mdo mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan gzhung man ngag dang bcas pa gsan/ de nas shar phyogs kha sa dru ṇi'i nags su rgyal ba mi pham pa bsgrubs pas mnal lam du zhal bstan nas/ da ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i don la 'grel pa byed —209—

pa'i bstan bcos grub mtha' mi gcig pa mang na/ su'i rjes su 'brang zhusngapas/ 'thad pa'i cha sdus shig ces bka'i gnang ba thob/ de nas mi ring b.rargyal po dha mi pā las spyan drangs te/ tri ka ṭu ka tsha ba gsum gyi gtsug lag khang du bzhugs nas sher phyin nyan pa stong phrag mang po la chos ston zhing / bgyod stonga'agrel chen la sogs pa bstan bcos kyang mang du mdzad/ rgyal po dharma pālargyal srid du 'khod nas lo nyi shu lhag cig na sku 'das so/ /slob dpon rgya mtsho sprin ni rgyal ba mi pam pa'i zhal gzigs nag rnal 'byor spyod pa'i sa sde lnga la 'grel pa rtsom par lung bstan thob pas yongasardzogs la 'grel pa mdzad par yang grags shing / byang sa'i 'grel pa ni gragasache'o/ /pad+ma 'byung gnas dbyangs ni lo dri mkhan po yin nam semag sleb dpon chen po sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs ni/ seng ge bzang po'i slob ma'i thogam lta bu yin zhing / seng bzang sku 'das pa tsam na/ grub pa brnyes nas cho se ston pa'i mgo brtsams pa tsam yin/ de nas lo 'ga' 'das pa na rgyal wa'i blamar gyur/ de nas mi ring bar bi kra ma la shī la'i rab gnas sogs mdzad de/de'i rdo rje'i slob dpon du mnga' gsol/ slob dpon 'di ni 'gro don wod pa nas brtsams te/ ji srid sku 'das kyi ring la nub re bzhin 'phags pa dzasnalas gser pa ṇa bdun brgya bdun brgya dang / lha mo nor rgyun mas mu tig ni do shal sum brgya pa re 'bul zhing / lha'i mthus de dag nyo ba'ang phyi de nyin khon 'byung la/ nyi ma de'i phyi de nyin kho na la de dag thams cad dge ba'i las la zad par mdzad nas/ tshul des dus 'da' bar mdzad do/ /de yang dpal gsang ba —210—

pyis pa lha bcu dgu la she ye rta'i 'phang lo tsam stson she/gauspyams ༷'a brgyud 'a /bloX drug sto swā gsum gsum/she pa dzolnga 'i dzir ༵ she gnyas kyas khyags kyas 'a pa baX lnga re/༵༷spos gzugapa ma po pa ya byad sna thams ༷da nas ༵rdo/la zhang/gcang kye sgo mi sla rdo gsangamadang /she tu byung ba dung /tso mo ba sna ris pa sdeb 'ad pyo parastso da sto//de ltar she dā yad dra / sna smi / ni spro pa nga du sre : da 'a ge mu kha she//rgyal pa dharma pā la la/khyad kya tsha ba dus na rgyal da 'jag pa' mtshan/ mkha/da pas/ze sreg gi cho ga r+ṣa po zhig byas na yun ngi du srid zin zhing si kyangade ge tsho lha)zla5/rderdeti giX lngar gsungs she/ pon btsobo sna ta la sa she ljag /gu dngakring ya byad ri sbyi bas/slab dpan rdzo/ 'ad gyur pa' rda 'an dro rnams/kyas ༷ mang por na sreg mdzad/yul skyonang po la dbang bsgyur bsta tsamardeḥng ge zhe ni /lhag ga rna di/ sa ( brgyud lngas spyo bsgyu sko ni sdo pa la dbang bsgyur bstan pa dar bar rdoX) tshe cho//rje rtse ge ge rwa mi dod dod pa zhi du byung /sa thar rgyas/pa gzhan du gsal/da 'azhig spre rda kas kyi gya lha khang gan he dzā//ka' sku rkyos 1 sdu : ༵5pa'agos wo po dang /rig 'a zhi smrugs rdom mje po ༷dge pa rgo nga pa so gosardesh+ka thos sen+ta pa 'ga' sag sa dag bdud kyas byas pa'o zhes byas nas sgigs bam sngas kyas 'a shang byas/ḍi gzugs shā yang dum bur bgoswānas da pa byas sa//bhaX ga la 'a yul nas kram la lar mchode pa lha re 'a dho yi su pa/gra/ba mang po'ang de spri theg wo zhes bya ba lta ba 'o ga ni spyod pa 'a ba na pas yang dag pa chosi ston pa po rnams la bor shag byas nas/kho ra

rnams nyid la bsgyur ba sogs phyis rgyal pos thos nas siṅga la pa rnams la bar skabs su chad pa byung ngo / mthar de las kyang slob dpon 'dis bskyangasaso/ /slob dpon 'dis kri yo ga sde gsum yang cung zad gsungs/ 'dus pa/ snyu 'phrul drwa ba/ sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor/ zla gsang thig le/ 'jam dpal khros pa ste nang rgyud sde lnga mang du gsungs/ khyad par gsang ba 'dus pa rtsal du bton pas de nyid kun tu tshes dar ro/ /slob dpon 'di'i slob ma rab zhi bzhesaganyen ni/ mngon pa dang / pha rol tu phyin pa dang / kri yo ga sde gsu5lamakhasapa'i parnyi ta zhig ci bder gnas pa la/ skal ldan du mkhyen nag slob dpon ye shes zhabs kyis dbang bskur mdzad de/ rang gis kyang bsgrubs pas gshin rje gshed zhal gzigs shing / gnod spyin gnod gnas dbang po grub nasalongs spyod kyi khyad par gang 'dod dag 'phral nas 'phral du blangs nas yo byad don du gnyer ba rnams la ster bar mdzad/ gnod sbyin kho na g.yog tu bkowanas nā len+t+ra'i lho phyogs su bdud rtsa 'byung gnas zhes bya ba'i gtsug lag khang zhig bzhengs/ mthar lus de nyid kyis rig pa 'dzin pa'i gnas grub bo/ /rgyal rigs sgra gcan 'dzin bzang po ni/ rig pa'i gnas la sbyangasapa'i parnyi ta'i gnas thob kyang blo cung zad rtul ba zhig yod pa la/ slob dpon gyis dbang bskur zhing byin gyis rlob par mdzad/ nub phyogs kyi yul si rgyu dnganye ba'i chu 'gram zhig tu gsang ba 'dus pa'i sgrub pa yun ring du byas/ de bzhin gshe/gas pa rigs lnga'i zhal gzigs/ gsang ba'i bdag po dngos su 'grub/'dzam bu'i gling du 'gro don cher ma mdzad/ 'gro lding gi yul du byon/ der—212—

gsang sngags kyi rgyud sde yang mang du gsungs shing / klu las nor blangs te lpin re bzhin gtsug lag khang bzhengs pa'i gla mi lnga brgya lnga brgya yod pa las mi re'i lpin re'i las la gla'i khyad par gser di na ra re re byin/ gsang ba 'dusapa'i lha khang chen po bzhengs/ lus de nyid la rig pa 'dzin pa'i sku grub cing /klu rnams 'dul bar bced nas rgya mtsho'i nang du byon te da lta yang bzhugs so/ /slob dpon sangs rgyas gsang ba dang/ sangs rgyas zhi ba ni sangs rgyasaye shes zhabs kyi sku tshe'i stod kyi slob ma yin la/ slob dpon nyid dang gzhanayang rdo rje 'dzin pa mang po las spyir gsang sngags mang po gsan/ khyad par du bya spyod rnal 'byor rgyud gsum la mkhas/ rnal 'byor rgyud la grub pa'ang thos pa yin/ de las sangs rgyas gsang ba ni/ wā rā ṇa sri'i gnas shig tu 'phags pa 'jam dpal bsgrubs pas nam zhig na bris sku bzhad/ dngos grub kyi rdzas ba dmar ser gyi mar khu yang khol/ me tog rnying pa rnams kyang kha 'bus pasadangos grub kyi ltas su mkhyen kyang / thog mar me tog 'bul lam marakhu'athung snyam the tshom du cung zad lus pa gnod spyin mo zhig gis gegs byas te/slob dpon gyi 'gram par thal lcag brgyabs pas slob dpon cung zad brgyal/brgyal ba sangs tsa na bris sku rdul gyis gos/ me tog rnyings/ mar khu yang pho/'on kyang rdul phyis/ me tog dbu la phul/ mar gang yod 'thu ngas pas sku lusand thams cad dang bral zhing shin tu yang stobs dang ldan pa dang / blo gros shin tu rno zhing mngon shes dang ldan par byung / sangs rgyas zhi bas rdzas dang brisasku—213—

sogs gang gi yang spros pa med par bsgoms pas kyang sangs rgyas gsang ba dang / yon to mtshungs par thob/ de nas de gnyis kyis ri bo ta lar byon/ri'i rtsa ba na 'phags ma sgrol ma klu'i tshogs la chos ston pa bzhugs kyang rgan mo ba lang gi khyu chen po 'tsho bar mthong / ri sked na khro gnyer can ma lha ma yinadang gnod sbyin gyi tshogs la chos ston pa yang bu mor lug gi khyu wo po 'tsho bar gzigs/ ri'i rtse mor phyin pa na 'phags pa spyan ras gzags kyi rdoskugacig las mi gda' skad/ 'on kyang sangs rgyas zhi bas gnas 'di na phal pa ga la yod/ bdag rang snang ba ma dag pa yin/ 'di rnams sgrol tshal sogs pa yin no/ /snyam nas yid tshes chen po byas nas gsol ba btab pag thun mongagi yon to ci 'dod par bsgyur nus pa'i rdzu 'phrul dang / mngon shes sogasadapag tu med pa dang / mchog gi yon tan sngon ma bslabs pa'i chos thams cad kyang shes shing / gnas lugs nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i don rtogs pa cigabyung / sangs rgyas gsang bas yid ma ches bzhin du gsol ba btab pas/zhabs sa la mi reg par 'gro ba tsam gyi dngos grub cig thob/ der rgan mo de na re/ khyod ri kha ba can gyi gangs ti ser song la sgrubs pa gyis zhes lung bstan/tshur 'ongs pa na sangs rgyas zhi ba la dngos grub gang thob dris pas/ ji ltarabyung ba'i tshul brjod/ der grogs kyis dngos grub wo po thob pa la phrag dogagi rnam rtog byung bas/ de ma thag tu zhabs sal mi reg pa'i dngos grub kyanganyams/ slar yun ring du bshags pa byas pas sor chud zer/ de nas lha rwa ṇa phyir lo 'ga' zhig chos gsungs/ yang 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyis sngar —214—

bzhin bskul bas/ ri te ser byon nas sgrub pa mdzad pa'i rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor chen po yang nas yang du zhal gzigs shing / 'phags pa 'jamadapal dang mi lab pa bzhin du gyur/ mi ma yin thams cad bran du 'khole/las tshogs dang thun mong gi dngos grub la mnga' bskyur ba zhig byung / de'i tshebod kyi btsan po khri srong sde btsan gyis dbas mnyu shrī la sogs pa sbyan 'dren du btang yang 'jam dpal gyis bka' ma gnang bar ma byon/ de rnams la kṛ yo ga sde gsum bshad/ rdo rje dbyings kyi sgrub thabs yo ga la 'jug pa dang/ rnamasnang mngon byang gi bsdus 'grel dang / bsam gtan phyi ma'i rgyas 'grel rnamasamadzad/ de'i gsung la zin bris byas pa'i 'grel pa gzhan yang mang du yod/mchog gi dngos grub ma brnyes kyang mi ring ba na sku lus mi snang bar gyur/sangs rgyas zhi ba'ang ti ser bzhugs zer na'ang / u rgyan du bzhud pa yin param phro no/ /slob dpon ka ma la shī la yang / rgyal po 'di'i ring la byon paramangon pas de las snga phyir byung bar mi bsam mo/ /rgyal po dpal ldan cho so skyongang pa dharma pā la'i dus kyi gtam ste sum cu pa'o// //de'i rjes la ma su rak+ṣi ta zhes pa rgyal po dharma pā la'i mag pa zhig gis rgyal srid lo brgyad tsam byas/ de'i rjes su ba na pā la zhes bya ba rgyal po dharma pāla'i sras cig gis rgyal srid lo bcu tsam byas/ de dag gi ring la slob dpon rtog ge pa chos mchog dang / dharma mi tra zhes bya ba zhig dang / bi mal mi tra dang/dharma ka ra la sogs pa byung / rgyal po de gnyis kyis chos la mchod pa che thang du mdzad kyang phyag rjes gsar pa med pas pā la bdun la mi bgrang / de nas rgyal —215—

po ba na pā la'i sras ma hi pā la zhes pa byung / rgyal srid lo lnga bcu nga gnyesastemadzad/ rags rtsis su byas na rgyal po 'di 'das tsam na bod na btsan pokhriral yang sku 'das pa tsam gyi dus yin no/ /rgyal po de'i ring la slob dpon kun dga' snying po dang / kun rdzob dang don dam byang sems kyi sgom rim mdzad mkhan rta dbyangs zhes bya ba dbu ma thal 'gyur ba zhig dang / slob dpon gzhan/ la phan pa dang / slob dpon zla ba pad+ma la sogs pa byung / slob de gron ye shesabyin dang / ye shes grags pa la sogs pa'ang 'di skabs byon par mar+sha// khacher 'dul 'dzin dzi na mi tra dang / sarba dz+nyā de wa dang / dā na shwe la la sogs pa byung ste/ 'di gsum gyis bod du'ang byon par mngon no/ /grub thob ti snyi pa yang 'di dus byung ste lo rgyus gzhan du gsal/ slob dpon kun dga' snying po ni/ 'khrungs sa ma ga dh+wa pa/ rigs rje rigs/ sde pa phal chen pa/ grub mtha' rnam rig dbu ma pa/ bi kra ma la shwe lar rig pa'i gnas lnga la sbyangs pa zhig yin la/ bhaX ga la'i yul na rgyal po'i grub thob prakā sha tsan+t+ra ste/ rab gsal zla ba'i slob ma rnams rnal 'byor gyi rgyud mtha' dga'achad par byed do zhes thos nas yul der byon/ rab 'byor bskyangs la sogasapa slob dpon mang po la gtugs te/ rnal 'byor rgyud mtha' dag la mkhas parabyas so/ /de nas sbyangs pa'i yon tan bcu gnyis la gnas bzhin pas nagasakhrod du sgrub pa mdzad pas rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor chen po zhal gzigs/bstan bcos rtsom par lung bstan thob/ lhag pa'i lha dang mi lab pa bzhin du gyur/ rig sngags kyi mthu grub pas las tshogs thams cad thogs pa med par —216—

'grub cing / dngos grub kyang 'grub rung du bzhugs pa las/ yul dbus nasaslob dpon pra dz+nyā pā li ta zhes bya bas snyan pa thos te chos zhur 'ongs pa la dbang bskur te/ de kho na nyid bsdus pa bshad/ slob dpon de'i don du rdorje ཿngab mdzad/ des yul dbus su bshad pas rgyal po ma hi pā las thos nas/ chosa'adi gang las thos zhes dris pa na/ rang go yul na gnas pa yang mkhyen tam/bhaX ga la ni slob dpon kun dga' snying po bzhugs pa de las thos byas pas/rgyal po dad pa skyes nas spyan drangs/ ma ga dha'i lho phyogs 'bar ba'i phun pa dang nye ba a tsa ya na gtsug gi nor bu zhes bya ba'i lha khang du spyan drangs/ gsangartesngags nyan pa po shin tu mang bar byung zhing / de nyid bsdus pa'i 'grel chen de nyid snang ba la sogs pa'i bstan bcos mang du mdzad/ o ḍi bi sha'i yul gyi rgyal po bi ra tsar+ya zhes bya ba ma hi pā la dang pha sbun du 'gro ba zhig gis sngon rgyal po muñja byung ba'i gnas na gtsug lag khang zhig yod pa der spyan drangs/dpal mchog dang po'i 'grel chen mdzad/ gzhan yang gsang ba 'dus pa sogs rgyud du ma la 'grel pa mdzad do/ /bod kha cig ni yo ga'i rgyud brgya rtsabargyad la 'grel pa mdzad zer te/ yo ga'i rgyud ni dus de tsam na 'phags yulan nyi shu longs pa yang yod yod mi 'dra/ yo ga'i rgyud re re la'ang 'grel chen 'grel chung gnyis gnyis mdzad zer ba mkhas pa rnams kyis mi 'thad par bshad pa ltar yin/ des na brgya rtsa'i grangs nges mi 'thad par mo 3 no/ /dusa'adir slob dpon bha go zhes bya ba rdo rje bdud rtsi'i rgyud las grub pa thob pa zhig byung ste/ de yang sngon kha che'i yul gyi paṇ+ḍi zab pa'i rdo rje zhes bya ba zhag dur —217—

khrod bsil ba'i tshal du dpal sangs rgyas thams cad mnyam par spyod ba'i rgyud la brten nas rdo rje nyi ma sgrub cing bzhugs pa tshe/ mthar rdo rje bdud rtsi'i dkyil 'khor chen po mngon sum du zhal gzigs/ rgyud byin gyis rlabs pasathun mong gi dngos grub rnams la dbang 'byor/ mchog bdag la stsal du gsowazhus pas u rgyan gyi gnas su song zhig /de'i gnas kyi bye brag dhu ma spyi ra zhesabya ba na bud med snga yil mthing ga'i mdog can dpral pa na rin po che margad kyi dbyibs lta bu'i ri mo yod pa zhig yod kyi de las longs shig gsung ga de bzhin du byung yang byung ste/ mkha' 'gro ma des bdud rtsi bzhi'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur/ rgyud bshad cing glegs bam yang gtad/ de'i nang gi he rukabasgoms pas phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub thob/ phyis ma la war bzhugs te/sprang po brgyad skal ba dang ldan par gzigs te dbang bskur nas/ sgom byed du bcug slob dpon rang gis dur khrod du ro langs brgyad bsgrubs nas de re re la byin pas/ de rnams kyis kyang grub pa chen po re re thob pa byung/ gzhan yangathun mong gi dngos grub mang po bsgrubs nas skye bo gzhan la sbyin par mdzad de/rang gi dngos grub 'grub pa ni mang yang gzhan la sbyin nus pa ni grub pa ches che ba la ma gtogs mi 'byung bar grags so/ /yang slob dpon de la lan cigaslob ma bzhi yod pa las/ de rnams so sor bdud rtsi bzhi'i dkyil 'khor reresgom du bcug rdzogs pa'i rim pa yang bstan pas rdorje'i sku thob ste mi snangabar song ngo / /phyi'i slob dpon bdud rtsi gsang ba zhes bya ba rjes su bas ste/de la dbang rgyud man ngag rnams bstan nas/ lha'i gnas su 'gro ba'i don la—218—

bzhud do/ /slob dpon bdud rtsi gsang ba yang grub pa thob pa'i rnal 'byorabachen po zhig ste/ gter gyi bum pa brgyad tsam bskrubs nas skye bo phongs pa thams cad tshim par mdzad do/ /nam mkha'i lha las longs spyod blangs te chosagazhi chen po brgya tsam rtag tu 'degs pa byung / de rnams rgyal po gang gi dusasubyung gsal kha med kyang / 'og gi rig pa bsgres na rgyal po de lha pā la sman chad la byung bar gsal lo/ /de'i slob ma ni slob dpon bha go ste/ de yang ro'angasakyi dngos grub grub/ de la brten nas gter gyi bum pa bzang po mang po bsgrubs te/ phyogs bzhi'i skye bo thams cad tshim par mdzad pa grong khyer prayoka dang nye bar de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga'i lha khang chen po dang / lho phyog༅kaṇ+ḍa ṭar rdo rje bdud rtsi'i lha khang wo po yang bzhengs shing pa ni ta dri med bzang po la sogs pa mang po la rgyud kyang bshad do/ /slob dpon de rnams kyi drin las ma ga spre yang rgyud 'di lhag par dar bar gyur to zhes grags so/ /rgyal po ma su rak+ṣi ta dang / ba na pā la dang / rgyal po chen po ma hi pul rnams kyi dusasu byung ba'i gtam gyi skabs te sogacig pa'o// //de'i sras ni rgyal po mahā pā la ste/ 'dis rgyal srid lo bzhi bcuzhegacig mdzad/ o tan+ta pu ri'i gtsug lag khang du nyan thos kyi dge 'dun rnamasagatso bor mchod cing / dge slong lnga brgya dang chos ston pa lnga bcu la le tshob sbyor de'i yan lag tu u ru bā sa zhes bya ba'i gtsu/ga lag khang bzhengs/ der yanganyan thos sen+ta pa lnga brgya re la 'tsho ba sbyor/ bi kra ma shī lar sngar gyi srol de gabazung ste mchod 'os kyi mthil du mdzad/ dpal nā le rgyur yang chos gzhi 'ga' —219—

re btsugs/ som pu ri dang/ na len+t+ra dang/ tshab gsum gyi gtsug lag khang la sogs par yang chos gzhi mang po btsugs/ rgyal po ma hi pā la'i sku che'i smad tsam na/ pi ṭo ā tsa byas dus kyi 'khor 'o 'i rgyud spyan drangs te rgyal po dza'i dus su dar bar mdzad/ rtog ge ba rgyan mkhan po ste shes rab 'byung rganasaspas pa byung / yo ga ba pad+ma lcags kyu dang / dze tā ri chen po dang/ nag po dmatshig rdo rje dang / slob dpon tha ga na la sogs pa byung / pi ṭo twa tsa bya'i lo rgyusagazhan du gsal/ de'i slob ma dus 'khor zhabs kyang rgyal po 'di'i skabasasuka byung bar mngon no/ /rgyal po 'di 'das nas de'i mag pa shā mu pā las rgyalasrid lo bcu gnyis byas so/ /de la slob dpon dze tā ri ni/ sngon rgyal po ban pālas rgyal srid skyong ba'i skabs shig shar phyogs wa ra rmyer rgyal phran san ta na zer ba zhig byung / de nyid kyi btsun mo'i mchog gzugs dang blo gros phun sukhotshogs pa zhig yod/ de yang de la bla lhag tu rtsis su byed cing / khrag byed pa na'ang gser gyi rus sbal gyi steng du 'jog gzhan la mi ston par sbed pa las/ rgyal po des bram ze'i rigs kyi slob dpon snying po'i zhabs la gsang ba 'dus pa'i dbang bskur ba zhus pa'i yon du btsun mo de dang / rta dang/ gseradang / glang po che la sogs pa mang po phul/ dus gnan chig na/de la snying po'i zhabs kyi sras mtshan dang ldan pa zhig btsas/ lo bdun len pa na bram ze yi goslob pa'i grwar brdzangs pas/ nam zhig na bram ze'i khye'u gzhan rnams kyis khyode ni rigasang na yin no zhes brdegs so/ /rgyu mtshan dris pas/ khyod kyi pha ni nangapa'i sngags pa yin pas dmangs rigs kyi btsun pa gral 'gor 'jog—220—

mchod pa byed pa'i gnas skabs su rigs bzang ngan gyi dbye ba med par bsres pas so/ /de ltar mang du gtses pas de ngu zhing khyim du ldog pa na/ yab kyis drisapa na de ltar byung ba bshad do/ /'o na 'di dag zil gyis gnon dgos zhesagasungs te 'jam dbyangs kyi dbang bskur/ rjes su gnang pa stsal te sgrub tubacug pas lo gcig tu nye bar song ba na/ ting nge 'dzin gyi gsal snang mched cing grub pa'i rtags byung nas/ spyil bu'i phyi nang thams cad 'od dmar seragyis lam gyis khyab/ mas kha zas skyel du 'ongs pas de ltar mthong ste spyil bu la me shor ro snyam nas/ cho nges btab pas ting nge 'dzin sad de 'od kyang yalalo/ /der yab na re/ de ltar gsal snang de la zhag bdun du ba theg na 'phagasapa 'jam dpal dngos dang mnyam pa zhig 'ong na'ang / cung zad bar chad du song / 'on kyang rig pa'i gnas thams cad la thogs pa med pa'i blo gros rgyasapa zhig 'ong gsung / de ltar byung yang byung ste yi ge dang / bzo'i gnas thams/cad dang / sdeb sbyor mngon brjod la sogs pa ma bslabs par sheg gzhan yang rig pa'i gnas rnams la klog pa tsam dang / shin tu dka' ba rnams kyangatshar re zung bltas pas thams cad shes te mkhas pa'i dbang phyug chen por gyur/ ji srid 'tsho ba'i bar du rten dge bsnyen yin/ yab la ji tsam ma par ba'i gsang 'dus bde kye sogs gsan/ gzhan yang bla ma mang du bston/ khyad parachos thams cad 'phags pa 'jam dpal dngos la gsan par nus/ gangatshebram ze snying po'i zhabs sku 'das pa'i 'og tu rgyal po ma hi pā la'i dus rgyal po'i pa tra ma thob pas/ yul sna tsho gis su lha khang rnams la phyag mdzad pa dang/—221—

pa ni ta rnams dang rig pa 'gran pa'i phyir byon te/lan cig kha sa rla ṇa ra byon pa na/sgo drung na migayo ba'i sku shin tu khros pa zhig gzigs nas/srin yi gzugs can 'di lta bu snyam nas ma dad pa zhig byung /mnal lam du ra'idabang po'i thugs ka nas mi g.yo ba mang po spros nas gdug pa can tshar gcod pa rmi bas/sangs rgyas kya thabs la mkhas pa la ma dad pa byas sgo/snyam nasabashags pa mdzad pas/sgrol ma'i zhal gzigs/khyod kyi theg pa chen po'i bstan bcos mang du gyis shig sdig pa byang bar 'gyur ro gsung /de nas phyisargyal po mahā pā la'i dus su brik+ṣa pu ri zhes bya ba'i gnas gzhi bzang po zhig phul/bikra ma la shwe la'i pa ni ta'i pa tra yang phul nas/ye chas kyang mang du gsungs/snyan pa'i grags pa cher byung /bslab btus dang /spyod 'jug dang/nam mkha'i snying po'i mdo sde sogs bsdus 'grel re yang mdzad/mdo sngags kyi bstan bcos thor bu brgya rtsa tsam mdzad do//nag po dam rdzo rdo rje ni/slobadapon sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs kyi chos brgyud 'dzin pa zhig yin la/ra ra'i yul gyi dben gnas zhig tu dgyes pa rdo rje'i thang sku zhig bkram/rtse gnatudi yi ri rwa de/sgrub pa mdzad kyan bzhugs pa las/lo mang dag song ba 'a skabs garang nyid dkyil 'khor gyi gsal snang la thugs rtse gcig tu gnas pa zhig gi skabs/rig mas bltas pas bris sku'i mdun na yor yor ba ka'adun/slob dpon la sbran pas gsal snang sad de/yor yor de la phyag gis bsnabasapas mi ro zhig 'dug dngos grub kyi rdzas yin par mkhyen nas tsham tsho mi med par gsol bas/bde stong gi nyams la zhag bdun 'byams te sad pa tsam na/

dgyes pa'i rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor mngon sum du zhal gzigs/ nus pa dpagatumed pa la mnga' brnyes so/ /rgyal po mahā pā la dang / shā mu pā lo'i dus su byupaba'i skabs kyi gtam ste so gnyis pa'o// //de nas rgyal po mahā pā la'i sras che ba sri ni pā la zhes bya ba rgyal srid du bskos te lo gsum nas 'das/ phyag rjes kyang med pas bdun la mi bgrang/mahā pā la'i tshe smad tsam mam/ 'di dus tsam na bod du bstan pa phyi dar mgobartsams pa rags rtsis su dus mnyam par bya'o/ /'di skabs bram ze ye shesazhabs kyang byung / nag po spyod pa chung ba'i yang sku tshe'i smad kyi dus yin paragrags/ sras chung ba lo bcu bdun las mi 'gro bas/ bar der de'i zhung po tsan ka zhes bya bas rgyal srid byas/ kho rang gi ring la slob dpon shān+ti pa sogasaspyan drangs te/ mkhas pa sgo drug gi tha snyad byung / rgyal srid kyang lo nyi shu rtsadagubyas/ tu dra sko'o rgyal po dang 'khrugs pas kyang g.yul rgyal/ lan cig bhaXgalapa rnams ngo log ma ga dhar dmag byung ba la/ bi kra ma la shī la'i gtor ma'i slob dpon gyis mi g.yo ba'i gtor chen byas nas gaṅgā la pho bas bhaX ga la'i tu ru lko gru btang nas byung bas gru mang po rdib/ g.yul ngo yang rgyal po rgyal te mnga' 'og tu chud nas rgyal khams bde bar byung / phyis khong rang gi tsha bo rgyal po mahāpā la'i bu chung shos ste ya pā la rgyal srid du bskos nas/ bhaX ga la'i shar phyogasargya mtsho dang gaṅgā 'dres mtshams kyi gling phran 'dra ba bhā ṭi zhes bya ba'i yul du bsdad nas lo lnga na 'das so/ /de skabs su byung ba'i mkhas pa sgo drug lagashar sgo srung ba po slob dpon rat+na a ka ra shān+ti pa'i lo rgyus ni gzhan du shes—223—

par bya'o/ /lho sgo srung ba shes rab 'byung gnas blo gros ni/ rig pa'i dzinasathams cad la mkhas shing 'jam dpal gyi zhal mngon sum du gzigs pa/ mustegs dang rtsod pa'i tshe/ 'jam dpal gyi bris sku zhig la mchod pa dang gsolagadab mdzad pa tsam gyis mu stegs kyi rtsod pa ji ltar zer du 'ong ba dang / de'i lan 'debs tshul cig car thugs la shar nas slar brtsad pa'i tshe nges par rgyal ba zhig yod par grags so/ /shes rab 'byung gnas zhes pa tsam khyimatshan la 'khrul nas sher 'byung blo gros dang / sher 'byung sbas pa gcig par 'o dod pa'i 'khrul pa yang mang du snang / 'di ni rten dge slong yin la/ sher 'byung sbasapa ni dge bsnyen yin no zhes mkhas pa rnams la grags so/ /nub sgo srung ba slob dpon ngag gi dbang phyug grags pa ni/ yul wā rā ṇa srir sku 'khrungs/rigs ni rgyal rigs yin/ dge 'dun phal cher pa'i sde pa las rab tu byung ba/mkhan pos btags pa'i mtshan ni shī la kirti zhes bya'o/ /sgra tshad dang / gzhudalugs kyang mang rab mkhyen pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta zhig tu song ba'i dus/ koṅka na rgyal ba bzang po'i rjes 'brang ha sa badz+ra zhes bya ba zhig la 'khor lo sdom pa zhus te/ tshag dha'i phyogs gcig tu sgrub pa myo5dzad pas mnal lam du zhal gzigs/ ngagagi dbang phyug gi dngos grub bsgrubs na 'gru/ba bam mi 'grub btags pas kyang 'grub par mkhyen/ ga d+ma'i 'gram du bsgrubs pas/ shing ka ra wi re'i me togadamar po sgra dang 'od 'byin pa de gaṅgā la 'phangs/ dpag chad mang por yud kyis khyer nas slar yang gyen du ldo min pas de nyid chu dang bcas par gsol bas ngag gi dbang phyug chen po 'grub ste/ nyi rma re rer tshigs su bcad pa stong phrag—224—

re trere tshad kyi gzhung gi tshig don ma lus par mkhyen par nus pa'i blo gros byung bas ngag gi dbang phyug grags pa zhes mtshan gsol lo/ /mdo sngags rig pa'i gnas mtha' dag la mkhas pa'i phul du gyur pa/ 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gangala'ang thogs pa med pa/ khyad par 'phags ma sgrol ma rtag par zhal bzhigs shing the tshom gcod pa byung / der yul sna tshogs su byon te mu stegs kyi rgol ba mang ngo/ tshar gcod pa'i blo gros can du gyur nas snyan grags tshe bar yod pa la/rgyal pos spyan drangs te nā len+t+ra dang / bi kra ma la shwe la'i nub sgo bar bskosashing / tshogs kyi bdag po las nor blangs te dus rtag tu lha khang dang dge'adun mang po la mchod par mdzad/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i chos gzhi brgyad/ gsang ba 'dus pa 'chad pa'i chos gzhi bzhi/ bde dgyes gdan bzhi mā yā 'chad pa'i chos gzhi re re/ dbu tshad kyi chos gzhi thor bu dang bcas pa chos grwa mang du btsugs/ bcud len mang po sgrub par mdzad de gzhan la byin pas/ lo brgya lnga bcu sogs su thub cing rgan po yang gzhon nur bsgyur b.lasogs pas rab tu byung ba dang / khyim pa chos ldan lnga brgya tsam la phan rig tshogs dang / phar phyin dang / mdo sde rgyan dang / gsang 'dus(dgyes rdoragashin rje gshed/ la skor gshegs pa la sogs pa'i mdo sde 'ga' zhig dngabacas pa dus rtag tu gsung / gzhan yang chos mang du bshad cing / mu stegs kyi rgol ba bzlog pa la blo shin tu rno bas nub phyogs nas 'ongs ba'i rgol ba sum brgya tsam sun phyung / bum chu la da rigs pa btad na de ma thag khol ba dang/ skugazugs la ye shes phab na 'phar g.yo 'byung ba dang / lan cig rgyal po'i don —225—

du dkyil 'khor bzhengs pa zhig la/dkyil 'khor gyi thad rang du shwa bos/byungab/da rigs pas srung 'kho 3 mdzad pa'i mtshams nas log/de lta bu la sogs pa'i ngo mtshar can gyi ltas thor bu ba shin tu mang ba zhig mnga'/lan cig dgoslong a wa ju tī pa zhes bya ba zhig dang chos kyi bgro gleng mdzad pas/des dbyigaganyen gyi lung drangs/de la kyal ka'i tshul gyis dbyig gnyen gyi gzhung la zuraza ba'i tshig brnyas mdzad pas/de nub kho na la ljags skrangs shing chos gsungam thub/tshul des zla ba 'ga' snyung nas sgrol ma la zhus pas/slob dpon dbyig gnyen la tshig gis brnyas pa byas pa'i nyes pa yin pas slob dpon de nyid la bstod pa gyis gsungs ba bzhin bstod pa brtsams ma thag tu snyung ba dwangs/de ltar bi kra ma la shī lar lo mang po'i bar du 'gro don mdzad/sku tsho smad tsam na bal po'i yul du phebs/gtso bor sgrub ba la gzhol zhing/sngagasardekyi theg pa cung zad gsungs/gzhan chos cher mi ston/btsun mo mang po'angamanga' bas skye bo phal cher gyis bslab pa ma thub pa yin te 'ong bas bsam pa las med/lan cig rgyal pos shun+ta pu rir 'khor lo sdom pa'i lha khang gcikabazhengs/de'i rab gnas kyi mthar tshogs kyi 'khor lo chen po zhig bya b.ra'adod nas lha khang gi phyi rol du sngags pa mang po dag bsags/tshogs dpon la slob dpon spyan 'dren pa'i pho nya btang /slob dpon gyi spyil bu'i 'gag na bud med sgeg mo zhig dang /bu mo mdog nag mo khro gtum che ba zhig 'dugaslob dpon gang na bzhugs byas pas/nang na yod zer/des nang du phyin/rgyal po'i tshogs kyi snyen ra lo'i dpon ༷ 'byon par zhu byas pas/khyod ṣ+ka

mgyogs par song /nga yang da lta 'ong gsung /des mgyogs par phyin tsan/shan+ta pu ri dang nye ba'i lam gyi gzhi mdo zhig na slob dpon btsun mo gnyis dang bcas pa sngar byon te/khyod ma byung bas yun ring du bsgugs pa yin gsung/rab gnas dngos kyi tshogs kyi 'khor lo rgyas pa de gyes zin pa'i rjes su lha khang gi nang du slob dpon yab yum gsum bzhugs/tshogs rdzas mi drugaculhag cig gi skal pa blangs te song bas/rgyal pos bsam pa/nang na migasum las med/tshogs rdzas 'di tsam dgos pa ci yin snyam nas sgo seng nas bltas pas/'khor lo bde mchog lha drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor mthon sum du bzhugs nas tshogs rdzas la longs spyod pa mthong ste/de nyid du slob dpon 'ja' lus su gyur nas bzhugs pa yin la/da ltar yang gnas de na bzhugs so zhes grags/bod kyi lo rgyus tsho na/lho sgo srung ba ngag dbang grags pa dang/nub sgo srung ba shes rab 'byung gnas zer ba gda' na'ang /'dir rgya gar gyi yig cha gsum gung mthun pa ltar bkod do//byang sgo srung ba ni/nā ro pa yin la/de'i lo rgyus gzhan du shes/slob dpon de la ni rtsod dus kyi thams cad mkhyen pa shān+ti pas kyang chos gsan te/de yang slob dpon shān+ti pa dpon slob mchod pa zhig mdzad pa'i skabs/slob ma zhig gis gtor ma bskyal bar phyin pas/gtor stegs kyi steng na rnal 'byor ba shin tu 'jigs pa zhig mthong nasagator ma ci dgar bskyur/shin tu skrag ste nang du 'ongs/slob dpon la zhusapas/nā ro pa yin par mkhyen nas spyan drangs/dus der zhabs la gtugs te/dbang bskur ba dang /gdams pa dang /rjes su gdams pa shin tu mang bar

gsan/ phyis kyang yang yang gus pas bshud/ dus phyis shān+ti pa grub pa brnyesatsam gyi dus shig na/ nā ro pas thod pa cig bsnams te/ skye bo kun la slong ba ltar mdzad pa la chom po zhig gis thod pa'i nang du gri chung gcig bskyur/ nā ropas lta stangs mdzad pas mar khu ltar ltems kyis zhu nas gsol te song/ bzhimado na glang po che shi ba'i ro zhig 'dug pa la'ang grong 'jug mdzad nas dur khrod du bskyal/ de'i logs nas mar shān+ti pa phebs pa la/ nā ro pa'i gsungagis kho bo rnal 'byor pa yin pas rtags de ltar lags/ da mkhas pa chen po yang rtags ston par mi spro'am gsungs pa la/ slob dpon shān+ti pa na re/ bdagalta bus gzhan ci zhig 'tshal te/ 'on kyang khyed lta bus gnang na bya'o gsung ste/mdun na tshur chu'i bum pa thogs pa 'ga' byung ba la chu la sngags btab pa tsam gyis gser zhun mar song / der dge 'dun rnams dang bram ze rnams la so sor bgos te byin no/ / nā ro pas kyang byang sgo srung ba lo 'ga' zhig mdzad nas/spyod pa la gshegs pa yin/ der rjes de'i tshab gnas brtan byang bzang gisamadzad/ de ni o ṭi bi shar rje rigs las skye ba brnyes pa byang chub sems dpe'ispyod pa phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan zhing / rigs sad pa zhig yin la/ rigatshogs dang / spyod phyogs dang / khyad par du byang chub sems dpa'i sal mkhasapa/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi zhal gzigs shing dngos su chos gtan pa zhig go /dbus kyi ka wo dang po bram ze rin wo rdo rje ni/ sngon kha tsho yul du bram ze zhig gis lha dbang phyug chen po bsgrubs pas lung bstan thob ste/khyod kyi rigs brgyud la mkhas pa grags ldan sha stag 'byung zhes lung bstan/—228—

de ltar byung ba la mi rabs nyi shu rtsa bzhi yan chad du mu stegs pa yin/ rtsa lnga par bram ze ha ri bha dra zhes bya ba sangs rgyas pa dang bstan pa dang nga du btsugs nas brtsad pas rtsod pa pham ste nang pa la zhugs/ chos kyang mkhas par mkhyen pa'i paṇ+ḍi tar gyur/ de'i sras ni bram ze rin snyo rdo rje yin/ rten ni dge bsnyen yin la/ dgung lo sum cu'i bar du kha che nyid du legs/ par sbyangs te mdo sngags rig gnas mtha' dag thugs su chud/ de nas ma sa/ nyer byon nas gsan pa'i 'phro cung zad kyang mdzad sto / rdo rje gad myo/ du sgrub nga rma dzad pas rdzoralosdom pa dang / rdo rje phag mo la sogs pa'i lha mang po zhal gzigs/ rgya5posabi kra ma shī la'i pa tra phul/ der lku5nga sngags kyi theg pa rnam grangs du rma dang /tshad ma sde bdun dang / byams pa'i chos lnga sogs gtso bor gsungs/ lorangapo zhig 'gro ba'i don mdzad/ slar yang kha cher rja kras nas/ mu stegs ma nga ngo / zhig rtsod pas sun phyungs nas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la bkod/ rig chogasadang / mdo sde rgyan dang / gsang ba 'dus pa la sogs pa 'chad pa'i grwa yanga'aga' re btsugs/ sku che'i smad la nub phyogs u rgyan du gshe/gas/ kha che'i yul na bram ze mu stegs kyi grub mtha' la mkhas shing dbang phyug gi 'a/la mthong ba zhig yod/ de la khong re'i lhas u rgyan du song zhig don chen po 'grub cesalung bstan/ u rgyan du phyin nas bram ze rin chen rdo rje dang mjal/ bstan pa dpang du btsugs nas brtsad pas zin chen rdo rje rgyal/ de sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la zhugs te ming gu rgya dra/ dz+nyā zhes par btas/sa/ snga gas kyi theg pa la bslab pas phyis dngos grub kyang thob/ bod du byon pa'i ā tsar+ya dmar por grags pa —229—

de yin/ bram ze rin chen rdo rje de u rgyan gyi gnas de nyid du 'ja' lusasugashegs zhes kha che ba rnams zer ro/ /rin chen rdo rje'i sras ma hā dzan/ de'i sras sadz+dza na yin te/ bod kyi chos brgyud rnams la'ang shin tu bka' drin tshe rdo /dbus kyi ka chen gnyis pa dz+nyā na shrī mi tra ni mtha' gnyis su sel ba'i bstan bcos mdzad mkhan de yin la/ dpal ldan i ti sha'i yang sku drin che ba'i blaslazhig yin/ de yang yul go ṭar 'khrungs/ dang por nyan thos sen+ta pa'i paṇ+ḍita/de'i lugs kyi sde snod gsum la shin tu mkhas pa zhig yin pa la/ phyis thegachen la dad pa thob ste klu sgrub dang / tho gos med kyi gzhung thams cad lamakhasapar sbyangs/ gsang sngags kyi rgyud sde yang mang po mkhyen/ khyad par mdo rgyud kyi gsan rgya shin tu che/ rtag tu byang chub gyi sems la goms pa/ bcom ldan 'das shākya'i rgyal po dang / byams pa dang / spyan ras gzigs gsum/yang yangazhal gzigs/ mngon shes thogs pa med pa mnga'/ lan cig bi kra smangabazhugs pa'i tshe/ slob ma dge tshul zhig la khyod da lta myur bar song/ gnangasakyi lpin par nyi ma gung la ga ya'i grong khyer du sleb pa gyis/ rdo rje gdan gyi dgo'adun rnams dang / dkon gnyer rnams de na bram ze zhig gis dus ston la thosa'ong bar 'dug byang chub chen po bzhugs pa'i gan+dho la la me'i gnod pa 'ongabar 'dug pas de rnams khrid la me snol zhig gsung / des phyin pas lungabastan pa bzhin ga yar rdo rje gdan pa rnams dang 'phrad/ kho bo'i slob de tho/ gyas lung bstan pa yin yar 'dengs byas pas phyed tsam yid ma tshes par bsdad/ lhag ma phyed tsam dang bcas rdo rje gdan du 'ongs pas rdo rje gdan gyi —230—

gan+dho la la me shor te/ phyi nang kun tu 'bar gyin 'dug der lha lagasolaba'adebs kyin me bsad pas lha khang zhig pa cher ma byung / ri mo zubs pa dngashing tshig pa rnams slob dpon gyis gsos/ gzhan yang chos gzhi nyams pa gsos pa dang gsar du btsugs pa'ang ma ga dh+wa dang / bhaX ga la gnyis kan mngabar yod/ mkhas pa sgo drug 'di rgyal bo bhe ya pā la'i rgyal srid skyong ba'i stod kyi dus na'ang yod do/ /rgyal po tsa na ka 'das bstan pa la bya ba cher byas kyangapā la'i rigs ma yin pas bdun la ni mi bgrang ngo / /'ji/ dus nas bzungakhacher tshad ma shin tu dar/ rtog ge pa nyi ma sbas pa yang byung ngo / /rgyal po tsan ka'i skabs kyi gtam ste sogasum pa'o// //de nas rgyal po bhe ya pā las rgyal srid lo sum cu so gnyis tsam byas na'ang / sngar gyi rgyun ma nyams par skyong ba'i rnam pa tsam las bstan pa la byabadamigs su thon pa cher ma byung / bi kra ma shrī lar ni pa khri ta bdun cu tsa༅gyi pa tra las ma tshugs te/ de'i phyir 'di yang pā la bdun la mi bgrang ngo / /rgyal po 'di'i dus la/ mkhas pa sgo drug 'das pa'i 'og tsam du jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti shar grags pa dī paX ka ra shrī dz+nyā na mkhan por spyan drangs/ 'dis o tan+ta pu riyang bskyangs/ de nas mi ring ba na mnga' bdag mai tri pa'i 'phrin las kyang darab yin/ mi tri pa dpal gyi ri nas 'khor ba'i dus/ shwarnyi pa so ges mkhas pa sgodrug gi dus yol nas lo yang 'ga' re song ba yin pas/ sngon gyi do ha 'chad pa rnams kyi lo rgyus chal chol la snying po med do/ /gzhan yang do ha'i lo rgyusa'akhyams po rnams na/ mi tri pa nag po spyod pa'i skye ba yin pa'i lugs su byag—231—

'bar ba'i gtso bo spyod 'chang nag po zhes lo rgyus bsres pa nyog nyog po dag yod pa la phyogs zhen gyis yid brtan du byas nas/ spyod 'chang nag po bya ba nag po spyod pa min pa zhig byung bar 'dod pa yang snying pos dben pa ste/ slob dpon dpag med rdo rje'i gzhung chung 'ga' re yod pa la ltos shig 'khrul pa sel bar 'gyur ro/ /rgyal po bhe ya pā la de'i sras ne ya pā la yin te/ jo bo rje bod du byon dus 'ji/ rgyal srid la 'khod 'phral yin par rnam thar khungs ma rnams nas bshad/ bal yul nas khong la brdzangs pa'i 'phrin yig gcig kyangasnang / rgyal srid lo sum/ cu so lnga byas/tsā/ 'di rgyal srid la 'khod nas lo dgunas mnga' bdag mai tri pa yang 'das/ rgyal ngo 'bi/sa rdo rje gdan pa chen poragrags pa la mchod de/ de dag bsnyen gyi dus kyi mtshan pu khyo shrī/ rab tu byungaba'i mtshan pu khyo ā ka ra gu lta'o/ /gzhan yang a mo gha badz+ra dang / shar phyog༅rdesu'abar+ya bha dra mngon shes can dang / de wa ā rka/ ra tsan+d+ra dang / pra dz+nyā ra khri ta dang/gzhan yang nā ro pa'i dngos kyi slob ma phal cher bzhugs/ nā ro pa'i de ngosaslob dpal mchog rkaX bhi pa dang / kan+ta pa'i lo rgyus gzhan du gsal/ ka so ri pa ni rdo rje rnal 'byo mo ṭā5 'o/ na bsgrubs pas sprin/ gyi gseb nas zhal ras bstan te/ ci 'dad zi /sung / nyid kyi go re phang thob par mdzong/ zhus pas snying gar thim/de ma thag tu la tshe dngas grub mang po thob rnga ra gyur te/ dur khrod rnams su stag dang/lce spyang la sogs pas gar byed cing mchod pa 'bul bskal ba dang mi ldan pa rnams kyis rgyang ma nas mthong zhing drung du gtugs pa na yal 'gro ba zhig yod skad/ ri ri pa ni sbyangs stobs kyi shernga/rab shin tu chung ba sa ( na ga byung/ dpal nā —232 —

ro pas 'khor lo bde mchog la brten pa'i bskyed rdzogs kyi gdams pa nyung ngu zhig bstan pas/ de kho na bsgoms pas grub pa thob/ chos gang la yang thogasardepa med pa'i blo gros skyes/ nags kyi srog chags gdug pa can bse ru lasogs pa bkug nas chibs shing gshegs/ de'i tshe gar log gi dmag zhigabyung ba la/ wā rā ṇa sri'i nub phyogs kyi lam zhig tu rdzas sngags kyi rten 'brelacung zad mdzad/ gar log rnams yong dus rdo shing sa 'bar 'bur sogs yod tshad mi ro kho nar mthong nas phyir ldog go /de gnyis kar yang 'ja' lus su gshegs so/ /pra dz+nyā rak+ṣi ta ni dgoslong paṇ+ḍi ta chen po zhig nā ro pa lo bcu gnyis bsten te pha rgyud dang / mo rgyud kyi chos mang du gsan/ khyad par ma rgyud la mkhas/ yang sgos 'khor lo sdom pa latshes mkhas te/ 'grel pa'i lugs bzhi dang / man ngag gi lugs yin turangab thugs su chud/ o tan+ta pu ri dang nye ba'i gnas chung ngu zhig tu lo lnga bskrubasapas 'bor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor dang / 'jam dpal dang / dus kyi zhe boralo la sogs pa yi dam gyi lha dpag tu med pa zhal gzigs/ 'khor lo sdowapa'i rigs kyi dbang bskur rang yang bdun cu tsam mnga' bar grags/ nus pa ni shin tu che ste/ bi kra ma lar lan cig tu nas kho/ dmag byung ba la 'khor lo sdom pa'i gtor ma chen po zhig mdzad pas/ dmag gi dbus su thog chen po bstud mar lan bzhi lhungs/ dmag dpon dang / dpa' bo mang po shi nas phyir ldogamu stegs kyi rgol ba brgyad tsam rtsod par 'ongs pa la/ rtsod pa'i gral du stastangs mdzad pas drug ngag lkugs/ gnyis mig long / phyis 'grol bar yang—233—

mdzad/ 'khor lo sdom pa gtso bor gyur pa'i 'gro don cher mdzad nag nā len+d+ra dang nye ba'i nags khrod cig tu sku 'das/ zhag bdun du sku gdung g.yo ba med par shog gsung pa ltar slob ma rnams kyis bzhag pas/ zhag bdun nas bdungarang yang yal nas song / ri ri pa ni/ rig ngan gdol pa'i rigs su gyur pa zhig yin pa las/ nā ro pa chen po mthong res kyis dga' ba dang / dad pa'i shugs cher skyes nas lus rengs shing brgyal 'gro ba zhig byung / der rnal 'byor pa byas te/ nam shig na yo byad mang po bsags/ nā ro pa la 'khore lo sdom pa'i dbang bskur ba zhus te rtse gcig tu bsgoms pas/ bskyed rim bsgoms pa las kyang rlung sems dbu mar 'gags shing gtum mo'i nyams myong skyes te/ sngon gyi las 'phros sad pa yin gsung / mi ring bar dngos grub mchog thob/ nā ro pa'i 'khor du gshegs pa'i tshe yang chos nyan pa dang / dgos don yod pa'i tshe lusasnang bar byed/ phal cher mi snang ba'i tshul gyis 'gro ba zhig go /slob de pon dpe med mtsho yang dus 'dir byung ste/ rig gnas thams cad dang dus kyi 'khor lo la mkhas pa'i dge slong paṇ+ḍi ta zhig 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs sgrub cing / kha sa rla 'ir lo bcu gnyis g.yeng ba spangs te brtson 'grusabartsams pas kyang ltas cang ma byung ste/ lan cig mnal du song bas ranalalam du/ khyod bi kra ma pu rir song zhig ces lung bstan byung / slob ma legasardepa'i bu dang lhan cig der song ba las/ grong khyer de'i dus ston gyi zlos garachen po mthong / de'i rkyen gyis snang ba thams cad sgyu ma lta bur gzigs pa'i ting nge 'dzin skyes/ nam phyed na lhag pa'i lha a wa dhu lte pa'i cha byad du khyon nag—234—

bu de kho na nyid ni 'di yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa tsam gyis phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub thob/ de nas slob ma rnams kyi don du bstan bcos kyang 'ga' remadzad cing / slom ma thams cad kyang rnal 'byor yan lag drug pa'i tingange'adzin nam/ rjes dran gyi yon tan skyes pa sha stag yin skad do/ /de'i tshe rtogagol mkhas pa ya mā ri yang byung / de ni sgra tshad gtso bor gyur pa'i rig gnas kun la mkhas kyang bu smad gsum gyi 'tsho ba tsam yang mi byed pa'i shin tu bkren pa zhig yod pa la/ shar phyogs nas rnal 'byor ba zhig rdo rje gdan du 'byon pa'i lam du khong la gnas tshang g.yar/ der phongs ba'i gtam byas pas/ khyed parnyi ta rnal 'byor pa la brnyas te chos mi zhu ste 'ong / 'byor pa thob pa'i thabasang la yod de gsung / gnang bar zhus pas/ pi tsu ri'i shing 'bras dang / tsan+dan gyi lde gu sogs sta gon gyis shig rdo rje'i gdan 'khor nas bya'o gsung/ tshuralam nor rgyun ma'i byin rlabs shig mdzad/ des kyang bsgrubs pas lo de nyid nas rgyal pos mnga' thang cher gtod/ bi kra ma shī lar pa tra cher thob/ dus 'di tsam na kha che'i yul na yang bram ze bde byed dga' ba zhes bya ba byung stogazhung lugs spyi dang / tshad ma la'ang shin tu mkhas pas/ chos kyi grags pa 'gokapa'i tshad ma gsar pa zhig bya'o snyam pa la/ rmi lam du 'jam dpal gyis chos kyi grags pa ni 'phags pa yin pa'i phyir dgag mi nus la/ skyon du mthong ba dedag kyang khyod nyid kyi blo skyon no zhes gsungs pas/ slar bshags pa mdzad de sde bdun la 'grel pa brtsams/ longs spyod sku bsod shin tu che bar byung zhesagrags so/ /'grel pa chos mchog gi tshig ris la bde byed dga' ba byung zin —235—
