paṇ+ḍi ta dge slong zhig yin pa las/ der chang yang gsol ba dang / bud med dang lhan cig spyod pas dge 'dun gyis gnas nas phyung / de nas gsa'i 'gram du gru pa la gru gtong dgos byas pas/ gla dgos zer ba la gla ster rgyu med de gaṅgā la sdig 'dzub bstan pas/ gaṅgā gyen du bzlog nas pha rol tu song / de nas o ḍi shar chang 'tshong ma gcig la chang nyo byas pas rin dgos zer/ nyi grib mtshams la ri mo byas te 'di las ma 'das gong du spyin byas nas/ nyi ma la mdzub mo bstan nas btod la mnan te chang gsol/ de nas gtong ma 'dod de dbyug tshod dang mel tsho thams cad 'chugs/ rnal 'byor pas nus pa bstan par shes te/ rgyal pos chang rin byin nas btang bar zhug pas/ zhag gsum gyi tho rangs su song yang zer/ de nas tri lid+ma'i rgyal po'i mchod gnas byas/ mu stegs kyi mchod pa kun gyi phud zos/ phyag mi 'tshal bas/ rgyal po sogs kyis rgol ba la/ slob dpon gyis phyag byas pas mu stegs kyi lha thams cad gas/ lha'i gtso bo ni bi shwa nā tha bya ba 'jig sdes bzhengs pa ling ga gdong bzhis mtshan pa gcig yod pa de bzhi tshal du gas yod gsung / de nas ḍā ki nī pa ṭar mu stegs pa'i tshogs khang du byon/ der mi phal pa su byung ba la tri shu la rang zug ste shi ba'i sha la phra men ma rnams tshogs byed pa yin pa la/ slob dpon gyis thal mo brdabs pas tri shu la chag tsaṇ+ḍi ka'i rdo sku rang byung gul gul byed pa la/mgo lcag bsnun pas mgo brang na mar sleb/ rna ba ya gar lus pas krong nge ba da lta'ang 'dug gsung / phyin chad sems can la gnod pa mi byed par bka' bsgos/ ḍā ki nī pa ṭa zhes pa 'di bod rnams lho phyogs yin zer na'ang / bod —288—

ni shar phyogs na yod par gda'o/ /yang lha mo 'di 'dul ba po go rak+ṣa yin zer ba'ang yod/ de nas so ra:ra byon nas so ba nā tha zhes bya ba/ lha dbang phyug chen po'i rdo sku rang byung gcig yod/ cho 'phrul shin tu che/ de la sdigs 'dzub bstan kyang 'gas su ma 'dod nas/ ci yin brtags pas/ steng na spyan ras gzigs kyi sku zhig snang skad/ kha cig 'od zer can ma'i sku yin nam yang zer de bsal bas dngos su gzugs bstan nas bka' bzhin byed par zhus pa la/slob dpon gyis khyod kyi mchod gnas su dge 'dun brgya rtsa zhig mchod cigasrog bcad pa'i mchod pa ma len/ phud kyis nga'i sku la mchod pa gyis gsung /kho na re/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa myur du 'jig la/ nga la mchod pa rtag tu 'ong mod/ 'on kyang bstan pa nam gnas kyi bar dge 'dun mchod zer/ slob dpon rang rdo sku gser 'gyur rtsi phyag tu bsnam pa cig tu song zer/ re shig dngos su mi snang bar thal/ nyin re bzhin rdo sku'i phyag gi gser 'gyur rtsi de blangs te/lcags zangs mang po la reg pa tsam gyis gser du 'gro bas/ de la brten te dge 'dun gyi 'tsho ba sbyor/ phyi zhig na dzo na gha ṭa'i rgyal po zhig gis/ gser srang khri phrag gnyis zhus nas/ da dung zhu snyam pa la rdo sku'i spar ba bsdams/yang bram ze dbul po zhig gis sa the btsugs nas gsol ba btab pas/gser 'gyur rtsi gnang / zhag bdun nas khyer shog gsung / des zhag gsum gyi bar du yo byad gser du ci 'gyur byas pas/ rgyal po'i mi gnyis byung nas len par brtsams pa la/ bram zes rdo sku'i phyag tu phul bas/ yang spar ba bsdams/ rgyal po'i mi gcig gis phyag la dbyug pa bsnun pas rang lag pa —289—

chad nas sha/ gcig gis lag pa chog byas pas kha lkugs/ rgyal po yang sems spyo byung nas 'das pas/ shin tu gnyan par grags/ da lta de na dge 'dun ni med/ nags tshal dgrod dka' ba cig gi dkyil na rdo sku smug nag zhal gdangs pa zil che ba cig yod gsung / yang bar skabs rgyal po rā ma pā la'i dus su rnal 'byor pa si ro pa zhes par mtshan btags nas kyang / yul dbus su 'gro ba'i don ci rigs mdzad/ zhabs bkrus pa'i khu ba rgyal po rā ma pā la'i glang po che bha nā da la blud nas g.yul 'thab pas kla kle'i rgyal po brgyad tsam thul/ dus phyis shar phyogs go ra'i yul du stag gzig gi rgyal po zhig gnyid sad pa'i rngas mgo na/ rnal 'byor pa zhig 'dug chu bo la bskur bas yang yang ldog me la bsregs pas kyang ma tshig mtsho ni cha sna tshogs bsnun kyang ma bsnad cing mtshon cha rnams chag dug khal drug gsol du bcug nyin zhag phrugs cig mi mang pos bsrungs pas/ slob dpon stobs dang mdangs rgyas par mthong nas/ grub pa thob par shes te/ su yin zhus pas/ bi rū pa yin zhes gsung /der yang skal ldan 'ga' la gdams ngag gnang ba dang / gus par bsten pa la bden tshig tsam brjod pas/ thun mong gi dngos grub thob pa mang du byung / bha ga lar zla ba bzhi tsam dngos su kun gyis mjal du rung bar bzhugs/ phyis gar gshegs cha med/ rgya nag tu dngos su byon pa'ang 'di skabs ka yin/ bi rū pa mi yul du lan gsum 'byon par grags pa/ gsum char sngar song ngo / /slob dpon 'di la shrī dharma pā la zer yang / gnas brtan dharma pā la zhes bya ba nā lan+t+ra'i mkhan po mdzad pa de dang mi gcig go /de'i slob ma ni o ḍi ya ṇa ra byung —290—

ba'i nag po bi rū pa yin te/ de ni bram ze'i rigs btsas tsam na bram ze ltas mkhan rnams kyis sdig pa bzhi byed par lung bstan skad/ ming ni nag po zhes bya'o/ /der lo bdun tsam na/ sdig pa bzhi po mi 'byung bar bya ba'i phyir/ yul gzhan du tshe khyams su btang ba las/ dus yun ring mo 'das te ma bram ze mo la k+ṣi zhes pa de yang khyim thab dang / gyos rgyug rnams shi bas/ yul g.yin du 'khyams shing song ba rigs nyams te/ shar phyogs o ḍi bi sha'i yul du chang 'tshong zhing yod pa las/ phyi zhig na bu yang o ḍi bi shar sleb/ ma'i khyim du phyin pa na/ phan tshun ma dang bu ngo ma shes pa'i skyon gyis ma dang 'dus/ rdzi'u nas chu 'dod pas skom 'thungs pa myos byed du 'dug khros te rdzi'u shod du 'phangs pas ba zhig la phog ste sha/ de gsang bar bsams te/ mtshan mo yang thog nas ce spyang gi bzar 'phangs pas/ srang ka na bram ze zhig rgyu ba'i mgo la phog bram ze shi /der the tshom zos nas gtam dris pas chang 'tshong ma de rang gi ma yin par shes/ de yang sngon lung bstan pa'i sdig pa bzhi na/ bram ze gsod pa/ ba glang gsod pa/ ma dang 'dus pa/ chang 'thung ba ste rig phyed nas bshad pa'i bram ze nyams byed kyi sdig par grags pa bcu drug gi nang nas bzhi po de yin la/ de rnams nub gcig la byung bas sdig pa de sbyang ba'i don du/ phyi nang gi gnas thams cad du song nas dris kyang gzhan yid ches pa ma byung / slob dpon dza lan+ta ra pa dang mjal/ rdo rje phag mo'i gdams ngag cig gnang ste/ des sdig pa 'byang gsung / de nas koṅku na'i yul du chu nang du mgrin pa man chad nub par byas nas/ zla ba drug tu bsgrubs pas/ rtags ci yang ma byung ste/ 'phreng ba —291—

bcad de chu la dor/ slob dpon la drir song bas/ da dung sgrubs shigadangos grub myur du 'ong gsung / der snga ma bzhin du bsgrubs pas/ theg bdun song ba'i tho rangs/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma mi'i bu mo'i rnam par byung ste/ aṣ+ṭa si kha ṭa/ na ba si dza la na/ kaX ā yi bu tra/ tuX hi koṅku na mā ra ṇa/ de yang rgya mtsho'i lag brgyad brgya dang / chu bo dgu brgya 'das te bu ga nas 'ongs/ ko du'i yul du khyod 'chi bar byed dam zhes pa yin pa la/ tshig dang po gnyis 'dra ba la/ a yi mā ta badz+ra yo gi nā/ te ri sa ra ṇa/ yum rnal 'byor ma khyod la skyabs su mchir 'ongs zhes pa'o/ /de nyid du phyag spyi bor bzhag pas/ ting nge 'dzin mchog tu gyur pa thob cing / khyod kyi skye ba mang por las kyi 'brel ba yod pa ni bi rū pa yin pas/ de ma ra ha ṭa na yod kyi der song gsung / der yang bi rū pas rdo rje thod bcings phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub thob nas/ dur khrod rnams su brtul zhugs kyi spyod pas rgyu zhing gshegs so/ /rdo rje thod byas kyang zhwa chung sngon po gcig yod do/ /da lta yang sku lus ma spangs par o rgyan gyi gnas na bzhugs par grags/ bi rū pa che chung 'di gnyis gshin rje gshed dang / phag mo'i lam la brten nas grub pa brnyes par byed gsung / bi rū pa chung ba la bya dā li pas zhus te/ de ni sngon bya gsod pa'i rigs yin pa la/ lan cig ne tso zhig shing tog khar thogs nas nam mkha' la 'phur ba mthong ste/ der khyod ci zhig byed dris pa na/ phyogs 'di na grub thob bi rū pa bzhugs pas/ de la mchod pa byed du 'gro zhes zer bas des bsam pa/ dud 'gro 'di lta bu yang dge ba'i sems dang ldan na/ kho bo cag mir gyur pa dge ba byed pa lta smos kyang ci dgos —292—

snyam ste/ shing tog 'ga' zung de la bskur te/ khyod kyis 'di yang grub thob de la phul zhig ces byas so/ /ne tsos kyang rngon pa'i shing tog phul ba na/ bi rū pas de ma blangs te/ kwa ye ne tso/ phyin chad kyang sdig pa can de lta bu'i yo byad khur ma 'ong zhes gsung ngo / /de nas ne tso des shing tog slar kho rang la gtad/de la khyod kyis ci'i phyir ma phul zhes dris pas/ grub thob de 'di ltar gsung zhes snga ma ltar bsnyad do/ /de nas shin tu 'gyod par gyur nas sdig pa bshags/nags tshal de nyid du yang dang yang du 'khor zhing 'tshol du song ba na/ phyi zhig na mjal/ dbang bskur gdams pa yang gnang bas/ de nyid bsgom bzhin du rtse gcig tu 'dug pa na/ bya rngon pa'i bya ba la sems yengs te/ bla ma la zhus pas/shin tu dgag dka' ba'i rnam rtog 'di bkag kyang ting nge 'dzin skye mi thub kya/de bas na 'jim pa dang / zan dag la bya'i gzugs chos la/ de dag gi ske chod cing ting nge 'dzim sgoms shig ces gsungs/ des kyang de bzhin du byed cing bsgoms pas/ mthar gyi lo bcu gnyis na phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub kyang thob cing / grong khyer rnams su bya sna tshogs gsod pa'i sprul pa ston/ sha yang gsol/ der mi rnams kyis rnal 'byor pa'i gzugs bzung nas/ sems can la gnod pa 'di lta bu byas so zhes 'phya bar byas pa na/ sngar bsad pa thams cad slar gsos/ de ltar lo bcu gnyis su bya rngon pa'i bya ba byed par sprul nas/ rig pa brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa spyad pa na/ mtshan yang grub thob bya dā li pa zhes grags te/ bya dā li pa ni bya rngon pa zhes bya ba yin no/ /des ku sa li bha dra la bshad de/ gtum mo'i brgyud pa lugs gcig go /yang bi rū pas —293—

ḍom+bi he ru ka la gdams te slob dpon de ni ko mkhan yin par bod na grags kyang / shar phyogs ti pu ri'i yul gyi rgyal po zhig yin gsung / der slob dpon bi rā pa byon te/ rgyal po de yang lhag par dad nas rjes su 'dzin par zhus pas dbang bskur zhing gdams pa yang gnang ngo / /rgyal pos kyang de nyid bsgom bzhin du 'dug pa na/ rim pa gnyis kyi rtogs pa yang rgya cher skyes pas/ spyod pa bya ba'i dus yin par mkhyen nas sa/sa nga sa te spyod pa cung zad spyad pa na/ phyag rgya mo lung bstan pa byung ste/ g.yung mo'i rigs kyi bu mo pad+ma can du gyur pa zhiga'ajig rten pa'i mngon du bsten pas/ rgyal po'i rigs nyams zhes blon po la sogs pa'i 'bangs rnams kyis rgyal srid las bton te phyir bskrad do/ /de nas rig pa brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa spyod cing / yul dang nags tshal rnams su rgyu ba na/ rgyal po ḍom+bi pa zhes grags so/ /de yang ḍom+bi zhes pa ni g.yung po ste/grong khyer gyi phyi rol tu gnas pa/ nya dang bya dang ri dwags gsod cing za/ sha 'tshong du med/ glu gar byed/ rtsa ba 'bras bu 'tshong ba la sogs pa/ ngan pa'i las gcig tu ma nges pa spyod pa'i rigs ngan gyi khyad par zur ba zhig yin no/slob dpon rang ḍom+bi min yang / btsun mo ni zhi ni yin pas ḍom+bi par thogs/ḍom+bi zhes pa ni g.yung mo can zhes pa yin no/ /slob dpon 'di ni shin tu dbangapo rno bas/ sngon bi rū pas dbang bskur nas/ de bar du lo drug las ma lon skad/ de nas yul sna tshogs su spyod cing / ring zhig lon pa na sngar gyi yul der nad yams dang mu ge la sogs pa sna tshogs pas sdug bsngal bar gyur/ ltas mkhan rnams kyis brtsis pas/ rgyal po bsod nams can yul gzhan du bskrad —294—

pas yin par shes nas/ slar yang spyan drangs pa na/ slob dpon rig ma dang bcas pa stag mo grus mu/ la chibs/ dug sprul phyag tu bsnams te byon pa na/thams cad kyis rgyal po grub pa thob pa yin par shes/ zhabs la phyag btsal/yul gyi gnod pa thams cad kyang zha/ yul mi skal ba dang ldan pa rnams kyis rjes su bzung bar zhus te/ gdams pa mtha' dag gis nye bar gdams pas/der yang dngos grub thob pa dang / sgrub pa po mchog tu gyur pa mang du byung / de nas yul ra dha zhes pa'am phal skad du rar zhes bya ba'i rgyal po de na/ sangs rgyas pa'i bstan pa la gnod pa byed pa zhig ste/ 'on kyang stag dang sbrul la ni shin tu skrag pa zhig yod/ de snyul ba'i don du slob dpon gyis de'i pho brang dang nye ba'i nags tshal zhig tu bzhugs pa na/ rgyal pos rnal 'byor pa ngan pa de ma 'dug zer/ de nas slob dpon gyis cho 'phrul gzhan snga ma dang 'dra ba la/ sbrul reg pa'i dug can gyis rgyan mdzad/ mthong dug can ni lcag gi tshul du bsnams/kha rlang gi dug can bdun gyis dbu la gdengs ka byas/ rgyal po'i mdun na phar gshegs pa na/ rgyal po grong khyer gyi mi dang bcas pa 'jigs shing skrag nas/gser dang dngul gyi me tog gtor te/ slob dpon gzhan du gshegs par zhu zhus pas/ slob dpon nyid he ru ka phyag gnyis pa'i rnam par gyur/ stag mo yang mi gang tsam gyi sa la ma reg par nam mkha' la 'gro zhing / khyed rnams sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la mi 'jug na/ sbrul gdug pa can 'di rnams gtong ngo zhes bsdigs pas/ thams cad sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la zhugs/ ra ra'i yul du re zhig mu stegs rgyun chad skad/ de nas lho phyogs kaṇ+ḍa ṭa ka'i yul du byon nas/—295—

nags tshal zhig tu 'khor mang po dang bcas shing ting nge 'dzin du bzhugs/ re zhig na/ aṣ+ṭa khye hā sa zhes bya ba'i dur khrod cig tu rgyal po sa muts+tsha ya zhes bya bas spyin bdag byas te/ rnal 'byor pho mo lnga brgya'i snyen ra gyis bskor nas/ zla ba drug tu tshogs kyi 'khor lo bskor ba na/ bram ze'i dge slong su sidha ka ra zhes bya ba tshogs kyi spyod pa la ma dad nas/ slob dpon la gnang ba ma zhus par phyir song ngo / /de nyid ni bka'i chad pas sha/ gas lnga brgya po thams cad kyi dngos grub sna re ma thob pa ma byung skad/ de dang nye ba na mu stegs kyi rgyal po zhig gis/mu stegs pa'i lugs kyi mchod rten brgya rtsa brgyad bzhengs/ ral pa can khri tsam 'tshogs nas rab gnas byed pa na/ srog chags sna tshogs bsad pa'i snying gi phung po 'ba' zhig rang la yang mi 'greng gsum tsam gyi dpangs yod pa'i gtor ma byas so/ /der slob dpon gyi g.yog mo zhig song ba de rnams kyis brdungs pas/ slob dpon gyis dgongs pa btang bas nub mo mchod rten thams cad mgo gzhug log gtor ma sogs mchod pa thams cad phyogs bcur 'thor/nang par mu stegs rgyal po dang bcas pa 'jigs shing skrag nas slob dpon gyi drung du byung ste bzod par gsol/ mchod rten rnams rnal du gnas par zhus/der slob dpon gyis khyed rnams phyin chad lha mchod pa'i don du srog chags gcig kyang ma gsod cig gal te gsod na mchod rten thams cad 'gas par 'gyur ro/ /sangs rgyas pa'i nus pa bstan pa'i phyir/ mchod rten gcig min pa thams cad rnal du gnas par 'gro gsung / de rnams kyis slar ldog ste bltas pa na de bzhin du song / dus phyis yul de'i rgyal po zhig gis srog gi mchod pa —296—

byas pas/ mchod rten brgya dang bdun po thams cad nyis tshal gsum tshal du gas/ da lta lcags kyis bsdams nas 'dug mu stegs kyi mchod rten zer yang ling ga'i rigs can zhig yin gsung / der yun ring du 'gro ba'i don mdzad nas/ sku lus de nyid kyis mkha' spyod du gshegs so/ /de'i slob ma grub pa brnyes pa'i gtso bo na/ ḍom+bi rigs kyi rnal 'byor ma/ slob dpon a la la badz+ra/he ma la badz+ra ste gser 'chang rdo rje/ yul dbus kyi ra ta badz+ra ste bzhi'o/ /gzhan yang nags khrod pa dang / slob dpon ga rba ri pa dang / dza ya shrī dang / mi thub zla ba dang / sgra gcan 'dzin rdo rje la sogs pa yang / slob dpon 'di'i zhabs la reg pas dngos grub phra mo thob pa yin no/ /de la grub thob chen po ḍom+bi pas g.yung mo rnal 'byor ma la gdams/ des ra ta badz+ra la/ des nag po spyod pa la gdams te brgyud pa'i lugs gcig go /yang g.yung mo rnal 'byor mas/ spyod pa pa la gdams pa'ang lugs gcig yin mod kya/ gtum mo'i bka' babs ni bar pa gtso che ba yin no/ /de'i g.yung mo rnal 'byor ma ni lta stangs bzhis 'gro ba'i mdzad pa/ las bzhi'i sngags dang sbyor ba mang po khong nyid kyis mdzad pa shin tu nus pa che ba mang po da lta yang yod gsung / des rdo rje'i glu mang du blangs shing sems can gyi don byas te/ mkha' spyod du bzhud de/ ḍom+bi pa nyid la he ru kas lung bstan pa'i phyag rgya de yin no/ /de la mi thub zla bas zhal gzigs kyi sgo nas zhus so/ /de ni paṇ+ḍi ta shin tu mkhas pa yin/ to zhi'i slob brgyud mang po la thos pa mdzad/ phyis ḍom+bi rnal 'byor ma'i slob brgyud gcig la gdams ngag zhus/ o rgyan du rtse gcig tu bsgoms pas ḍom+bi pa yum dang bcas pa mjal/—297—

gdams pa stsal/ der dur khrod du thod skam gyi spyil bu chung ngu brtsigs/ rnal 'byor ma gcig gis sgrub g.yog byas/ slob ma gcig gis 'tsho ba bskyal gyin bsgrub pas/ mthar rtogs pa khyad par can skyes/ he ru ka'i zhal mthong / thun mong gi dngos grub thob/ de nas lan cig tshogs 'khor chen po byas/ mkha' 'gro ma dang phra men ma kun tshogs la bkug /la hor gyi yul na gzugs can ma gcig khyim gyi shing 'bras bu can thams cad rtsa ba bton nas khyer tshogs 'khor la yang phyin pa na/ de'i khyos nub mo mi sdod par shes/ skyed tshal gyi a mra'i yal ga'i phag tu gab nas bsdad pas/ shing de rang yang rtsa ba nas bton nas khyer/ de ltar tshogs gral du sha chen sogs bza' ba dang / rnal 'byor can rnams dang lhan cig spyod par shes nas/ mi de khyim thab dang / tshogs pa la ma mgu/ slob dpon na re/ rang re'i tshogs 'di na gsang ba la 'khu ba yong pas sgrol dgos gsung / tho rangs mos shing khyer nas rang gnas su btsugs/ nang par bdag po la khyod la slob dpon su du rdza ya tsan+t+ra'i bka' gcig yod de khyod bsgral zin byas pas der sha/ de sogs nus pa dpag tu med/ de la de'i rig ma su bho gas zhus/ de la dā na shis zhus/ de la rdo rje gdan pa bar pas zhus/de la ku sa lis zhus pa'ang yod mod/ tshig brgyud gtso che/ yang spyod pa bas sing ga la'i rnal 'byor ma la bshad/ de la mi thub zla bas zhus/ de la rā hu la badz+ra gyis zhus pa'ang yin/ de ni chung ngu nas yi dam zhal gzigs rigs rgyal rigs/ bi kra ma'i dge slong paṇ+ḍi ta yin/ der gsang sngags sgom zhing / bla mas kun spangs gyis shig gsung / 'on kyang nga rgyal gyi dbang las bka' bcag ste —298—

re zhig kun spangs ma mdzad/ phyis de'i sdig pa spyod pa la rtse gcig tu bsgrubs kyang cang ma 'grub/ bla ma gu ṇa a ka ra na re/ lce dang yan lag chod gsung /ljags dang yan lag bzhi bcad pas/ spyan ras gzigs dang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ nag po chen po/ sgrol ma ste bzhis dngos su zhal bstan/ byin gyis brlabs/ de nas bla ma dz+nya nas ga ra na re/ khyod chu 'dir zhag bdun lus spyings la sdod gsung / de ltar byas pas/ lus kyi khrag srin bu pad pa mang pos 'jibs nas/ 'chi la khad par song / de gnyis kyis bla ma'i bka' bcag pa'i sgrib pa dag skad/ de nas lho phyogs su bsgoms pas phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub thob/ shing gi ri zer ba/ ri nag po'i khong seng na bzhugs skad/ shing gi ri zhes pa mon mtshams kyi 'di min lho phyogs na yod do/ /de la dā na shis zhus pas na gong bzhin yin mod/ 'di dgyes rdor gyi gas mo kho na yin yang gsung / da ta badz+ra ni nā la sde'i paṇ+ḍi ta cig yin snang yang / rnam thar rgyas par mi gsung / yang tsar+ya pa kha gcig bi rū pa chung pa/ nag po spyod pa/ ḍom+bi he ru kami thub zla ba/ ku sa li bha dra zhes brgyud pa 'ded pa'ang yod mod kya/ de ni ma dag gsung / rin po che'i 'byung khungs lta bu'i gtam las/ gtum mo brgyad pa'i gtam gyi skabs te gnyis pa'o// //gsum pa ni las kyi phyag rgya'i bka' babs yin no/ /de yang sangs rgyas dngos kyi zhal mthong ba'i rgyal po in+t+ra bhu ti chen po de na/ ngo bo gsang bdag phyag na rdo rje yin gsar brnyes dang gdod ma gang yin bsam par mi nus/ bstan pa 'di la gsang sngags pa thams cad kyi gtso bo yin/ de yang o —299—

rgyan gyi rgyal po ste rgyal srid 'byor zhing bde bar yod pa'i skabs/ ston pa'i 'khor dgra bcom pa rnams gling gzhan la 'phur te 'gro 'ong byed pa rgyal po in+t+ra bhu tis gzigs pa na thag ring pas cha ma phyed de/ blon po rnams la bya dmar po'i khyu 'di rnams ci yin dris pas/ blon po rnams na re/ lha ciga'adi ni bya ma lags/ drang srong chen po sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi nyan thos lags so byas pas/ rgyal po sangs rgyas lta 'dod pa la/ blon po rnams kyis thag ring bas mi 'byon zer ba na/ rgyal pos gsol ba btab pas/ nang par gdugs tshod la sangs rgyas 'khor dgra bcom pa lnga brgya dang bcas pa byon pa la rgya cher mchod nas/ sangs rgyas thob pa'i thabs zhus pas/ rgyal po 'dod yon spangs la bslab pa gsum dang pha rol tu phyin pa drug la brten cig gsungs pas/ rgyal pos bdag bud med kyi tshogs dang lhan cig 'dod pa lnga la longs spyad pas sangs rgyas thob pa'i thabs cig 'tshal lo/ /dzasbu'i tshal ni nyams dga' bar/ /wa skyes nyid du gyur kyang bla'/ /'dod yon spangs pa'i thar pa na/ /nam yang mi 'dod go ta ma/ /zhes zhus pas/ der nyan thos kyi tshogs rnams mi snang bar thal te/ 'di na gang zag brgyad med cing / /nyan thos rang rgyal 'ga' yang med/ /byang chub sems dpa' rdzu 'phrul che/ /de dag de yi gzugs su sprul/ /zhes nam mkha' nas sgra yang byung / der dkyil 'khor chen po mtha' yas par gyur/ rgyal po la dbang bskur bas/ de nyid du zung 'jug gi sku 'grub ste/ de la bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang rgyud thams cad gtad do/ /des kyang o rgyan gyi skye bo thams cad la rgya cher bstan/ rgyud rnams glegs bam —300—

du byas/ mthar btsun mo'i tshogs dang lhan cig mi snang bar gyur te/ longs spyod rdzogs pa'i skur gyur mod/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing nas zhing du spyod cing gsang sngags thams cad kyi sdud pa po'i tshul mdzad do/ /de'i dus rgyal po 'khor bcas su ma zad o rgyan gyi yul mi dang / 'byung po dang / srog chags dud 'gror gyur pa 'bu srin yan chod thams cad bde ba chen po'i lam gyis dngos grub thob cing 'ja' lus su song ngo / /de dngos kyi zhal mthong ba'i mkha' 'gro ma phyis bzhugs pa ni dpal ldan bde ba'i rol pa mo yin/ de yang sa hā dza sirnyi lhan cig skyes grub kyi rol pa mo gcig gsung / 'on kyang brgyud pa'i khyad par mi 'dra ba na/ byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa tha dad pa dang / gdams ngag mi gcig pas yin gsung / de la rnal 'byor ma de'i lo rgyus na/ lhan cig skyes grub kyi 'grel ba ltar na/ de ni o rgyan gyi yul phyogs zhig gi rgyal po'i bu mo ste/ de yang cher skyes pa na/ 'khor bu mo lnga brgya dang lhan cig nags tshal rnams su rgyu ba na/ o rgyan gyi phyogs zhig na/ byang chub sems dpa' phyag na rdo rje de drang srong 'gro ba dbugs 'byin pa zhes bya bar sprul te bzhugs pa las/ bu mo rnams kyis de mthong ba na/ drang srong skra 'dzings pa 'jigs 'jigs ltar 'dug nas/ 'dre yin no snyam phyir bros pa na/ rol pa mos khyed rnams ma 'jigs shig 'di ni mthong ba tsam gyis nga'i yid la dga' ba de'i ting nge 'dzin khyad par can skyes pas na 'di ni bdag nyid chen po zhig go /de nas 'khor lnga brgya dang bcas te de'i zhabs la phyag byas te/ drang srong des kyang bu mo bde ba'i rol ba mo'i mgo bor phyag bzhag pas/ sngon skye ba gzhan du dbang —301—

bskur ba'i ye shes kyang dran/ rang gi sems nyid lhan cig skyes pa mngon sum du rtogs te/ rang gi 'khor rnams la yang bstan pas/ de thams cad kyang rnal 'byor ma chen mor gyur ces 'gyung ste/ de thams cad mthong pa'i chos de nyid la sa bcu gang rung re thob pa yin te/ des pad+ma badz+ra chen po la bshad/ des yan lag med pa'i rdo rje phag tshangs pa la bshad do/ /des pad+ma badz+ra bar ba mtsho skyes la bshad/ des in+t+ra bhu ti 'bring po la bshad/ des dza lan+ta ri pa la bshad/des nag po spyod pa ba la bshad/ des dge ba'i mgon po la bshad/ des dpag med rdo rje la bshad/ des ku sa la bha dra la bshad do/ /de la pad+ma badz+ra chen po na/ nub phyogs ma dra'i yul du rigs bram zer 'khrungs/ sde snod gsum dang bstan bcos thams cad la shin tu mkhas par sbyangs pa zhig yin la/ o rgyan gyi yul du song nas/ gsang sngags phyi'i rgyud mang du bslabs shing mkhas par mkhyen pa la/ de rnams bsgoms pas/ gnod spyin mo dang bcud len la sogs pa thun mong gi dngos grub thob kyang / de kho na nyid ma shes par/ o rgyan gyi phyogs shig tu song nas/ de 'ba' zhig sems par byed pa la/ rdo rje sems dpa'i zhal mngon sum du mthong ba'i slob dpon zhig gis dbang bskur pas/rang bzhin gyi gnas tshul mthong nas/ phyag rgya'i dbang gi ye shes ni de kho na nyid mtshon par byed par mkhyen mod kya/ 'on kyang 'di nyid gtso bor ston par byed pa'i sde snod cig mthong na ci ma rung snyam du de nyid sems par byed pa na/bu mo bde ba'i rol pa mo 'khor rnal 'byor ma brgya stong du ma dang lhan cig tu slob dpon gyi drung du byon te/ phyag rgya bzhi'i man ngag dang / gsang ba 'dus pa —302—

gtso bor gyur pa'i bla med kyi rgyud sde du ma bshad pas/ de rnams kyi don mngon sum du rtogs te/ de nyid du phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub thob par gyur cing / mthar gyi zla ba bcu gnyis na/ rdo rje 'chang chen po'i go 'phang brnyes pa yin gsung / des kyang gdams ngag bstan pas o rgyan gyi yul du skye bo dpag tu med pa mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub la bkod/ gsang ba grub pa zhes bya ba'i bstan bcos kyang mdzad do/ /yan lag med pa'i rdo rje na/ rigs ngan skal ba dang ldan pa zhig yin pa la/ slob dpon pad+ma badz+ra gyis legs par gdams pa bzhin lo bcu gnyis su go taX pa'i ri la bsgoms pas/ phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub nyams su chud kyang bdag nyid kyi bya ba slob dpon la zhu dgos par shes te/ zhus pas/ khyod phag rdzi mo bsten cing / phag rdzi'i spyod pas rim gyis rdo rje sems dpar 'gyur gsung / de nas o rgyan gyi byang phyogs grong khyer zhig tu phag rdzi'i spyod pas sems can gyi don mdzad cing / skal ba dang ldan pa rnams la dbang bskur nas/ phyag rgya bzhi'i gdams ngag bstan pas smin cing grol bar mdzad pa yin no/ /dpal phag tshang pa zhes grags so/de'i slob ma ni slob dpon sa ro ru ha zhes pa bod skad mtsho skyes zhes pa yin te/de yang rigs rgyal rigs/ rig pa'i gnas thams cad la mkhas pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta chen po gsang sngags kyi rgyud mang po mkhyen pa zhig yin/ de rgyal po'i mchod gnas mdzad/ 'khor mtha' yas pa la chos ston cing yod pa la/ shing thun rgan mo zhig phyogs der shing 'thu ba'i zhar la 'ong bas/ res dgod/ res ngu ba zhig mthong / phyi zhig na slob dpon gyis de'i khyim du song ste dris pas/ rgod pa —303—

ni khyod chos ston pa rdo rje 'cha chos gsung ba 'dra bas rgod pa yin/ ngu ba ni rdo rje 'chang gi dgongs pa ltar mi 'chad pas ngu ba yin zhes zer ba la 'o na bdag gi the tshom gcod par zhu zhus pas/ ngas gcod par mi nus kya/ dpal phag tshang pa la zhus gsung / de ga na bzhugs dris pas/ byang phyogs kyi grong khyer ngan pa zhig na yod gsung / der slob dpon gyis 'tshol du bzhud pas/byang phyogs kyi grong khyer re rul zhig nas/ dpal phag tshong pa de phag gi khyu chen po gcig gdong du ded/ rigs ngan mo dang lhan cig tu shing khur chen po gcig khur nas byung ba dang mjal nas/ de dag kyang brda ru shes te/ shing khur thogs pa ni zhe sdang ma spangs rang gnas su dag pa'i brda/ rig ngan mo dang bcas pa ni 'dod chags dag pa dang / phag khyu bdas pa ni gti mug dag pa'i brdar go ste/rjes su bzung bar zhu zhus pas/ nga rigs ngan klog kyang mi shes pa la/gdams ngag dgos zhes smra ba snyad 'tshol ba yin zhes gsung / khro zhing brdeg go /grong khyer ba'i phag kun 'jug pa'i ra ba'i phug btsog btsog ltar snang ba zhig tu bzhud do/ /der mtshan mo them pa la mgo brtad nas/ sgo drung du sa the btsugs te 'dug pa na/ nub kyi ring la phag rnams 'thab pa dang / slob dpon gyi chu la gnod pa bskyal bas/ phag rnams brdungs/ jo mo rigs ngan rgan mos bzlog par byed cing / shin tu dman pa'i spyod pa ltar bcos pas so ma sod do/der nyin zhag mang po'i bar du 'dug pa na/ lan cig tho rangs kyi tshe slob dpon na re/ sgo drung na yod pa'i mi 'di ci zhig don du gnyer/ jo mo na re/ de kho na nyid kyis rjes su bzung bar zhu zer gyin 'dug zer pa la/ slob dpon gyis/—304—

'di kun paṇ+ḍi ta bya ba nga rgyal che bas de kho na nyid kyi snod du mi rung gsung /der bdag gi don rnams nges par grub po snyam ste/ yang dang yang du gsol ba btab pas dbang bskur zhing / gdams pa dang rjes su gdams pa mtha' dag rtsal/ slob dpon nyid kyi sras mo ngan ngon ltar snang ba zhig stsal nas 'di rig mar gyis la sgoms shig gsung / de nas slob dpon yang sngar gyi rgyal po'i mchod gnas kyi bya ba yang mdzad cing / yid gzhan du ma gyur par rtse gcig tu bsgom pas/ lo bcu gnyis na phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub nyams 'og tu chud do/ /de yan chad du gsang ste spyod pas gnas pa la/ de phyin chad 'jig rten pa'i mngon du yang spyod pas/ skye bo kun gyis rigs ngan mo bsten pas slob dpon ma dag slob dpon ma dag na rgyal po ma dag par 'gyur/ des yul phyogs thams cad ma dag cing nyams par 'gyur bas/ gang ma dag pa 'byung ba'i gzhi slob dpon rang dang rigs ngan mo me la bsregs na dag par 'gyur zhes/ rgyal po la yang dang yang du zhus/ dus lan gcig khang bzang gi rtse mo nas bltas pas/ slob dpon khang pa nas rigs ngan gyi bu mo dang bcas pa phyir byung ba mthong / der rgyal pos chad pa byed par brtsams te/ shing gi phung po chen po yang byas/ de la slob dpon yab yum bzhag slar yang shing sbungs te me bus pas/ zhag bdun du me lce 'bar ba rgyun ma chad cing / brgyad pa'i nyin par thal ba'i phung po gyur pa mi rnams kyis thal ba bsal bas dbus na mtsho chung ngu zhig gi gung du pad+ma shin tu rgyas pa la/ slob dpon yab yum he ru ka yab yum gyi sku gzi brjid dang ldan par mthong / der thams cad ngo mtshar du gyur cing / o ḍi 305—

ya ṇa'i yul gyi mi de dag thams cad kyang rdo rje theg pa la bkod de/ rgyal po 'khor lnga brgya dang bcas pas kyang dngos grub thob ces grags so/ /dus gzhan cig na ma dra'i yul gyi phyogs shig tu byon te/ der mi zhig gis nyin gung bye tshan gyi thang la ri dwags shin tu grang bas nyen pa mthong bas/ der tsan+dan sa mchog yod par shes nas grus pas/ tsan+dan gyi sdong dum chen po byung ba slob dpon la phul bas/ de la he ru ka'i sku zhig byas na legs par mkhyen nas/ de brdar ba dang / brdung ba'i las byed pa yang / bud med pad+ma can gyi rigs yon tan sum cu rtsa gnyis dang ldan pa zhig dgos pa las/ de yang gzhan na med de/yul de'i rgyal po mu stegs kyi lugs 'dzin pa zhig gi klas kyi btsun mo zhig kho na la yod par mkhyen nas/ de mtshan re bzhin ting nge 'dzin gyis bkug nas/tsan+dan brdar du bcug pa na/ lan cig rgyal pos de'i lag pa gas par mthong nas/ khyod skyid de bar 'dug pa la/ lus kyang rid lag pa ser kar song ba ci yin dris pas rgyal pos mi shes sam/ nub re bzhin re'i phug cig tu btsun pa zhig gis tsan+dan gyi sde gu'i las kho na la bkol/ nam langs su nye ba na/ slar 'di nyid du skyel zer/ de phyogs gang na yod dris pas/ mgo 'khor te phyogs ni mi shes zer/ der rgyal pos kyang brtags pas/ mun sros tsam na rgyal po nyid kyang sems myos shing mgo 'khor ba ltar 'dug pa la/ btsun mo de ni mkha' la yer gyis song nas/ nang par gang nas byung med par khyim du sleb po/ /phyi nub si rgyu ra'i rkyal pa zhig lag tu gtad nas/ ci lcogs lcogs lam du gtor cig byas gtor pas/ nang par rgyal pos si rgyu ra'i rjes bcad pas/ slob dpon gyi —306—

drung du sleb/ rgyal po khros te 'khor dang bos pa go pa gcod du 'ongs/ der slob dpon gyis rdo rje gri gug gi sbyor ba byas pas/ rdza'i spyi blugs kyi mgrin pa bskor ba na/ rgyal po 'khor bcas kyi gdong ltag par blta bar song / der 'jigs nas zhabs la phyag btsal bas/ slob dpon gyis khyod sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la zhugs shig ci ste mi 'jug na/ khyed rnams kyi mgo bo bcad par bya'o zhes gsungs pas/ rgyal po yang sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la zhugs/ he ru ka'i lha khang bzhengs pa gnyan cing byin rlabs che bar grags pa/ dam tshig nyams pas sku de'i zhal ras mthong na khrag skyugs te 'chi ba dang / dus phyis rang stag gzig gi dmag gis bshi/ga par brtsams pas/ stag gzig gi rta ba bcu gnyis dus gcig tu shi bas/ da lta yang shin tu gnyan gsung / slob dpon des sems can dpag tu med pa'i don mdzad de/ he badz+ra dngos kyi go 'phang thob pa yin gsung / de'i slob ma rgyal po in+d+ra bhu ti bar pa na/ gong du po gad ma thag pa'i slob dpon nyid me la sreg mkhan de yin te/ 'on kyang 'di'i lo rgyus rgyas par mi gsung / zur tsam zhig gsungs pa lwa ba pa'i skabs su 'chad/ yang brgyud pa lugs gcig la/ in+d+ra bhu ti des zhal bstan te pad+ma ka ra la gdams/de la slob dpon ku sa las zhus/ 'di la ni ku sa la bha dra chung bas zhus pa yin no/ /'on kyang brgyud pa de'i lo rgyus na/ 'og tu shes par bya'o/ /rin po che'i 'byung khungs lta bu'i gtam las/ las rgya brgyud pa'i gtam gyi skabs te gsum pa'o// //bka' babs bzhi pa na/ 'od gsal gyi gdams ngag yin te/ de yang —307—

slob dpon rdo rje dril bu pas/ o rgyan du rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma rnams la dngos su zhus pa dang / yang ring brgyud kyi dbang du byas na/ slob dpon chen po rta mchog ces bya ba phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub thob pa/ 'od gsal bsam mi khyab kyi ting nge 'dzin bsgom zhing o rgyan gyi grong khyer zhig gi sgo drung dang nye bar spyil po byas nas bzhugs pa la/ rgyal po'i mi rnams kyis tho co'i spyod pas yang yang brnyas pas/ dus lan cig o rgyan gyi yul de tsam du che ba yang ri klung med pa rtas khyab nas/ zhing dang skyed mos tshal thams cad zos pas/ rgyal po'i mi rnams kyis rta rnams ded pas/ zin du nye ba nye ba la mi zin pa 'ba' zhig byung /mthar rta 'ga' zhig yod pa yang / slob dpon gyi spyil por zhugs pa mthong nas spyil po la bltar song ba na rta gcig kyang med de/ der sprul pa yin par shes/ slob dpon grub pa thob par yang shes mod kya/ 'on kyang slob dpon de rdzu 'phrul gyis mi ma yin gyi gnas su 'phur nas bzhud do/ /'on kyang rgyal po la sogs pas de'i slob ma bi nā ba ste pi waX zhabs la gdams ngag zhus/ slob dpon de na/ dang po rgyal rigs yin pa/ slob dpon rta mchog gis dbang bskur zhing gdams pa gnang ba na/ bdag gis rgyal rigs kyi bya ba ni spangs par nus na/ 'on kyang pi waX gi sgra spang bar mi nus pas/ ji ltar bgyi zhus pas/paX waX gi sgra nyid la sems 'dzin pa'i gdams ngag gnang ste/ des kyang bsam mi khyab kyi dngos grub thob pa yin skad/ de'i slob ma ni chang 'tshong ma bi la phya badz+ra yin te/ bod skad du/ sgeg mo rdo rje zhes bya'o/ /de ni o rgyan yul gyi rgyal po zhig gi chang sbyor mkhan yin pas/ des lo bcu drug lon pa'i tshe/ slob —308—

dpon ḍom+bi he ru ka phyogs der byon nas chos gsung ba na/ rgyal po de mu stegs la dga' bas thul bar ma gyur pa la/ slob dpon gyis chang 'tshong ma de'i sar byon de la dris pas/ sbrul gyis bsdigs na thul zer/ der slob dpon gyis dgongs pa btang bas/ sbrul gdug reg pa dug can gyis rgyal po'i khyim bskor ba na/ rgyal po 'jigs te skyabs gzhan med pa la/ myong 'a lnga'i ma na re/ mu stegs kyi slob dpon 'di rnams kyis skyob par mi nus kya/ ḍom+bi pa la gsol ba thob ces smras/ rgyal pos kyang snying nas gsol ba btab pas/ slob dpon der byon pa na/ sprul gdug pa thams cad sa 'og tu song / rgyal po 'khor dang bcas la yang sangs rgyas pa la dad par gyur/ slob dpon la yang yun ring du mchod pa byas skad/ der chang 'tshong ma de snod dang ldan par gzigs nas/ḍom+bi pa dang / bī na pa gnyis kyis dbang bskur zhing gdams pa yang gnang /nus pa thob pa'i rnal 'byor mar gyur pa na/ lcam lak+ṣi ka ras bde ba chen po'i gdams ngag bstan/ slob dpon bī na pas bsam mi khyab kyi gdams ngag bstan pas/ 'od gsal rdo rje'i sems dang ldan pa'i rnal 'byor ma rnams kyi gtso mor gyur/ 'gro ba'i don dpag tu med pa mdzad de/ rnal 'byor ma shis zhes kyang grags so/ /des ni rdo rje dril bu pa la gad/mas pa yin te/ slob dpon de ni o ḍi sha dang nye ba'i rgyal rigs shig nā la sder rab tu byung / blo gros snying po'i dpal zhes mtshan btags/ phyis mkhas pa chen por gyur nas/mu stegs kyi rgol ba tshar bcad pas/ dgra las rnam par rgyal ba'i lha zhes grags/ nā la sde'i mkhan por yang lan cig mnga' gsol skad/ de nas grub —309—

thob dā ri ka pa dang mjal/ dbang bskur dang de kho na nyid zhus nas bsgom zhing yod pa la/ o rgyan du song dngos grub 'byung zhes lung bstan pa byung nas/ o rgyan du song bas/ der rnal 'byor ma bi la su badz+ra phag rdzi ma'i tshul bzung ba dang mjal nas/ des kyang phyag chen po bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'dod chags chen po'i tshul bstan pas/ de kho na nyid thams cad khong du chud nas/ shar phyogs o ḍi shi'i nags khrod du bsgoms pas/ rim pa gnyis kyi rtogs pa khyad par can skyes pa na/ yul gyi rgyal po de nags la ri dwags bshor du 'ongs pas mthong ste/ dge slong 'tsho ba med pa snying re rje snyam nas grong khyer du 'byon par zhus pas/ dngos rnams rab tu shes pa'i mkhas pa dag la brnyas par mi bya ste/ /de ni rtswa rtse chung ngu bas kyang chung ba'i 'byor bas 'ching bar nus ma yin/ /rgyun mi 'chad par chang 'dzag pa yi 'gram lang nag por gyur pa ya/ /glang chen rnams ni pad+ma'i skud pa phra mos 'khyig par mi nus bzhin/ /zhes slob dpon gyis brjod pa las/ der rgyal pos dge slong 'dis nga la brnyas so/ /'di la lan dma' dbab po snyam nas grong khyer du dril bsgrags te/ nags seb kyi dge slong 'di lta bu su zhig gis 'bebs par nus pa de la bya dga' chen po ster byas pas/ der chang 'a sna khri ma zhig gis khas blangs so/ /de nas des slob dpon la rtag tu 'tsho ba skyel bar byed/ dus gzhan zhig na/ chang 'tshong ma'i bu mo pad+ma can zhing skyes kyi mtshan nyid thams cad tshang ba zhig yod pa phyag rgya mor bzung ste bsgoms pas/ lo bcu gnyis na slob dpon de ni phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub kyi go 'phang thob bo/ /der grong khyer pa rnams ma mos pa —310—

bzlog pa'i phyir dang / ma 'ongs pa'i ser/ru can gyi bsod nams kyi zhing du spyan ras gzigs kyi rdo sku rang byung bzhag nga/ dang / gsang sngags kyi bstan pa rgya cher spel ba'i phyir/ lan gcig khye'u gcig dang bu mo zhig kyang sprul lo/ /rgyal pos gtam de thos nas chang 'tshong ma la slob dpon grong khyer du bos shig ces bsgos/ grong khyer gyi shar sgor skye bo mang po bsags/ slob dpon nags tshal nas grong khyer du byon pa na/ lam du chang bum mang po bstar du bcugayum gyis de nas rwa bshor du 'dren gyin/ sprul pa'i khye'u ni g.yas nas rgyugabu mo ni g.yon nas rgyug go /de nas grong khyer gyi shar sgor sleb pa na/ yul mi rnams kyis sngon rgyal po la brnyas pa'i tshig de glur blangs shing / rgyal pos spyan drangs na mi 'ong / chang 'tshong mas bos pa na 'ong ba 'di ci zer gyi thal mo brdabs pas/ der slob dpon gyis rwa'i bshor zhal sa la 'phangs pas sa 'og bdun phug ste chu chen po byung ngo / /slob dpon yab yum ni he ru ka yab yum du gyur/ khye'u dang bu mo ni rdo rje dang dril bur gyur pa phyag tu bsnams te nam mkha' la bzhud/ skye bo rnams kyang chus nub pa tsam du song ba na/ slob dpon la gsol ba btab pas/ spyan ras gzigs la gsol ba thob gsung /skye bo thams cad kyis na mo lo ke shwa rā ya/ zhes brjod pa na/ chu'i dbus su spyan ras gzigs kyi rdo sku rang byung du byung / chu yang de la lan bdun du bskor ba byas nas sa 'og tu song ngo / /der slob dpon gyis/ yul de na gnas pa rnams la rdo rje theg pa rgya cher bshad de/ dngos grub thob pa'i slob ma yang dpag tu med pa byung ngo / /des ni lwa ba pa la gdams pa yin te/ slob dpon de —311—

ni rgyal po'i sras shig yin pa/ 'di'i yul yang o rgyan gyi nang tshan zhig yin gsung / 'ga' zhig o ḍi bi sha yin 4/nga zer/ cher skyes pa na/ gtsug lag khang zhig tu rab tu byung zhing / sde snod gsum la yang mkhas par gyur/ phyi zhig na shar phyogs su 'ongs pas/ slob dpon rdo rje dril bu pa dang mjal te/ 'khor lo sdom pa la sogs pa'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur/ ji ltar gdams pa bzhin du bsgoms pas/ ye shes mchog thob par gyur nas/ nub phyogs o rgyan gyi mkha' 'gro ma'i gnas su song ba na/ mu stegs kyi mkha' 'gro rnams kyis/me tog gi 'phreng ba zhig lag tu gtad de/ de blangs pa na/ sangs rgyas pa'i mkha' 'gro ma rnams byung ste/ bu me tog blangs pa ma legs/ de mu stegs kyi rnal 'byor ma yin/ gang me tog blangs pa de'i rjes su 'jug dgos zer/ 'o na khyed rnams kyi srung ba byed dgos byas pas/ gnas 'di na phyi rol pa dang / nang pa'i mkha' 'gro ma rnams me tog phog pa su snga ba de'i rjes su 'jug dgos pa'i chad mdo byas pa yin zer/ der slob dpon gyis ting nge 'dzin bsgom zhing bzhugs pas/ nam phyed kyi dus na/ thug chom gyi sgra chen po byung nas bltas pa na/ mu stegs kyi mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis pha bong gi char chen po phab/ bskyed rim bsgoms pas bsrung 'khor ji tsam bsgom pa'i bar gnod pa ma byung pas/bskyed rim gyi mthu yang 'di 'dra na/ rdzogs pa'i rim pa'i mthu bstan par bya'o snyam ste/ mtshan ma med pa'i ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par ba theg pas/ rdo thams cad nam mkha' la chags so/ /nam mkha' la rten med par pha bong zhig dang /brag me long ltar 'jam pa'i ngos la rdo dam dum mang po rten med par chags pa —312—

da lta'ang yod/ der mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyi bar chad kyis ma tshugs so/ /de nas bsod snyoms spyod cing bzhugs pa na/ grong khyer gyi sgo drung du yang yang rgyal po dang 'phrad pa na/ 'phrad res bzhin rgyal pos dri ba re byas pa la/ slob dpon gyis lan ci yang ma btab bo/ /lan cig rgyal pos dge slong blun po mi shes pa khyod/ yang yang 'gro zhing 'dug pas ci byed/ de bas ring du gnyid log na rung byas pa na/ slob dpon gyis rgyal po'i sgo drung du lo bcu gnyis su gnyid thun gcig gis 'khyongs pa log bzhin 'dug pa na/ der 'gro ba'i mi kun yang slob dpon la phyag ma byas na byin pa rengs 'gro bas/ rgyal po la sogs pa thams cad phyag 'tshal zhing 'gro 'ong byed do/ /lo bcu gnyis na sad de/ rgyal pos slob dpon de tsam ci'i phyir sa nyad log slob dpon na re/ lha nyid gsung ngo zhes gsung / de nas rgyal po yang shin tu dad par gyur cing / yul gyi skye bo mang po rdo rje theg pa la bkod/ rgyal po de ni in+d+ra bhu ti bar pa yin gsung / de nas slob dpon dur khrod na kun tu spyod pa'i tshe/ o rgyan gyi yul gyi sngags 'chang ma'i gtso mo lnga brgya dur khrod nyul du song ngo / /de la sngags 'chang ma zhes pa ni ma rgyu bā di te/ lhan cig skyes pa dang / byin gyis brlabs pa'i sngags kyi mthu can/ dmod pa grub pa'i phra men ma yin no/ /des na de rnams kyis slob dpon la bar chad byed par 'dod nas slob dpon btsal ba na/ slob dpon gyi shul na na bza' lwa ba gcig ma gtogs g.yin ma mthong nas/ kye ma dge slong 'di'i sgyu ma la ltos/ rang gi lus lwa bar sgyur ro/ /de bas na 'di gtubs nas so sor bza' bar bya'o zhes zer te/ lwa ba dum bu lnga brgyar bgos nas so sor —313

mid do/ /der slob dpon gyis lus snang bar byas te de rnams la dmod pa bor bas/ sngags 'chang mo lnga brgya po lug ma mo lnga brgyar song ngo / /der lug ma mo rnams rgyal po'i drung du song ste/ dge slong dur khrod pas bdag cag 'di ltar du byas pas/ rgyal pos sgrol ba'i thabs mdzod ces zer ro/ /der rgyal pos slob dpon la zhus pas slob dpon gcer bur byung zhing / rgyal po khyod kyi yul gyi sngags 'chang ma rnams kyis/ dge slong gi nor lwa ba cig yod pa'ang zos so/de bas na sngags 'chang ma rnams khug cig gsung / der gsum ma gtogs thams cad bkug nas/ re re bzhin thams cad la sdigs 'dzub re byas pas/mgo brnyan sna tshogs su song nas/ lwa ba'i dum bu so sor skyugs/ de dag tshem bu byas pas/ cung zad ma 'grig ste/ da dung gsum yod pas khug cig gsung /der btsun mo'i 'khor gyi nang na gsum yod pa yang der 'ongs pa la/ snga ma ltar lwa ba skyug tu bcug de nyid sku la gsol bas rje btsun lwa ba pa zhes yongs su grags so/ /der rgyal po in+d+ra dh+wa ti la dbang bskur te/ de'i gdams pa bsgoms pas rgyal po'ang dngos grub thob/ de nas slob dpon brag phug gcig tu lo bcu gnyis su mtshan ma med pa'i ting nge 'dzin bsgom bzhin du 'od gsal gyi lam gyis 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa na/ skye bo rnams smod par byed de/ gti mug chos su smra ba zhes zer/ rgyal po in+d+ra dh+wa ti de zhag re bzhin bud med lnga brgya dang lhan cig spyod pas/ mi rnams smod par byed pa la/ dus gzhan zhig gi tshe/ rgyal pos btsun mo zhig gi lag tu sna di ma ku ba gang gtad/ 'di ma grang pa la slob dpon lwa ba pa la phul zhig byas pa na/ des nyi ma mang po chod pa'i lam —314—

du tshod ma ma grang pa ga la 'ong byas pas/ rgyal po na re de la ni sngags yod de/khyod mig tshum la 'di skad smos shig slob dpon lwa ba pa gnyid spangs pa'i dka' thub la gnas pa 'di bden na/ da lta nyid du ko taX bha ri'i brag phug tu phyin par gyur cig /ces brjod cig gsung / des kyang de bzhin byas pas/mig gdangs tsam na/ slob dpon gyi mdun du sleb 'dug skad/ der slob dpon ni slob ma 'ga' la lung 'bogs pa'i bya bas g.yengs nas yun ring rab cig 'dren rgyu ma byung / slar drangs pa phal cher gsol nas/ lhag ma cung zad drod yod pa nyung shas shig gtad nas/ 'di drod ma yal ba rgyal po la thengs pa gyis gsung / dpag tshad bcu gnyis kyi lam yod pas ma grang ba ga la 'ong byas pas/ slob dpon na re/ rgyal po in+d+ra dh+wa ti tshangs par spyod pa'i mchog yin pa bden na/ da lta nyid du rgyal po'i drung du spyan par gyur cig /ces brjod cig dang myur du sleb 'ong gsung / des bsams pa/ slob dpon 'di yang rdzun du smra ba zhig ste/ 'di ltar skye bo thams cad kyi mngon sum dang 'gal ba'i tshig 'di la su zhig yid ches snyam mo/ /'on kyang de bzhin du byas pas/ yud tsam gyis lam rnams chod 'gro yin 'dug nas/ ngan rtags rnams khyer zhing 'ongs nas/ rgyal po mdun khang du skye bo brgya stong gi dbus na yod pa'i drung du sleb ste/tshod ma'i lhag ma gtad/ der sngar gyi lo rgyus byas/ ko taX bhaX ri'i brag phug gi btsag dang / grub pa'i chu bo zhes bya ba chu dmar ser 'bab pa cig yod pa las rkang gdub gang dang / i lo'i ri la yod pa'i grub pa'i sman sna tshogs pa dang /gā dza kha dzu ra'i nags nas 'bras bu gsum/ skyu ru ra'i nags nas kyang 'bru —315—

gsum/ grub pa'i mtsho'i nang nas me tog pad+ma gcig rnams bden pa'i rtags can du khyer ba'ang skye bo rnams la bstan pas/ thams cad ngo mtshar du gyur cing /sdod rgyal po yang dngos grub thob par shes so/ /slad kyis rgyal po dang slob dpon gnyis kyis o rgyan gyi mi rnams la gdams pa bstan pas/ dngos grub thob pa dang rnal 'byor can sha stag tu gyur te/ o rgyan gyi yul de tsam du che ba yang stongs su nye bar gyur skad/ gtam 'di sa ha dza sirnyi 'grel pa bod na yod pa 'di'i gtam rgyud dang cung zad mi mthun mod/ dper na mdo las thams cad sgrol gyi lo rgyus 'dra min mang po 'byung ba bzhin/ in+t+ra dh+wa ti lwa ba par gyur pa mdzad spyod phyogs mthun pa gzhan cig byung na ni mi ca' gal lo/ /yang bod rang na yod pa lhan cig skyes grub kyi 'grel pa'i dpe 'ga' na/ gtam rgyud de med pa'ang snang bas/ rgya dpe la la na yang med par snang zhing / lar rgya gar na yang bstan bcos kha 'phangs dang / tshig sna ring thung 'dra min mang bas deb ther sngon po sogs na dgag sgrub yod de snying po med do/ /rin po che'i ཿnga khungs lta bu'i gtam las/ 'od gsal brgyud pa'i gtam gyi skabs te bzhi pa'o// //slob dpon in+d+ra dh+wa ti dang / lwa ba pa ste slob dpon de gnyis car la/grub thob dza lan+ta ri pas slad gsal dang bde ba chen po'i gdams ngag zhus te/slob dpon de gang du 'khrungs pa'i yul na/ nub phyogs si rgyu'i grong khyer na ga ra tha ṭha zhes bya ba zhig tu rigs dmangs rigs su skyes te/ 'on kyang bsod nams kyi mthus longs spyod chen po dang ldan no/ /phyi zhig na gtsug lag khang zhig tu dge slong byas/ slob dpon lwa ba pa la gdams ngag zhus nas bsgom —316—

zhing yod pa'i tshe/ nam mkha' las sgra byung ste/ khyod o rgyan du song la sgoms shig der 'dod pa'i dngos grub thob par 'gyur zhes 'byung pas/ o rgyan du song ste rgyal po in+d+ra bhā ti dang / lcam ju ka ra dang / slob dpon kats+tsha pā da rnams la rgyud thams cod kyi gdams ngag thos shing / der bsgoms pa'i tshe/tshes bcu'i dus shig na dur khrod du song bas/ der dpal he ru ka'i dkyil 'khor mngon sum du mjal zhing / rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma mang pos dbang bskur bas/ de nyid du phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub kyi go 'phang thob bo de nas ring zhig tu yul de nyid du 'dug nas sems can gyi don ci rigs par mdzad do/ /lan cig ko taX bha ra zhes pa'i grong khyer zhig na yod pa na/ grong khyer gyi mi rnams kyis slob dpon la yang co dris pas/ yun ring po'i bar du slob dpon khro bar mi byed/ dus gzhan zhig na/ grong khyer gyi rigs kyi gtso bo gsum zhig bzhi mdor song / slob dpon ting nge 'dzin la bzhugs pa mthong ba na/ gcig na re/ rnal 'byor ba 'di long ba zhig zer/ gzhan gcig na re/'di ni rnal 'byor pa ma yin lkugs pa zhig go /yang gcig na re/ 'di ni shi ba'i ro zhig go zer ba la/ slob dpon gyis khyed rnams de bzhin du gyur cig ces dmod pa bor bas/ gcig ni mig long / gcig ni ngag lkugs/ gcig de nyid du shi'o/ /der skye bo thams cad 'jigs shing / grub pa thob par grags so/ /de rnams kyi gnyen rnams 'ongs shing gsol ba btang pas/ slar yang gsol/ de nas slob dpon yul dza lan+ta ra rdo dang chu la me 'bar ba'i gnas su bzhugs te/ yun ring po lon pa na mtshan yar yul gyi ming thogs te/ grub —317—

thob dza lan+ta ri pa zhes zer ro/ /dus gcig na rang byung gi mchod rten dang nye ba'i bal yul gyis phyogs shig na/ dbang phyug gi ling ga cho 'phrul shin tu che ba/ zhag bdun du sa the btsugs nas gsol ba btab na/ mig mthong gi mngon shes dang / dbang dang rgyas pa'i las phra mo mang po dang / khyad par drag shul spyod pa'i las 'phral du 'grub pa zhig yod pas/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la bar du gcod pa zhig byung ba/ de 'dul ba'i don du sa phyogs der byon/ res gcig tsa na ling ga de mchod pa la rgyal po yang gsum tsam 'dus shing / skye bo brgya stong du ma tshogs pa'i dbus su/ slob dpon yang byon te/ ling ga la sdigs 'dzub bstan pas mgo zhabs log phus btab pas cha du mar zhig go /der yang skye bo thams cad kyis grub pa thob par shes te zhabs la phyag byas/ de nas lan cig yul tsam ga rngar bzhud de/ de na sdig spyod kyi rgyal po zhig gis/ gtsug lag khang mang po bzhig par brtsams pa na/ rgyal po'i sgo drung na pi waX mkhan mkhas pa zhig byung / pi waX mkhan zhig rgyal po la sems shing 'dug ces bsgo bas rgyal po la sbran pas/ nang du bos pa na/ glu dang pi waX gi sbyor pa mang po byas pas/ rgyal po 'khor bcas dga' bar gyur pa la/ pi waX mkhan de ni rnal 'byor par 'gyur nas song ngo / /der rgyal pos sangs rgyas pa 'di kun skyu mas slu bar byed cing / zhes smras pa la/ slob dpon gyis sangs rgyas pa'i bsngags pa brjod/ mu stegs pa rnams dang / khyad par rgyal po de rang la smad pas/ rgyal pos 'khor rnams la 'di mgo chod ces byas so/ /der mtshon cha sna tshogs bsnun pas/ slob dpon gyi sku la gcig kyang ma gnod/ mi lnga brgyas 'ching bar —318—

brtsams pas kyang / sku 'gul pa yang ma byung / slob dpon gyis thal mo brdabs pas/ rgyal po'i pho brang phyed mar gas/ rgyal po'i 'khor rnams kyang lta stangs kyis rengs par byas pas shin tu 'jigs shing / rgyal po nyid kyis slob dpon gyi zhabs la phyag btsal te/ bdag gis ci zhig bgyi zhes zhus pas/sngar gyi sdig pa bshags pa'i don du gtsug lag khang sngar bas nyis 'gyur du gyis/ der gnas pa'i dge 'dun yang nyis 'gyur gyi lhag pa tshugs/ ma shi bar du dge 'dun la mchod pa gyis/ bu la sogs pa bdun brgyud kyi bar du dge 'dun la mchod pa gyis shig /ces zangs kyi glegs bu gyis gsung / des kyang de bzhin du byas so/ /yang lan cig yul ma la ba na/ rgyal po legs sbyar la bha rta ha ri zhes bya/ da lta 'phral skad bha ra thā ri zhes bya ba/ rta 'bum phrag bco brgyad dang / bud med stong dang bcas pa 'byor zhing rgyas par gnas pa la/ de 'dul ba'i dus yin par mkhyen nas/ grong khyer dang mi ring ba'i phyogs shig tu bzhugs pa na/ mtshan mo'i dus shig chom rkun pa mang po byung / de rnams kyis slob dpon la bskor ba byas/ grong khyer 'joms pa la song bas/ nor mang po thob/ de rnams phan tshun du deng gnod pa med par nor mang po thob pa na/ rnal 'byor pa de'i mthu las yin gyi de bas na thams cad kyis mchod pa bya'o zhes mu tig gi do shal srang brgya stong ri ba la sogs pa mchod pa du mas mngon par mchod nas song ngo / /der mi rnams kyis rgyal po la zhus pas/ rgyal pos kyang rtog pa'i mi btang bas/ slob dpon nor mang po dang bcas pa mthong bas/slob dpon rkun po yin no snyam nas rgyal po la phul/ des kyang ma brtags par —319—

shing gi gsal shing la bskyon no/ /der nyin bar ni sku lus gsal shing gis phug pa'i tshul du 'dug mtshan mo ni de las babs te ting nge 'dzin bsgom zhing bzhugs/ de ltar zhag bdun thal ba na/ rgyal po yang de'i drung du song ngo / /der gsal shing gis phug bzhin pa la gsal shing bcag nas chu klung gi 'gram du khrus mdzad du byon pas/ rgyal po'ang ngo mtshar skyes te/ bzod par gsol nas rjes su bzung bar zhus pas/ rgyal srid spongs la a wa dh+wa tī gyis shig de'i tshe gdams ngag byin par bya'o gsung ba bzhin du rgyal srin kyang yongs su spangs te/ slob dpon gyi phyi bzhin du 'brang song ba na/ dus gzhan zhig na slob dpon gyis gdams ngag kyang gnang ste bsgoms pas ring po mi thogs par rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug tu gyur te/ phyis 'khor lnga brgya dang bcas nas mkha' spyod du gshegs so/ /sngar gyi 'phros la/ slob dpon dza lan+ta ri pa ni phal cher byis pa lta bu'i spyod pa mdzad pas / bā li bā ta te/ byis pa'i zhabs zhes grags so/ /de nas dus phyis shar phyogs pa rnams 'dul bar bzhed nas/ bhang ga la'i tsā ṭi gra ma zhes pa'i grong khyer gyi srang kha 'chag pa'i ha ḍi ba'i tshul bzung zhing yod pa las/ yul de'i rgyal po gzhon nu go bi tsan+da zhes bya ba rgyal srid la 'khod nas ring po ma lon pa zhig yod pa/ rang gi gzugs mdzes pa la yongs su chags te/me long la blta zhing byi byad 'chos pa la/ lan cig gi tshe/ rgyal po de'i mas tho rangs bltas pa na/ slob dpon rgyal po'i bza' shing gi ra bar song nas/ shing rnams kyi rtsa bar 'dug nas/ na ri ke la dhik+ṣa a wo zhes brjod pas/ zhi/nga 'bras rnams slob dpon gyi drung du byung / khu bcud gsol zin pa na/ na ri ke —320—

la u pa ra dza ha/ zhes gsungs pas/ shing 'bras rnams snga ma bzhin du 'byar nas 'gro ba yang yang mthong bas/ rgyal po'i mas/ grub pa thob par shes nas/'dis rgyal po 'dul bar 'gyur ro snyam ste/ lan cig bu'i drung du mchi ma phyung ba na/ rgyal pos smras pas yum ci zhig nyes/ des smras pa/ khyod kyi pha gzugs dang stobs dang blo gros thams cad khyod pas bcu 'gyur gyis lhag kyang / mi rtag pa'i rang bzhin bstan/ khyod kyang 'chi ba'i chos las ma 'das zer/ rgyal pos smras pa/ 'o na mi 'chi ba'i thabs ma mchis sam/ mas smras pa/ rang re'i ha ḍi ba 'di la yod ces smras so/ /rgyal po ha ḍi ba'i drung du song ste khyod kyis nga la mi 'chi ba'i gdams pa ster dgos byas pa na/ des gdams pa yod de/rgyal srid ma spangs na mi 'grub ces gsung / der rgyal pos smras pa/ 'o na thog mar gdams ngag zhus la phyis rgyal srid spong ngo zhes byas nas/ nags tshal dben pa zhig tu/ rgyal po dang slob dpon gnyis kho na song ste/ slob dpon gyis rgyal po la rdza'i bum pa stong pa zhig gtad de/ der lag pa chug gsung bcug pa na/ ci 'dug myur ba myur ba smros gsung / der rgyal pos cang mi 'dug brjod pa na/ de kho na 'chi ba med pa'i lam yin gsung / lan gsum du rgyal pos dris pas kyang / de bzhin du gsungs nas/ rgyal po yid ma ches par 'di ni g.yo can zhig go /zhes sa'i dong gting ring po bcug tsher ma'i shing gis bskor/glang po che'i lci ba dang / rta'i sbangs kyis bkangs te sbas nas bzhag go /de yang slob dpon gyi sku'i bkod pa gnyis bstan pa yin te/ yul dza lan+ta ra na yang kun spangs kyi spyod pas sems can gyi don mdzad/ bhang ga lar yang de —321—

ltar bstan pa yin no/ /de nas phyi zhig gi tshe/ slob dpon nag po spyod pa lho phyogs ka ta li slo tra chu shing gi zhing zhes bya/ phal skad du ka tsa li zhes zer bar byon pa na/ slob dpon nag po spyod pa'i slob ma rnams kyis/ lam du rnal 'byor pa mang po 'dug pa rnams la/ longs longs grub thob nag po spyod pa pa phebs kyi yod byas pas/ gzhan rnams kyis langs/ grub thob go rak+ṣa ni ldang ba mi mdzad do/ /der slob dpon yang byon te/ go rak+ṣa dang gtam mdzad pa na/ ji zhig na go rak+tas/ khyed kyi bla ma gang yin dris pas/ dza lan+ta ri pa yin gsung /go rak+tas/ 'o na dza lan+ta ri pa ni rgyal po go bi tsanas sa dong du bskyur nas lo bcu gnyis lon zhes gsungs pas/ spyod pa pa 'khor stong bzhi brgya dang bcas pa shar phyogs su song nas/ go bi tsan+t+ra'i sgo drung du khros nas bzhugs so/ /der rol mo rnams la yang sgra ma byung / rta dang glang po che yang rtswa shing mi za/ bu chung rnams kyang 'o ma mi 'thung ngo / /de slob dpon gyi mthu yin par shes nas/ rgyal po bcom chung dus phyir phyung nas/ slob dpon 'khor dang bcas pa nang bar zas la 'byon par zhu zhus pas/ slob dpon na re/ nga la 'khor stong dang bzhi brgya yod pas tshims par bya mi nus gsung / rgyal po na re/ ngas dmag mi 'bum phrag du ma la rtag tu 'tsho ba sbyor nus na/ slob dpon 'khor bcas la ci'i phyir mi nus/ slob dpon na re/ 'o na nga'i slob ma ma hi la dang / bha da la gnyis sngon la gtong gi tshims par gyis shig de tshims na phyis kho bo cag kyang 'ong ngo zhes gsungs pas/ rgyal pos kyang / 'bras khal lnga brgya tsam byan dang bcas par sbyar ro/ /der ma hi la dang / bha da la gnyis byon/ zas de dag thams cad —322—

khong gnyis kyi ku bar blug kyang ma khengs pas/ rgyal po ngo mtshar skyes te/ slob dpon gyi drung du song nas/ 'chi ba med pa'i lam 'tshal lo zhus pas/ der slob dpon gyis glang po che bcu gnyis kyi rgyab khal non pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi yo byad blangs te/ rgyal po la dbang bskur ba'i tha mar/ sngar ha ḍi pas bstan pa'i gdams ngag de nyid bstan pas/ rgyal pos 'di ni bdag gis sngar yang thos zhes sngar gyi lo rgyus bshad do/ /der slob dpon na re/ 'o na khyod la 'chi ba med pa'i grub thob ga la 'ong / de ni nga'i bla ma dza lan+ta ri ba yin no gsung /der rgyal po grub thob kyis dmod pa 'ong zer shin tu 'jigs pas/ slob dpon gyis thabs bya'o gsung / rin po che sna brgyad bsres pa'i 'jon dmar la/ rgyal po'i gzugs brnyan gsum byas so/ /der nag po spyod pa'i slob ma rnams kyis/sa sogs nyal nyil thams cad bsal/ rgyal po'i gzugs dong gi khar khyer nas/ grub thob ha ḍi pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal du bcug pas/ bla ma'i zhal nas 'di su yin gsung / rgyal po go bi tsan+d+ra yin zhus pas/ phi ṭu ma ro thal bar gyur cig gsungs pas/ gzugs de thal bar song / yang gzugs gnyis pa phyag 'tshal du bcug pas kyang / snga ma ltar song ngo / /de bzhin du gsum pa yang song ngo / /der rgyal po 'jigs te 'khor dang bcas pa snying 'gas pa tsam du gyur skad/ slar slob dpon gyis rgyal po khrid de/ bzod pa gsol du bcug goder grub thob dza lan+ta ri pa'i gsung gis/ bu ka sni pa khyod la slob ma du yod gsung / stong dang bzhi brgya yod zhus pas/ 'o na nga la tsha bo mang du yod pa 'dugang lo bcu gnyis su ma zos ma 'thungs bkres shing skom pas na nang par gnyis —323—

khrus kyi la shog za ba yin gsung / nang par slob ma gsar pa bdun cu tsam khrus byed du bcug pa las/ gzhan rnams khrus thon pa na bros/ dha ma pa dang dhu ma pa gnyis 'dug pa las/ de gnyis dza lan+ta ri pa'i drung du khrid de mdun du sdod du bcug nas/ chu gris yan lag gi sha rnams gcod par bzas te/ bla ma gang nas gsol zhus pas/ grub thob dza lan+ta ri pa rgya cher bzhad de/ ha ha nga sdom brtson mi sha ci la za/ mig 'phrul mkhan 'dra ba kun bzhud cig gsung / der phyag gnyis dha ma dhu ma'i mgo bor bzhag pas/ de gnyis kyis kyang mchog gi dngos grub thob bo/ /de nas rgyal pos slob dpon dpon slob gnyis yun ring du bsten cing / rang gi sems rgyud kyi dri ma yang rim gyis byang / zla ba drug tu tshogs kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i mthar/ grub thob dza lan+ta ri pas/ rgyal po la do ha rdo rje'i glus gdams pas/ rgyal po 'khor stong dang bcas pa sems rnal du gnas pa mtshon nas/ thams cad kyang srid bor te kun spangs kyi spyod pas rgyu zhing rnal 'byor pa chen por gyur to/ /de la rgyal po bha rta ha ri ni rgyal po go bi tsan+t+ra'i zhang po yin no/ /de nas re zhig na dza lan+ta ri'i phug pa zhig tu slob ma rnams la zhal mi ston par bzhugs/ lan cig gi tshe/ slob ma blun po mang po phug der 'tshangs nas 'ongs pa la/ slob dpon huX zhes gsung bzhin phug gi steng phug ste mi snang bar bzhud/ nam mkha' nas slar yang mi'i yul du lan drug 'byung ngo zhes pa'i sgra byung ngo / /phug de da lta yang byin rlabs che gsung /yang dus phyis shig lho phyogs ra smi shwa ra dang nye ba'i nags tshal zhig tu/ ma mo'i rten rang byung zhig byung ba/ der mkha' 'gro ma dang sha za mang po 'dus te/—324—

phyogs de'i lam la 'gro ba'i skye bo thams cad kyi bla tshe rku bar byed pa la/ lan cig gi tshe/ tshong pa lnga brgya rnal 'byor pa gcig dang bcas pa phyogs der song ba na/ bud med dang bram ze 'ga' zhig byung nas khyed rnams do nub gzhan du mi sleb kya/ nags tshal /'dir 'dug na rtswa dang shing 'dzom la/ gcan gzan dang sbrul gyi gnod pa yang med/ de bas na 'di dang 'dir 'dug ces mi re shing re'i rtsar bzhag go /de rnams de na yod pa'i tshe/ yang bud med gzhan gnyis byung nas/ khyed rnams 'dir sdod ces ston pa de mi shes sam/ mi shes byas pas/ de dag ni mkha' 'gro ma dang srin po yin te/ des khyed rnams bcings so de bas na do nub za bar 'gyur bas/ de'i thabs soms shig ces de nyid du mi snang bar song ngo / /der rnal 'byor pa gcig po de dza lan+ta ri pa'i slob brgyud yin pas/ des slob dpon dza lan+ta ri pa la skad phyung zhing gsol ba btab pas/nam zhig na phyogs der 'gron btsun shig byung ngo / /de yang der 'dug pa la/khong rnams kyis sngar gyi lo rgyus bshad pas/ re zhig 'gron btsun de cang mi smra'o/ /nam srod pa na sha za'i mkha' 'gro ma dang srin po rnams mngon du byung bas/ re res mi re bcings nas khrid nas ma mo'i gnas su bzhag ste za bar brtsams pa na/ 'gron btsun des phu ṭa zhes zer zhing gar byas pas/ mkha' 'gro ma dang srin po rnams brgyal zhing 'gyel/ ma mo'i rten yang dum bu gsum du gyes te/ der slob dpon gyis phyin chad sems can la gnod pa mi byed par bka' bsgos/ 'gron btsun de ni grub thob dza lan+ta ri par snang ste/ tshong pa lnga brgya po de thams cad kyang rnal 'byor pa byas te bsgoms pas/ mthar lnga brgya —325—

po thams cad dngos grub thob pa yin zer skad/ der slob dpon gyis lo gsum tsam du lho phyogs kyi yul du 'gro ba'i don mdzad par grags/ dus der gsungs pa'i gdams ngag kyang mang du yod par snang ngo / /yang dus phyis shig nub phyogs ma dra'i yul du slob dpon dz+nyā na gu pa ta zhes bya ba/ 'khor mang po la chos gsung zhing yod pa'i skabs shig der rnal 'byor pa ngo mtshar can zhig byung nas/ su yin dris pas/ dza lan+ta ri pa yin gsung / yid kyis dri ba mang po byas pas/ de thams cad kyi lan shar shar btab byung bas/ yid ches nas rjes su gzung bar zhus pas/ thod pa rnam snang gis gang ba zhig gnang ba/ slob dpon dz+nyā na gu pa tas rnam rtog med par gsol bas/ de nyid du mi snang bar yal/der dge 'dun rnams kyis yang dang yang du gsol ba bang ba pas/ zla ba gsum tsam du de nyid du bzhugs te/ de rnams la rjes su gdams pa bstan/ de nas rab tu byung ba dang dge bsnyen pho mo yan chad yo bsdoms pas stong tsam yod pa las/ thams cad rdo rje theg pa'i snod du gyur pa yin pas/ de rnams la khyong/ rnams lo gsum du gsang ste nyams su long / lo gsum nas thams cad kyang sngags kyi spyod pa spyod bzhin 'tsho ba ci bde bar song zhig thams cad kyang dngos grub thob par 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs te mi snang bar gyur to/ /der shar phyogs nas rnal 'byor pa drug gis slob dpon dza ladha ri pa dngos su bzhugs nas chos ston zhes thos pas/ gtsug lag khang der 'ongs pa'i tshe/slob dpon gshegs nas mi 'dug yang der sa the btsugs te gsol ba btang pas/ zla ba drug nas dngos su zhal bstan nas gdams pa dang rjes su —326—

gdams pa stsal te/ zhag bdun song ba na nyan thos sen+ta pa zhig der 'ongs/gang zhig rtog ge la dga' ba/ /gang dag dge slong dngos gnas dang / /mi gang rgan por gyur pa ste/ /de la de nyid bstan mi bya/ /zhes gsungs nas mi snang bar gyur skad/ gtsug lag khang der nyan thos sen+ta pa mang du 'ongs shing gnas pa la/ sngar gyi dge 'dun rnams lo gsum 'das pa'i rjes su/ sngags kyi spyod pas phyogs gzhan du rgyu zhing song ba na/ nyan thos rnams kyis yongs su smod par byed do/ /'on kyang ring po mi thogs par thams cad kyis dngos grub sna re thob pas/ grags pa ma yin pa sangs skad/ rnal 'byor pa drug po des 'chi ba med pa'i dngos grub thob/ rgan shos ni bi bhā ti dā sa yin gsung / 'dis bod la yang byon te/ bu ston rin po ches kyang cho so zhus so/ /da dung slob dpon mi'i 'jig rten du lan bzhi 'byon par grags/ slob dpon 'di'i slob ma grub pa brnyes pa na/ nyi zla ltar yongs su grags pa dang por byung ba nag po spyod pa dang /phyis byon pa sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs gnyis yin/ gzhan yang grub chen ta rnyi pa/ bi rū pa chung ba/ rgyal po bha ra thā ra/ go bi tsan+d+ra sogs yongs su grags pa mtha' yas pa zhig yod do/ /skabs 'dir slob dpon de nyid kyi slob ma'i mchog dus 'khor rgyud phyi mar/ kha ṭāX ga dang rus pa'i rgyan cha chang snod cang te thogs pa nag po'i ming can no/ /zhes pa lung bstan pa/ nag po spyod pa pa'i lo rgyus na/ sngon gyi bod rnams yul ka rnar 'khrungs pa yin zhes gsung pa dang / da lta yang rgya gar ba'i rnal 'byor pa rnams kyi kha skad la/ bī du na ga rar 'khrungs zhes zer te/ de yang bī du na ga ra dang / kaṇi ni 'khris nas 'khris kyi yul yin —327—

pas/ snga rabs kyi gtam de de yang rgya gar ba'i kha skad tsam yin no/ /gsung las rigs bram ze yin gsung zhing / rgya gar la kha skad kyang de bzhin du grags/ bod snga ma rnams rje rigs yin zer yang / slob dpon nyid kyi do ha las/ reg gin reg gin 'gro ste bram ze'i bu/ /zhes bram ze'i rigs su gsal de nang don la sbyor yang phyi dang mthun pa'i brda mdzad pa yin pas so/sangs rgyas nyid kyis lung bstan pa yang yul u ru bi sha yin la/ kho bo'i bla ma gsung pa yang yul u ru bi sha de ni bhang ga la dang nye bar yod gsung / lung bstan ni nag po chen po'i rgyud/ mgon po mngon 'byung rtsol bral rwa chos rab kyis bsgyur ba las/ de ltar yul u ru bi sar yang mtshungs par nges pa'o/ /der skyes bu brtson 'grus chen po'i sbyor ba dang ldan pa/ rā ma ṇa'i bka' dang mtshungs pa/ sde tshan dang po'i dang po la dbyangs yig dang pos brgyan pa/ sde tshan bdun pa'i bzhi pa/ cung zad na la zhon pa'i ming can rnal 'byor dbang po gcig pu 'dis dngos grub brgyad thob par 'gyur ro/ /dzam bu'i gling du ma byung zhing 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /de'i slob ma drug gis lus dngos po spangs pa'i phyag rgya chen po thob par 'gyur ro/ /zhes yul dang mtshan dang dngos grub dang slob ma rnams zhib por gsungs pa'o/ /slob dpon chen po 'di'i lo rgyus ni rnam thar logs su 'byung ba las blta bar bya'o/ /slob dpon de la sangs rgyas kyis lung bstan pa'i slob ma drug na/ bzang po'i zhabs/ ma hi la/bha da la/ dge tshul tshim bu pa/ dha ma pa/ dhu ma pa rnams so/ kha cig bha da la/bha dra pa bzang po pa dang gcig zer nas logs su mi bgrong / 'dir bgrong rgyu —328—

e ya la par 'dod/ rnal 'byor ma yang me kha la dang / ka na kha la dang / ban khyu pa la sogs pa de rnams na/ slob dpon nyid bzhugs pa'i dus su mchog gi dngos grub thob pa yin gsung / blon po ku sha la nā tha/ rgyal po li la tsan+d+ra dang /dpag med rdo rje/ rgyal bu la ba yi la sogs pa rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung / bram ze dpal 'dzin la sogs pa dus phyis mjal ba'i dngos grub brnyes pa yang byung ngo / /slob dpon bha dra pas arnyar pa la gdams/des nag po spyod pa chung ba zhes kyang grags pa la gdams/ des bhu ba ri pa la gdams/ des bod du 'khrungs pa bhu ba blo ldan la gdams/ des ku sa li bha dra chung ba la gdams pa'i lugs kyang yod/ yang nag po spyod pas gu phya pa zhes grags pa bzang po'i zhabs la gdams/ slob dpon 'dis bla ma la bar chad byed pa'i mkha' 'gro ma bā hu rī zhes pa de zhing thams cad du mngon shes kyis btsal yang re zhig ma rnyed/ phyi shig na de ldi ko ṭa nyid na shing shim pi la'i sdong po zhig gi khog nang na/ rdul gcig tu brdzus nas 'dug pa mkhyen nas/ de'i co to nas bzung / shing sdong gi nang nas phyir phyung ste grub pa'i ral gris bsnun nas tshar bcad do/ /des slob dpon ti snyi pa la bshad gsung / bod na sngar grags pa la gu phya pas an+ta rba la gdams/ des ti snyi pa la gdams par 'dod/ skabs 'dir mi gsung yang / spyir gyi dus bsgrigs pa dang brgyud pa'i babs la de ngos 'thad par snang ngo / /yang spyod pa pas dge ba'i mgon po la zugad de/ de ni re zhig blon po'i bya ba byed cing bsgoms pas/ mngon shes cung zad thob ste/ rgyal po'i drung du 'dug pa'i tshe/ rang gi lha khang du zho'i rdzi'u zhig —329—

bzhag pa/ byi las ldags pa mngon shes kyis mthong nas de skrod pa'i brda' byas pa/ rgyal pos ci yin dris pa na/ drang por smras pas/ dngos grub thob par shes te/ mchod gnas su bkur/ ring por mi thogs pa rgyal pos kyang mngon shes lnga grub/ blon po ni rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug r+ṣa por gyur to/ /des kyang ti snyi pa la spund do/ /slob dpon ti zhi pa na/ shar phyogs tsa ṭi gha po zhes bya ba'i grong khyer du bram ze'i rigs su skyes te/ cher skyes pa na bram ze'i lugs kyi bstan bcos thams cad shes shing / yul 'ga' zhig tu slong mo la phyin pa'i tshe/mthar gtsug lag khang zhig na/ dge 'dun rnams spong bas gnas pa mthong nas/ der dad de rab tu byung / sde snod gsum gyi tshul yang shes/ sngar smos pa'i slob dpon gnyis la dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba dang / gdams pa mtha' dag mnos nas bsgoms pas ring po mi thogs par ye shes khyad par can skyes te/ grub pa'i skyes bu mtha' yas pa'i zhal yang mthong / de rnams dang gtam 'dre zhing rjes su gdams pa yang thob/ dpal he ru ka dang mkha' 'gro ma'i tshogs rtag tu zhal mthong bas/ de rnams kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i rkyen gyis kyang / ye shes gong nas gong du 'phel bar gyur te/ zhing gi rnal 'byor ma til brdung mkhan gyi bu mo zhig dang lhan cig tu spyod pas/ dge 'dun rnams kyis gnas gzhi nas bskrad/ grong khyer du til brdung gi bya ba mdzad pas/ sngar bram ze'i paṇ+ḍi ta dge slong du gyur pa yin pas/ rnyed bkur chen po yod pa yang nyams te/ til brdung ma'i bdag por gyur pas ti snyi pa ste/ til brdung mkhan zhes ming yang 'gyur ro/ /de nas zhing sna tshogs su spyod cing gnas pas/ o rgyan la —330—

sogs pa'i yul rnams su mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyi gdams pa thams cad thob/des na til brdung ba'i bya ba mdzad pas/ til la mar khu 'byung ba bzhin/ bla ma'i man ngag gis lus la gnad du bsnun pas/ lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes 'byung bar mkhyen pa sogs bya ba thams cad kyis kyang rang la ngo sprad par song ste mchog gi dngos grub thob/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyi zhal yang gcig car mthong ngo / /der rang gi rtogs pa de gzhan la ston par bzhed nas/dus gzhan cig na/ grong khyer gyi tshong 'dus rnams su rtogs pa glur blangs pas/skye bo thams cad the tshom du gyur/ lan cig bhang ga la'i grong khyer cig tu skye bo brgya stong du ma/ slob dpon la bltar 'ongs pa la/ slob dpon rig ma dang lhan cig mi gang tsam gyi nam mkha' la til brdung bzhin 'dug go /mi res dri ba re byas pa la/ lan du rtogs pa'i glu re blangs pas/ der 'tshogs pa'i skye bo phal cher gyis kyang don rtogs nas dngos grub thob pa yin skad/ der grub thob ti l+li pa zhes grags shing / yun ring par 'gro ba'i don mdzad nas/ sku lus ma spangs par mkha' spyod du bzhud pa yin no/ /'di'i slob ma ni rol pa'i rdo rje dang / nā ro pa gnyis yin/ snga ma'i gtam rgyud 'dir mi gsung ste/ mi tra dzo gi'i chos skor na 'dug pa de yin par mngon/ mar do dang / pu rangs lo chung gi lugs kyi bde mchog gi lo rgyus dang / dpyal pa'i dges rdor lo rgyus na/ go ta ma shi rtsi yang slob ma mchog tu bshad do/ /nā ro pa ni kha che'i yul du bram ze'i rigs su 'khrungs/ chung ngu nas mu stegs kyi paṇ+ḍi tar gyur pa la/ der mu stegs pa'i gsang sngags pa byas nas/ bram rigs kyi spyod pa bor/ a ba dhu ti byas so/—331—

lan cig chang 'tshong ma zhig gi nang du phyin pas/ de na sangs rgyas pa'i ba ṇa chung zhig yod pa/ nā ro pa'i zil ma bzod par bros song ba/ de'i shul du ma sto dpe zhig lus 'dug pa gzigs pas/ chos la shin tu mos te/ yul dbus su song nas/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la rab tu byung ste/ paṇ+ḍi ta ches chen por gyur pa na/ nā len+d+ra dang / bi kra ma shī la'i byang sgo bsrung ba mdzad/ der mu stegs rnams tshar bcad kyin nyan bshad rgya cher mdzad pa las/ rang sems ba 'jo ba'i yun tsam yang mi gnas par 'dug nas/ mtshan re bzhin 'khor lo bde mchog rtag tu bsgoms pas/ mkha' 'gro ma mang pos zhal bstan te/ shar phyogs na slob dpon ti snyi pa zhes bya ba yod pas de'i drung du songs shigadangos grub thob par 'gyur ro zhes bskul/ shar phyogs su song nas phyogs thams cad du ti snyi pa btsal bas ma rnyed/ lan cig gtsug lag khang zhig na dge 'dun rnams zas la 'dus te sgo nang nas bsdams/ nā ro pa rung khang na yod tsa na/ mi sngon po btsog btsog 'dra ba zhig byung nas/ nya gson po mang po me mdag la bsreg gin 'dug nas/ der nā ro pas bzlog ma thub/ de rjes dge 'dun rnams byung nas gshe ba la/ de na re/ khyed rnams mi dga' na slar yang chu la btang bas chog gsung ste/ nya mes tshos pa rnams chu la pho bas 'phyong zhing song skad/ nā ro pas de grub thob yin par shes nas/ phyi bzhin song ste zhabs la phyag byas gsol ba btab pas/ khro zhing brdeg pa las/ tshig rnal ma tsam yang mi gsung / ti snyi pa yin nam snyam pa'i tshe yin yin gsung / min nam snyam pa'i tshe min min gsung / der gzhan sems mkhyen pa dang / ti snyi pa yin —332—

par shes/ yang res 'ga' rnal 'byor pa'i spyod pa ltar ston/ res 'ga' spyon par brdzu yin snang / der yang nā ro pa la rnam rtog ma skyes/ lan cig grong khyer na bag ma len pa'i sa shig nas tshod ma mang po blangs te/ slob dpon la drangs pa na/ slob dpon de la zhen zhen ltar mdzad cing 'dug pas/ bla ma 'di la mnyes so snyam ste/ slar yang sngar gyi sar song / de yang rgya gar na nyi ma gcig la mgron du lan gnyis skru ba'i srol med pas/ tshod ma'i snod brkus te khyer 'ongs pa/ mi rnams kyis ded pas/ dbyugs pa dang rdo mang po lus la phog kyang / snod ma shor bar tshod ma rnams bla ma la drangs/ yang lan cig srin bu dza lu ka ste pad pa mang po yod pa'i chu kha zheng chung ngu zhig gi 'gram na/ bla ma phar tsam tshur tsam mdzad/ der nā ro pas/ bdag chu'i dbus su zhugs nas zam pa bgyi'am zhus pas/ rung gsung / de ltar byas pas/ nā ro pa'i mgo bor zhabs bzhag nas mchongs te phar byon/ nga myur du ldog 'ong bas de khar sdod cig gsung / bla ma yun ring rab ma byung / tshur lam yang bla mas snga ma bzhin byon/ der srin bu pad pas lus kyi khrag thams cad 'jibs te 'chi ba la thug par song / yang rim gyis gsos nas/ bla ma'i phyi bzhin song ba na/ lam du rgyal po'i bu mo mdo li la btegs nas byung ba dang 'dzom pas/ ti l+li pa na re/rgyal po'i bu mo 'di phrogs shig gsung / na ro pas bram zer brdzus te/ shis pa brjod pa ltar byas nas/ bu mo'i mgo bor me tog bzhag ste/ stobs kyis khrid nas bros pas/ g.yog rnams kyis nā ro pa brdungs te ldang mi thub par sa la ro bzhin song / de slob dpon gyi thabs kyis gsos nas/ yang lam du song ba —333—

las/ blon po'i chung ma 'gro ba dang / bag ma zhig 'gro yin 'dug pa la yang snga ma ltar gsung nas/ gsos pa'i bar gong bzhin/ der bla ma bud med bzhed par 'dug snyam ste/ rigs mtho ba'i bu mo zhig pha ma la rin spyin te nā ro pa rang gis blangs nas/ nang par bla ma la 'bul snyam ste/ de nub rang gis bsten pas/ nang par bla mas nā ro pa'i rtags rdo'i bar du bcer/ der nyin zhag mang por shin tu na par gyur pa na/ bla mas sngags btab pas gsos/ der bud med de slob dpon la phul pa las/ lan cig bu mo de nā ro pa la blta rgod byed pa la/ bla mas khyod nga la mi dga' bar 'di la dga' ba zhes de dang nā ro pa gnyis car brdungs so/ /de dag kyang nā ro pa'i dad pa brtan mi brtan brtags pa yin pa las nā ro pa ma dad pa ma skyes par ma zad dad pa phyir zhing 'phel lo yang lan cig dpon slob gnyis khang bzang gi rtse mo zhig na yod pa la/ 'di na mar mchongs nus pa gcig byung na nga dga' ste gsung pa la/ bla ma'i thabs kyis myur du gsos 'ong snyam ste/ nā ro pas mchongs pas yan lag rnams chag der bla ma nyin zhag mang por byon ma byung / da yongs 'chi ba las 'os med snyam pa la/ bla ma byon te sngags btab pas gsos/ de ltar lo bcu gnyis su dka' ba dpag tu med pas bla ma bsten kyang / tha na tshig legs pa gcig kyang ma gsungs skad/ de nas lan cig thang stong pa cig tu/ da ngas gdams ngag bstan gyi maṇ+ḍal phul gsung / 'di na chu dang me tog mi 'dug zhus pas/ khyod kyi lus la khrag dang sor mo yang med dam gsung / khrag gtar te khrag gis chag chag btab/ sor mo rnams bcad de tshom bur bkod/ der ti snyi pas/ nā ro —334—

pa'i sor mo rnams bsdus nas/ 'jim pa dang mchil lham na ro pa'i gdong la rgyab pas/ yug cig dran med du song / /sangs tsa na chos thams cad kyi de kho na nyid mngon sum du mthong / sor mo'ang gsos so/ /slar yang gdams pa dang rjes su gdams pa mtha' dag stsal/ der nā ro pa rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug tu gyur pa la/ ti zhi pa na re/ da khyod rtsod pa ma byed/ slob ma ma bsten/ bshad pa ma byed/ de ltar na myur du mchog thob par 'gyur gsung / de nas phu lā ha rir spros med kyi ting nge 'dzin la gnas pa'i tshe/ lan cig mu stegs dang rtsod pa byed dgos byung ste/ de yang dge 'dun gyi sde cig tu mu stegs kyi rgol ba mkhas po zhig rtsod par byung / de dang rtsod nus pa ma byung pa'i skabs rgan mo zhig na re/dpal snyan grags bzang po gaX yo na 'dug pa la zer ba/ dge 'dun rnams kyis btsal pas rnyed/ rtsod par zhus pas sangs rgyas pa'i bstan pa la phan par dgongs nas/ de'i nang par rtsod pa mdzad tsa na/ rtsod pa cung zad pham pas nga lta bu'i smra ba'i dbang phyug ci phyir pham snyam bsams pas/ bla ma'i bka' dran te/ bla ma la gsol ba btab pas/ de ma thag rtsod pa yang rgyal/ ti l+li pa mi thod khrag 'dzag pa thogs nas 'jigs 'jigs 'dra ba sprang po'i rnam par mngon sum du byon/ nā ro pas zhabs la phyag byas/ mu stegs na re/ khyod sangs rgyas pa snying rje can yin zer yang / snying rje med pa'i srin po 'di la phyag 'tshal ba rang gis khyod pham pa yin byas pas/ ti snyi pas mu stegs pa'i lha khang la sdigs 'dzub mdzad de/ pham mo pham mo zhes bro brdungs pas/ lha khang zhig ste/ der rtsod pa dang nus pa gnyis ka sangs rgyas pa rgyal lo/ /bla ma'i bka' cung zad —335—

bcag pa des/ sku tshe de la mchog gi dngos grub ma thob/ sku lus bor ma thag tu sangs rgyas pa yin gsung / slob dpon 'di ni phal cher phul+la ha ri nyid du bzhugs/ skabs skabs su yul sna tshogs su rgyu zhing dbang bskur ba dang / rgyud dang gdams ngag gsung pa dang / mu stegs can rtsod pas tshar gcod pa la sogs pa mkhas pa'i bya ba mang po'ang mdzad/ gtso bor las chen bcu gnyis thogs med du grub pa'i sgo nas sems can gyi don mdzad/ yi dam gyi lha thams cad kyi zhal rtag tu gzigs pa/ thun mong gi dngos grub nyams 'og tu chud pa'i sgrub pa po chen po yin no/ /slob dpon 'di'i slob ma na/ rtsod dus kyi thams cad mkhyen pa shān+ti pa la sogs pa sgo bsrungs kyi paṇ+ḍi ta dang / jo bo rje a ti sha la sogs pa bstan pa'i mnga' bdag mang po yod/ thun mong ma yin pa'i slob ma'ang / nga khrind rgyud 'dzin pa la pha rgyud la mkhas pa bzha/ ma rgyud la mkhas pa bzhi ste brgyad do/ /dang po bzhi na/ nag po 'jigs med rdo rje/ pi ṭo ha du/ dza yā ka ra/ kha che a ka ra sirnyi 'o/ /phyi ma bzhi na/ ma na ka shā/ dharma ma ta/ phaX ting pa chen po/ pradz+nyā rak+ṣi ta'o/ /de rnams kyang nus pa la mnga' brnyes pa sha stag goyang kha cig pi ṭa ha du/ dharma ma ti dang gcig snga ma bzhi la/ dz+nyā na gar+bha bgrong zer/ grub pa brnyes pa'i slob ma bzhi ste/ dpal mchog toX bi pa/ ri ri pa/kan+ta pa/ ka so ri pa ste thams cad kyang dngos grub thob pa'o/ /slob ma bzhi gsum bcu gnyis 'di bod na sngar grags pa ltar bkod pa yin no/ /dpal mchog zloX bi pa na/ dang po rgyal po'i ba glang mang po'i rdzi bo yin te/ klog kyang mi shes pa yin pa la/ nā ro pa dgon pa zhig na bzhugs pa la mos pa skyes nas/—336—

yang nas yang du 'o ma dang mar drangs so/ /de nas slob dpon nā ro pas/sems bskyed pa zhig kyang bslabs/ dges pa rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur nas sgom thabs shig kyang bslabs/ des kyang bsgom bzhin yod pa'i tshe/lan cig chus khyer pas/ nya zhig gis mid/ nya'i khog nang du he ru ka'i dkyil 'khor zhal mthong ste gnod pa med par phyir phyung / de nas slob dpon gyi drung du kun spangs kyi spyod pa byas te/ rtse gcig tu bsgoms pas/ mchog gi dngos grub nyams 'og tu chud de/ chos thams cad dang / khyad par rdo rje'i theg pa thams cad la blo gros kyi snang ba rgyas/ slob ma mang po la yang bshad pas/ dngos grub thob pa byung / der bstan bcos mang po rtsom dgos pa byung nas/ yi ge slar bslabs pas mu stegs dang / nang pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta thams cad co 'dri ba chos kyi gtam gyis tshar bcad/ phyogs thams cad du snyan pa'i grags pas khyab a ti sha'i yang bla ma yin/ bod rnams jo bos dngos su ma mjal zer yang / mi g.yo ba don dam pa sgrub pa zhes pa jo bos mdzad par yang / ḍom+bi pa la dngos su gsan par bshad cing / des mdzad pa'i bstan bcos de nyid bzhi pa la/ jo bos mdzad pa'i 'grel pa yang snang ba der yang chos de dag dngos su thob pa'i tshig snang ba dang / rgya gar mkhas pa rnams mjal bar mdzad kyin 'duga'agrel pa de'i glegs bam gyi rgya dpe yang / slob dpon ni rbu ṇa shrī'i phyag na 'dug pa kho bos kyang mthong ngo / /slob dpon ḍom+bi chung ba de la ku sa la bha dra chung bas zhus pa yin no/ /slob dpon de ni rgya gar nub phyogs me bar zhes bya bar 'khrungs/ chung ngu nas rig pa'i gnas mang po mkhyen/ mu stegs kyi bla ma —337—

chen po cig la rab tu byung bar zhus pas/ des ma khrid/ 'o na mu stegs 'di rnams thams cad sun phyung dgos snyam nas/ dpal rdo rje'i gdan pa'i drung du rab tu byung / sde snod thams cad la shin tu mkhas par sbyangs/ slar ka ma dra'i yul du bram zer brdzus te phyin nas/ mu stegs kyi paṇ+ḍi ta dang bram ze drug tsam 9 4// mu stegs kyi grub mtha' thams cad mkhas par bslabs/ ka ma rle'i yul gyi sgyu ma dang / bi dze gi ri pa'i lugs kyi sngags mang po dang / mkha' 'gro ma'i ngan sngags mang po dang / shung nga ra'i sngags kyi rigs mang po bslabs shing grub par byas/ sngar gyi nub phyogs na yod pa'i mu stegs kyi paṇ+ḍi ta rnams kyi rtsa ru song / rgyal po kaṇ+ḍa zhes bya ba gcig yod pas/ dpang por bzhag sangs rgyas pa'i rnal 'byor pa dang paṇ+ḍi ta ni nyis stong tsam 'dus/ mu stegs ni brgyad stong tsam 'dus nas rtsod pa byas pas/ slob dpon rig pa bzang zhing mu stegs kyi rgyus yod pas/ re re bzhin du thams cad sun phyung / der cho 'phrul 'gran par byas pas/ mu stegs pa'i rnal 'byor pa zhig gis nam mkha'i skar ma gnyis sa la phab pa ltar snang ba na/ mi mgo'i gzugs can khang pa tsam nag po gnyis 'dug skad/ de ni slob dpon gyis mig 'phrul yin par shes nas/ de bzhig pa'i sngags bzlas pas/ de gnyis sol ba rdog po gnyis su song / mi thams cad kyis mig 'phrul du go /mu stegs 'ga' res lus la me 'bar ba sogs ston pa la/ der chu phab pas me rnal ba sogs re re nas sun phyung ste thams cad sgyu mas sgyu ma bcom pa yin gsung / mthar mu stegs kyi gtso bo bzhi slob dpon gyis sngags btab pas byi lar song / shung nga ri'i sngags kyis der —338—
