tshogs pa'i mu stegs thams cad kyi khyim gyi yo byad thams cad sa rdor btang /der mu stegs rnams phams te/ re zhig yul der sangs rgyas pa shin du dar bar byung / da ltar yang mang bar yod gsung / der slob dpon gyis bsams pa/nga'i 'di kun rdzu 'phrul ni ma yin/ rig sngags sna tshogs kyis mi rnams kyi mgo bskor ba yin pas nyes pa che zhing / sngon chad thos bsam thams cad chags sdang gi dbang du gyur pas/ da ni kun spangs bya'o snyam nas tsar ya pa'i rnal 'byor pa byas thugs dam mdzad kyin yod pa las/ slob dpon dpal mchog ḍom+bi pa dang mjal/ bde dges kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba zhus nas/gdams ngag thams cad kyang thob par byas/ de bzhin du gong du brgyud pa so so'i skabs su smos pa'i bla ma thams cad kyi drung du song ste/ snga ma bzhin du bla ma thams cad mnyes shing / gdams ngag kyang thob yun ring du bsgoms pas/grub chen nag po spyod pa dang / bi rū pa dang / byā da pa la sogs pa/ sngon byon gyi grub chen mang po dang yang mjal te/ de rnams kyis kyang gdams pa re yang gnang / khong nyid kyis lo bcu gnyis su shar phyogs sa ra bhang ga'i nags tshal du 'dug ste kha zas kyi 'khri ba bcad nas chu kho na gsol zhing bsgrubs pas/rtogs pa nam mkha' dang mnyam pa skyes/ g.yang sa la bya bzhin du bzhud pa dang / zla ba tsam gyi lam chu tshod gcig gis bgrod pa dang / gcan gzan gtum po rnams kyis rnyed bkur byed pa dang / 'byung po bran du 'khol pa dang /yi dam gyi lha du ma'i zhal gzigs pa dang / sems can rnams kyi bsam pa shes pas/ de dang mthun par chos ston pa yin no/ /dus de tsam na rgya gar tsam —339—

na yang gdams ngag che/ grub pa thob par grags/ lan cig slob dpon nag po spyod pa dang dngos su mjal nas/ khyod spros bcas kyi spyod pa gyis/ nga'i rjes su 'brang ba tsarla pa thams cad kyi gtso bor 'gyur/ ngas byin gyis rlob po zhes lung bstan/ 'khor rig ma nyi shu tsam dang bcas te yul sna tshogs su spros bcas kyi spyod pa lo bcu gsum mdzad/ tsarla pa'i rnal 'byor pa thams cad kyis zhabs la gshugs/ mthar de ldi ko ṭa'i dgon par lo bdun cu don gnyis bzhugs/ slar slob dpon 'dis lo brgya lnga bcu rtsa bdun bzhugs pa yin gsung / phyis kyi tsarla pa rnams kyi sde sgrigs bkod can 'di 'dzugs mkhan slob dpon 'di yin no/ /de'i slob ma ni mang yang / 'dir slob dpon a si ta gha na yin te/ de yang thog ma mu stegs kyi rnal 'byor pa zhig yin/ yul ni pra ya ga ra 'khrungs/ sgra dang rtog ge la mkhas/ lha dbang phyug chen po bsgrubs pas grub pa'i dngul chu byin/ des mi ma yin gyi gnas mang por 'gro ba dang / lus mi rgas pa la sogs pa byung / ma mo dang 'byung po'i sngags mang pos drag shul spyod pa grub/ der nga rgyal che bar yod pa la/ tsarla pa'i rnal 'byor pa zhig dang nus pa 'gran pas/ dngul chu'i dngos grub kyang nus pas phrogs/ khong gi drag shul spyod pa'i mthu gcig kyang ma song bas der sangs rgyas pa la mos nas/paṇ+ḍi ta pra bha bar ma dang/ slob dpon wo po rat+na rak+ṣi ta dang / bi bhu ti tsan+d+ra dang / de wa ā ka ra la sogs pa mang po la gdams ngag zhus/ rgyud kyang bde dges 'jigs byed gdan bzhi 'dus pa sde lnga zhus shing mkhyen/ slar slob dpon ku sa li bha dra chung ba dang mjal/ bka' babs kyi gdams ngag thams —340—

cad kyang gnang / rtse gcig tu bsgoms pas/ 'dod yon gyis sems la gnod par byung nas/ nags su lo bdun dka' ba spyod cing bsgoms/ der lha yi nga dang / byā da li pa la sogs pa sngon gyi grub thob mang po dang dngos su mjal te gdams pa yang thob/ khyod grong khyer du songs shig 'dod pa'i don 'grub par 'gyur ro zhes gsungs te/ nang par grong khyer du song bas/ de na glu gar mkhan mang po glu gar rtse ba mthong bas rkyen byas te/ sems rgyud yongs su grol nas dngos grub thob/ der rdzu 'phrul gyis bzhud nas skye bo rnams la chos mang du bstan/ de nas yul sna tshogs su skal ba dang ldan pa rnams la ngo mtshar ba'i ltas cung zad ston cing snying po'i don bshad pas/ skye bo rgyud grol ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung ngo / /lo nyis brgya tsam sku lus de kas bzhugs/ slob dpon 'dis rtogs pa don gyi glu blangs pa dang / rgyud sde'i bstan bcos chung ngu mdzad pa yang mang du snang ngo / /des ye shes bzhes gnyen la gdams te/ paṇ+ḍi ta mkhas brgyud byas na rnam grangs mang mod kyang zhib par mi gsung / byin rlabs bka' babs kyi brgyud pa 'di'i dbang du byas na/ slob dpon ku sa li chung ba dang / a si ta gha na dang / ye shes bshes gnyen gsum gyi ring la paṇ+ḍi waṃ brgyud pa ded na/ bla brgyud bco lnga nye shu yong bar snang ngo / /slob dpon de ni rigs dmangs rigs/ yul ti pu ra/ shar phyogs dza gad da la'i gtsug lag khang du rab tu byung / sde ba ni mang pos bkur ba yin/ de'i lugs kyi 'dul ba dang / mngon pa'i sde snod kyang mkhyen/ theg pa chen po'i gzhung lugs kyang mang du mkhyen/ khyad par gsang sngags la mkhas pa'i slob dpon mang po la —341—

thugs nas/ 'dus pa gshin rje gshed/ bde dgyes/ zla gsang thig le/ phyag chen thig le/ dus kyi 'khor lo rnams mkhas par mkhyen/ yang dharma pa'i slob brgyud kyang yin/ tsarla pa yang yin pa zhig la mahā mā ya dang gdan bzhi zhus/ de rnams ci rigs rigs bsgom zhing yod pa'i tshe/ grub thob a si ta gha na dang mjal/ bka' babs gsum gyi gdams ngag ma lus pa gnang / der rdzogs rim gyi rtogs pa khyad par can skyes shing bla ma la zhus pas/ da ste lo bcu gnyis na ye shes grub pa'i slob dpon zhig zla ba'i gling du 'byung / nga'i gdams ngag gis rgyu byas/ de'i gdams ngag gis rkyen byas te/ khyod kyis phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub thob par 'gyur gsungs nas/ slob dpon ni o rgyan du 'gro gsung ste nam mkha' la gya gyur bzhud do/ /bar der lo bcu gnyis bsgoms pas rtogs pa bzang po skyes te/ da ni spyod pa cig bya snyam pa la da lta mu stegs mang bas mi kun gyis tho cor mthong na bstan pa la gnod snyam ste re zhig bshol/ der lan cig zla ba'i gling du byon pa zhig la/ slob dpon dga' byed skyong de sa 'og dpal gyi sgo nas thon te gling der byon pa dang mjal/ der phyag rgya bzhi'i gdams ngag zhus pas/ phyag rgya gzhan gsum gyi skabs/gdams ngag nga rang che snyam/ de nas phyag rgya chen po bshad pas/ bla ma de ye shes kyi skur gzigs/ sems rang bzhin gyi lhan skyes bde chen gyi don mngon sum du mthong / the tshom thams cad chod cing chos thams cad kyi gting sleb/slob dpon dga' skyong dpal gyi sgor bzhud nas/ lo phyed dang nyis brgya na shar phyogs su 'thon/ a si ta gha na dang mjal/ de nas lo nyis brgyar nye ba'i —342—

mtshams su slob dpon 'di dang mjal ba yin/ de nas slob dpon 'di spyod pa spyod par bzhed de/ sngar gyi dge 'dun gyi gnas der ma bzhugs/ tsarla pa'i gnas rnams su spyod cing rab tu byung ba'i rtags ni ma bsgyur/ spyod pa ni spros bcas kyi spyod pa gtso bor lo gsum mdzad cing / spros med kyi spyod pa yul sna tshogs su rgyu ba shin tu spros med kyi spyod pa dang bsres kyin lo drug tsam mdzad de/ phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub kyi go 'phangs grub/ lan cig o ḍi sha na/ mu stegs kyi lha khang dza gad nā tha zhes bya ba/ lha khyab 'jug gi rdo sku rang byon cho 'phrul shin tu che ba yin pa la/ slob dpon rnal 'byor ma bzhi dang bcas nas lha khang gi sgo drung na bzhugs nas/ dkon gnyer la lha khang mjal bar zhus pas/ des kyang gnas gzhi'i bdag po mu stegs kyi bla ma zhig la smras pas/ de na re/ sangs rgyas pa 'di kun 'o skol gyi lha la ma dad mod kya/ de khyim btsun zhig yin snang bas yul lha'i 'du shes kyis mjal ba yin yong / de thong zer/ der slob dpon lha khang du byon pa na/ slob dpon ri mo la blta bzhin du yun ring du 'dug go /dkon gnyer bas dbyug pa brdegs pas/ der slob dpon gyis rwa dung bus pa na/ dza gad nā tha la sogs pa lha khang de'i rdo sku thams cad yan lag dang dbang po thams cad brul te/ sngar gyi cho 'phrul rnams chung du song / sngon gyi sangs rgyas pa'i sde zhig pa rnams kyang slar gsor btub pa byung ste/ bar skabs su rgyal po gsum tsam gyi bar la/ lo brgya tsam du o ḍi shar sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa shin tu dar bar byung / da lta yang tho re ba yod gsung /slob dpon 'di yang lta stangs bzhi thogs pa med par grub nas sems can gyi —343—

don mdzad cing / khyad par ga myos lus sa kyi don mngon sum du gzigs nas rgya cher bshad pas rtsod pa'i dus kyi tha mar gyur pa yin kyang / nam mkha' lta bu'i rtogs pa brnyes pa stong du longs ba byung skad/ thun mong gi dngos grub thob pa yang mang du byung / mchog gi dngos grub mngon gyur du thob pa ni slob dpon sto ka ra zhes bya ba zangs gling du 'ja' lus thob pa zhig dang / rnal 'byor ma zla 'od ces bya ba dang / rnal 'byor ma bha dza ru ru zhes bya ba ste snga slob gsum mo/phyi slob grub chen zhi ba sbas pa ste bzhi'o/ /rin po che'i 'byung khungs lta bu'i gtam las/ 'od gsal la sogs pa bka' babs bzhi gcig tu 'dres pa'i gtam gyi skabs te lnga pa'o/ /bka' babs lnga pa na/ bskyed pa'i rim pa 'phrin las dang bcas pa yin te/ de yul dbus kha bi zhes pa'i nang tshan/ grong khyer rdo 'jog ces par/bram ze'i slob dpon shin tu mkhas pa zhig yod pa/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la lhag par dad de/ nā len ra dge 'dun phal chen po'i sde la rab tu byung ste/ bzhi shrī dz+nyā na zhes bya ba sangs rgyas dpal ye shes zhes mtshan btags so/ kha cig na/ slob dpon 'di rgyal rigs klog pa po cig yin zer ba'ang 'dug der slob dpon seng ge bzang po la theg pa che chung gi chos mtha' dag legs par bslabs/ gu ṇa mi bhā zhes bya bas gsol ba btab ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsdud pa'i 'grel pa sogs bstan bcos kyang mang du byas/ gu ṇa mi tru 'di bod pa'i phar phyin gyi chos brgyud la bzhugs/ dge slong ma yin par zhal lung 'grel pa las bshad do/ /de nas nub phyogs o rgyan du song / slob dpon —344—

sgeg pa'i rdo rje dang / rnal 'byor ma gu ne ru zhes bya ba la gsang sngags phyi nang gi chos mang du zhus/ ting nge 'dzin bzang po thob/ o rgyan gyi byang phyogs na gdol pa'i bu mo dzā ti dza la zhes bya ba/ lcam dpal mo dang rgyud gcig pa zhig la zla ba brgyad brten/ dzam bha la'i lung thob pa tsam gyis rig sngags grub/yul dza lan+ta rar slob dpon byis pa'i zhabs te/ bā li pa da zhes bya ba la shes rab kyi rgyud zhus/ 'di grub thob dza ra ri pa'i sku'i rnam 'gyur ka yin par grags/ der shes rab brgyud la chu bo rgyun gyi ting nge 'dzin thob/ de nas lho phyogs kong ka na zhes bya ba shing nam mkha' na skye ba zhig na/ slob dpon pā li ta pa da ste/ slob dpon bsrung ba'i zhabs zhes bya ba/ rdzu 'phrul dang ldan pa'i slob ma rnal 'byor pho mo bco brgyad tsam dang bcas pa la/ yo byad thams cad ni nor rgyun mas spyor/ de la gsang ba 'dus pa zhu zhing lo dgu bsten/ rgyud tshar bco brgyad nyan/ 'on kyang de kho na nyid cung zad ma rtogs nas/ bla ma la zhus pas/ kho bos kyang ma rtogs gsung / der mā la mo di zhes bya ba'i phyag rgya zhig yod pa 'dus pa'i glegs bam du bsgyur te mgul du btags nas/ rdo rje gdan gyi rgyab/ ku pa'i tshal zhes bya bar sgrub pa lan gsum spyad pas zla ba bco brgyad dang / drag shul spyod pa zla ba drug tu bsgrubs pas/ lung bstan pa byung ste/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal la the tshom chod zer/ 'o na 'jam dpal rgya nag ri bo rtse lnga na bzhugs pas der 'gro dgongs te/ dpag tshad bcu tsam byang shar du song ba na/ nyi ma ma phyed tsam gyi dus shig tu khang pa dkar po zhig gi drung na/byim btsun rgan po sham thabs bye ba/ chos gos kyi thod byas pa zhig bud med —345—

ngan ma gcig dang lhan cig zhing rmod pa mthong ste cung zad ma dad/ de dang nye ba ni khyi mo dkar mo ngan ma gcig kyang nyal nas 'dug go /der nyin mo'i dus tshod bsod snyoms kyi dus la babs pas na/ kha zas bslangs pas/ yur ba nas nya zhig bzung khyi mo la byin/ der skyugs pa slob dpon la drangs pas rnam rtog gis ma gsol/ der khyim btsun na re/ 'dzam bu gling pa rnam rtog che/ zas bzang po drongs zer nas gzhan zhig tu song ngo / /der bud med des 'bras chan dang / zho bzang po drangs pa gsol nas 'byon par chas tsa na/ de ring grong du mi sleb nang bar song zer bas der bzhugs te/ gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud bton pas/ the tshom gyi gnas gang yin pa der/ bud med de mi dga' ba'i rnam 'gyur re byed kyin 'dug nas/ 'di gzhan sems shes pa'o dgongs nas/ bdag gi the tshom gcod pa zhu byas pas/ ngas mi shes/ da ci'i khyim btsun de 'dus pa la shin tu mkhas/ nyi ma phyi phred na sleb 'ong de la the tshom chod zer ba ltar/ phyi phred na chang gis bzi nas 'khyor bzhin byung / der sngags kyi spyod pa can du shes te ma dad pa spangs te zhabs la phyag btsal nas the tshom rnams zhus pas/ dbang bskur dgos gsung / sngar gzhan la thob zhus pas nga'i chos ston pa la nga rang gis dbang bskur dgos gsung / dkyil 'khor khang pa zhig tu zhugs so/ /nam srod kyi dus su slob dpon nang du bos pa la/ 'jam pa'i rdo rje lha bcu dgu'i dkyil 'khor mngon sum du bzhugs pa'i drung na/ sngar gyi sprul pa'i dge slong bud med dang khyi mor bcas pa yang snang ste/ su la dbang len gsung / de rnams ngo bo gcig par shes kyang / rnam pa dkyil 'khor la mos nas/ dkyil 'khor —346—

las 'tshal zhus pas/ 'o na long gsung ste/ de gsum khang chung gzhan zhig tu song / dkyil 'khor yang mi snang bar gyur/ der slob dpon thugs skyo bas tho rangs kyi dus/ khyod ni sems can kun gyi yab ste zhes sogs gsol ba btab pas/ dkyil 'khor snga ma bzhin du sprul te dbang bskur nas/ 'jam dpal zhal lung bshad/ der slob dpon dgongs pa ni nam mkha' dang mnyam par gyur/ chos thams cad kyi gting sleb/ dang por zas nya sha khyis skyugs pa dang /khyim btsun gyi spyod pa gnyis dang / rjes su rnam pa khyim btsun rgan po la ma dad pas 'ja' lus ma grub/ bar dor dngos grub mchog brnyes par 'gyur ba'o/de nas rang gi rtogs pa thabs rim gnyis khyad par can dang bcas pa rgya cher spel bar bzhed nas/ chos kyi myu gu zhes bya ba'i gnas/ skye bo mang po 'du bar rung la/ bsam gtan yang mthun pa/ sngon gyi byang chub sems dpas bsten pa zhig yod de/ der dzam bha las yon bdag byas/ snod dang ldan pa mang po la chos bshad pas/ phyogs bzhi'i mkhas pa paṇ+ḍi ta la sogs pa'i slob ma mang du 'dus pa la/ 'jam dpal gyi dgongs pa rgya cher bshad pas/ snyan pa'i grags pas sa steng thams cad khyab/ lung dang mthun pa'i chos bcu bzhi mdzad/ slob dpon pā li pa des kyang / 'jam dpal gyi lung gi gdams ngag rnams zhus pas mchog gi dngos grub thob bo/ /rdo rje gdan mchod pa'i lo rgyus na/ lan cig slob dpon rdo rje gdan dang nye ba na spyil po mdzad nas bzhugs pa'i tshe/rgyal po dharma pā la rdo rje gdan la mchod pa la 'ongs pas/ sangs rgyas pa'i slob dpon gzhan thams cad mchod pa la byon/ slob dpon 'di mchod pa mi byed —347—

par mthong nas chad pas gcod dgos snyam ste/ slob dpon gyi spyil por zhugs pas/ de na slob dpon mi bzhugs par 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi sku zhig mthong / phyir 'ongs te 'khor rnams la dris pas/ 'di nyid na yod zer/ yang nang du 'ongs pas slob dpon du snang / der khyod mchod pa mi byed pa ci yin dris pas/ nga 'di nyid nas mchod pa'i 'bul gsung / des ji ltar 'bul dris pas/slob dpon gyi dgongs pa la mnyam par bzhag pas/ rdo rje gdan gyi lha sku thams cad mngon sum du slob dpon gyi drung du mgron du bos pa ltar byung ste/slob dpon gyis de la rgya chen po'i mchod pa byed par mthong / der rgyal po yid ches nas/ dbang bskur ba zhus te yon gzhan med nas/ rang nyid btsun mo dang bcas pa 'bangs su phul/ nang par pho brang nas khong rang thams cad kyi lus tshad dang mnyam pa'i gser bslus mar phul lo/ /bi kra ma shī la'i rab gnas kyi lo rgyus na/ yang bi kra ma shī la dang / o tan+ta pu ri dang / shrī nā lan+da dang / so ma pu ri ste/ gtsug lag khang bzhi po de/ so so'i bar bar na nyin lam mang pos chod pa yin cing / bi kra ma gsar bzhengs yin/ so ma pu ri zhig gsos yin zer/ gzhan gnyis na'ang rgyal pos lha khang gsar du bzhengs pa mang du yod pa rnams la rab tu gnas par zhus pas/ slob dpon gyis sku'i bkod pa bzhi sprul te/ gtsug lag khang bzhi car la rab tu gnas pa dus gcig tu mdzad/ de skabs bi kra ma shā lar/ rab gnas kyi zhal bsro chen po yod pa'i skabs/ mu stegs kyi rnal 'byor ma dpon g.yog gnyis kyis skrur 'ongs pas/ dge tshul ma rungs pa rnams kyis brdungs so/ /g.yog mos 'di la nus pa ston dgos —348—

zhes yang yang gsol ba btang pas/ dpon mos sngags bzlas pas/ rab gnas kyi dkyil 'khor gyi 'og nas chu brdol/ der slob dpon gyis rdul sto gyi dkyil 'khor nam mkha' la btegs pas/ des char drag po phab bo/ /de yang slob dpon gyis phyag bkab ste bsrungs pas/ dkyil 'khor la gnod pa ni ma byung zhing / rab gnas legs so/ /phyis kyang lo re'i dus la de'i nyin par mu stegs kyi gnod pa re yong / tshugs ni mi tshugs so/ /nā len+d+ra btul ba'i lo rgyus na/ der slob dpon chen po des/ nā len+t+ra dang / bi kra ma la shī la'i gnas kyi bdag po yang mdzad/ de skabs o tan+ta pu ri na gnas pa'i nyan thos sen+ta pa rnams dang / rnam par rtog pas g.yengs pa'i dge slong rnams kyis ngan du zer zhing / slob dpon nā len+t+ra ra bzhugs pa'i skabs shig na/ dge slong de rnams kyis/ sangs rgyas ye shes tshul khrims dang mi ldan pas dge 'dun gyi mkhan por rung pa ma yin zhes yang yang rgol ba dang / gsang sngags la gshe zhing / rdo rje gdan gyi sen+ta pa sing gha la pa mang pos/ he ru ka'i sku brnyan dngul las bsgrubs pa bshig ste rnyed par byas so/ /rgyal pos rdo rje gdan gyi sing gha la pa mang po bsad/ sen+ta pa gzhan rnams la'ang chad pa gcod par brtsams pa na/slob dpon gyis thugs rje chen pos/ de rnams rgyal po'i gnod pa las legs par bskyabs so/ /ma dad pa bzlog pa'i phyir du/ sa 'og tu rdzu 'phrul gyis gshegs pa dang / yang skabs 'gar/ mi ma yin mang po slob dpon la mchod pa dang / ya ma zung gi cho 'phrul mang du bstan/ der sngags kyi spyod pa mchog gi bstan bcos kyang mang du mdzad pa las/ nyan thos kyi sde snod dang yang mi 'gal —349—

ba bsgrubs so/ /sngon 'jam dbyangs sprul pa a ba dhu ti'i spyod pa can de la/ ma dad pa gtan nas ma skyes na/ de nyid du 'ja' lus rdo rje'i skur gnas 'gyur ba yin pa las/ der ma gus pa'i rnam par rtog pa cung zad skyes pas/ dgung lo brgyad cu lhag cig bzhes pa na/ rnam par smin pa'i sku lus bor te/ zung 'jug gi sku brnyes pa yin no/ /de'i slob ma na/ mthong ba'i chos la mya ngan las 'das pa'i slob ma bzha/ rgyal tshab kyi sa la gnas pa zhes bya ba skye ba gcig gis thogs pa dang / bar dor sangs rgya ba'i rigs can bco brgyad/ mkhas pa paṇ+ḍi ta dang / rnal 'byor pa ku sa li grangs las 'das pa byung ngo / /slob dpon 'di'i rdo rje'i spun grogs slob mar gyur pa ni kong ka na'i chos kyi 'byung gnas dang / ri bo sa phya kyi gtsug tor rdo rje'o/ /zhes dpal 'bras rdo rjes bshad/slob ma'i mchog bzhi po na/ mar me mdzad bzang po/ rab zhi bshes gnyen/bde ba chen por pad+ma ka ra/ rgyal rigs sgra gcan 'dzin no/ /slob dpon chen po 'di'i dngos slob/ yang slob/ nyid slob kyi bar du dzam bha la grub pas yo byad sbyor ba dang / nor rgyun mas yo byad sbyor ba dang / rgyud las 'byung ba ltar khye'u dang bu mo la ye shes pheb nas dkyil 'khor 'bri ba dang / rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor yang dkyil 'khor dngos su ston nus pa dang / bden stobs brjod pas rdul tshon gang dgos su 'phel ba sogs yod do/ /de rjes rgyal po mahā pā la'i gzhug gcig la dge slong gi rten dang cha byad can la/ sngags spyod mngon gyur pa bkag pas de phyin chad de 'dra mang po ma byung ngo / /de la mar me mdzad bzang po ni rgya gar nub phyogs su sku 'khrungs/—350—

rigs pa'i gnas thams cad la thogs pa med pa'i blo gros brnyes/ rten ni dge slong / sde pa ni 'di yang dge 'dun phal chen pa yin gsung / de yang dpal nā len+t+ra ra mkhas pa thams cad kyis bkur ba yin/ slob dpon chen po sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs dang mjal nas/ rnal 'byor dang rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud kyi dkyil 'khor thams cad du zhugs/ rgyud sde yang mtha' yas pa gsan/ 'on kyang man ngag thob dka' bar byung nas/ re zhig lho phyogs kyi yul du byon nas lo gnyis gsum du sngags rgyud sbyor bas sems can la phan btags/ der 'du ba dang longs spyod rgya chen po byung ba/ de thams cad slob dpon la mchod pa'i yo byad du dril nas/ slob dpon gyi drung du lha 'bangs kyi khyim drug cu dang / gser srang stong / mu tig gi do shal sum brgya la sogs pa yo byad dpag tu med pas mchod cing / khyad par bdag nyid slob dpon gyi bran du khas blangs te/ slob dpon gyi drung du lo gsum tsam du tha na grong khyer nas dam rdzas sha chang len pa tshun chad kyi bya ba'ang mdzad/ der slob dpon gyis man ngag thams cad kyang gnang / phyogs gzhan zhig tu song nas bsgoms pas/ rtogs pa khyad par can skyes te slob dpon gyi drung du 'ongs pa bla mas kyang dbang bskur bas/ de nyid du phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub kyi go 'phang thob ste/ slob dpon sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs las kyang rtogs pa mtho ba yin no skad/ slob dpon 'dis drag po'i las kyi sgo nas mu stegs kyi rgyal po tshar bcad pa'i gtam rgyud snang ste/ rgya gar mtha' 'khob si rgyu'i yul du bzhugs pa'i skabs shig yul de'i rgyal pos slob dpon gyi slob ma rnams la rtag tu 'tshe ba byed pa zhig yod/—351—

gzhan yang rgyal po des sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la shin tu gnod pa byed pa zhig yod pa/ lan cig slob dpon dang lam gcig tu mjal bas/ rgyal pos slob dpon la mdung thung 'phangs pas sku la ma gnod/ slob dpon gyis sdigs 'dzub mdzad pas/ rgyal po yo byad dang bcas pa thul gyis tshig nas thal bar song / der rgyal po'i mi mu stegs la dga' ba thams cad 'jigs te/ dge slong mgo bregs 'di kun nus pa 'di tsam zhig ces phyin chad mi rabs mang por nang pa'i gtsug lag khang rnams la 'tshe ba mi byed do/ /lo rgyus 'ga' las rgyal po de tu dra dzi'i rgyal po dh+wa khri na zhes pa yin te/ de dus yul dbus na tu rtsa ske med pas/ lta ba log pa rnams la mu stegs zhes zer ba'i stabs nas mu stegs kyi rgyal po zer ba byung ba yin gsung / yang nub phyogs ma la ba'i yul na/ mu stegs kyi rgyal po khyab 'jug chen po la lhar 'dzin pa zhig yod pa/ des sangs rgyas pa'i lha khang mang po bzhag dge slong rnams yul dbus su bskrad/ dge bsnyen rnams la yang sdug bsngal sna tshogs pa ster bas/ lan cig slob dpon yang de'i yul du byon pa zhig la/ slob dpon ye shes zhabs kyis byin rlabs mdzad pa'i lha khang zhig yod pa der bzhugs/ der slob dpon la rgyal po des snyad mang po btags/ slob dpon gyis phyis nyin par dgongs pa zhig btang bas rgyal po chung mar bcas pa nad kyis btab/ yang blon po mu stegs la dga' ba zhig dang / slob dpon lam du mjal bas/ blon po na re/ rgyal po la ngan thabs byas pas khyod la chad pas gcod zer ba la/ slob dpon gyis mchan khung nas ras la bris pa'i ling ga zhig bton te/ ngan pa de da rung ma shi'am —352—

gsung nas ling ga de phyed mar bshags pas/ rgyal po lus tshal par gas nas sha/ blon po de la sngags btab pas rengs/ yang mu stegs kyi slob dpon sa ga ra nan+da zhes bya ba zhig yod pa las/ des phra men ma'i rig sngags mang po bsgrubs te/ sangs rgyas pa mang po la gnod pa byed/ pa zhig yin pa las/ lan cig lam srang dog po zhig tu slob dpon dang 'phrad pas/ lam bzur res ma byung / der mu stegs na re/ nang par khyed rnams ma shi na kho bo cag gi lugs mi bden zhes ngan sngags kyi dus btab nas song / nam srod kyi dus su song ba na/slob dpon gyi gnas rnams su thug tshom chen po byung / slob dpon gyis dgongs pa la mnyam par bzhag pas/ mu stegs de rnams nyid kyi lha khang spyil po dang bcas pa thams cad zhig ste/ der sa ga ra 'khor dang bcas pa yang de nyid du dus gcig la sha/ dus de'i tshe sa ga ra ni mu stegs kyi sngags mkhan thams cad kyi gtso bo yin no/ /slob dpon des sman pa zhabs la gdams te/ slob dpon de ni mtha' 'khob zhig tu bram ze'i rigs su skyes nas/ mu stegs kyi chos lugs la mkhas shing nus pa yang grub pa yin pa la/ phyis sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la dad nas/ yul dbus nā len+t+ra ra slob dpon mar me mdzad bzang po dang /mar me mdzad bzang po'i yang bla ma dpal sangs rgyas ye shes gnyis la pha rol tu phyin pa nas brtsams te/ gsang sngags phyi nang gi bar gyi thos pas rgyud sbyangs/ dbang bskur zhing gdams pa mtha' dag gnang / khyad par 'dus pa dang he ru ka'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba'i tshe/ me tog khro bo huX mdzad la phog yun ring du bsgoms pas rim gnyis kyi ting nge 'dzin khyad par can —353—

skyes/ khyad par zla ba drug tu sgrub pa byas pas dngos grub thob par shes nas/de'i sgrub pa'i rten du gdol ba'i bu mo yil sngon po'i kha dog lta bu rdo rje'i rigs kyi phyag rgya'i mtshan nyid tshang ba zhig dgos pa/ phyogs zhig nas btsal bas rnyed nas/ pha ma la bslangs pas/ de rnams na re/ bram ze'i slob dpon khyod smyo ba yin nam/ nged gdol pa'i rigs yin pas/ khyod nyid dang nged rnams la yang chad pa mi 'ong ngam zer ba la/ nga la sgrub pa'i rten du dgos pas/tha mal gyi rigs nyams pa sogs kyi chad pa mi 'ong byas pas/ 'o na bu mo'i lus dang mnyam pa'i gser dang dngul dgos zer/ der slob dpon gyis skad cig la sa 'og gi gter phyung ste/ de rnams la byin/ de nas slob dpon phyag rgyar bcas pa ri phug cig tu zla ba drug skrub pa byas pas yar ngo'i tshes brgyad kyi tho rangs kyi dus su nam mkha' la hūX gi sgra chen po grags/ dpal he ru ka la sogs pa dkyil 'khor thams cad kyang mngon sum du mthong / phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub kyi go 'phang yang thob/ 'dus pa gtso bor gyur pa'i lam gyis 'gro ba mang po la phan btags/ bstan bcos kyang mang du mdzad nas/mthar sku lus de nyid kyis sangs rgyas mi 'khrugs pa'i zhing du khyung gi rgyal po 'phur ba ltar bzhud do/ /'di rnying ma ba la grags pa'i slob dpon huX ka ra dang gcig par grags/ de lta na 'khrungs yul bal po yin/ rgyal po sad na legs kyi dus bod du yang byon par rig go /de la slob dpon a ba dhu ti pa zhes bya ba zhig gis zhus/ de la rat+na ā ka ra shān+ti pas zhus/ de la rdo rje gdan pa chen pos zhus/ de la ku sa li pas zhus pa'i brgyud pa'ang yod gsung / 'on kyang —354—

bka' babs gtso bor gyur pa na/ sman pa zhabs la o rgyan gyi slob dpon sangs rgyas dpal zhi bas zhus/ de la rdo rje gdan pa chen pos zhus/ de la rdo rje gdan pa sa so ri pa yang zer/ rat+na ā ka ra gup+ta yang zer/ rdo rje gdan pa bar pas zhus/ yang slob dpon chen po sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs kyis slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas la bshad/ 'di la pad+ma badz+ra phyi ma'am chung bar grags/rnam thar rgyas pa logs su yod pa las shes so/ /pad+ma pa che chung du grags pa ni dus snga phyi la btags pa yin no/ /slob dpon des kā ma rle'i yul gyi a ba ga ti'i rnal 'byor pa rat+na shwe la zhes bya ba la gdams/ de la ka ya smra bri dha ste/ yirge mkhan rgan po zhes bya bas zhus te/ slob dpon ka ya smra bgres po de na/ rgyal po dharma pā la'i yig mkhan yin pa la/ lo brgyad cu lon nas nā len+t+ra ra rab tu byung /gsung rab bslabs pas/ de dang nye ba na rgyal po ma hi pā las lam du 'gro ba mthong ste/ shing gi yal ga skam po zhig slob dpon la bstan te/ khyod kyi sde snod rnams shes pa'i tshe/ shing 'di la'ang me tog 'byung nges zhes dpyas so/ /slob dpon gyis bsams pa/ de ni sgrub pa bya'o snyam nas/ kā ma rle'i a ba ga ti pa la gsang ba 'dus pa 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur zhus nas bsgoms pas/ lo gsum nas bskyed rim gyi lam mtha' dag rdzogs/ chu gling zhig tu maṇ+ḍal byas nas sgrub pa mdzad pas/ zhag bdun song ba'i tho rangs 'jam pa'i rdo rje rma bya la chibs pa mngon sum du zhal bstan nas byin gyis brlabs pas/ chos thams cad kyang skad cig gis shes/ dngos grub kyang thob par gyur/ rgyal po'i drung du song ste/ ngas ni sde snod gsum shes na/ rgyal pos —355—

sngar gyi shing de la me tog ston dgos byas pas/ rgyal po yang ngo mtshar skyes nas bla mar bzung / slob dpon des gsang sngags kyi lha khang yang mang du bzhengs/gtso bor bskyed rim dang sgrub thabs bshad/ kyai rdo rje'i 'grel pa kha sbyor dri med mdzad mkhan de yin no/ /'grel pa 'di la snga 'gyur khyung po rnal 'byor gyis zhus nas/ glan dar ma blo gros kyis bsgyur ba la mdzad byang la yang ka ya sba bgres pos mdzad ces 'gyung la/ shong blo brtan gyi 'gyur la ni ḍaX ga da shas mdzad ces 'byung ste/ slob dpon gcig po de'i mtshan gyi rnam grangs yin par sem mo/ 'grel pa de ni slob dpon de'i gsung rgyun slob mas bkod pa yin nam sems/ 'di dang slob dpon bha ba skan+ta gcig par grags so/ /slob dpon des dur ha ri zhes bya ba la bshad/ des rdo rje gdan pa snga ma la bshad/de la rdo rje gdan pa bar bas zhus so/ /slob dpon rdo rje gdan pa chen po na/yul ma la bar sku 'khrungs/ rigs bram ze rig pa'i gnas thams cad la shin tu mkhas/ phyis nā len+t+ra ra rab tu byung / gsang sngags phyi nang thams cad la mkhas shing / khyad par gdams ngag shin tu che/ byang chub kyi thugs 'byongs pas/ ma ga ta pa la shin tu bkra shis shing 'gro don che ba byung / a ti sha bzhugs pa'i dus tsam na rdo rje gdan gyi mkhan por mnga' gsol ba yin no/ /phyis bi kra ma shī la'i mkhan po yang mdzad/ de'i slob ma rdo rje gdan pa par pa rat+na ā ka ra gup+ta na/ shar phyogs go ra'i yul du 'khrungs/ rigs ni bram ze/chung ngu nas mdo sngags thams cad la mkhas shing / bsnyen pa yang grub pas/ rdo rje slob dpon du byed cing / rten dge bsnyen yin yang / dge slong mang pos —356—

mtha' bskor te chos ston cing yul dbus su 'ongs pas/ rgyal po'i blon po dad pa can zhig na re/ khyed dge slong gyis shig /g.yin du na dge slong sde snod gsum pas dge bsnyen la phyag 'tshal ba 'ad/ bstan pa la gnod pa yin zer/nga la ma rgan mo zhig gso dgos pa yod pas/ dge slong mi byed byas pas/ des ma'i 'tsho ba la gser srang drug cu byin/ de nas slob dpon bi kra ma la shī lar dge slong mdzad/ der paṇ+ḍi ta dang rnal 'byor pa gdams ngag che tshad la gshugs/ slob dpon rdo rje gdan pa'i dbang rgyud gdams ngag thams cad kyang thugs su chud/ phyis rdo rje gdan gyi mkhan po rgyun ring du mdzad/ de nas lco phyogs kyi rgyud du 'byon par bzhed nas/ dpon slob sum cu tsam gyis so rir byon/ so ri'i rgyal po'i rmi lam du rdo rje gdan gyi mahā bo dhi'i zhal nas/ nga'i bstan pa lho phyogs su ma gtong zhes gsung ba rmis pa la/ nang bar slob dpon 'khor bcas lho phyogs su 'byon pa'i po ti dang / sku gzugs sogs gdan 'dren pa'i 'u lag dgos zhes byung bas/ rmi lam gyi don go nas/ der rgyal pos bzhugs par yang yang gsol ba btab pas/ slob dpon shin tu thugs rje che bas so ri nyid du bzhugs pas mtshan yang so ri par grags/ slob dpon 'di yang bskyed rim mthar phyin/ yi dam gyi lha gru/nga po'i zhal mthong / khyad par rgya gar gyi yul rang na gdams ngag che bar byed/ des slob dpon 'jigs med 'byung gnas la gdams pa yin/ des shu bhā ka ra gup+ta la/ des da shā pā la la/des rnal 'byor pa badz+ra shrī la/ des rtsod pa'i dus kyi slob dpon thams cad mkhyen par grags pa chor+sha/ 'byung dpal/ des sangs rgyas grags pa la/ des —357—

rin chen grags pa/ des rā ti gup+ta la gdams te/ de dag gi bar gyi lo rgyus rgyas par mi gsung / rin po che'i 'byung khungs lta bu'i gtam las/ bskyed rim brgyud pa'i gtam gyi skabs te drug pa'o// //bka' babs drug pa ni tshig gi brgyud pa yin te/ de yang tshig gi brgyud pa byas kyang / rgyud kyi bshad pa'i brgyud pa yin gsung / de la rgyud mang po zhig gi bshad bka'/ nā ro pa dang / mai tri pa gnyis la bzhugs/ yang 'ga' zhig ni klu sgrub kyis ār+ya de ba la bshad/ des sgra gcan 'dzin la bshad/ des zla ba grags pa la bshad/ des 'od zer 'byung gnas la bshad/ des ye shes grags pa la bshad/ des shān+ti pa la bshad/ yang rgyud kyi bshad pa mang po zhig ni 'jam dpal bzhes gnyen gyis/ bram ze ye shes rdo rje la bshad nas de las brgyud pa dang / byang chub rdo rje las brgyud pa dang / yang dpal ye shes zhabs kyis rab zhi bshes gnyen la bshad/ des dpal sde dang / tsi lu ba dang / nag pa skyes dang / sman pa zhabs te bzhi la bshad/ de la bzhi la 'jam dpal ye shes kyis zhus/ de la don yod rdo rje chen pos zhus/ de la sirnyi bi ras zhus/ de la a ti shas zhus/ de la bzhes gnyen gsang bas zhus/ de la rdo rje gdan pa che bas zhus pa'i skor dang / yang mang po zhig na/ tsi lu pa/ tha ga na/ shan+ti pa/dz+nyā na shrī mi tra/ jo bo rje/ rdo rje gdan pa snga phyi rnams nas brgyud pa'ang yod la/yang slob dpon la li ta badz+ra ste rol ba'i rdo rjes o rgyan nas rgyud mang po spyan drangs/ slob dpon li la badz+ra la bshad/ des 'jam dpal ye shes la bshad/slob dpon 'dis rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rnal 'byor gyis brdung stangs byas pas —358—

stag gzig gi rgyal po glang po che dang bcas pa phyed mar song ba'i gtam rgyud yod/ des ni don yod rdo rje chen po la gdams pa yin no/ /yang slob dpon spyod pa pa dang / slob dpon bram ze dpal 'dzin zhes bya ba phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub thob pa/ lto phyogs be+e da lha na dge slong sde snod gsum pa chos smra ba chen po zhig /mu stegs kyi rgyal po gcig gis mgo gcod par rtsom pa la/ slob dpon rgyal po'i drung du byon te/ 'di mgo ma gcod byas pas/ 'o na khyod rang gi mgo slus mar thong zer bas/ slob dpon gyis dbu bcad nas byin/der ma he'i mgo cig bslan pas 'byar ba'i cho 'phrul bstan/ slob dpon ma he'i dbu can du grags so/ /des ha ri ke la la gdams/ 'dis ni phyag rgya byi lar bsgyur bas/ bhi ra ḍi ba zhes grags/ des kyang 'jam dpal ye shes la gdams so/ /yang rgyud kha cig ni slob dpon ku ku ri pas spyan drangs pa yin te/ de yang shar phyogs bhang ga la'i yul du 'khrungs/ nā le rgyu'i paṇ+ḍi ta dge slong zhig yin pa/ nags tshal dben pa zhig tu rtse gcig tu bsgoms pas/ der thun mong gi dngos grub mang po yang thob/ bskyed rim yang brtan par gyur/ nang gcig phug pa'i nang du khyi gu mo zhig byung / nyin zhag 'ga' re zas kyis gso zhing yod/der lha rnams kyis slob dpon spyan drangs te sum cu rtsa gsum du 'dug pa la/ji zhig na sngar gyi khyi gu de dran te/ lha rnams la nga 'dzam bu gling du 'gro byas pas/ ci yin zer/ khyi gu de ltogs te 'chi ba yod byas pas/ lha rnams na re/khyed yun ring du ting nge 'dzin bsgom na/ da dung yang khyi gu'i rnam rtog kyang ma —359—

zhi'am zhes zer bas/ bden snyam/ slob dpon gyis lo bcu gnyis lha'i gnas su bzhugs/ de nas rang gi gnas su 'ongs pa na/ sngar gyi khyi gu de ni che ru ma song par 'dug skad/ brag gi phug la khyis grus pas chu mig kyang brdol snang ba/khyi gu lag tu blangs pas bud med rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa cig tu gyur skad/ de ni rdo rje'i rnal wor ma yin te/ de dang lhan cig tu spyod pa spyod cing /skye bo'i mngon du khyi mor sprul pas/ slob dpon ku ku ri pa zhes grags/ des mkha' 'gro ma'i gnas las rgyud mang du spyan drangs/ pad+ma badz+ra zhes pa la bshad/des tisli pa la/ des nā ro pa la/ des shan+ti pa la/ slob dpon de na/ ma ga 'du' yul du bram ze'i rigs las 'khrungs te/ rig byed dang / rig byed kyi yan lag rnams dang / brtag pa brgyad la sogs pa la chung ngu nas mkhas par sbyangs so/ kha cig rje rigs su 'dod pa'ang yod gsung / o tan+ta pu rir thams cad yod smra'i sde la rab tu byung / nyan thos kyi sde snod gsum po thams cad thugs su chud/ bi kra ma shī lar byon te/ dze ta ri chen po la sogs pa mkhas pa mang po la theg pa chen po'i mdo dang bstan bcos phal cher gsan/ gnas brtan slob dpon chen por gyur te/ so ma pu ri'i mkhan por yang mnga' gsol/lo 'ga' gtsug lag khang de nyid kyi gnas brtan mdzad do/ /de nas rin chen grags pa dang / nag po dam tshig rdo rje dang / tha ga na la sogs pa bla ma mang po bsten cing / rgyud brgya rtsa gsan cing thugs la bzhugs par grags so/ /de nas ma la bar phebs te/ lo bdun du thugs dam la bzhugs pas/ 'jam dbyangs dang / sgrol ma dang / mi pham mgon po rnams kyi zhal gzigs shing /—360—

dam pa'i chos kyi bdud rtsi gsol ba las/ de kun yang thogs med kyi gzhung lugs dang mthun par gsung ba byung bas/ slob dpon 'di 'phags pa thogs med kyi lugs mthar thug tu mdzad do/ /de skabs slob dpon gyi mnal lam du 'phags ma sgrol mas/ sing ga'i gling du bzhud cig par lung bstan to/ /sing ga la'i rgyal po'i rmi lam du yang / 'dzam bu'i gling na slob dpon rin chen 'byung gnas zhi ba yod pas/ de spyan drongs shig khyod kyi yul du theg pa chen po dar bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes lung bstan pa byung bas/ slob dpon bhang ga lar phebs pa dang / sing ga la'i pho nyas bhang ga lar slebs pa dus mtshungs byung / theg pa chen po'i mdo sde nyis brgya tsam sbyan drangs te/ sing ga lar lo bdun chos gsungs/ theg pa chen po'i dge 'dun lnga brgya tsam byung / mdo sde de dag shin tu dar bar gyur to/ /de sngon sing ga lar grub wo ni mang du byon mod kya/ dge 'dun thams cad nyan thos yin par mngon no/ /de nas 'dzam bu gling du phebs pa'i lam du rgya mtsho'i rlabs 'khrugs pa dang / gzings la skyod pa'i chom rkun byung ba rnams/ sngags bzlas pa'i bye ma gtor ba tsam gyis chom rkun rnams dbang du 'dus/ rgya mtsho'i rlabs zha/ de nas rgya gar lho phyogs kyi yul tha dad brgyud/ rim pas rdo rje gdan du phebs/ phyis rgya nag ri bo rtse lngar sgrub pa la bzhud par dgongs pa'i tshe/ rgyal po'i rmi lam du sangs rgyas dngos dang mjal ba zhig rmi ba/ nang par slob dpon byon pas/ rgyal pos bi kra mar bzhugs par gsol ba btab pas/ bi kra ma shī la'i shar sgo ba mdzad pa yin no/ /lo rgyus 'ga' zhig tu/ rgyal po 'di ma hi pā la yin zer ba dang / kha cig las de'i —361—

tsha bo rgyal po tsa na ka yin zer ba gnyis las/ phyi ma dag par mngon no/ /der mu stegs kyi paṇ+ḍi ta nyis brgya tsam dang snga phyir rtsod pa mdzad pas/ thams cad las rgyal te/ snyan pa'i grags pas phyogs thams cad du khyab/ sangs rgyas pa'i nang du yang mkhas pa la 'gran zla med de/ rgyal po'i bla mar bkur/ rtsod dus kyi thams cad mkhyen pa zhes mtshan du gsol/ lha yul nas dgra bcom pa dngos su byon nas chos nyan par grags/ de ltar nyin mtshan du dam pa'i chos kyi bya bas dus 'da' bar mdzad cing / nam zhig na/ nā ro pa kho pos dngos grub brnyes pas/ de la gdams pa cung zad gsan/ dgung lo brgyar nye ba'i gnas skabs kyi tshe/ nyan bshad kyi bya ba ma lcogs nas/ gsol zas rags pa spangs te/ dben pa zhig tu bzhugs pa na/ sngon rang gi slob ma zhing pa zhig dus der grub pa thob nas rdzu 'phrul gyis nam mkha' la 'ongs nas phyag byas pa bla mas ma mkhyen/ de nas lus snang bar byas te/ slob dpon phyag 'tshal lo zhus pas/ khyod su yin gsung / dngos zhing pa tog rtse pa lags zhus pas/ ngas de yang brjed nas mi dran mod kya/ da khyod kyi gdams pa de nga la byin ces gsung pas/ tog rtse pa des gdams pa phul/ de'i don bsgoms pas rdo rje phag mos zhal bstan te grub pa thob bo/ /de nas sku lus kyang nyams stobs dang ldan par gyur te/ slob ma rnams la chos kyang ci rigs par gsung zhing bzhugs pa las/lan cig srod kyi dus na/ bud med bzhis gdan gyi mtha' nas bteg ste yud tsam pa zhig la o rgyan gyi gnas su dngos su spyan drangs/ zhag mang du bzhugs te dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro ma'i dbus su tshogs kyi 'khor lo rgya chen po mdzad/—362—

rdo rje'i glu mang du blangs/ tshogs kyi gtso bo rdo rje phag mos mdo rgyud kyi dgongs pa 'grel ba'i mchog tu dbugs dbyung ba mdzad/ de skabs ma ga dha'i slob ma dang skye bo'i tshogs kyis slob dpon gar byon cha med/ mi snang bar gyur pa yin nam snyam ste/ dus kyi mchod pa bya bar brtsams pa las/ slar yang khri'i steng du slob dpon nyid gang nas byon cha med par phebs/ slob ma rnams la rtogs pa brjod pa dang / lo rgyus gsung bar mdzad pas/ phal cher ngo mtshar du gyur cing /'ga' zhig yid ma ches par yod pa las/ dus nam zhig na o rgyan gyi mi mang po zhig rdo rje gdan du mchod pa dang tshong byed pa la byung ba la/ ma ga dha pa rnams kyi gtam dris pas/ o rgyan gyi dhu ma tī rar dngos su phebs/ yun ring du bzhugs/ chos kyang mang du bstan cing / nged rnams kyis kyang chos thos zhes zer bas rtsod med du gyur to/ /de nas kyang 'gro ba'i don ci rigs pa mdzad/dgung lo brgya brgyad lhag tsam na sku 'das te/ slob ma rnams kyis bsil ba tshal du sku gdung zhugs la bzhen par brtsams pa na/ me cung zad 'bar ba na sku gdung mi snang bar gyur skad/ slob dpon 'dis rgyud sde mang po la rang stobs kyis 'grel pa mdzad cing / 'khor lo sdom pa la mdzad par rtsom pa na/ rdo rje phag mos bka' ma gnang ngo / /o rgyan gyi gnas su tshogs kyi 'khor lor gshegs pa na/ grub thob gzhan yang lnga bcu rtsa gsum tsam 'dus te/ de thams cad dang chos kyi 'gro ba mdzad par grags so/ /yang rgyal po in+d+ra dh+wa ti bar pas/ slob dpon ku ku rā dza zhes pa nyin mo khyi stong la chos 'chad par sbyad cing /mtshan mo dam tshig gi kun tu spyod pa zhig yod de/ de la slob dpon pad+ma 'byung —363—

gnas kyis zhus pa sogs rgyud mang po'i bshad rgyun byung mod kya/ da lta ni bklags lung tsam las cher med gsung / yang 'dir a ti sha'i lo rgyus kyang grags che bas ma bkod do/ /yang dus 'khor sogs rgyud sde mang po zhig na/slob dpon pi to pa ste bsod snyoms pa bya ba zhig la phyag na rdo rjes lung bstan te/ rdzu 'phrul gyis sham bha lar byon/ rgyud mang po spyan drangs/ rat+na gi rir slob ma mang po la bshad/ pi ṭo pa nyid mthar mi snang ba'i dngos grub brnyes so/ /slob ma drug yod pa las/ gsum gyis rdo rje'i sku grub ste mi snang bar gyur/dge slong a ba dha tī pa dang / bo dhi shrī dang / nā ro pa gsum gyis dar bar mdzad do/ /yang a ba hūṃ tī pas so ri pa la bshad do/ /de la pi ṭo pa ni rgyal po ma hi pā la'i dus su byon yang / a bhi yuk+ta ka nas kyang brgyud de/ de dag gi brgyud pa 'di'i dbang du byas pa'o/ /de ltar bla ma sna tshogs las brgyud nas bshad pa'i rgyun de dag thams cad slob dpon chen po snyigs dus kyi sangs rgyas 'jigs med 'byung gnas sbas pa la mnga'o/ /slob dpon de ni rgya gar lho phyogs o ḍi bi sha dang nye ba dza ri khaṇ+ḍa zhes bya bar pha rgyal rigs dang / ma bram ze'i rigs te/ gzhon nu nas rig byed yan lag dang bcas pa dang / sgra dang rtog ge la shin tu mkhas shing / chen por gyur pa na mu stegs kyi rgyud dang gzhung lugs thams cad mkhyen/ skyed mos tshal zhig tu sngags bzla bzhin yod pa na/rang gi mdun du bu mo mdzes ma zhig byung / nga gdol pa'i bu mo yin/ khyod dang lhan cig spyod par 'dod zer ba la/ de ltar ga la rung zhes bzlog nas/ nga rigs mthon por gyur pa yin pas grags pa ma yin pa 'byung / 'dir ma —364—

'dug byas pas/ de yang phyir song ste brtags pa na sgo rnams rang gis nang nas bsdams pa de kho na ma zhig par 'dug nas/ lha mo'am gnod spyin mo'am su yin snyam pa las/ rang gi grogs mched sangs rgyas pa'i rnal 'byor pa zhig yod pa la dris pas/ de ni rdo rje rnal 'byor ma yin pa la/ dngos grub ma blangs pa ma legs kya/ khyod sangs rgyas pa'i rigs su 'dug pas/ shar phyogs su song la sangs rgyas pa gyis gsung nas/ de bzhin du byas/ bhang ga la'i yul du mdo sngags thams cad la mkhas par sbyangs/ slob dpon so so la dbang bskur ba yang mang du zhus/ dge slong sde snod 'dzin pa chen por song nas/ 'dul ba 'dzin pa thams cad kyi slob dpon du bskos/ lan cig lha khang gi 'khyams cig na 'dug pa la/ bu mo gzhon nu zhig gis/ ba glang gi sha khrag 'dzag pa cig khyer byung ste/ de slob dpon la gto de/ nga gdol pa'i bu mo yin/ 'di khyod kyi don du bsad pa yin pas zo zer ba la/ nga gtsang ma'i rigs kyi dge slong / phyed du brdos pa'i ba glang gi sha ga la za gsungs pas/ de phyir ldog nas 'khyams smad du mi snang bar song / de yang rdo rje rnal 'byor mas dngos grub gnang pa ma blangs pa yin no/ /der slob dpon sde snod gsum gyi mnga' bdag yin yang /man ngag gis yid ma tshims par/ mthar thug pa'i man ngag gi bdag por grags pa thams cad la man ngag sna tshogs gsan cing yul thams cad du byon/nā la sder yang mang du bzhugs/ sde pa bzhi'i 'dul ba thams cad dang / nyan thos kyi sde snod gzhan yang shas che ba rnams dang / theg chen sde gnyis kyi mdo dang / bstan bcos rigs mi gcig pa thams cad la shin tu mkhyen pa rgyas —365—

shing / nang pa'i rtog ge la sogs pa thun mong gi rig pa'i gnas rgya mtsho la mkhas/ khyad par du gsang sngags tsam la ches mkhas/ man ngag dang bcas pa yang thob/ de nas dpal so ri pa'i drung du phebs/ khong la mnga' ba'i sngags kyi chos thams cad zhus/ rtsa ba'i bla ma yang 'di la mdzad/ slob dpon nyid kyis sngon rab tu byung ba'i mkhan po yang 'di yin zer/ so ri'i dgon pa der bla ma'i man ngag bsgom bzhin bzhugs pa'i skabs shig tshes brgyad kyi dus nam srod cig la/ slob dpon so ri pa'i chu len g.yog mo bu mo dge bsnyen ma zhig yod pa de kho na 'dra ba zhig /slob dpon gyi mun khang du byung ste/ snod chung ngu cig nas tshogs rdzas mang po bton nas/ nga slob dpon gyis btang ba yin/ khyed dang lhan cig tshogs kyi 'khor lo bya zer/ ngas tshogs 'khor sngar ma byas gsungs pas/ de ltar yang / da res gyis zer/ der slob dpon gyis rnam par rtog pas ma mdzad pas/ de na re/ khyed rgyud sum brgya shes shing / de rnams kyi mthar thug pa'i man ngag thob nas/ sngags kyi spyod pa la rtog pa byar ga la rung zer/tshogs rdzas rnams khyer nas phyir song / der mun nag tu gyur pa na/ sgrub khang gi sgo rim pa gsum la gzigs su byon pa na/ sgo ni rang gis nang nas bsdams pa de kho nar 'dug nas/ the tshom skyes te/ nang par bla ma la mdang g.yog mo bdag la tshogs skyel du btang ngam zhus pas/ khyod rnam rtog shas che bas ma btang / khyod kyis ci mthong gsung / lo rgyus zhus pas/ bla ma na re/ 'o na rdo rje rnal 'byor mas dngos grub bstabs pa ma blangs par 'dug pa gsung / der yi mug nas zhag bdun du kha zas bcad de gsol ba btang pas/ bdun pa'i nub —366—

mo rmi lam du thog mar bud med rgan mo zhig byung / de rdo rje phag mor shes te bshags pa phul gsol ba btab pas/ rdo rje phag mo dngos su gyur nas khyod kyi skye ba mang por nga la bzlas pa dang mchod pa byas pas/ da res dngos grub lan gsum byin yang de ma blangs pa yin pas/ tshe 'dir mchog mi thob/ da ni bstan bcos mang du rtsoms/ gas la chos mang du shod/ bar dor mchog 'grub po gsung / de nas dur khrod sna tshogs su bsgom bzhin bzhugs/ der rgyal po rā ma pā la'i btsun mo zhig gis e ḍa pu ra zhes bya ba'i gtsug lag khang zhig bzhengs nas phul ba/ der yang ting nge 'dzin bsgom zhing bzhugs pas/ zla ba drug tu ting nge 'dzin thun gcig la gnas pa yang byung / dur khrod bsil ba'i tshal du bzhugs dus/ bu gcig po gces po zhig gi ro skyel du byung ba/ nye du rnams sdug bsngal chen po 'dug nas/ bar do'i rnam shes bkug ste lus de la bcug nas slar gsos/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' nus pa can du grags nas/ rdo rje gdan gyi mkhan por spyan drangs/ der yang phyogs bzhi'i slob ma rnams la chos mang du gsungs/ rtsis kyis brtags pas mkhyen te/ bram ze dbul po zhig gi thab kyi 'og nas gter bton te byin/ chom rkun bsrung pa dang / dug zhi ba dang / dmag bzlog pa dang / gzhan yang rgyud nas gsungs pa bzhin gyi las tshogs 'grub/ sa bha na ga ra zhes bya ba'i grong khyer chen po zhig la me shor ba bden stobs brjod pas zha/ de nas nā len+d+ra dang / bi kra ma la shī la'i mkhan por spyan drangs/ rgyal pos kyang bla mar bkur/ der rmi lam du rdo rje phag mos bstan bcos rtsom par slar yang bskul bas/ bdag lta bu'i bstan —367—

bcos kyis sems can la phan mi thogs zhus/ khyod bstan bcos rtsom pa'i tshe nga nyid lus la 'jug go gsung / de nas slob ma so sos gsol ba btab pa'i ngor/ brgyad stong pa'i 'grel pa brtsams pas/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyis shis pa brjod/ 'phreng ba skor gsum las/ dkyil chog rdo rje 'phreng ba brtsams pa'i tshe/ me tog gi char babs/ man ngag snye ma brtsams pa'i tshe/thog mtha' bar gsum du bde dgyes dus 'khor gsum gyis shis pa brjod/snyan pa'i grags pas phyogs thams cad du khyab/ gzhan yang phar phyin la thub pa dgongs rgyan dang / mngon pa la 'jig rten bsdus pa dang / 'dul ba la dge slong gi rig byed 'grel pa dang bcas pa dang / 'dul ba snang ba dang / dbu ma la dbu ma'i snye ma dang / gzhan yang yo ga'i rgyud 'grel pa med pa 'ga' re la 'grel pa dang / sgrub thabs grags pa can bzhi dang / sangs rgyas thod pa'i 'grel pa dang / ma rgyud mang po'i rgal lan dang / 'jigs med lam rim dang /mdor byas dang / rim lnga'i 'grel pa/ rtsis la 'jug pa/ dus 'khor gyi rgal lan/ dus 'khor gsal byed/ g.yin yang bstan bcos thor bu dang / sgrub thabs phra mo shin tu mang ba mdzad/ sgrub thabs sna tshogs bsdus pa yang bsgrigs/ nub phyogs kyi yul du gtsug lag khang bzhengs pa'i tshe/ lhung bzed nam mkhar bzed pas zas skom gyis khengs yong ba sogs mthun rkyen thams cad dzam bha las sbyar/ gzhan yang khri mon du bcug pa'i skye bo 'bum phrag du ma thar bar mdzad/ slob ma yang rgya bod kyi mkhas grub bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung ste/ 'di phyin chad phyis byung ba'i rgya gar ba'i theg chen pa thams cad slob dpon —368—

'di la tshad ldan du rtsi bar snang / des shu bhā ga ra gup+ta ste dge ba'i 'byung gnas sbas pa la bshad/ des da sha pā la bshad/ des rnam par grags pa'i lha la bshad/ 'di ni bhang ga la'i paṇ+ḍi ta shin tu mkhas pa zhig yin pa/ nā len+t+ra ra byon te/ chos dang gdams ngag thams cad la shin tu 'dris par byas/ yul nas 'byon dus rtsa ba'i bla mas rab tu byung gsungs yang / phyis sred pa shas che ba'i skyon gyis rab tu ma byung / chung ma blangs pas/ bu tsha ming sring gsum skyes/lan cig rmi lam du spyan ras gzigs kyi gsung nas khyod kyi bla ma'i bka' bcag pas da ste lo gsum nas tshad rims kyis shi nas dmyal bar 'gro gsung / der shin tu skrag ste mtshams bcad nas thugs dam mdzad/ lung bstan ni thog tu babs te/ lo gsum nas tshad rims kyis btab sku 'das/slob dpon rang gi snang ba la/ gzhin rje'i skyes bus thag ring du khrid pa na/'phags pa spyan ras gzigs lha lnga nam mkhar byon nas/ rta mgrin gyis gshed ma rnams brdungs/ 'phags pas spyan chab nar gyis phyung nas 'di rang gi lus la skyol gsung / 'phags pa'i 'khor rnams kyis tshur bskyal ba'i snang ba la/ slar yang rang gi lus la zhugs te/ de phyin chad rtag tu spyan ras gzigs kyis zhal gzigs shing / nus pa yang che/ rtogs pa yang bzang po brnyes/ grub pa thob pa yin/ grags pa yang che bar byung / des kha che'i paṇ+ḍi ta shākya shibha dra dang / burnya shrī bha dra dang / rat+na rak+ṣi ta rnams la bshad/ de dag la mu ni shrī bha dras zhus/ des kā ru ṇa shrī bha dra la bshad/ des shākya rak+ṣi ta la bshad/ des su dza ta ba rma la bshad/ des ki sbo la'i paṇ+ḍi ta bi muk+ta de ba ste/—369—

rnam grol lha la bshad/ des dza na gup+ta la bshad/ des ra ti gup+ta la bshad/des da lta sa'i steng na 'gran zla thams cad dang bral ba'i grub chen zhi ba sbas pa la bshad do/ /rin po che'i 'byung khungs lta bu'i gtam las/ rgyud bshad brgyud pa'i gtam gyi skabs te bdun pa'o/ /bdun pa man ngag thor bu sna tshogs kyi bka' babs na/ grub chen go rak+ta'i man ngag rnams kyi bka' babs yin te/ de yang sde tshan bcu gnyis kyi dzo gi rnams na re/ sī na pas lha dbang phyug chen po la brten te/ thun mong gi dngos grub thob/ de la go rak+tas rlud gi gdams ngag zhus te bsgoms pas/ phyag rgya chen po ye shes rang byung du skyes pa yin zhes zer ba sogs khungs med gtam sna tshogs yod kyang / re zhig bzhag go /'dir grub chen zhi ba sbas pa la sogs pa paṇ+ḍi ta khungs ma rnams kyi gsung dang / kho bo'i bla ma sangs rgyas sbas pa'i zhal snga nas kyis bla ma go rak+ta'i gdams pa ma lus ba'i mdzod du gyur pa grub thob mang po dngos su zhal mjal/ nus mthu dang byin rlabs dpag tu med pa mnga' ba'i slob dpon 'bab stegs mgon po dang / nag po mgon po dang /bram ze mgon po ste/ go rak+ta'i rjes 'brang rnam pa gsum po de'i bzhed pa mthun par byung bas kho bo'i bla ma yang 'di kho na 'thad gsung / de yang rgya gar shar phyogs su bram ze'i slob dpon byā li pa zhes bya ba zhig gis/ yo byad mang po bsags te lo bcu gnyis su dngul chu'i bcud len bsgrubs pas/ 'grub pa'i ltas cig kyang ma byung / yo byad kyang zad/ der dngul chu'i sgrub thabs kyi po ti chu bo gaṅgā la 'phangs te rang nyid ldum bu spyod cing song ba na/ ji zhig na/ o —370—

ḍi bi sha'i yul du sleb pa'i tshe/ chu gcig la khrus byas pas/ sngar po ti bskyur ba der ma god par rnyed/ de dngos grub thob pa'i ltas su shes nas/ slar rang yul du phyin pa na/ dbul chu ni g.yas su 'khor zhing sgra snyan po yang grags/ me tog gi char yang 'bab par mthong nas/ nang mi rnams la ci yin dris pas sus kyang ma shes/ rang gi bu mo glen ma zhig na re/ khang pa 'dir kho mo rdul dang ldan par gyur te/ khrus shig byas/ de phyin chad 'di ltar byung / ci yin ni ma shes zer/ de brtags pas/ sngon skyu ru ra dmar po ngo ma shes te/ de ni gzhon nu ma'i rang byung gi rdul yin pa las/ skyu ru ra mdog dmar po 'ba' zhig btab pas ma grub/ dus der khrus byas pa'i khrag gi zer ma zhig song bas dngul chu grub pa yin no/ /de nas dngul chu'i cho ga'i lhag ma rnams zla ba drug tu byas nas zos pas/ byā li pa rang dang chung ma dang / bu dang bu mo dang mna' ma ste lnga/rta gcig dang drug gis rdzas kyi rig pa 'dzin pa thob skad/ der dngos grub la ser sna byas te/ lho phyogs kyi rgya mtsho'i gling gi gnas shi go na/ phyogs bzhi car 'dam gyis bskor ba'i dbus na brag ri chen po zhig yod pa der 'dug skad/dngul chu'i rdzas gser 'gyur rtsi de gzhan slong du byung dogs te/ mis mi thar pa'i sar bros pa yin/ dngos grub sgrubs pa ni nag po chen po'i rigs sngags la brten nas grub pa yin skad/ gtam de slob dpon klu sgrub kyis gsan te/klu sgrub la mkha' 'gro ma'i rig sngags shig la brten nas mkha' la 'gro thub pa'i shing lo'i lham gnyis yod pa las/ gcig sbas shing / gcig gyon nas nam mkha' la 'phur te byā li pa'i drung du sleb/ der slob dpon gyis gser —371—

'gyur gyi rtsi ster dgos byas pas/ des kyang khyed kyi lham de nga la byin zhigagaser 'gyur gyi rtsi sbyin du rung ngo zer/ der dngul chu'i gdams ngag mang po dang / bcud len gyi rigs bye ba brgya stong du ma dang / gser 'gyur gyi rtsi grub zin pa de nas kyang byin/ lham gcig po de yang de la phul/ lham sbas pa de gyon te nam mkha'i lam nas 'dzam bu'i gling du 'ongs/ bcud len gyi gdams ngag rgya cher spel ba yin no/ /de nas ljongs mu ni rgyu zhes bya ba rgya gar byang phyogs yul sa 'dzin na/ ri dhi ko ṭa zhes bya ba yod/ ri de gser dang dngul du bsgyur bar bzhed pa la/ 'phags ma sgrol mas/ ma 'ongs pa'i sems can rnams 'thab rtsod du 'gyur bar mkhyen nas/ gser dngul du bsgyur ba bkag nas lan tshwar 'gyur bar byin gyis brlabs par grags/ deng sang yul sa 'dzin la ṭi la zer/ der byā li bas da ni ser sna byas kyang don med do snyam nas 'dzam bu'i gling du 'ongs so/ /de'i lus ni rig pa 'dzin pa thob kyang / sngar nang gi mngon par rtogs pa ni cung zad kyang med pas/ slob dpon tsar pa ṭi pa zhes bya ba phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub thob pa zhig la/ gdams ngag zhus te bsgoms pas/ ring por mi thogs par ye shes khyad par can rgyud la skyes te/rtogs pa don gyi glu yang blangs/ sems can gyi don lnga ci rigs pa byas skad do/khong gi bcud len gyi gdams pa thams cad slob dpon tsar pa ṭi pa la drin lan gyi tshul du phul/ bla ma des kyang dngul chu'i bcud len gyi cho ga de cung zad byas pas 'phral du grub/ des sems can mang po la phan gdags par bzhed de/ tsa spa rje'i phyogs gcig na 'brog pa'i rigs shin tu mang ba yod cing / de na —372—

'brog pa gcig shin tu nor che ba/ ma he dang / ba men/ ba glang / rta lugs sogs stong phrag du ma yod/ der bu la mna' ma zhig blangs pa de la'ang khye'u zhig btsas/ lan cig yul du ston mo chen po zhig byung ba'i skabs/ mna' ma dang bu chung der 'dug gzhan rnams song ba la/ grub thob tsar pa ṭi bas zas slong ba la byon/ der slob dpon la zas thams cad drangs/ slob dpon na re/nang mi rnams mi khro na khyod sdod la nang par nas kyang nga la zas mang po byin zhigagal te khro na/ nga nags tshal ya gir me gtong gin sdod pas/ nga'i tsar bros la shog gsung / der nang mi rnams 'khor ba na/ snod thams cad 'phro can du mthong nas/ de thams cad kyis mna' ma la 'thabs pas/ des bu chung thogs te bros/ slob dpon gyi drung du byung ba la/ slob dpon gyis bcud len gtor bas/ ma smad gnyis rig pa 'dzin pa'i lus su gyur/ de'i rjes bsnyegs la skye bo mang po byung ba/ de rnams la yang slob dpon gyis bcud len gtor bas/ skye bo sum brgya tsam rig pa 'dzin pa'i lus su gyur te/ don chen po dang 'phrad skad/ der tsam pa'i rgyal pos gtam de thos pas/ skye bo mang po dang bcas te slob dpon gyi drung du song / rgyal pos phyag byas pas/ slob dpon khros pa ltar byas nas/ zas kyi snod sa la brdabs pas/ sa 'og nas klu'i rgyal po'i bu mo byung ste/ des yo byad mang po rgyal po la bstabs pas/ rgyal pos kyang / slob dpon grub pa thob par shes/ brag ri'i phug lha khang gi rnam pa can gnyis bcos te/ gcig tu ni slob dpon dang ma smad gnyis te gsum bzhugs par byas/ gcig tu ni sum brgya po gnas par byas so/ khye'u des kyang dngos grub —373—

mang du spyin nus pa yin te/ mig nas mig sman/ rna ba nas ri lu/ kha nas ral gri sna nas rkang mgyogs/ rdo rje nas gser 'gyur rtsa/ 'og sgo nas bcud len rnams 'byung / de gsum po stan gcig la 'dug ste/ ji srid byams pa ma byon gyi bar du 'gro ba'i don byed de gnas de la yang tsa spa tsan ṭi zer/ da lta yang gsol ba btab na dngos grub myur ba yin skad/ de'i slob ma ni grub thob ka sku ṭi pa yin te/ de yang slob dpon chen po pū yi pa la phyi'i dbang bskur ba rnams thob kyang zer/ lha yi pa yin par gcig tu yang ma nges par snang / de nas grub thob tsarla ṭi pa la gdams pa dang rjes su gdams pa mtha' dag thob nas/dur khrod rnams su spyod pa spyod cing bzhugs la/ rig ma bcu gnyis yod pa grong khyer du 'gro ba na khyim byar bsgyur te bzhud pas/ ka klu ṭi pa zhes grags/lar ka sku ṭi pa yang mi gcig pa gnyis byung gsung / de'i slob ma ni sī na pa yin te/ de ni rgya gar shar phyogs kā ma rle'i nya pa yin/ nya pa'i rlung cung zad goms pas/ lan cig nya la lcags kyu btang ste drangs pa la/ nyas khong phar drangs te mid/ der las kyi mthu dang nya pas rlud bsgoms pas ma shi ba la/ chu bo ro hi ta zhes bya ba da lta'i bod kyi gtsang po 'ad/ kā ma rur sleb pa de yin pa/de la u ma gi ri zhes bya ba'i ri de'u cig yod pa la/ lha dbang phyug gis u ma la rlung gi rnal 'byor gyi gdams ngag bshad pa/ chu de la nya song bas/ nya'i khog gi nya pas thos te bsgoms pas yon tan du ma thob/ lan cig nya pa rnams kyis nya de bzung nas bshas pas mi gcig byung / der sngar gyi rgyal po yang 'das/ sngon rang gi bu btsas ma thag pa yang der lo bcu gsum lon/ lar nya'i —374— ——

khog tu lo bcu gnyis bsdad/ de nas slob dpon tsar pa ṭi pa'i drung du song ste/pha bu gnyis kas gdams ngag zhus te bsgoms pas/ gnyis kas kyang grub pa thob ste/ pha ni grub thob sī na pa zhes grags/ bu ni grub thob ma tshin dra ba zhes bya'o/ /grub thob sī na pa'i slob ma ni ha li ba ste zhing rmod mkhan/ mā li pa ste skyed mos tshal mkhan dang / taX po li ba ste/ so rtsi mkhan te grub thob gsum byung / mawo dra'i slob ma na/ tso rang gi pa dang / go rak+ṣa nā tha gnyis yin/ de yang dang po ni rgyal po'i bu zhig yin/ lan cig rgyal po yul gzhan du song ba'i dus shig na/ btsun mo chun ma zhig yod pa/ rgyal bu gzugs mdzes pa la chags te/ rgyal bu'i drung du yang yang 'ongs kyang / rgyal bus 'dod pa dang du ma blangs pas de khros te rgyal po byung ba'i tshe/ gos ni bral/ mgo ni thal bas g.yogs/ yan lag nas khrag byung ste 'dug pa la/ rgyal pos ci nyes dris pas/'di ni lha'i sras kyis byas te/ da kho mo'i drung du 'dod pa don du gnyer bar byung ba la/ kho mos 'dod pa dang du ma blangs pas 'di ltar bgyis so zer/ de nas rgyal pos ma brtags par rang gi bu nyes pa med pa rkang lag bcad de sa phyogs shin tu dma' ba skye bo mang po 'gro ba'i lam gyi 'og cig tu shing drung gcig gi rtsa bar bor/ der slob dpon ma tshin dra pa byung ste/ de la lo rgyus po gad pas/'tsho ba ni ngas sbyor nus na/ khyod kyis lo bcu gnyis sgom nus sam gsungs pas/ des kyang nus par khas blangs/ de nas slob dpon ma tshin dra pas/ rang gi slob ma ba glang rdzi phyug po zhig yod pa la pha gi'i shing drung cig na mi yan lag bcad pa zhig yod kya/ de la khyod kyis lo bcu gnyis su zas skyol gsung / des —375—

kyang de bzhin du byas/ mthar lo bcu gnyis song ba'i dus shig na/ lam de la tshong pa mang po mtshan mo 'gro ba la/ tso rang gi pas khyed rnams su yin dris pas/de rgyal po'i sho gam pa yin gyi dogs nas/ nged rnams sol ba 'tshong mkhan lags byas pas/ de na re/ 'o na khyed rnams kyi yo byad thams cad sol bar gyur cig gsung / tshong pa rnams tshong 'dus su sleb nas zong bkram pa na/thams cad sol bar song 'dug ste/ phan tshun du ci nyes zhes brtags pa na/ tso rang gi'i tshig gi nus pa yin par shes nas/ tshong pa de rnams kyis slar song nas tso rang gi pa la bzod par gsol zhing / gsol ba btab pas/ tso rang gi pa na re/ 'o na sngar bzhin gyur cig byas pas/ tshong pa rnams slar ldog nas bltas pa'i tshe/ yo byad thams cad snga ma bzhin du thams cad bzang por gyur nas 'dug /de slob dpon gyi drin yin par shes nas/ zong gi phud slob dpon la phul ba/ slob dpon ma 'dod de/ slar khong rnams nyid la gto do/ /der rang gi yan lag sngar bzhin du gyur cig byas pas/ de bzhin du song ngo / /'gro ba'i don yang ci rigs pa mdzad de/ mkha' spyod du bzhud skad/ grub thob go rak+ṣa ni zas sbyor ba'i ba glang rdzi de nyid yin te/ mtshin dra'i gdams ngag gis rnal 'byor thob nas/ phyi rol kyi bya ba gzhan spangs te bsgoms pas/ rdzu 'phrul dang dngos grub thams cad thob/ des bsams pa/ nga'i rtogs pa 'di gzhan la spo snyam ste/ yul thams cad du skye bo mang po la gdams pa bstan pas thams cad grol/ sems can bye ba phrag gcig ma grol gyi bar du mkha' spyod du mi 'gro bar dam bcas/ sems can dpag tu med pa grol bar mdzad bzhin —376—

pa'o/ /'di'i lo rgyus mtha' yas pa ni bri bar ma lang ngo / /de la slob ma'i gtso bo yang bcu gnyis yod mod kya/ 'dir bka' babs pa na/ grub thob ka rna ri pa yin te/ de ni yul me ba ra'i rgyal po yin/ 'di'i btsun mo ping gā la zhes bya ba zhig yod sleb nas lo 'ga' song ba na/ rgyal po la shin tu snying nye ba yin yang /rgyal pos brtag pa'i phyir rang nyid skyed mos tshal du song / stag gis zos so zhes shi brdzun byas pas/ sdug bsngal gyis de ma thag btsun mo ping gwa la shi nas lus dur khrod du bskyal/ rgyal po yang grong khyer du mi 'gro bar dur khrod de nyid du btsun mo shi ba'i gro'i drung du hā ha ba ping ga lwa zhes zer zhing 'dug go/de ltar lo brgyad thal kyang skad/ bcu gnyis thal kyang zer te/ der grub thob go rak+ṣa byon te/ rdza'i chu snod ḍi pi gcig lag nas lhungs ma thabs su byas nas bcag ste/ de'i mya ngan byed cing hā ha ba ḍi pi zhes zer zhing bsdad pas/ rgyal po na re/ rnal 'byor pa blun po chu snod chag pa la ci'i phyir mya ngan byed/ gzhan zhig bcos pas chog mod byas pas/ slob dpon na re/ 'o na khyed nyid blun gya/nga'i chu snod chag pa da ltar shul yod la/ khyod kyi ping gā la na/ da ltar rdul tsam du song ste mi snang na/ da dung khyod nyid mya ngan byed pas so/ /der slob dpon grub thob sro rak+ta ra shes nas/ rjes su bzung bar zhus pas/ rgyal srid spongs gsung / des kyang rgyal srid spangs nas phyi bzhin du 'brangs/ lan cig gi tshe/slob dpon sha chang la dga' ba ltar mdzad pas/ des grong khyer du sha chang nye bar song ba na/ bud med gcig gis phag gi sha drug dang / myong gi bum pa drug bsgrigs te/ rin du khyod kyi mig g.yas pa sbyin na 'tshong gi gzhan zong rnams —377—

mi dgos zer/ der slob dpon la mchod pa'i don du mig g.yas pa tsham tshom med par bton te byin no/ /de nas sha chang de rnams slob dpon gyi drung du phul bas/ khyod kyi mig g.yas pa gang du song gsung / slob dpon la mchod pa'i don du 'di rnams la btsongs pa yin byas pas/ khyod kyi de bden na mig g.yon pa yang nga la byin gsungs pa las/ g.yon pa yang phyung ste phul lo/ /der slob dpon mnyes te byin gyis brlabs pa lo gsum nas mig gnyis kyang sngon bzhin du gyur/ de rjes lo gsum nas grub thob chen por gyur to/ /'di la be ra gi nā tha zhes kyang zer/ de'i slob ma na/ nā go pa ste/ bod skad gcer bu pa zhes bya ba yin no/ /da lta'i dzo gi mang po rgyal po ka ṇa ri pa dang / rgyal po bhar+sha ri gcig par 'dod pa shin tu 'khrul gsung ngo / /de la grub thob nā go pa na/ sku la snal ma gcig kyang ma gsol bas gcer bu pa zhes grags pa yin no/ /des lho phyogs kyi yul du bzhugs tsa na/ lan cig kong ku na'i rgyal po'i btsun mo'i 'khor gyi nang du byon te gdams ngag gsungs pas/ rgyal po khros te/ slob dpon gyi yan lag lnga bcad nas phyogs bzhir bor ro/ /der 'grig pa la yang bcad/ de ltar lan bdun song ba'i tha mar/ slob dpon gyis dmod pa bor bas rgyal po yan lag lnga rang chad de shi /yang kun gyis gsol ba btab pas gsos so/ /de lta bu'i nus pa yang bstan/ de nas ri bo lhan da pa la bzhud de/da lta yang lus ma spangs par yod skad/ de'i slob ma na/ bi ru pa chung ba'i slob brgyud go len nā tha te rdza sī mgon po zhes bya ba yin no/ /de yang dang po 'dul ba mang pos g.yengs pa la/ zhe bcad byas te/ rdza ma chen po gcig gi nang du —378—

zhugs nas/ dngos grub ma thob bar du 'di nas mi ldang ngo zhes dam bcas nas/ rtse gcig tu bsgoms pas lo bcu gnyis na grub pa thob ste/ skal ba dang ldan pa la gdams ngag ci rigs pa bstan nas/ bla ma gcer bu pa bzhugs pa'i drung du song ste mi snang bar gyur skad/ de'i slob ma ni o ko ra nā tha yin te/yul dbus na rgyal rigs kyi bu chung zhig chung ngu nas pha 'das shing / phu bo'i khyim du gso ba las/ go len nā thas/ rnal 'byor ma'i sgrub thabs shig byin no/ /de tsam ma gtogs lo bco brgyad lon gyi bar du rig pa gcig kyang ma bslabs pas/ phu bo dang khyim bdag mos blun po khyod kyis ci rung zhes spyos nas phyir phyung bas/ yid 'byung nas gzhan gyi yul du slong mos 'tsho zhing rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sgrub par byed/ mthar gyi lo bcu drug song ba na/ ting nge 'dzin bzang po yang skyes nas/ nub phyogs hi ga lwa tsi lha mo u ma'i gnas su song nas/ lha mo'i rdo sku'i steng du zla ba drug gnyid kyi 'od gsal thun gcig bsgoms pas/ lha mo skrag nas/ rnal 'byor pa rid dhi de hi ki ni dhi de zhes zer ba na/ rnal 'byor pas rdzu 'phrul dang gter gyis ci byed/ ye shes kyi dngos grub spyin na blang mod/ lha mos bdag la grub thob spyin du med/ go rak+ṣa las long zer ba la/ des go rak+ṣa 'tshol du song ba na/ yul go dā ba ri na rnal 'byor pa grangs med pa 'dug pa'i gral gyi tha ma zhig na/ bzhin shin tu mi sdug pa/yan lag las rnag khrag lhung ba zhig 'dug pas de yin par shes nas/ phyag btsal zhing gsol ba btab pas/ des byin gyis brlabs pa'i skrudi ma phul gang gnang ba 'thungs pas/ de nyid du shes bya'i yul kun la mnga' brnyes/ chos —379—

nyid mngon sum du mthong ba'i grub thob chen por gyur nas chos zugad do/ /des paṇ+ḍi ta chen po rā ti gup+ta la gdams pa yin no/ /de ni rgya gar lho phyogs su sku 'khrungs/ rigs ni tshong dpon gyi bu/ cher skyes pa na sangs rgyas pa'i sde la rab tu byung ste/ sde pa ni thams cad yod par smra ba yin gsung / blo shin tu rno bas 'dul ba 'bum sde dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'bum sde yang thugs la gzung / phyi rol kyi rig pa'i gnas la shin tu mkhas/ gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i chos 'tshol bar bzhed nas/ shar phyogs dang / rgya mtsho'i gling phran dang /nub phyogs kyi gnas mang por byon/ slob dpon chen po rin chen grags pa las dkyil 'khor bcu gsum du dbang bskur ba zhus/ yang slob dpon chen po dz+nyā na gup+ta la/ ra khang gi yul du dkyil 'khor drug cur dbang bskur ba zhus/bal po'i yul gyi paṇ+ḍi ta dā sha ba lwa la ping ha zhes bya ba la dbang dang gdams ngag mang po zhus/ rgyud kyi bshad pa yang slob dpon de gsum la zhus pa shas che/lan cig rgya gar shar phyogs su ston mo chen po zhig gi sa na/ mu stegs ral pa can 'dra ba'i rnal 'byor pa hrul po gcig 'dug pa la/ de dang gtam 'dra byas pas/ gzhan sems shes par 'dug nas su yin dris pas/ grub thob a si ta gha na yin gsung / der zla ba tsam bsten te gdams ngag kyang mang du gsan skad/ grub thob o ko ra nā tha la yang gdams pa dpag tu med pa gsan/ de nas yul ru lu ra ti la sogs pa lho phyogs kyi yul gyi gtsug lag khang sum cu tsam gyi gnas brtan mdzad/ bskyed pa'i rim pa la brtan pa thob/ rgyud sde lnga bcu tsam mkhyen pa yin no/ /rin po che'i 'byung khungs lta bu'i gtam las/—380—

gdams ngag sna tshogs brgyud pa'i gtam gyi skabs te brgyad pa'o// //de ltar bka' babs de thams cad ni grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po zhi ba sbas pa la mnga' ba yin te/ de la slob dpon 'di ni lho phyogs kyi grong khyer dza la maṇ+ḍal te chu'i dkyil 'khor zhes bya bar 'khrungs/ rigs ni rgyal rigs/gzhon nu nas rig pa'i gnas phra mo mang po/ sgra dang rtog ge yan lag dang bcas pa rnams la sbyangs/ yab kyang rje btsun ma sgrol ma nyams la zhal mthong ba'i sngags pa yin/ de la sgrol ma'i dbang bskur ba dang / sgrub thabs kyang gsan/ dgung lo nyi shu rtsa gnyis pa la rgya mtsho'i 'gram kong ku na'i yul du gser gyi rgyal mtshan zhes bya ba'i gnas gzhi gcig dus de tsam na btsun tshugs bzang ba/ chos grwa dar ba/ dge slong lnga bcu tsam/ dge bsnyen yan chad la 'dus che dus stong phrag tsam 'ong ba cig yod pa der mkhan po rā ti gup+ta la bsnyen par rdzogs/ dang por nyan thos kyi sde snod rnams dang / de nas dbu sems kyi gzhung lugs thams cad la mkhas par sbyangs/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa brgyad stong pa dang / sems tsam mdo bzhir grags pa la sogs pa gsung rab du ma thugs nas bshad/ mkhan po la yon dbul ba dang / rnyed bkur chen po bya bar bzhed nas/ sing ga la'i gling du yug cig byon/ der nag po chen po'i rig sngags cung zad grub pa dang / chos bshad pa'i mthus rnyed bkur dpag tu med pa byung / de rnams bla ma'i drung du bsnams te rin po che sna bdun gyi phung po chen po byas te phul/ dbang dang gdams ngag rnams zhus pas/thun mong gi dbang thams cad bskur/ rgyud lnga bcu tsam gyi bshad pa phal cher —381—

yang gnang / 'on kyang thun mong ma yin pa'i dbang dang gdams ngag rnams ni ma thob bo/ /de nas lo mang por bla ma'i tha na thal ba 'phyag pa tshun chad kyi g.yog mdzad cing / rang gi longs spyod chos gos gsum ma gtogs bla ma la phul/ rang gi zas ni grong khyer gyi bsod snyoms kyis mdzad/ de ltar lo drug song ba'i rjes su/ bla mas kyang thun mong ma yin pa'i dbang gong ma rnams dang /byin rlabs sna tshogs pa dang / gdams ngag thams cad gnang / de dag bsgoms pas nyams bzang po yang skyes/ der mkhan po sku 'das te/ gtsug lag khang de thams cad kyi bdag po yang mdzad/ dge 'dun gyi gnas brtan lo dgu'i bar du mdzad/ de dag tu yang mtshan mo ting nge 'dzin 'ba' zhig bsgom bzhin bzhugs/ 'on kyang nyin mo dge 'dun gyi bya ba sna tshogs pa des ye shes mi 'phel bar mkhyen nas/ dge 'dun la yang yang gnang ba zhus kyang / dge 'dun rnams kyis ma gnang ba la der slob dpon gyis chang gsol/ grong khyer gyi srang kha rnams su skad rigs sna tshogs kyis glu blangs sgo dang sgo ru gar sna tshogs mdzad pa/ dge 'dun rnams na re/ mkhan po chos mang po la mkhas pa yin pas chad pa mi byed kya/ da khyed 'tsho ba gang bde bar song zhes zer bas/da ni don thams cad 'grub snyam ste/ yul sna tshogs su brgyud/ yul tsi ba la'i gro nge khyer gcig gi 'dabs su spyil po zhig tu/ lo gsum sgrub pa mdzad/ de nas nub phyogs u rgyan gyi yul du bzhud/ der yang lo gsum tsam bzhugs/lan cig chu 'gram zhig na smad 'tshong ma drug khrus byed cing 'dug ji zhig na de rnams rtsig pa zhig gi phag tu song / 'di rnams ci zer dgongs te gsan —382—

pas/ gcig gis gcig la gtam gyi tshul gyis phyir bzlog man ngag drug bshad kyin 'dug de la sogs pa ngo mtshar du ma gzigs shing / rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis grogs mdzad pas/ ye shes gong nas gong du 'phel yang / de kho na nyid kyi gnas ma rtogs nas/ de kho na nyid ston pa'i slob dpon sems bzhin yod pa la/ der chang 'tshong ma zhig gi sgor byon pas/ de rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i rnam par gyur nas/ shar phyogs kyi yul na slob dpon ye shes bshes gnyen zhes bya ba bzhugs te/ des khyod la 'dod pa'i dngos grub ster bar 'gyur gsung / de nas slob dpon rim gyis shar phyogs su byon/ grong khyer gyi mi thams cad dang / phyi nang gi gnas thams cad du song ste ye shes bshes gnyen dris pas kyang bshad rgyu mi 'dug tsarla pa'i sde rnams kyi nang du phyin te dris pas kyang gzhan su la'ang bshad rgyu med/ lan cig de na rnal 'byor pa rgan po zhig na re/ de ni nged tsarla pa'i slob dpon nus mthu chen po zhig yin pa la/ da gar gshegs cha med nas lo mang po lon zer/ de nas kyang yang yang btsal bas/ lan cig nags kyi grong dang nye ba'i mchod rten gcig gi grib ma la 'gron btsun khyim btsun gyi cha byad gcig nyal nas 'dug de la ye shes bshes gnyen khyed kyis mthong ngam dris pas/ de'i zhal nas/ shes te nga yang de'i drung du 'gro ba yin/ 'di nas shar phyogs na ti pu ra zhes bya ba'i grong khyer na yod gsung / bstan par zhu byas pas/ nga'i nor 'di rnams nags 'di la khyod kyis 'phyer thub na bstan gsung / der khur lci mo zhig bdug pa bsnams te byon/ 'gron btsun de ni sngon la song / zhi ba sbas pa ni lam du chom pos —383—

bzung / khur bzhig pas rdo 'ba' zhig byung ste/ rkun po rnams tshig pa zos te/slar yang cher brdungs/ sa la ro bzhin 'gyel ba na/ yang slob dpon de byung ste/chus bkrus shing sngags btab pas 'phrul du gsos te 'gro thub par byung / ti pu rar byon pa'i tshe bla ma bstan par zhu byas pas/ mtshe'u gcig gi 'gram du khrid nas/ der bla ma rang gi gzugs brnyan shar ba la/ ye shes bshes gnyen ni 'di yin zhes gsungs/ des kyang ngo sprad pa bzhin du song nas/ ting nge 'dzin bzang po zhig kyang skyes/ 'o na bdag rjes su bzung bar zhu byas pas/khyod ci brtol che/ rnyed bkur med par rjes su bzung bar zhu zer ba gsung nas/ khros shing mang du brdungs/ der khyim bdag nor chen po zhig la/ ngas khyod kyi las kyi g.yog byas na/ nga la gla ji tsam ster byas pas/ de na re nyi ma re la gser di nar re re sbyin zer/ de'i g.yog lo gcig mdzad/ rgya gar ba'i zhing las kyi khol bo ni shin tu sdug gsung / der g.yin yang yo byad mang dag ster mkhan byung ba/ de thams cad slob dpon la phul/ yang bla ma'i phyi bzhin song ba na/ lan cig nags gseb zhig na ma he mo sna thag btags pa zhig 'dug 'di khrid cig gsungs/ bla ma sngon la gshegs/ zhi bas de khrid nas phyin pas/ bdag pos phyi bzhin bsnyegs pas zin nas/ des shin tu btags te/ thang la ro bzhin song ba la/ bla ma byon nas thabs mdzad pas gsos/ yang lan cig bla ma'i rdzas 'dra rtswa khyim pa 'dra la bcol te bzhag dpon slob gnyis grong khyer la byon te ldog phebs pas/ rtswa khyim thams cad la me 'ur 'ur 'bar gyin 'dug der bla ma rang gi rdzas la thugs khral che che ltar mdzad kyin —384—

'dug pas/ 'o na bdag gis blang ngam zhus pas/ long gsung / der me'i dbus su tsham tshom med par zhugs te bla ma'i rdzas rnams blangs pas/ rkang lag thams cad rus pa la thug gi bar du tshig lus thams cad kyang chu bur du gyur/ de la shi yang bla ma'i rdzas kyi phyir yin snyam ste/ 'gyod pa'i sems ni skad cig kyang ma byung / de yang rdzas 'gangs che ba ni med de chu snod gcig na ri ke le'i phor pa gcig shing gi maṇ+ḍal gcig ka pā la gcig rnams yin gsung /der nges par 'chi'am snyam pa la/ bla mas sngags dang sman mdzad pas ring por mi thogs par gsos/ der zhi ba sbas pa'i thugs la/ bdag gi lus ngan pa 'di gso ba'i phyir du slob dpon gyi sman zad par byas pa ni ma legs/ da yong slob dpon gyi phyir du bdag nyid dka' ba du ma byed pa ni rang gi don 'ba' zhig yin pas/ de la slob dpon las sngags dang sman blang ba shin tu mi rung bas/ slob dpon nga'i g.yog tu mi bkol zhes dam bcas/ yang lan cig slob dpon ra khang gi yul du 'byon par bzhed nas/ grur zhugs pa na/ ji zhig ltar na/ chu'i dkyil nas nya mche ba can zhig nyang gis byung / des slob dpon la gnod par gyur gyi dogs nas/ de la mdung thung zhig bsnun/ nya des zhi ba sbas pa'i zhabs la rmugs/ chu'i dkyil du nyas 'byer la khad pa la/ bla ma dran par byas pas/ nya'i kha nas btang ste nya chu la song ngo / /der rmas sdug bsngal bar gyur kyang slob dpon gyi rim gro byed pa la ma g.yel bar byas pas/ zhag bdun song ba'i tho rangs shig ci byas med par zug rngu rnams zha/ yang shar phyogs ra khang gi yul der slob dpon brag phug cig tu bzhugs/ zhi ba sbas pas grong —385—

khyer sna tshogs nas yo byad 'tshol ba sogs don mang po la 'gro dgos/ yul de ni chu klung shin tu mang bas/ yang yang rkyal zhing brgal dgos pa las/ srog chags si sā ra te 'dzin khri'i rigs su gtogs pa/ bod la chu srin spar du grags pas kyang lan gsum bzung mod kya/ slob dpon rang gis kyang nus pa brnyes pa dang / bla ma dran par byas pas des kyang btang ba 'ba' zhig byung /gzhan yang srog chags gī ka ra dang / nya dang chu'i sprul la sogs pas zos shing phug pas/ rmas pa ni bgrang du med gsung / de thams cad la bla ma'i sngags dang sman gcig kyang ma blangs te/ sngags dang sman sogs phan pa'i thabs thams cad gzhan las bslangs/ yul der slob dpon lo gsum bzhugs pa/'khor mchog gi rnal 'byor pa lnga/ rig ma bcu gnyis dang bcas te/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo yang dang yang du spyad pas/ zhi ba sbas pa ni rgyu 'grul gzhan pas mang pa mdzad dgos shing / yul de'i chu'i srog chags gzhan pas gdug pa che bas/lo gsum du lus shin tu sbyongs spyod che yang / thugs la skyo dub gcig kyang ma byung ngo / /de dus kyi 'khor de kun phyis dngos grub thob pa sha stag byung gsung /de nas dpon slob gnyis gru la brten te bhang ga lar byon/ dang po mjal nas de bar gdams ngag tshig gcig kyang ma gnang bas/ der gdams ngag gnang bar zhus pa na/ rnyed bkur med par rjes su bzung mdzod ces/ de nyid thob ma thag tu slob dpon la/ lhag pa'am mnyam zhes 'gran byed mi de la/ dpal chen rdo rje sems dpa'ang 'jigs zhes gsung / zhes bya ba yin gsung ste/ khros shing ma mnyes pa'i tshul bstan te bros nas bzhud do/ /der bang thag pa nas rgyugs —386—

kyang rjes ma zin/ zhag bdun du yul de'i phyogs thams cad du btsal yang ma rnyed/ de nas thag ring por song nas/ grong khyer sna tshogs su mi rnams la dris kyang cha med/ de ltar zla ba gnyis su btsal yang ma rnyed pas/ sto ra ṭaX ḍa zhes pa'i grong khyer zhig tu zhag bdun ngu bzhin gsol ba 'debs kyin bsdad/ der yang ma byon pas/ da ni tshe 'dir skal ba med pa yin/ 'di nyid du shi bar bya snyam ste/ brag de'u gcig gi rtse nas mchongs pas kyang yan lag bsnad pa sogs med cing / gnod pa cang ma byung / der yid skyo bas cung zad cig bsdad pa na/ rig ma ngo shes pa cig phyogs der byung ste/ slob ma bzang po ci byed kyin yod gsung / slob dpon gyi rig ma bla ma yin pas/ zhabs la spyi bos gtugs te/ kho bo ni skal ba med de/ bla mas bor bas 'chi bar sems byas pas/ de na re/ khyod slob dpon gyis nges par rjes su 'dzin par 'dug gsung / der yid cung zad spro ba skyes te/ slob dpon gang na bzhugs dris pas/ bla ma ni nga'i khyim du byon nas zhag 'ga' bzhugs te da lta bal por bzhud gsung / bud med de mi snang bar thal lo/ /der zhi ba sbas pas lam du zhugs byon pa na/ brag rtse nas mchongs pa mthong ba'i mi rnams kyis/ ci'i phyir mchongs zhes 'dri ba mang du byung ba la/ lan ni ma smras/ kho bo bla ma ma rnyed pas sdug bsngal ba la/ 'di kun sos re dal na snyam tshog pa za bar byung skad/ de nas bal po'i yul du byon te/ grong khyer dang gnas gzhi so sor dris pas/ gzhan rnams su shod mkhan ma byung / yaX bu'i nag po chen po'i lha khang gi dkon gnyer na re/ de 'dir byung ste zhag 'ga' tho co'i spyod pa 'dra byas nas kā ma rur song zer/ de ma thag kā ma ru —387—

la bstad nas byon pas/ nags kyi lam rnams su chom rkun dang / stag dang /ma he dang / bse ru la sogs pa 'jigs pa ji snyed byung yang / bla ma 'ba' zhig dran par byas pas gnod pa ma byung / kā ma rle'i grong khyer ga ru ḍa gha ṭa na slob dpon bzhugs pa dang mjal/ dga' ches te lus sa la brdabs pa'i phyag brgya stong du ma byas so/ /der bla ma na re/ gal te khyod gdams ngag 'dod na/ nga'i bla ma a si ta gha na mkha' spyod du gshegs pa'i sa/ he raX pa'i brag gi rtse de yin pas/ der so phag gi mchod rten mi 'greng lnga yod pa zhig bzhengs shig gsung /de nas yul der phyin nas gos zhig yod pa/ phag bre'i rin la sprad nas/ pha gu brdeg pa dang / so gtong ba thams cad kyang zhi ba sbas pa gcig pas mdzad/ de nas khyim bdag dad pa can gcig gis grogs cung zad byas nas/ he raX pa'i rtse mor mchod rten bzhengs zin nas/ bla ma'i drung du 'ongs pa na khyim bdag la grogs bcol ba des mi rung zhes gsungs te/ de nas kyang lo gcig gi bar gdams ngag ma gnang / de rjes o ḍi sha'i grong khyer ka ṭa ka bha na ra si na bzhugs pa'i dus su/ bla ma'i zhal nas/ khyim zhig bstan te khyim 'di na gser mang du yod pa brkus nas nga la phul zhig gsungs/ de yang khyim de ni mgar ba nor che zhing ser sna dam pa/ phyi nang gi rab tu byung ba gang la yang sdang ba zhig yin te/ dang por de'i khyim du zhi ba sbas pas zhugs phyin pa na/ de'i sgo bsrung gis brdungs rdeg mang po byung / der slob dpon sku'i stobs che bas/ sgo bsrung de phyag gcig gis mnan te/ nang du myongs kyis zhugs pas/ mgar ba de lcags kyi las byed pa dang thug ste/ de shin tu khros nas lcags gong dmar —388—

'bar ba zhig zhi ba sbas pa'i sku la 'phangs pas na bza' yang ma tshig sku la yang gnod pa ma byung ste/ der khyi mche ba dug can mang po rbad byung ba de rnams kyis slob dpon la rmugs kyang sku la gnod pa ma byung zhing / thugs kyang g.yo ba med par 'dug pa des mthong nas cung zad dad par gyur te/ de na re/khyod der 'dug zas drangs kyi zer/ zas ngan ngon zhig drangs/ der shin tu dgyes pa ltar gsol bas/ de yang cung zad ngo mtshar skyes shing / khyed zas 'di tsam gyis tshims na nang par nas kyang shog cig zer/ der yang dang yang du byon pas 'dris par gyur pa'i mtshams shig de'i khyim dang yo byad kyi gnas tshul thams cad kyang slob dpon gyis shes nas/ des sdig pas bsgrub pa'i gser srang stong phrag tsam yod pa su la yang spyin par mi nus pa de/ lan cig khong rnams yengs pa zhig la/ slob dpon gyis brkus nas 'ongs ste bla ma la phul bas/ bla ma na re/ bu de legs/ ser sna can gyi nor 'di/ gzhan la sbyin dgos gsungs te/ ra khang gi yul gyi dge 'dun rnams la phul zhig gsung ba ltar 'bul bar byon/ phyis zhi ba dus gzhan lan cig grong khyer du song ba la/sngar gyi mgar ba des zin te/ yul de'i rgyal po mu kun+da de ba la gtad nas/sngar gyi lo rgyus rnams bsnyad/ der stes dbang gis skye bo mang po yang 'dus/rgyal pos slob dpon nyid la dris pa la/ slob dpon gyis ser sna can gyi longs spyod ni brkus pa'am phrogs te gzhan la byin na/ de nyid bsod nams 'phel ba yin gsungs pas/ der mi thams cad kyis gad mos btab ste/ 'di ni rkun po chen po zhig ste/ 'di'i spyi brtol la ltos/ 'di ltar rkun mo byas pa yang yon —389—
