tan du rtsi'o zer/ der rgyal pos re zhig btson khang du zhog cig phyis brtags la chad pas gcod do zhes rgyal po skye bo dang bcas pa so sor gyes so/ /bar der slob dpon ye shes bshes gnyen gyis dgongs pa mdzad pas/ btson khang gi steng du bya rnam pa sna tshogs pa 'dus/ mtha' kho ra khor yug tu khyi dang ce spyang sna tshogs pas nyin mtshan bye brag med par bskor zhing skad 'byin pa byung pas/the tshom du gyur pa la/ de'i phyi de'i nyin bar de pho brang la yang de bzhin du byung bas der rtsis pas/ rnal 'byor pa btson khang du bcug pa zhig gi nus pa yin zhes byung / de nas zhag 'ga' zhig lon pa na/ btso ni khang gi sgor ye shes bzhes gnyen byon nas btson bsrung rnams la bye ma gtor bas thams cad rengs/ sgo lcags kyang rang bye nas zhi ba sbas pa dang btson lnga stong lhag cig thar/ zhi ba sbas pas btso ni khang du zla ba phyed song / gser blangs pas bla ma mnyes pa re dga' snyam pa ma gtogs mi dga' ba dang yi mug sogs gtan nas ma byung ngo / /de nas slob dpon gyi phyi bzhin du 'brangs te yul tri ling ga zhes bya ba'i grong khyer zhig tu byon/ grong khyer der phebs tsam nyid nas bla mas kyang gdams ngag mang du gsungs/ de nas lo gnyis tsam song ba na bla ma na re/da dbang bskur bar bya dgos pas/ chu bo'i pha rol kyi khyim pha gi na/ rigs dang ldan pa'i sngags can ma 'di lta bu zhig yod/ de 'dir khrid la shog gsung /nang bar 'gro'am zhus pas do nub nyid khrid la shog gsung / der chu bo chen po zhig yod pa la rkyal nas song ste/ nyi ma nub tu nye ba na khyim der sleb/ khyim de ni rgyal rigs rgyal po'i glang chen gnas pa zhig yin/ grong khyer gyi ming yang —390—

lañja ka ra zhes bya ba yin gsung / khyim der 'o bo 'grul ba zhig yin yud tsam gnas g.yar gsungs pas/ des kyang nang du byon zer te byon/ der slob dpon gyis steng 'og kun tu brtags pa na/ bla mas lung bstan pa de ni khyim bdag de'i bu mo yin te/ de ni shin tu srungs pa yin pas thabs ci zhig gis thob par 'gyur sem mo/ /de nas srod kyi dus su skye bo'i rgyu 'grul chad pa na/ slob dpon gyis rig sngags kyis ngag bcings te/ bud med de re zhig cang mi smra ba byas nas/ stobs chen pos phrag pa la bkal te/ sgo rnams kyang stobs kyis phyes nas bros so/ /grong khyer gyi phyi rol tu sleb pa na/ nang gi mi rnams kyis rjes bsnyegs kyang ma zin/ nub mo de nyid la chu bo la rkyal nas 'ongs/ bla ma'i drung du nam phyed kyi dus su sleb/ bla ma na re/ dus kyang la nye legs pa yin gsung /der tho rangs kyi dus su dbang bskur/ zhag bdun gyi bar du byin gyis brlabs pa dang / thun mong ma yin pa'i zhal gyi gdams pa mtha' dag stsal/ gnas de yang brag de'u gcig la yod de/ sngon slob dpon klu sgrub kyi phug pa yin gsung /glang chen gnas kyi rjes gcod kyi mi rnams kyang khong gnyis chus khyer bar bsam ste/ phyogs der phyis ma byung / de nas bla ma sbyin sreg gcig mdzad pa'i skabs/ slob dpon gyis las kyi rdo rje mdzad pa la/ bya ba cung zad cig 'khrul bas/ bla ma khros nas thab kyi me mang po gtor bas/ des rkyen byas te bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ye shes nam mkha' lta bu mtha' dbus med pa mnyam nyid khyab brdal gyi ye shes mngon du gyur nas chos thams cad kyi gting sleb/ der rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen por gyur to/ /bud med des kyang rnal 'byor ma byas —391—

te/ spyod pa pa'i sde rnams su so/nga bar / rnal 'byor ma me na ka zhes bya bar grags/ rtogs pa nam mkha' dang mnyam/ lta stengs bzhi grub/ chu la mi bying /phyis dngos grub kyang thob bo/ /der bla ma ye shes bshes gnyen na re/ zhi ba sbas pa/ ngas khyod la gdams ngag thams cad ni bstan zin/ don chen po yang grub/ da khyod so da'i) song la/ thog mar spros med kyi spyod pa gyis/ de nas gsangs te spyod pa gyis/ de nas spros bcas kyi spyod pa byed par zhig bskul bar 'ong bas/ de'i tshe spros bcas kyi spyod pa gyis shig tshe 'di nyid la rdo rje 'chang chen po'i go 'phangs thob po gsung / der zhi ba sbas pas/ bdag 'di ltar chos thams cad kyi gting sleb pa ni bla ma'i sku drin lags pas tshe 'dir dngos grub mchog ma thob kyang sla'/ bla ma nyid kyi rjes su 'brang zhus pas/ bla ma na re/ ngas khyod gcig pu'i phyir lo de snyed cig mi'i yul du gnas pa yin/de bas na nga'i rtogs pa 'di skal ba dang ldan pa tham sa cad la khyod kyis spos shig ces gsung ste/ de nyid du mi snang bar gyur to/ /der bla ma'i thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes ni bdag nyid kyi mngon du gyur pas/ som nyi thams cad ni chod mod kyang / bla ma'i gzugs kyi sku de mi snang bar song bas/ thugs rab tu gdung bar gyur te glu blangs so/ /der slob dpon ye shes bshes gnyen de lo bcu tsar/ bsten pa yin gsung / de nas gdung ba'i glu len pa'i tshul gyis zab mo'i don ston bzhin du rim gyis rgya gar nub phyogs so mas byon/ dzo na gha ṭa zhes bya ba'i grong khyer zhig dang mi ring pa'i phyogs shig tu smra ba thams cad spangs/ yang nas yang du mnal zhing sad pa na yang mnyam par bzhag pa kho nas —392—

—bzhugs/ lam du lan cig stag gzis mong gol zhig gis phyag zhabs me la bsregs pas kyang / rdo sku'am shing sku me la bsregs pa bzhin du tshor ba med pa ltar bzhugs/ yang hen du'i rta pa zhig slob dpon la dad de/ gser dang dngul gyi me tog bre gang sku la gtor bas kyang snga ma ltar tshor ba med pa ltar 'dug bdag gi bla ma'i zhal nas gtan ma tshor ba ni min/ stong pa nyid du gzigs pa yin gsung / de ltar lo gnyis 'das sam yang zer/ phyed dang gnyis song ngam yang zer/ phyi ma dag ste spyod pa zla ba drug tu spyod dgos pa/ da ltar gyi dus 'grub dka' ba yin pas/ lan gsum du bskyar ba yin gsung /de ni shin tu spros med kyi spyod pa'o/ /de las grol te grong khyer dang nags tshal rnams su rgyu zhing / gsang ste spyod nga cung zad mdzad pa la/ ji zhig nas a ba ga tī 'jig rten pa'i mngon du spyod pa spyon pa'i brtul zhugs zla ba drug tu mdzade de/ bar bar du skye bo rnams la chos kyang bstan pas ye shes mchog skyes pa mang du byung / grong khyer gyi mi mang pos kyang / slob dpon ye shes can du shes nas ci rigs par mchod pa la/ yul de'i rgyal po stag gzig gi rigs/ sngon sangs rgyas pa rnam sa la snyad 'tshol ba zhig yod pa yul de dge slong mang bas/ phyis dbe slong rnams kyi btsun tshugs la dad de/ sangs rgyas pa la mchod pa mang po byed pa zhig yin pas/ slob dpon gyi sngags kyi spyod pa byas pa la yid ma ches te/ slob dpon gyi drung du byung nas/ kwa ye khyod rdzun du smra ba'am/ bden par smra ba zhig rab tu byung ba rnams sun 'byin par byed dam zhes zer ba la/slob dpon gyis kho bo cag ni 'dod pa la longs spyod bzhin du yid gzhan du —393—

gyur pa med do/ /rgyal po na re de brtag par bya'o zhes slob dpon pho brang gi nang du spyan drangs/ yang thog shin tu dben pa zhig tu bzhag sku lus la na bza' med pas/ rdzas sbed pa'i gnas med/ nye 'khor du rtog pa'i mi ni nyin dang mtshan du gnas/ zas skom gcig kyang ma drangs par nyin zhag bdun 'das kyang / sku lus snga ma bzhin du 'dug la/ der rgyal pos yul khams kyi bzhin bzang ma stong lhag gcig kyang zer/ lnga brgya yang zer/ de tsam bsdus/ khyed sngags kyi spyod pa can yin na/ 'di rnams nyin zhag gcig tu spyod nus sam zhes slob dpon la gtad pa na/ spros bcas kyi spyod pa spyod par bskul ba 'byung zhes bla mas lung bstan pa de yin par mkhyen nas de rnams dang lhan cig tu rig pa brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa spyod cing / bdag nyid kyi nus pa bstan pa'i phyir de rnams kyi lus ro bcud dang bral bar mdzad cing / bdag nyid nyin byed lta bu'i gzi brjid dang ldan pas nyi ma gnyis pa la pho brang gi yang thog nas rgyang grags tsam mkha' la gya gyur gshegs te thag ring po'i skyed mos tshal zhig tu bzhugs so/ /yul phyogs de yang zhing mchog tu gyur pa yin pas/ pho nya mo yang shin tu mang ba yin te tshogs kyi 'du ba khyad par can gyi spros bcas kyi spyod pa yang zla ba drug mdzad/ lhar na ri zhes bya ba'i ri la bzhugs pa'i dus shig tu phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub kyi go 'phangs nyams 'og tu chud par gyur la/ de'i dus nam tho rangs kyi tshe/ sa g.yos sgra chen po byung / dri bzang pos khyab/ me rta ge gi char babs/ nam mkha' nas rol mo'i sgra bsgrags pa na/ skye bo thams cad kyi mngon sum du byung / phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyi zhal gcig —394—

car gzigs/ yi dam sna tshogs pa dang / grub pa thams cad mngon sum du byon nas shis pa brjod/ zhag bdun du gnas gsum kyi mi ma yin dang / dpa' bo mkha' 'gros mchod pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa rgyun ma chad par byung / ri de la slar yang zla ba drug tu mtshan ma med pa'i ting nge 'dzin 'ba' zhig la bzhugs/de nas lho phyogs kha gen dra zhes bya ba'i ri la bzhugs pa'i skabs shigayul bhaX dwa gyi rgyal po dga' byed gtum po zhes bya ba ri dwags bshor du 'ongs pa na/ ri'i zur zhig na ri dwags ha ri ṇa gcig 'dug pa mthong / de'i rjes bsnyegs te phyin pa na/ ha ri ṇa de ni stag gcig tu gyur/ der yang cung zad brtags pas/ de yang me zhig tu dmar khyug ste song / lo ma'i spyil po zhig gi nang du zhugs so/ /rgyal pos de la blta ru song ba na/ dge slong gi gzugs gzi brjid che ba zhig 'dug nas/ khyed su yin dris pas/ lan gnyis su slob dpon cang mi gsung / lan gsum pa dris pas/ sdig spyod kyi rgyal po ci zhig smra/kho bo rnal 'byor pa zhig yin gsung / der lta stangs kyis zil gyis mnan pas rgyal po lhag par dad nas zhabs la phyag byas te/ yang dag pa'i gtam ci rigs pa gleng zhing yod pa'i tshe/ 'khor rnams kyang der 'ongs te/ slob dpon gyi zhabs la phyag 'tshal/ chos kyi gtam gyis dga' bar mdzad/ bram ze'i khye'u zhig la snying po'i don bstan pas/ glu dang gar mang du byas shing mi snang bar gyur skad/ de'i ming ni dza na ma de ba zhes zer te/ slob dpon 'di'i slob ma grub pa thob pa sngon ma ni de yin skad/ der dge tshul paṇ+ḍi ta gaX bhi ra ma ti zhes bya ba zhig slob dpon gyi drung du byung ste/ shin tu dad nas slob mar khas —395—

blangs te/ rim gro thams cad byed cing gnas so/ /de yang snod dang ldan par mkhyen nas/ dbang bskur zhing gdams pa gnang / des kyang bsgoms pas ring por mi thogs par rkang mgyogs kyi dngos grub thob/ slob dpon rdzu 'phrul gyis gang du gshegs pa der/ des kyang bla ma'i rim gro byed pa la 'byon nus pa yin no/ /de nas slob dpon ma dra'i yul du byon nas/ mu stegs dang / tu puṅge ste/ kla klo stag gzig rnams la rengs pa'i lta stangs kyis rengs par mdzad/yul gyi mi dang gtso bo rnams dbang du byed pa'i lta stangs kyis dbang du mdzad/skye bo rnams la chos kyang bstan pas ye shes khyad par du gyur pa'ang mang du byung zhing / yul 'di nang pa lhag par mang bas/ dge 'dun phal cher gyi zhabs la ga khas/ thun mong ma yin pa'i gdams pa gnang pa'i slob ma ni drug yod de/paṇ+ḍi ta bi ma la sa phya dang / tsan+d+ra a ka ra dang / rat+na ka ra ste dge slong paṇ+ḍi ta gsum dang / dge bsnyen paṇ+ḍi ta su ga ta dang / rnal 'byor ma u ma pa ti dang /rnal 'byor ma tā raX ga rnams so/ /de la dang po gsum yang bskyed rdzogs kyi rtogs pa khyad par can brnyes/ ngag gi dmod pa dang bden tshig 'grub pa yin/'di gsum kas rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i zhal mngon sum du gzigs/ dge bsnyen su ga tas las bzhi dang / khyad par mngon spyod thogs med du 'grub/ slob dpon 'di bzhis lhan cig shar phyogs kyi ljongs blta zhing byon pa la/ shar phyogs kyi kla klo pa khyu na rnams kyis yul 'khor rnams la ches sdug bsngal ster zhing / phyi nang gi lha khang thams cad kyang bzhag pa gzigs/ khyad par rgya mtsho'i 'gram gyi de ba gi re zhes bya ba'i ri la sangs rgyas kyi lha khang mang po yod pa de —396—

skabs me la bsregs/ kha sa rla ṇi'i gtsug lag khang la'ang me btang mod/ mes ma tshig /slob dpon grogs mched rnams byon pa la yang / nga'i yul du mgo bregs gos dmar can 'di lta bu sngar med pa las da ltar 'ongs pa ma legs zhes slob dpon bzhi po btson dong du bcug /gshed ma bskos te bgrong par bsam pa las/ gshed ma dang btso ni srung rnams la nyungs kar gtor bas/ de rnams dran med du myos pa'i bar la bros nas byon te/ byang chub chen po la gsol ba btab pas/ drag po'i 'phrin las 'grub cing bya ba'i dus yin par lung bstan/ de nas dza ri khaṇ+ḍa ra slob dpon 'di bzhi zhal 'dzom ste/ gshin rje gshed kyi 'khor lo bskor bas/ zla ba drug tsam na pa khyu na dang / mo khol nang 'khrugs te shar phyogs kyi tu ruski'i rigs thams cad g.yul ngor brlag heskye'i rgyal po ma na shing zhes bya bas 'dzin pa byung ngo / /u ma pa tis 'ja' lus grub/ rnal 'byor ma mu tā raX gas lta stangs bzhi thogs med du grub/ der slob dpon nyid kyi rjes su 'brang ba'i slob ma rnal 'byor pho mo nyi shu tsam byung / de nas lho phyogs ka rna ṭar bzhugs tsam na/ de'i yul gyi rgyal po ni mu stegs pa yin pas/ de 'dul ba'i phyir rgyal po'i pho brang du byon/ pho brang nang na sngon srid sgrub kyis bzhengs pa'i ling ga 'jigs su rung pa gcig yod pa'i steng du byon te gar mdzad pas/ zhabs rjes byung / rgyal pos glang po che khros pa drug rbad pas/ glang po che drug kar phyag gis mnan pas g.yo ba med/ sgo ka'i rdo sku cho 'phrul che ba zhig yod pa la sdigs 'dzub mdzad pas mar gyi gong bu la nyi ma phog pa bzhin du mer gyis zhu/ da lta sku de ya cha ba gcig tu song 'dug gsung /—397—

der rgyal pos kyang grub pa thob par shes nas phyag byas/ slob dpon grub pa brnyes pa'i grags pa phyogs thams cad du khyab pas/ ma ra ha ṭa dang / koṅku na'i dge 'dun rnams kyis spyan drangs te de'i gtsug lag khang thams cad du phebs/dbang bskur pa dang / gdams ngag spyin pa dang / rgyud bshad pa la sogs pas rdo rje theg pa'i bstan pa cher gsal bar mdzad/ paṇ+ḍi ta sum cu tsam dang /gzhan yang 'khor rnam bzhir gtogs pa drug cu lhag gcig dang grong khyer gyi mi bcu gcig tsam gyis phra mo rnams grub/ gzhan yang ting nge 'dzin mchog thob pa mang du byung zhing / de nyid du dngos grub mchog thob nas mi snang bar gyur pa mang du byung / de nas bhaX dwa gyi rgyal pos spyan drangs te yun ring du mchod pa byas shing /der gser gling dang / dha na shrī gling dang / be+e gu'i gling dang / ra khang dang / pu kang la sogs pa thag ring po'i gling rnams dang / gzhan yang 'dzam bu gling gi dge slong rnams dang / paṇ+ḍi ta ji snyed 'dus te/ rgyal pos kyang de thams cad la lo gsum du mchod pa byas/ rab tu byung ba ni stong phrag gsum tsam/ dge bsnyen dang / dge bsnyen ma ji snyed cig dang / gzhan yang phyogs bzhi'i rnal 'byor pa brgya stong du ma rnams la la ni sgrub thabs zhu/ la la ni gdams ngag zhu/ la la ni dbang dang byin rlabs zhu bar byed/ kha cig ni zhabs la phyag 'tshal zhing skor ba la sogs pas las 'brel 'jog par byed de/ lho phyogs ka ling ka'i paṇ+ḍi ta chen po be+e da tik+ṣa dang / sang ga shī la dang / ma phywa ra'i yul gyi slob dpon chen po bī ra brgyu dang / a sang ga bo dhi dang / pañca dhar ba li'i yul gyi slob dpon a nan+ta mā ti dang / be dā nan+da dang / pu kang gi yul gyi mkhas pa chen po dharma k+ṣa —398—

lho ṣa dang / par he ta sto ṣa dang / rdo rje gdan pa su me gha la sogs pa rnams kyis slob dpon chen po nyid dang / rnal 'byor ma dī na ka ra dang / slob dpon chen po gaX bhi ra mā ti la sogs pa slob dpon gyi thugs kyi sras rnams la rgyud sde zab mo thams cad zhus/ de ltar slob dpon 'di'i bka' drin gyis 'phags pa'i yul gyi dge 'dun sogs nang pa thams cad la rdo rje theg pa'i bka' drin bstsal ba yin no/ /nas gling dang gser gling dang zangs gling la sogs pa'i dge 'dun rnams ni nyan thos sen+ta pa kho na yin pa'i phyir slob dpon 'di'i bka'i gnang bas ma khyab ste/ gu ru shar phyogs pa nir pa ṇa shrī slob dpon gyi drung du bzhugs pa'i tshe/ slob dpon chen po tri ling ga'i tshong 'dus chen po gcig na bzhugs/ skye bo brgya stong du ma phyag 'tshal zhing yod pa la/ mahā bo dhi mjal du 'gro ba'i nas gling pa'i dge slong mang po 'dug pa de kun gsang sngags la ngan du zer zhing / slob dpon la phyag mi 'tshal bar 'dug gsung /de nas tri ling ga'i yul der rgyal po bi ka ṭa zhes pa na ba'i lto bcos la mi mang po dang ma he lnga stong / bya dang ra lug 'bum phrag mang po bsad pa'i mchod sbyin byed dgos zer te/ der cho ga byed pa'i mu stegs dang bram ze brgya stong 'dus/srog chags thams cad bcings nas yod pa'i skabs shig slob dpon ni gang nas byung cha med par de rnams kyi mchod sbyin khang par byon/ bram ze dang mu stegs thams cad la lta stangs mdzad pas thams cad rengs/ der rgyal po ngo mtshar skyes nas 'ongs pas/ slob dpon na re/ srogs chags 'di snyed cig bsad na khyod myur du 'cha/ shi nas kyang dmyal bar skye/ 'di rnams thong zhig —399—

gsung / de rnams bkrol te btang ma thag tu slob dpon gyis rgyal po'i mgo bor phyag bzhag pas nad las grol/ der mchod sbyin gyi mi rnams kyang rnal 'byor pa 'ba' zhig byas/ ye shes khyad par can skyes pa mang du yod gsung /der yul tsa lha'i tu ru kho/ rgyal po zhig slob dpon bzhugs pa dang nye ba'i lam la song bas/ der glob dpon la ngan du brjod nga/ mang du byas pa/ slob dpon gyi slob ma zhig gis thos pas/ khyed rnams lkugs par gyur cig ces dmod pa btab pas/ rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa de nyid du lkugs/ der shin tu skrag nas slob dpon la gsol ba btab pas/ sangs rgyas pa rnams kyi nus pa bstan pa'i phyir/ gcig ma gtogs pa thams cad smra nus par gyur cig ces gsungs pas de bzhin du gyur/ yang yul dbus su byon wā ra ṇa sir/ mu stegs kyi paṇ+ḍi ta ye shes can du 'dod pa/ ma da su da na swar su sta/ 'khor mang po'i dbus su khri mthon por gnas pa la sdigs 'dzub mdzad pas khri de las lhung / ma thu ra'i yul du sngon nang pa'i rnal 'byor pa cung zad byas pas/ phyis mu stegs pa'i rnal 'byor pa byas pa'i mu kun+da warti zhes pa des a hu ṭha tsaṇ+ḍasnyi bsgrubs nas skye bo mang po dbang du byed pa grub thob tu grags pa de/ lta stangs kyis tshar bcad de/ de yang mthar bcom brlag gi grong khyer du slob dpon dpon slob gsum tsam phebs pa zhig la/ mu kun+da warti 'khor dang bcas pa yang der 'ongs pa 'dzom/ grong khyer gyi skye bo dpag tu med pa yang der 'tshogs te/'di gnyis kyi grub rtags blta'o zhes zer ro/ /der mu kun+da de mig 'phrul gyi rig sngags grub pa yin pas/ sngar stag gzig gi rgyal po chen po ha me hu bā tsa —400—

pa dang / de'i bu a ka pa ra sogs kyang dad par byas pa zhig yin/ dus der slob dpon gyi ting nge 'dzin gyi nus pas/ mig 'phrul gcig kyang sprul ma nus shing / slob dpon gyis 'di la lta stangs mdzad ma thag spyo nas ha ha zhes rgyug cing / zhag bdun du ma sangs/ de'i slob ma rnams kyis slob dpon la gsol pa btab pas slar gsos so/ /bhaX dwaX gyi rgyal po snga ma ni dus der 'das/de'i bu stobs bzang po zhes bya bas/ sngar pha dang thog mar mjal ba'i gnas de dang nye ba na slob dpon nyid yang dang yang du bzhugs pa'i phug pa zhig yod pa de'i sgor lha khang chen po bzhengs te phul/ lha 'bangs kyi khyim lnga brgya yang phul/ rnal 'byor pho mo mchog tu gyur pa lnga stong tsam 'dus pa'i dus shig byung bas/ de rnams la zla ba gsum du tshogs kyi 'khor lo mdzad pa'i yo byad rgyal pos phul te tshogs kyi 'khor lo rgya chen bskor/ slob ma rnams sems rgyud grol ba yang 'di dus kho na mang ba byung / de'i byin rlabs kyis rgyal po de la mnga' zhabs sngon grong 'bum tsam yin pa la/ da ltar 'bum phrag bzhi bcu rtsa lnga'i bdag por song / gu ru lto phyogs pa'i zhal snga nas kyang / lan lnga mjal ba'i rting ma 'di dus yin gsung / de nas phal cher gnas 'di nyid du bzhugs/'gro ba dpag tu med pa smin cing grol bar mdzad nas/ de rjes slob ma rnying pa mchog rnams ma gtogs mi mjal bar lo bdun tsam song ba na rnam smin gyi sku 'ja' tshon ltar yal te/ ye shes kyi sku mkha' khyab tu bzhugs par gyur to/spyir rgya bod gnyis mi 'dra ste/ bod na ni dpyod ldan rnams kyang bskyed rdzogs sam lta ba'i rtogs pa bzang tsam yod pa dang / nyams ban bun shar ba dang /—401—

yi dam chos skyong ci rigs zhal mthong ba dang / rdzu 'phrul dang mngon shes ci rigs shar ba dang / las tshogs dang nus mthu than thun thob pa tsam la grub thob tu ming 'dogs la/ blun po rnams kyis ni khrel dang tshul lugs btang ba'i zog po 'gal/ spyin 'bras kyi dbang thang che ba tsam la'ang grub rtags su 'dzin cing / grub thob yin ces zer la/ rgya gar na ni rgyud nas gsungs pa'i 'phags lam gyi sa thob pa'i yon tan mngon du gyur pa'am/ lus 'ja' lus su gyur pa sogs thun mong gi rig 'dzin tshad ldan cig thob na grub thob tu 'dzin gya/gzhan ni ji tsam bzang yang sgrub pa po zhes pa las grub thob ces mi zer ro/ /slob dpon chen po 'di ni lta stangs dang / ji tsam gsungs pa thams cad 'grub par 'gyur ba'i tshig kho nas 'phrin las rnam bzhi sgrub par mdzad/ cung zad dag pa'i 'khor gyi dbus su ngo mtshar ba'i ltas rgyun mi 'chad par 'byung /tshogs kyi 'khor lo gong bu dang khu ba dang chang dang khrag dang nags tshal gyi shing tog la sogs pa dngos su dgug par mdzad/ sa steng gi 'dren pa gcig pu par gyur pas/ mtshan yang shrī sa twa nā tha ste/ dpal sems can gyi mgon po zhes che ba'i tshig tu skye bo rnams brjod par byed do/ /rje btsun de nyid la kho bo'i bla ma rgya gar ba gsum car gyis chos gsan cing / gu ru lho phyogs pa ni chos kyi sras mchog tu gyur pa'ang yin mod kya/ 'on kyang bla ma gsum kas zhal lung rgyas pa rnams bla ma chen po nyid la gsan/ slob dpon gaX bhi ra ma ti dang / rnal 'byor ma'i dbang phyug ma chen mo dī na ka ra gnyis la dbang dang byin rlabs dang bshad pa mang du gsan 'dug dogs pa gcod pa ni slob ma'i gtso bo bcu —402—

tsam la mdzad par snang mod kya/ slob ma'i gtso bo rnam pa gnyis po de'i rnam thar mdor bsdus brjod na/ dang po na/ yul gu dzi ra tha zhes bya ba na/ rgyal rigs kyi bu gha gha zhes bya ba zhig blo shin tu rno bar gyur nas/ sgra dang rtog ge yan lag dang bcas pa la mkhas par gyur/ a bha 'a gtsug lag khang du rab tu byung / ming gaX lhir ma tir btags/ sde snod gsum gyi tshul yang mang du shes/'on kyang lo tshigs ma rdzogs pas rten ni dge tshul yin/ dgung lo bcu dgu pa la slob dpon gyi drung du bsnyen/ lo gsum du dbang dang gdams ngag ni ma gnang / bla ma bsten tshul ni rgyud dang mthun par mdzad/ de nas bla mas dbang bskur zhing gdams pa gnang / lo gnyis nas bskyed pa'i rim pa la brtan pa thob/ rdzogs pa'i rim pa'i ye shes kyang ci rigs pa skyes/ slob dpon nyid kyi rnyed bkur bya ba'i phyir du rkang mgyogs kyi dngos grub bsgrubs pas 'phral du grub/ bla ma bsten tshul mkhas pas slob dpon gyi dbang rgyud gdams ngag thams cad thob/ thog mar spyan ras gzigs dang rta mgrin zhal gzigs/ de nas 'jam dpal dang gshin rje gshed/ de nas dges pa rdo rje dang ku ru kul+le zhal gzigs/ nag po chen po rtag tu bran bzhin du byed/ 'jig rten pa'i lha mo drug gis bka' thams cad sgrub pa yin/ mnal thams cad 'od gsal du tshud/mngon par shes pa rgya chen po mnga' yang / bla ma'i rim gro sgrub pa'i bran mdzad pa yin no/ /rnal 'byor ma dī na ka ra na/ lho phyogs kyi grong khyer shaX bha da ta zhes bya ba zhig na/ pi si la'i rigs rgyal po gzhon nu 'phrog byed 'od ces bya ba zhig yod/ de la sring mo chung ngu nas blo rno zhing dge ba la dga' ba zhig yod pa/—403—

lo dgu lon pa'i dus shig na/ sgo drung du dge slong mdzes pa gzi brjid che ba zhig byung / de la bsod snyoms skyel du phyin/ der khyed mi bzang bzang 'dra ba zhig bsod snyoms spyod pa 'di sdug bsngal byas pas/ de na re/ nga ni mi sdug na khyod nyid sdug bsngal te/ 'khor ba ru 'byams 'dug pa gsung nas/ 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs mang du gsungs/ de las thar ba'i thabs cig zhu byas pas/sems kyi bzhag thabs dang / byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa'i gnad khyad par can bslabs pas/ des kyang legs par shes/ lo bcu lon pa'i dus su yul tsi ba lar rgyal rigs rgyal phran zhig la bag mar btang / lo bcu gsum lon pa'i dus su/ 'khor ba la yid nges par 'byung ste/ khyim thab dang gyos sgyug sogs la/ kho mo nags tshal rnams su ting nge 'dzin bsgom pa zhig byung na ci ma rung / khyed rnams kyis gnang ba mdzod ces yang yang smras pas/ de bzlog pa'i phyir du khyim gyi bdag mor bskos/ slong ba po ci byung pa thams cad la spyin pa rgya cher btang bas/ nang mi dang gnyen tshan rnams kyis smod/ slong mo ba dang skye bo rnams ni bstod pa zhig byung / de nas dus gzhan zhig na smyo rdzu btab/ spyod pa sna tshogs pa byas pas/ der g.yog mo zhig dang lhan cig dben pa zhig tu ba 'ag snga ma las kyang smyo ba che che ltar rdzus pas/ khyim thab dang bral/ de yang sngon btsas pa'i tshe/ 'di'i rkang lag la pad+ma dang 'khor lo phyed phyed kyis mtshan pa 'dug pas nags su gnas na ni bdag nyid chen mor 'gyur zhes lung bstan pa ltar thog tu babs pa yin gsung / tsi ba la dang nye ba ma ra ha zhi'i grong khyer zhig na/ slob dpon chen po zhi ba sbas pa bzhugs pa thos nas/ mtshan thos pa —404—

tsam gyis ting nge 'dzin skye ba snyam byung / zhal mthong ma thag ting nge 'dzin khyad par can skyes/ dus de'i tshe na lo nyi shu tsam lon pa yin skad/ bud med yin yang blo ni shin tu rno ste/ de gong du tsan+t+ra byā ka ra ṇa yongs su rdzogs pa shes/mngon brjod dang / sman dpyad dang / rtog ge yang ci rigs pa mkhyen/ sngon gyi bag chags kyis shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bdun brgya pa dang / sum brgya pa dang / bsdud pa'i tshigs su bcad pa rnams bklags pa tsam gyis zin/ dge slong ma dang / dge bsnyen ma 'dra la dris pas don yang legs par shes/ de nas slob dpon chen po zhi ba'i zhal snga nas la thog mar byang chub tu sems bskyed pa la sogs pa zhus shing / skal ba dang ldan par mkhyen nas/ rim gyis dbang bskur ba dang gdams pa mtha' dag gnang / slob dpon gyi drung du lo bdun du rdo rje theg pa la thos sgom gcig car byas pas/ rgyud thams cad kyi don legs par mkhyen/ de nas lo lnga'i bar du bla ma'i rim gro dang sgom pa rtse gcig tu byas pas/ ye shes khyad par can skyes te/ rtogs pa nam mkha' dang mnyam par gyur/ rlung gi rnal 'byor gyi nus pas/ glang po che brgyas kyang stobs 'gran du med pa dang / dpag tshad tsam du nam mkha' la 'gro bar byed/ lta stangs dang ngag gi bden pa yang grub/ der bla ma'i zhal nas/ da ni khyod rig brtul gyi spyod pa gyis shig de kho na nyid kyi rtogs pa yang sems can la ston cig deng nas lo nyi shu rtsa gnyis 'das pa na nga dang mnyam par 'gyur ro/ /zhes lung bstan skad/ zla ba drug tu spyod pa spyad pas/ thun mong gi dngos grub brgyad la sogs pa thams cad nyams 'og tu chud/ drung du byung ba thams cad la —405—

gdams ngag bstan/ rtogs pa mchog tu gyur pa'i rnal 'byor ma lnga brgya'i 'khor dang bcas nas/ yul sna tshogs su 'gro ba'i don spyod cing / slob dpon gyi drung du mchod pa'i phyir dang / rtogs pa'i tshad 'bul bar yang dang yang du 'byon par gnang gsung / lan cig rdzu 'phrul gyis kha gen dra nas/ rang ga nā tha zhes bya ba'i gnas su byon/ de na phyin na nga gnyis ka'i gnas yod pa la/de'i phyi rol pa'i gnas rnams su yang ngang yang du 'khyams pa ltar mdzad/ de nas dzaX gha ma dbang phyug chen po dang / dzhai ra ba grub par grags pa lta stangs dang khu tshur gyi rig pa grub pas/ sangs rgyas pa'i rnal 'byor pa rnams la bar du gcod pa zhig yod/ ming ni bhiX ga de ba zer/ des rnal 'byor ma la lta stangs byas pas ma gnod/ rnal 'byor mas de la lta stangs byas pas/ sa la 'gyel te dbugs 'gyu ba chad/ der ring zhig bzhag pas / gnas de'i mu stegs pa rnams kyis yang yang gsol ba 'debs par byung bas/ slar yang lta stangs kyis gsos/ de yang sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la dad/ rjes su 'dzin pa zhus pas/slob dpon gyi drung du brdzangs/ yang 'dis dam tshig nyams pa'i rnal 'byor pa gha ma la warma zhes bya ba/ sngon nus pa cung zad thob pas grub thob tu rdzu ba zhig dang / o ḍi sher 'phrad/ lta stangs mdzad pas gsus pa brdol te khrag zags/des thod par bzed pas de yang brdol/ de ltar dam tshig nyams pa tshar bcad gsung / dpal he ru ka dang / khro bo bcu/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sum cu rtsa bdun la sogs pa thams cad nam blta 'dod pa'i tshe zhal gzigs/ 'on kyang de skabs mchog gi dngos grub ni ma thob par grags/ de ltar slob dpon zhi ba 406—

sbas pa/ slob ma'i mchog gnyis dang bcas pas kho bo'i bla ma gsum la legs par gdams/ de la kho bos rdo rje theg pa lam man ngag go babs dang bcas pa'i bka' drin thob pa yin no/ /spyir rgya gar du gsang sngags la rig pa 'dzin pa 'bum phrag thog mar byung / de nas dpal sa ra ha byon pa nas gzung / rgyal po dharma pā la 'das pa'i bar du/ grub thob rgyun ma chad par ma zad grub thob mang po dus gcig tu bzhugs pa byung ba yin/ de nas a bha yā ka ra sku 'das bar la'ang / grub thob rgyun ma chad par byung la/ de man chad du res 'ga' na lan re re las ma byung / khyad par dus phyis grub thob gzhan med par yun ring rab zhig na/ ye shes bshes gnyen dang / o ka ra nā tha byon kyang sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la phan che ba tsam ma byung / o ka ra sku 'das nas/ lo brgyad cu lon tsa na grub chen zhi ba sbas pas grub pa brnyes te/ dus kyi dbang las sangs rgyas pa mang nyung gis gzhan phan che chung ma gtogs jo bo na ro pa chen po dang gzhan phan che chung 'dra ba/ go 'phangs slob dpon 'di mtho ba yin no/ /rin po che'i 'byung khungs lta bu'i gtam las/ bka' babs thams cad gcig tu 'dres pa'i gtam gyi skabs te dgu pa'o// //bka' babs bdun po de dag ni dngos su byin gyis brlabs pa'i brgyud pa 'ba' zhig yin cing / de'i nang gi yang drug po de dag ni don gyi brgyud pa kho na lags/ gdams ngag phra mo re re zhing gi bla ma brgyud pa mi 'dra ba rnams ni brgyud pa'i yi ge las shes par bya zhing / rnam par thar pa mtha' yas pa ni yi ger 'bri bar ga la lang / rgyud pa'i bla ma 'ga' zhig gi rnam par thar —407—

pa ni mi gsung bas re zhig de tsam yin no/ /'dir da lta rgya gar du grags pa'i lo rgyus gang thos pa rnams kyi steng du sngon gyi slob dpon gyi lo rgyus bod na yod pa'ang yid ches nges pa rnams kyis cung zad kha bskang nas bshad pa yin no/ /spyir rgya gar du byon pa'i shing rta r+pā po rnams dang / brgyud pa'i rnam thar ci rigs pa da dung g.yin du bshad par bya'o/ /bla ma'i rnam thar brjod pa las/ /bsod nams cung zad gang thob pa/ /des ni 'gro ba ma lus pa'ang /de 'dra'i tshul gyis sangs rgyas gyur/ /bdag kyang skye ba thams cad du/ /brgyud ldan bla ma thams cad kya/ /bran dang bran du skye ba dang / /thugs kyi gsang ba 'dzin par shog /ngo mtshar bka' babs bdun ldan rdo rje 'chang gi lam/ /phyogs kun skye bo rnams kyi nyer spyod rgya chen dang / man ngag rin chen gyis gang bdag sems shing rta ya/ /bgrod byar gyur te srid gsum dbul ba sel bar shog /ces bka' babs bdun ldan gyi brgyud pa'i rnam thar ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba rin po che'i 'byung khungs lta bu'i gtam zhes bya ba/ rje btsun bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka'i 'bangs kyi tha chung du gyur pa tā ra nā tha zhes bya bas rang lo nyer drug pa la nye ba na/ grub pa'i gnas mchog dpal stag lung thang dang nye ba rnam rgyal rab brtan zhes bya bar legs par sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni blo ldan kun dga' rnam rgyal lo// //phyis kyang zhus dag cung zad byas pa'o// //dge legs 'phel/ /zhus dag /—408—
